Name What it is Alternate identity A false mortal life, with papers and a past. When hunters report this vampire, each dot is a 10% chance the trail ends at the false name and their raid comes without knowing whom to look for. A masked vampire also keeps passing as mortal to visitors for an hour a dot after sunrise. Domain Hunting grounds the Prince grants. Each dot claims one mortal town within 40 tiles of the sworn court, picked from the row's link. Hunting there never makes the town warier. A rival poaching it is a strike to answer. Herd A flock of mortals who feed this vampire willingly. Each season they send blood vials worth about 4% of its blood pool for each dot, a fifth of its upkeep at 5 dots: never enough to live on. Each dot also adds a die to its hunting rolls in towns. Retainers Mortal ghouls kept in the sworn court's town, one for each dot. Each counts as a string there that never fades and can be pulled as any string can. Each drinks a blood point a season, paid on its own from the vampire's pool. A retainer left unfed walks away, and the dot goes with it. Status Standing in the eyes of the sworn court. When the colony asks the court for a service on credit, the dots stand in for court rank: 1 or 2 for a trivial boon, 3 minor, 4 major, 5 a life boon. Each dot bought also raises every court member's regard for the colony by 2.

Name What it is Ahrimanes Gangrel women remade by a shaman's working into something that speaks with spirits. Their blood is dead: it makes no childer, no ghouls and no bonds. The line vanished in the 1990s. Anda Mongol warriors of the Gangrel blood who rode with the hordes and guarded their tribes. They can't stay put: a few days sleeping in one place and they begin to fail. None have been seen since the fall of the Khans. Angellis Ater Lasombra who learned the Baali's black arts and worship sin itself. Every Kindred who knows of them wants them gone. Assamite Assassins from the mountain fortress of Alamut, bound by an old curse that makes other Kindred's blood burn them. Assamite antitribu Assassins who broke from their clan rather than take the Tremere curse. They answer to Caine, not Haqim, and the taste of Kindred blood hooks them fast. Assamite sorcerers The Assamites' caste of blood mages, older than the Tremere and bent on breaking their curse. Magic has soaked into their blood so deep that the second sight picks them out easily. Assamite viziers The Assamites' scholars and advisors. Each one is obsessed with its own field of study, to the point of forgetting to eat or find shelter. Baali Infernalists who believe the world is doomed and work to hurry it along. Every other Kindred wants them destroyed. They can't bear holy things, and True Faith hurts them twice over. Blood Brothers Sabbat shock troops made by sorcery out of kidnapped mortals, stripped of their selves and given matching faces. A circle of them shares one mind and one pain. They can't make childer: an Embrace only kills. Brahman The Ravnos seers of India, with a gift of sight the other castes lack. They are especially fond of swindling through fortunes and seances. Brujah Rebels and firebrands, quick to anger and quicker to act. They argue for every cause and fight for most of them. Brujah antitribu The Sabbat's Brujah, as angry as the rest of the clan and proud of it. They take what they want and make sure everyone sees. Caitiff Vampires with no clan. Their blood carries no clan's gifts and no clan's curse, and no clan will claim them. Cappadocians The clan of death-scholars that the Giovanni swallowed whole in the fifteenth century. Pale as corpses, and paler with age. A few may still lie asleep somewhere the Giovanni never found. City Gangrel Sabbat Gangrel who took to the cities like coyotes. They blend in with their prey until they are close enough to bite. Country Gangrel Sabbat Gangrel of the wilds between cities. They scout and kill for the sect and hunt in packs, like wolves. Daitya An Indian line of the Followers of Set who see Set in Shiva the Destroyer. They corrupt the world to hurry it to its end. Daughters of Cacophony Singers, nearly all of them women, who hear music every moment of the night. Their songs can lift a crowd, drive a listener mad or speak in an ear miles away. The music in their heads makes them a little deaf to everything else. Dominate Malkavians Malkavians who kept Dominate when the rest of the clan caught Dementation. Their madness is quieter and colder than most. Followers of Set Priests of a dark god who deal in vice and secrets. The sun hates them more than most, and bright light dazzles them. Gangrel Loners and wanderers, closer to the Beast than other Kindred. Animals accept them, and each frenzy leaves its mark. Gargoyles Grey, winged things made by the Tremere out of other Kindred to be guards and slaves. Many have broken free and joined the Camarilla. None can pass for human, and their minds were made to obey. Giovanni A Venetian family of merchants and necromancers who Embrace their own relatives. Their bite brings agony instead of pleasure. Harbingers of Skulls Shrunken, grinning corpses who say they were dead for five hundred years. All of them are elders, all of them are Sabbat, and they know the dead better than the Giovanni do. Kiasyd Tall, pale scholars of the Lasombra line, with pupilless eyes and skin that glows under the moon. Their blood carries something of the fae, which gives them fae tricks and makes cold iron burn them. Lamia The Cappadocians' guardians, women devoted to the Dark Mother, who died defending their masters from the Giovanni. Their bite carries a plague. Lasombra Proud masters of shadow who cast no reflection. Born to lead, or so they tell everyone. Lasombra antitribu Lasombra who never joined the Sabbat, or left it. The sect hunts them hard, and nobody outside it knows quite why. Lhiannan Pagan witches of the British forests, each carrying a shard of an old forest spirit. They are bound to their own woods and grow uneasy away from them, and mortals feel there is something wrong about them. The Inquisition burned the last of them, or so it is said. Malkavian Every one of them is mad, and some see more clearly for it. Their warnings make sense afterwards, mostly. Malkavian antitribu The Sabbat's madmen, madder than the Camarilla's. Whatever they want, it seems to include everyone else going mad too. Mariners Gangrel who live in the deep sea and come up at night to feed. On land they are much like any other Gangrel, if quieter. Nagaraja Flesh-eating necromancers, nearly hunted out of existence. They have jagged teeth in place of fangs, need flesh as well as blood, and tear it with every feeding. Noiad Gangrel shamans of the far north who read the will of the gods in the northern lights and guarded their tribe jealously. They can't feed on animals at all. Nosferatu Twisted into monsters by the Embrace. They live hidden, trade in secrets and hear everything first. Nosferatu antitribu Sabbat Nosferatu, as hideous as their cousins and as good with secrets. They have little need to prove they are monsters. Old Clan Tzimisce Tzimisce who think fleshcrafting is a sickness of the soul and refuse it. They rule their lands in the old way and never share blood with the Sabbat. Panders The Sabbat's clanless. They die first in every war the sect fights, and the sect respects them for it. Phuri Dae Ravnos seers who travelled with the Roma through Europe. They are the Brahman by another name. Ravnos Wanderers, tricksters and illusionists, each in the grip of one vice they can rarely refuse. Ravnos antitribu Ravnos who left their elders for the freedom of the Sabbat. Scouts and con artists for the nomad packs, with the clan's vices intact. Salubri Healers with a third eye, hunted since the Tremere drank their founder. Only a handful are left, seeking Golconda, and taking blood from the unwilling costs them dearly. Salubri antitribu The warrior Salubri, back in the Sabbat and out for Camarilla blood, the Tremere's first of all. Blood only feeds them when they take it by force. Samedi Walking corpses from the Caribbean who work as killers for hire. Their flesh rots and sloughs and grows back, and they smell like it. Serpents of the Light Setites who stopped worshipping Set and found the Sabbat in Haiti. Their methods are the clan's, and so is their trouble with light. Telyavelic Tremere Tremere who went to pagan Lithuania, were taken for gods of the dead and came to believe it. Christian faith frightens them as it did their flock. The clan says they were wiped out in the sixteenth century. Tlacique Jaguar mystics of old Mexico who claim descent from Tezcatlipoca. Only their weakness to light shows they are Setites at all. Toreador Artists and patrons who chase beauty, sometimes to the point of losing themselves in it. Toreador antitribu The Sabbat's artists, who wrote much of its ritual. Their love of beauty has turned into a taste for pain, and the chance to hurt someone is hard for them to pass up. Tremere Wizards who stole immortality and made blood magic of it. They answer to a strict pyramid of elders and bond to them more easily than other Kindred. Tremere antitribu Tremere who went over to the Sabbat and were marked as traitors. One night every one of them burned. Only those asleep somewhere far away might be left. True Brujah Cold, patient scholars who say they are the real heirs of Brujah, robbed by Troile. They feel less with every year, and time itself bends for them. Tzimisce Old lords of the eastern mountains and masters of flesh. They must sleep near earth from home or lose themselves night by night. Tzimisce kolduns Tzimisce sorcerers of the old faith, who draw on the living land itself and work it into a weapon. Some keep Vicissitude, some scorn it for Dominate. Ventrue Rulers by habit and by right, or so they say. Each can feed on only one kind of mortal. Ventrue antitribu Ventrue who think their clan sold out to the merchants. They want to be Caine's knights again, and they mean it. Warrior Setites Setites who serve their god as warriors. Members are trained into the line, and their childer are ordinary Followers of Set. Wu Zao Descendants of Saulot's two childer in China, scholars of the occult. Each has a subject it can't leave alone: a book or a strange relic can draw it off whatever it is doing.

Name What it is Armor of the Abyss Shadow closes around the body and hardens, without weighing it down. Baal's Sight The sorcerer's eyes stay open to what walks without a body. The sorcerer caste's own: it sharpens sight for good. Bagman's Shelter Shadow thickens around the sleeper. For a day sunlight does half its damage. Beneath Contempt Nobody thinks the vampire worth noticing, for as long as it takes to walk away. Bestial Presence Something huge broods behind the vampire. Every outsider nearby feels it. Birth the Vozhd Twenty blood remakes one of the colony's own into a war-beast for good. Bliss Fall into a trance before beauty and come back steadied, with the world a little easier to bear. Blood Sight Taste what a pawn's blood is, and whose. Blood Thorns Spit a hardened spine of blood at someone within eight cells. The wound is aggravated. Body Armory Grow blades out of bone and flesh. Burning Wrath Bare hands burn with Rage for the fight, and what they tear doesn't mend the easy way. Carriage Horses Three of the vampire's wounds pass to a colony animal, which takes them instead. Chain of Slavery Follow someone's blood bonds to whoever holds them. Chaining the Beast Always on: mental powers can reach a vampire in frenzy or Rotschreck. Claw Immunity The hide turns teeth and claws for the rest of the scene. Cloak the Beast Always on: aura reading finds nothing to read. Command from Afar A word in the mind of anyone of the colony's, anywhere on the map, keeps them steady. Command the Wary Beast One look, and the hostile animals around the target break and run. Creepy Clown Coat Wear whatever the target fears the most, and watch them go. Days of Passions Past Read an aura for what it has been feeling, not only what it feels. Denial of Aphrodite's Kiss Always on: the first three dots of Presence fail against it from any vampire of higher Generation. Devil's Mark Mark a colonist's skin with Presence, so that all who see them are swayed. Divine Aura Until dawn, whoever tries to read this vampire's aura may fall entranced. Do As I Say, Not As I Say A muddled order sends the target wandering off with no idea what it is doing. Doubletalk Always on: speaks a second meaning under the first, which makes every negotiation go better. Draught of the Soul At diablerie, three Willpower and a Willpower roll drink down what the victim knew, for a quarter of its experience on top of the usual. Ears of the Bat Great ears for a while. Hearing is everything, and strangers are put off. Empower Minion Lend Potence to a thrall of the colony. Esprit de Corps Everyone of the vampire's own nearby stands firmer against fear and breaks far less easily. Eventide Strength Always on: illusions last three times as long. Eyes of a Thousand Shades Ghosts crowd close around the necromancer for an hour. Necromancy rolls gain two dice. Eyes of Alamut Read the aura of anyone on the map, in sight or not. Eyes of Blades For a few moments every blow can be seen and turned aside. Fear of the Dark Shadows move at the edge of sight, and the target and those around them run. Flaying Touch A touch strips the skin away. Aggravated, at arm's length. Flesh Wound Injuries stop showing, and the vampire goes on as if they had never landed. Forbidden Zone Mark out a place. For hours, outsiders who enter are slowed by dread. Forced March Cover ground for hours at a pace nothing mortal could hold, for a fraction of Celerity's price. Haunted Place Five blood soaked into the ground leaves a place wrong for fifteen days. Outsiders hate every moment there. Haunting Seduction Whisper something, and the victim sees the vampire everywhere and can think of nothing else. Heart's Desire Show someone what they want the most, and they will stand and stare. Honeyed Words Hear what a listener wants and say it, and everyone is easier to talk round for the rest of the scene. I Know A look that says the vampire knows. The target loses its nerve for the fight. Ignore Me The target loses all interest in the vampire and in the fight. Impeccable Manners Never a wrong word: talk and trade go easier for a while. Iron Heart Always on: powers that work on the mind find the vampire two Willpower harder to move, and pain matters less. King of the Beasts Animals called with Beckoning arrive tougher than they left. Always on. Leaps and Bounds Clear walls and gaps in one bound, up to twelve cells. Malkav's Pavlovian Response Plant a feeling in a word. For a day, the target's nerves are never quite steady. Mind Strike Meet someone's gaze and hit them from the inside. Mover and Shaker Always on: the vampire knows everybody, and everybody thinks it's a friend. Power Animal Lend Potence to a colony animal. Pulse of Undeath Size up a stranger: how much Celerity, Potence and Fortitude they carry. Rando The target keeps seeing someone else: a face it trusts, whoever is standing there. Reluctant Performance Artist A mortal stops whatever it was doing and stands there, helpless, for all to see. Rescue Beacon Always on: when the vampire falls into torpor, the colony hears it at once and knows where. Retaliatory Terror Always on: a blood point when struck in melee, and the attacker may flee. Scalpel Tongue One barbed remark and the target has nothing to say for a while. Scourge of Alecto Chain the Beast and set it loose inside someone else. It hurts them from within, and a vampire must fight off frenzy. Screams Made Real Pull the worst thing out of someone's head and show it to them. A mind can stay broken after that. See the Reflected Form See what a pawn really is, whatever shape it wears. Shadow Feint Slip half out of the eye for a moment, so attacks land where the assassin no longer is. Shadow Mark Step through the Abyss to any of the colony's own, anywhere on the map. Sharing the Master's Vigor Lend one of the colony's own, living or dead, some of the master's strength. Shatterproof Body and stubbornness soak together for a few moments, against anything. Shroud of Absence A pocket of nothing closes around everyone of the vampire's own within three cells. Soul Decoration Three Willpower, and a colonist's aura is remade. Nobody can read it for a week. Soul Painting Paint what someone is. A vampire's Path and Virtues, a mortal's state of mind. Spirit Tracking Catch the scent of the undead: names every vampire on the map. Sympathetic Agony Every hurt the target takes for the next hour feels far worse. Telepathic Command An order given in the mind, with no word spoken and no eyes to meet. Thaumaturgical Sight See the magic worked on a pawn, as Aura Perception sees a mood. The False Drink Always on: a good chance to hold blood in the throat and never let the bond take hold. Theft of Will Pull a running Discipline effect off a target and take it for the rest of its time. True Love's Face The target sees someone they love and won't raise a hand against them. Typhonic Beast Take the shape of Set's own beast: stronger, tougher and faster, with claws to match. Under the Skin Read a target's aura for a day's advantage, the way Aura Perception does. Waking Dream Believe in an illusory bridge or rope long enough to cross it. Once a day. Weigh the Heart Lay bare what someone lives by: a vampire's Path and Virtues, a mortal's state of mind. Wolf in Sheep's Clothing Hide a colony animal from every eye. Wound Sculpting Mould three wounds shut with bare hands, on any of the colony's own. Ze Monkey's Paw A cursed gift: the target's luck turns into bruises and broken bones.

Name What it is Conjured blizzard Hard snow called up by blood magic. It will stop when the spell runs out. Conjured fog Fog called up by blood magic. It will lift when the spell runs out. Conjured gale A gale called up by blood magic. It will drop when the spell runs out. Conjured rain Rain called up by blood magic. It will stop when the spell runs out. Conjured snow Snow called up by blood magic. It will stop when the spell runs out. Conjured storm A thunderstorm called up by blood magic. It will pass when the spell runs out.

Name What it is Animalism Kinship with the Beast in every creature: speaking to animals, calling them, and later quieting or unleashing the Beast in people. At 6, animal blood goes twice as far. Ash Path Looking into the land of the dead, speaking with its ghosts, touching them, and stepping into it bodily. Auspex Senses beyond the human: sharper sight and hearing, reading auras and objects, and in time leaving the body behind. At 6, the vampire reads a conversation before it happens. Awakening of the Steel The Assamite sorcerers' path of the sword: reading a blade's history, a grip nothing breaks, strikes that ruin armour, parrying arrows and bullets, and a blow that strips a foe of everything unnatural. Every power needs a blade in hand. Bardo The Children of Osiris' discipline of denial: lost Humanity won back, sorcery turned aside, animal blood made enough, a pillar to meditate at, and riddles that show a listener how small it is. A dot is lost whenever Humanity falls below it. Bone Path Power over corpses: making them twitch, setting them to work, raising them to fight, and pulling souls out of the living. Celerity Speed the eye can't follow. The vampire moves and strikes faster, and can burn blood to blur for a moment. Cenotaph Path Sensing the ties between the living and the dead: a ghost's touch, its fetters, places near the lands of the dead, the pull of each new death, and fetters made by hand. Death Knell, the fourth dot, is always on. Chimerstry The Ravnos art of illusion: figures that aren't there, walls and guns made of nothing, phantom beasts, illusions that last, and pain that is all in the mind. Corpse in the Monster The dead body inside the vampire: a corpse's face, a corpse's numbness, the curse of life laid on another, a corpse's immunity to what kills vampires, and a day of near-life. Daimoinon The Baali's black arts: finding where a soul is weak, turning its fears on it, cold black hellfire, a fight with one's own demon, and curses. At 6 a devil's bargain makes the vampire proof against fire. Dementation The madness of the Malkavians, passed on to others: feelings stirred or dulled, phantoms, glimpses of hidden patterns, and minds broken outright. Dominate One look, and another mind bends to the vampire's will Elemental Mastery Command of lifeless things: the strength of stone, talk with objects, weapons that turn on their owners, the shape of a statue, and spirits of fire, air, earth and water. Flight The Gargoyles' wings. Each dot carries them farther in one flight, and from the second they are quicker on the ground too. Fortitude The dead body refuses to break. Wounds land lighter, and even sunlight and fire bite less deep. Grave's Decay The rot that takes all flesh but a vampire's, turned on anything: corpses to dust, the stiffness of death, withered limbs, a plague of the undead, and vampire flesh to ash. Green Path Command of plants, living and dead: asking them what they have seen, quickening growth or rot, vines that seize, a shelter of branches, and trees that walk. Hands of Destruction Rot, warp and wither: decaying objects, twisting wood, acid on the hands, shrivelled limbs and years of age in a moment. Lure of Flames Fire called out of nothing, from a candle flame to a roaring blaze. Once it catches, it burns Kindred like any other fire, the caster included. Melpominee The Daughters of Cacophony's power of the voice Movement of the Mind Moving things by will alone: small objects first, then doors and weapons, then people and the thaumaturge itself, then heavy things hurled like missiles and blades left to guard the haven. Mytherceria The Kiasyd's fae-like powers: lies laid bare, hidden purposes seen, memories drawn out of objects, sigils that leave a mind lost, and riddles that hold it fast. Neptune's Might Command of standing water: seeing what it has seen, binding with it, turning blood to it, raising it as a wall, and drawing it out of a body. Obeah The Salubri gift of healing: reading the body by touch, easing pain, closing wounds, a ring no enemy may cross, and minds set right again. It opens a third eye in the forehead. Obfuscate Hiding in plain sight, the art of the Nosferatu and the Malkavians Obtenebration Command of shadow, the Lasombra's gift: shadows that shield, darkness that blinds, tentacles from the abyss, and at last a body made of night. Ogham The Lhiannan's blood magic, worked through runes drawn in vitae: woods that fight for them, war spirits in the skin, curses, the blessings of moon and sun, and the life of the earth drunk dry. Weaker away from home. Path of Blood The first path of Thaumaturgy, the blood's mastery of itself Path of Conjuring Making things out of nothing: simple things first, then lasting ones, then things with working parts, unmaking them again, and at last animals with no will of their own. Path of Corruption Slow twisting of a mind, never an order: turning a choice to its worse side, loosing buried vices, cooling every tie, making a need, and tying a soul to the caster's. Path of Mars Blood magic for war: a scream against fear, blows that can't miss, a dance out of every strike, the strength of a warrior, and all of it shared with comrades. Path of Technomancy Blood magic for machines: understanding them at a touch, burning them out, locking them to all but their owners, taking them over, and reaching any of them through the wires. Path of the Father's Vengeance Caine's own curses, spoken from the Book of Nod to a vampire: naming its bonds, ugliness, a diet of ash, pain in the light, and its stolen generations taken back. Path of the Four Humors The Lamia's art of the four humours held still in the undead body: nightmares whispered in, a poisoned bite, humours on the skin, a corpse's dead blood drunk, and a breath of despair. Potence Strength far past a living body's. Blows hit harder, loads weigh less, and doors give way. Presence The Blood's pull on every heart nearby Protean The body as clay for the Beast: eyes that see in the dark, claws, sinking into the earth, the shapes of wolf and bat, and mist. Quietus The assassin's art, the Assamite's gift: silence, poisoned blood, burst veins and caustic spittle. Sanguinus The Blood Brothers' shared flesh: blood spent to heal a brother anywhere, limbs passed between bodies, one mind across the circle, its generation pooled, and at last one great merged horror. Sepulchre Path The necromancer's first path: seeing the dead and calling them back Serpentis The serpent's gifts of the Followers of Set: a paralysing gaze, a forked tongue that drinks, scales, the cobra's shape, and a heart cut out and hidden. Spiritus The Ahrimanes' bond with the spirit world: things made to work better, animal spirits called into flesh, an animal's gift for a moment, spirits devoured for strength of will, and a cat-like hunting shape. Temporis The True Brujah's hold on time: a perfect sense of it, minds caught in a loop, a foe slowed to a crawl, fire frozen still, and moments stretched for the vampire alone. Thanatosis The Samedi's art of dead flesh: folds of skin that hide things, a rotting touch, a body that crumbles to ash and back, limbs shrivelled at a touch. At 7 the ash of Ashes to Ashes can drift. Valeren The warrior Salubri's Discipline: the healer's touch turned to judging how close to death a foe is, then pain, a halo of red armour and a blow that can't miss. Vicissitude The Tzimisce art of flesh and bone: a face of clay, bodies reshaped on the table, the zulo war-form, and at last a body of living blood. At 6 the vampire's blood turns to acid. Visceratika The Gargoyles' kinship with stone: skin that takes the colour of the walls, a sense of everyone inside a building, sleeping in rock, a hide like granite, and passing through stone itself. Vitreous Path The Nagaraja's command of entropy: reading the marks of death, an aura that ruins things, feeding on the dead, death breathed into the living, and a cry heard on both sides of the grave. Way of Earth The koldun's command of soil and stone: earth that grips and swallows, skin of stone, the ground's healing, and quakes. Way of Fire The koldun's command of fire and molten rock. The first dot takes the fear off fire, a little more with every dot. Then come flames out of the air, walls and floods of magma, and blasts of dry heat. Way of Water The koldun's command of water: illusions on its surface, sleep under it, gliding over it, servants raised from it, and whirlpools. Way of Wind The koldun's command of the air: words carried on the wind, freezing and drowsy winds, flight on the gale, and storms. Weather Control Command of the sky over the land around: fog, rain, a gale, a storm, and lightning brought down where the caster wants it.

Name What it is Barons' summit The Barons meet for a rant and a vote on the Movement's next cause. Blood Bath The candidates for a Bishop's seat boast and fight; the winner bathes in the blood of every guest. Brujah rant The Brujah of the region debate, brawl and pick a cause. Conclave A Justicar calls a Conclave at the colony: three nights, a trial and the grievances of the courts. Gangrel convocation Gangrel gather in the open for a shared hunt and tales by the fire. Inner Circle's envoys Envoys of the Inner Circle judge the colony room by room, then grant one audience. Lasombra court of judgment A Lasombra stands accused before the clan, and the colony's vampire is asked to judge. Movement rant Anarchs from every free city come for speeches, fist fights and a vote on revolt. Palla Grande The Sabbat's great masked ball, held only in the last days of fall: a danse macabre, then the host's gifts to the fire. Primogen gathering The Primogen of the region's courts meet at the colony for two nights of speeches and one quarrel to settle. Toreador salon The Toreador walk the colony looking at its art, then a colonist performs. Ventrue oath-taking A vassal kneels to its liege between two lines of Ventrue, with the colony as host and witness. War party Pack leaders gather for a war council and the Vaulderie, then set out against the Camarilla.

Name What it is Schemer Wants boons and secrets. Pays in boons, a size bigger than the others. Scholar Wants texts, relics and rituals. Pays in lore texts. Traditionalist Wants the Traditions kept. Pays in standing at court and leave to Embrace. Trickster Wants the court upset. Pays in whatever it has to hand: silver, lore, arms. Tyrant Wants control: rivals' herds, ghouls and havens. Pays in silver, feeding rights and boons. Zealot Wants war on the enemy sect and on hunters. Pays in arms.

Name What it is Hierarchy of Wyrm Taint What is left of a Garou's self after the Embrace, and the Wyrm takes a little more of it with every sin. When it is gone, so is the Abomination. Humanity The human conscience the vampire brought with it from life, worn down a little by every sin. Path of Blood A code of the blood: other Kindred are to be converted or destroyed, and killing mortals for food is beneath a true follower. Path of Caine Vampires are the children of Caine and should live as what they are: apart from mortals, masters of the Beast, never denying their own hunger. Path of Cathari Followers indulge every appetite, let the Beast run with them, and kill only when passion takes them. Path of Ecstasy Pleasure taken past every mortal limit tears a hole in the world's lies. Followers of this Setite Path spread rapture, break taboos and treat holding back as the one real sin. Path of Entelechy A Brujah's stoic discipline, older than Carthage. The Beast is an enemy to be mastered by reason, the mind and body are there to be perfected, and mortals are not to be used for more than a meal. Path of Honorable Accord A knightly code of duty, loyalty and keeping one's word. Its followers stand their ground and never kill without reason. Path of Lilith Followers believe pain teaches, hunger most of all. They go hungry on purpose, fear nothing of death, and see every killing as a lesson cut short. Path of Metamorphosis The vampire is one stage in a longer change. Followers feed without delay, study the Beast by riding it, and care nothing for what others need. Path of Night Kindred are damned to be horrors whose work is to frighten. Followers kill sparingly, rely on no one and bow to no one. Path of Paradox Kindred have slipped out of the great cycle and must send others back into it. Followers kill only for need and guard their own bloodline. Path of Power and the Inner Voice Power is the only thing worth having. Followers own their acts, reward the useful, help no one for free and never accept defeat. Path of the Bones Death is the one subject worth studying. Its followers fear nothing about it, waste no chance to watch it, and never stand in its way. Path of the Feral Heart The vampire is a predator and should live like one: hunting with its own body, feeding when hungry, killing cleanly and never for sport. Path of the Warrior Set is a god of war and storms, and his chosen are weapons. Followers of this Setite Path train and hurt themselves until the Beast fears them, and every kill is a prayer. Path of Typhon Every vice is a tool for raising a sleeping god. Followers corrupt others, help their own and show no one any mercy.

Name What it is Acute Sense One sense is unusually sharp. A little better at shooting and spotting. Addiction Needs a drug it can only get through its vessels' blood. On edge most of the time. Addictive Blood Its blood is the perfect drug. Ambidextrous Uses either hand as well as the other. Hits a little more often in melee. Ancestral Soil Dependence Sleeps badly without soil from a homeland it has never seen. Anosmia Has no smell or taste left. Antitoxin Blood Immune to most drugs and poisons. Arcane Curse A magical curse, from its studies or someone else's. Aura of Command Born to give orders. Aura of the Typhon Something coils in its essence that draws Lupines. Bad Sight Sees poorly, near or far. Beacon of the Unholy Everyone devout can tell what it is. Bestial Closer to the animals than to people. Betrayer's Mark Loyal, but branded with the antitribu mark. Bigger Boys Came Knows whose name to drop when someone leans on it. Bioluminescence Can make its flesh glow. Blind Can't see. Blush of Health Still has the colour of the living. However low its Humanity falls, it never looks like a corpse. Bound to the Clan Fully blood bound to Clan Tremere. Brahmin A priest or teacher among the Ravnos. Broken Antitribu An Assamite who still bears the Tremere curse and has pledged to the Sabbat anyway. Bruiser Looks like trouble. Better at getting prisoners and mortals to do as they're told. Bulimia Blood makes it sick, and it needs blood. Bullyboy Known as muscle, and used to it. Call of the Sea At home with the tides. A little steadier. Calm Heart Slow to anger. Two more dice to resist frenzy. Cannibal Human meat brings it joy, for what that's worth. Catlike Balance Sure on its feet. Dodges a little more often. Chandala Of the lowest jati, and treated that way. Cloistered Has seen little outside the chantry. Code of Honor A personal code that holds up under pressure. Cold Breeze A chill follows it from room to room. Cold Read Learns more than it should from a first meeting. Coldly Logical Weighs things without feeling. Harder to shake. Common Sense Knows a bad idea when it hears one. Concentration Isn't distracted when it matters. Aims a little faster and works a little steadier. Connoisseur Reads character in a vessel's blood. Consanguineous Resistance No one of its own Giovanni blood can bind it. Consumption Something inside is eating it. Contagious Full of noxious spores that sicken mortals near it. Controllable Night Sight Sees through the deepest shadow. Court Favorite Knows how to tip a Court of Blood. Critters Animals want to be its friend. Daredevil Takes wild chances and gets away with them. Hits harder and dodges more, though a rough fight hurts more too. Dark Fate It knows it will end badly, and soon. Dead Inside Feels nothing but pain and numbness. Deaf Can't hear anything. Deathsight Sees rot and death in everything. Deceptive Aura Its aura is bright and healthy, like a mortal's. Deep Sleeper Sleeps like the dead it is. Woken by day, it stays slow and heavy a step longer than others. Deformity A misshapen body that slows it and turns heads. Disease Carrier Carries sickness in its blood, and the people around it pay for it. Disfigured A disfigurement that nobody forgets. Distracting Aura Its aura is close to unreadable. Dracon's Temperament A whirlwind of moods that keeps it on its feet. Drug Resistance Years of vices have built a tolerance. Dulled Bite Weak fangs. Feeding tears at the vessel more than it should, and the bite does less in a fight. Dynamic Personality Mortals are drawn to it like groupies to a rock star. Early Riser Always up first: rises at dusk as if its Humanity were perfect. Eat Food Can sit down to a meal like a mortal without forcing it down. It still has to come back up later. Eerie Presence Mortals feel something wrong about it. Efficient Digestion Gets more out of blood than most: half again as much from every feeding. Eidetic Memory Remembers everything it sees and hears. Learns a fifth faster and forgets skills at half the speed. Embraced without the Cup The elders' blood had no hold on it. Enchanting Voice A voice people want to keep listening to. Enemy Brood Another brood of Nosferatu hunts it from one sanctuary to the next. Eyes of Shadow Meeting its eyes is like staring into the Abyss. Faceless Wakes with a new face every night. False Reflection Its Obfuscate fools cameras too. Fangless Never grew fangs. Flawed Reality Its illusions always have a tell. Flesh of the Corpse Dead flesh that stays dead. It takes damage like any corpse and looks like one. Forked Tongue A forked, flickering tongue, hard to hide. Former Ghoul Served a vampire before the Embrace and knows the world it joined. Foul Blood Its blood is so vile that even drinking it is a struggle. Friendly Face Has the kind of face people trust. Slightly better with people. Glowing Eyes Eyes that shine in the dark, for anyone to see. Grip of the Damned Its embrace is cold and terrible. Nobody wants it near. Guilt-Wracked Everything it has done weighs on it. Hard of Hearing Doesn't hear well. Harmless Nobody thinks it worth worrying about. Haunted A ghost won't leave it alone. Healing Touch Its bite closes without a trace, and its hands are gentle. Heart of Needles Too jaded by its own illusions to be moved. Heartless Its heart lies somewhere else, out of its hands. Hive-Minded Its Animalism reaches insects too. Huge Size Very large. Tougher and stronger, and easy to spot. Ignorance Its sire left it knowing nothing. Impatient Hates waiting. Impressive Restraint Hunger barely moves it near mortals. Inbred Generations of cousins marrying left their mark. Incoherent Can't speak so anyone understands. Indelible Tattoos and piercings stay after the Embrace. Infectious Madness passes in its bite. Infectious Bite Bites fester. The vampire's own wounds and its vessels are harder to keep clean. Infertile Vitae Something went wrong at the Embrace. Anyone it tries to Embrace simply dies. Its blood works for everything else. Inoffensive to Animals Animals don't mind it. Instrument of God Believes the Lord works through it, and acts like it. Insubordinate Does the opposite of what it's told, on principle. Introspection Understands its own mind better than most. Keys to the Library A chantry librarian with the run of its lore. King or Queen of Shadow Draws strength from what it still feels for the kine. Kshatriya A warrior or ruler among the Ravnos. Lame A bad leg. Walks slowly and fights badly on its feet. Laughingstock Nobody takes it seriously, or ever will. Lazy Does as little as it can get away with. Legerdemain Quick hands and card tricks. Lesser Mark of the Beast Keeps some say over how the Beast marks it. Light Sleeper Wakes by day at once and clear-headed: no daytime sluggishness, and Humanity doesn't cap any roll. Light-Sensitive Even a lamp hurts. It sees poorly and burns easily. Lizard Limbs Can shed a limb to escape and grow it back. Long Fingers Long, graceful fingers, good at fine work. Long-Term Planning Every action is part of a plan. Lord of the Flies Flies follow it everywhere. Lost Svadharma Failed its destiny, and it won't come again. Lucky Things go its way more often than they should. Lunacy The moon pulls at its mind. Mage Blood Blood so tied to magic that it can learn no Discipline but blood sorcery: Thaumaturgy, Necromancy, Koldunic Sorcery or Abyss Mysticism. Magic Resistance Magic slides off it, friendly or not. Master of the Masquerade Remembers to breathe, blink and fidget. Medium Hears the dead when they speak. Member of the Pack Only one kind of beast will listen to it. Monstrous Plainly not human. Monstrous Maw A huge mouth of sharp teeth. Mortuario Died and came back through the Ferryman's Recall. Two more dice on Necromancy rolls. Multiple Curses Carries a second Assamite curse. Mute Can't speak. Mute Devotion The beasts it has spoken with stay loyal. Natural Leader People follow it. Nightmares Bad dreams every day. It wakes tired of itself. Nine Lives Keeps surviving what should kill it. Oathbreaker Broke its word, and other Ravnos know. Obvious Predator The rage shows, and mortals fear it on sight. One Eye Has only one working eye. Open Wound A wound that never closes, leaking blood. Oracular Ability Sees signs in everything. Outcast Rejected by its caste, and worse with people for it. Outside Haven Trusted to sleep outside the chantry. Overstimulated Notices everything, and is easily distracted. Pain Tolerance Shuts off its nerves. Paper Trail Asylum or prison records that won't go away. Parasitic Infestation Crawling with ticks and leeches. Patagia Leathery flaps let it glide. Permanent Fangs The fangs never go back in. Permanent Wound Rises each night with the same wound, and carries it all night. Personal Masquerade Has other vampires believing it has a clan. Phobia Terrified of one thing, and never far from it in thought. Piscine Comfortable in water, even sewage. Precocious Learns fast. Prey Exclusion Refuses to feed on one kind of person, picked at the Embrace. A frenzy doesn't care. Privacy Obsession Can barely make itself cross a threshold uninvited. Private Life Keeps a whole second life, and the secret wears on it. Promethean Clay Its flesh changes almost before it asks. Prophetic Dreams Remembers its day dreams, and some come true. Putrescent Slowly rotting and fragile. Quartermaster Runs a chantry's stores. Rat in a Cage Being penned in brings on real panic. Repelled by Crosses Holy symbols hurt to look at. Repulsed by Garlic The smell turns its stomach. Harder to keep its nerve. Rugged Bad Looks Hideous, but might pass for human in the right light. Sanguine Incongruity Doesn't carry the Giovanni's painful Kiss. Scales Set marked it with a patch of scales. Scholar of Others Has studied a kind of creature that isn't Kindred. Setite Initiate Joined the Followers of Set from another clan, with the cult's contacts behind it. Shadow Walker Half in the Shadowlands. It struggles to touch the living world. Short Fuse Easily angered. Frenzy is two harder to resist. Shy Hates being looked at. Skald Remembers oral histories word for word. Sleep Unseen Keeps Obfuscate up while it sleeps. Slimy Secretes a slippery ooze. Hard to hold. Slow Healing Wounds close grudgingly. Healing with blood costs twice as much. Slowed Degeneration Humanity comes hard to lose. Smell of the Grave Smells of damp earth, always. People keep their distance. Soft-Hearted Can't stand to see suffering. Speech Impediment Trouble getting words out. Spirit Mentor A ghostly teacher looks out for it. Stench Stinks so badly even Nosferatu keep away. Stigmata Phantom wounds that seep blood. Territorial Can't stand strangers in its space. Thaumaturgically Inept Magic won't work for it. It can never learn Thaumaturgy. Thin Blood Weak blood that goes nowhere. Every point spent on powers or healing costs two, the blood bonds no one who drinks it, and an Embrace takes only one time in five. Thirst for Innocence Innocent blood calls to it. On edge around the blameless. Thousand Meter Killer A sniper of the Assassin's Club. Shoots more accurately at long range. Time Sense Always knows the hour, to the minute. Tortured Artist Nothing it makes is ever good enough. Totemic Change Its animal shapes are flexible, and all of them fit it well. Touch of Frost Plants wilt and frost forms where it touches. Tough Hide Skin like a rhino's. True Love Someone mortal loves it, and that holds it together. Tunnel Rat Knows every way under the ground. Unblinking Its eyes never close. Unbondable No blood bond will ever take hold of it. Uncommon Vitae Preference Its taste is rare even for a Ventrue. Uncontrollable Night Sight Sees into shadow, but any light is close to blinding. Unproven Has yet to prove itself worthy of the name. Useful Knowledge Knows something worth knowing, and learns faster for it. Vaishya A trader by birth. Vengeful Can't let a wrong go. Venomous Bite Venom glands in the mouth. Its bite in a fight is deadlier, and feeding is dangerous for mortals. Weak-Willed Gives in easily.

Name What it is A Combination Power to buy This vampire has the dots and the experience for a Combination Power. Press Combination Powers beside Recent rolls on the Disciplines page. See [[VTM_Guide_Disciplines#combination-powers\ Combination Powers]]. A new vampire The first nights go easier with four things done. - Give it a coffin or a roofed bed before dawn. - Spend its free Discipline dots on the Kindred tab. - Make sure it has a vessel: a willing colonist, a prisoner or [[VTM_Guide_Feeding#blood-vials\ blood vials]]. - Copy its schedule to any mortal who should keep its hours. See [[VTM_Guide_Being_Kindred\ Being Kindred]]. A target for the Scourge The Camarilla destroys blood this thin, whatever your standing. - The nearest Camarilla court can send its Scourge with a small band, by night, and they go for this vampire first. - A Scourge of your own, named in your domain's offices, stops that. See [[VTM_Guide_Sects_and_Courts#the-scourge\ The Scourge]]. Aggravated wounds Fire, sunlight, fangs, claws and some powers leave wounds that ordinary healing can't close. - 5 blood points and a full daysleep heal 10 HP. - Keep the pool above that cost, and set the heal policy under Habits to anything but never. - Aggravated damage is what kills a vampire for good. See [[VTM_Guide_Being_Kindred#healing\ Healing]]. Blood bound This pawn can't attack its regnant without fighting the bond, won't leave or betray, and is happiest near them. A full bond fades only after a long separation. See [[VTM_Guide_Embrace_Bonds_and_Ghouls#blood-bonds\ Blood bonds]]. Close to frenzy This vampire is hungry or out of Willpower, so a provocation is more likely to set off a frenzy. - Feed it, and keep it away from fights and insults until it has. - Good mood brings Willpower back. - Its Willpower policy under Habits on the Kindred tab decides when it spends a point to hold on. See [[VTM_Guide_Humanity_and_Frenzy#frenzy\ Frenzy]]. Close to Wassail At Humanity 0 this vampire is lost to the Beast for good and turns on the colony. - Avoid every sin you can. A vampire only tests for sins at or below its rating. - Raising Humanity costs experience, after a quadrum with no Humanity lost. - At 3 or lower it can take up a Path instead, if a teacher comes. See [[VTM_Guide_Humanity_and_Frenzy#humanity\ Humanity]]. Craving the Kiss This blood doll offers themselves first and wants feeding more often than is safe, so set a blood-loss limit. Without the Kiss they go into withdrawal for a while, and the craving fades after about a quadrum. See [[VTM_Guide_Feeding#craving-the-kiss\ Craving the Kiss]]. Day lethargy Woken by day, this vampire is slow and clumsy, and every roll is capped at its Humanity. - Undraft it and let it sleep unless you need it. - An eclipse or a dark sky that is too dim to burn lifts this. See [[VTM_Guide_Being_Kindred#daysleep\ Daysleep]]. Deranged This vampire's madness causes an episode every so often. A Willpower point holds one off for a day. Click the derangement on the Kindred tab to read what it does. See [[VTM_Guide_Humanity_and_Frenzy#derangements\ Derangements]]. Experience to spend This vampire has unspent experience. Spend it with the + buttons on the Kindred tab. See [[VTM_Guide_Experience\ Experience]]. Fang marks Frenzied feeding and bites in a fight leave marks that outsiders and hunters can read. Keep this pawn away from visitors until the marks fade. See [[VTM_Guide_Feeding#sources\ Feeding]]. Ghoul needs vitae A ghoul needs another drink every fifteen days or so. After that comes a week of withdrawal, and then the years it skipped catch up with it. - Right-click it with a vampire and pick Give vitae. See [[VTM_Guide_Embrace_Bonds_and_Ghouls#ghouls\ Ghouls]]. Hates the Kindred This mortal won't be fed on awake, and a mental break may send them after a vampire with fire or a stake, ideally one asleep by day. - Exile, imprison, bond or win them over before that happens. - A blood bond or ghouling sets their regard to devoted and keeps it there. See [[VTM_Guide_Feeding#how-mortals-feel-about-it\ How mortals feel about it]]. In frenzy The Beast has this vampire. It attacks, or in a hunger frenzy drinks past the safe limit, until the frenzy passes. - Keep mortals out of its reach. - Anything it kills can be a sin, and outsiders who see it become witnesses. See [[VTM_Guide_Humanity_and_Frenzy#frenzy\ Frenzy]]. In torpor This vampire lies down, unconscious and with no upkeep, for a time set by its Humanity. A letter gave the date. - Starved into torpor, it needs 4 blood points from vials or another vampire's vitae. It wakes in a hunger frenzy, so keep mortals away. - Vitae from a vampire at least two generations lower wakes it early. - Keep it in a coffin and out of hunters' reach. Aggravated damage now destroys it. See [[VTM_Guide_Being_Kindred#torpor\ Torpor]]. Keeping blood vials A vial holds 1 blood point and keeps four days, so store it in a freezer. It carries its donor's drug high and disease. See [[VTM_Guide_Feeding#blood-vials\ Blood vials]]. Nowhere to sleep This vampire has no bed of its own. At dawn it needs a bed, a coffin or a roofed cell. - Build a coffin and assign it. The lid keeps the sun off even under an open sky, and a full day in it is a good mood. See [[VTM_Guide_Being_Kindred#daysleep\ Daysleep]]. Outdoors near dawn The sun is close. Sunlight deals aggravated burns every second under an open sky, and a neonate at noon has well under a minute. - Get this vampire under a roof or into a coffin now. - Caught with no roof, it digs into soft ground by itself. See [[VTM_Guide_Being_Kindred#sunlight\ Sunlight]]. Rötschreck Fire, sun or True Faith has this vampire running for the nearest dark, safe spot, and it attacks anything in the way. - Clear the path to shade, and put out the fire if you can. - Leave it alone until it stops. See [[VTM_Guide_Humanity_and_Frenzy#frenzy\ Frenzy]]. Staked A stake through the heart holds a vampire awake and helpless until someone pulls it. - To free your own, add the stake's removal as a bill on the Health tab. - A staked enemy can be kept that way for as long as you like. See [[VTM_Guide_Being_Kindred#staking\ Staking]]. Starving Under 15% of its pool this vampire feeds whatever the mark on its Vitae bar says, and it may frenzy at the sight of a vessel. - Keep a willing colonist or a prisoner close. Either gives up to 3 points. - A [[VTM_Guide_Feeding#blood-vials\ blood vial]] gives 1 point. - Animals are worth about half, and nothing from the 6th generation down. - Afterwards, drag the mark on the Vitae bar up. With an empty pool it can't wake and falls into torpor. See [[VTM_Guide_Feeding\ Feeding]]. Tied to the moon This Rafastio's Disciplines follow the moon: 2 harder at the new moon, 1 harder while it waxes or wanes and 1 easier when it's full. The Embrace is refused to them, and so is the Ferryman's Recall. See [[VTM_Guide_Embrace_Bonds_and_Ghouls\ Ghouls]]. Unsettling to mortals Below Humanity 5 this vampire takes social penalties with mortals. - Don't make it your negotiator or warden. - Raise Humanity with experience after a quadrum with no Humanity lost. See [[VTM_Guide_Humanity_and_Frenzy#humanity\ Humanity]]. Using a coffin Anyone can sleep in a coffin. Its lid keeps the sun off even under an open sky, and a full day in it is a good mood. See [[VTM_Guide_Being_Kindred#daysleep\ Daysleep]].

Name What it is Decadent Pays in vessels, vials and invitations to its parties, and rarely in silver. Paranoid Trusts nobody. Its good opinion grows half as fast, and it tells what it wants only to someone it has a hold over. Cold to anyone from a colony it has never talked to.

Name What it is Diablerist's lair The hideout of a vampire who has drunk another's soul, and the rogues who follow it. Ghoul farm A barracks where a vampire keeps its ghouls fed and close. Herd's house A house where a rival keeps the mortals it feeds on, with rogues to watch them. Hunters' hideout A hunting order's safehouse. Somewhere inside, a vampire's heart is waiting to be burned. Mentor's refuge A vampire who has walked the road to Golconda lives here, alone. Old ruin Old walls with something worth reading inside, and rogues camped beside them. Rival's haven A vampire's haven, a coffin room behind its ghouls. Rivals' holding place Where a rival coterie keeps someone it took, locked in a cell under a rogue guard. Rogue Kindred lair A hideout of rogue Kindred and the mortals who guard their sleep. Runaway's hideout Where a runaway childe has holed up with a few mortals who don't know what it is. Torpor crypt Old sealed rooms where an elder of the Kindred lies in torpor among its treasures. Wight's hiding place Where the wight your colony let escape has gone to ground, among rogues who don't mind what it is. Witness's camp A camp where someone who saw too much has gone to ground, with a few guards.

Name What it is Cut out heart (heart of darkness) Take a vampire's heart out of its chest and keep it somewhere safe. Only a surgeon with Serpentis 5 can do it. Without its heart the vampire can't be staked, but if the heart is destroyed, so is the vampire. Draw blood Draw blood from this person and seal it in vials. They will be weak from blood loss for a day or so. Graft Hand of Conrad Graft the Hand of Conrad onto a wrist, replacing the hand. Install Brass Heart Shield Set the Brass Heart Shield over the heart. Install Eye of Hazimel Set the Eye of Hazimel into an eye socket, replacing what is there. Make blood wine Age fine blood vials into bottles of blood wine. Make sack of earth Dig up a sack of earth from this place. Remove stake Pull the stake out of this vampire's heart. Stake with a Nail of Dismus Drive a Nail of Dismus through a helpless vampire's heart. It stakes like wood and drains the vampire's Willpower every day it stays.

Name What it is Bratovitch Rural kennel-keepers who breed hounds and worse, and track for Sabbat packs. They lose their tempers fast and badly. D'Habi Warrior-priests of a Baali lord who betrayed him, then spent centuries as the slaves of what was left of his line. Their spirits never recovered, and they give way to a strong will. Ducheski A dwindling line that left the Tzimisce for the Tremere. Gifted with machines, and too inbred to be easy company. Enrathi Slavers and kidnappers for anyone who pays, Kindred and mortal alike. Nothing they do bothers them, and it shows. Grimaldi Wealthy go-betweens for the Sabbat in mortal society. Every adult Grimaldi is blood bound to the sect's bishops. Kairouan Brotherhood The Assamites' only revenants, spies and scholars bred by the sorcerers from captured Tzimisce stock. The breeding left their bodies slow to mend. Obertus Reclusive scholars of the strange, bred for intellect. Most of them can't rest until everything is just so. Oprichniki Descended from a tsar's butchers, now henchmen to the Russian Tzimisce. The dead of an old massacre follow every one of them. Rafastio A proud matriarchal line of witches who sell their magic to whoever suits them. Their Disciplines fade with the moon, and the Embrace has never taken on one of them. Rossellini Necromancers kept as vassals by the Giovanni, who call them little brothers. They see death and decay in everything, and sit badly in company. Servants of Anushin-Rawan Polished attendants raised on a Ventrue elder's island, and mistaken by most Kindred for ghouls. Generations of breeding have made them pliable to Ventrue commands. Zantosa Faded aristocrats who live for the next sensation. Whatever pleases a Zantosa once, it wants again.

Name What it is Ascension of the Blood The caster purifies its blood in a chalice. For a day, nobody who drinks from it takes a step toward a blood bond. Bind the Accusing Tongue Knot a cord in the caster's blood and a mortal can't speak of what they saw. They stop counting as a witness, and won't become one again for a season. Binding of the Watcher A night of blood sorcery that binds a ghoul a second time, to the spot where it stands. The ghoul must already be fully blood bound to a colony vampire. From then on it guards that spot: it goes for any enemy that comes near, looks harder for anyone hidden there, and goes back to it when it has nothing to do. Its skin turns to grey stone. Away from its post it is unhappy, and everywhere its mind is easier to bend. The binding is for good. Binding of the Watcher A night of blood sorcery that binds a ghoul a second time, to the spot where it stands. The ghoul must already be fully blood bound to a colony vampire. From then on it guards that spot: it goes for any enemy that comes near, looks harder for anyone hidden there, and goes back to it when it has nothing to do. Its skin turns to grey stone. Away from its post it is unhappy, and everywhere its mind is easier to bend. The binding is for good. Blood Contract The caster and someone of its own faction, or a prisoner, sign in blood. A prisoner who signs joins the colony. Whoever leaves the faction it was signed in, or strikes the other signer, dies. Blood Walk Read a vampire's blood: its clan and generation, its sire and further back a generation per success, and every blood bond it carries. Bone of Lies Hold an enchanted token to someone and their secrets come out: a thrall serving an outside vampire, or a hunter in disguise. Brotherhood of the Cup Four other Tremere on the map have to put their blood in the cup with the caster's. Whoever drinks is bound for an hour per success to the clan and its goals, and is hard to break. It counts as no drink from any of them. Burning Blade The caster's melee weapon burns as it strikes: each of the next blows, one per success, adds a burn that is aggravated to Kindred. It lasts four hours. Cadaver's Touch For a day, a mortal goes cold and grey and smells of the grave. They move slowly, and anyone who sees them would swear they were dead. Call of the Hungry Dead A mortal starts hearing the whispers of the dead. For hours they can't concentrate and can't shake the dread. Claiming the Dark The caster cuts itself open and draws the shadows in, a roll of Manipulation + Occult at 8. On a success its skin darkens and it hits harder and moves faster, for as long as it likes. Each day the change costs a point of blood per dot of Obtenebration, or it ends. The sun does triple damage, and the caster is uglier for it. Work the ritual again to let the shadows go. A botch costs a point of blood for each 1 rolled. Comforting Darkness The darkness closes the caster's wounds, for a point of Willpower and a roll of Stamina + Occult at 8. Each success spends a point of blood, whatever the Generation's limit, and heals as two points' worth. The dark then takes twice that blood from everything the caster drinks, and the ritual can't be worked until it's paid. The blood stays nearly black ever after. A botch burns the caster. Commune with the Abyss The caster asks the Abyss one question and falls into a sleep nothing can break. A nightly roll of Intelligence + Occult at 9 adds up to the question's rating, and a night with no success stretches the wait to a week between rolls. The answer is true and complete. Each communion leaves the caster stranger to others for good. Communicate with Kindred Sire Reach the caster's sire across any distance. A sire out in the world sends a few blood vials by drop pod, more with more successes. Death's Communion A Black Mass in the Giovanni manner, dedicating its subject to the Endless Night. The subject has two more dice on Necromancy rolls for a day per success. Defense of the Sacred Haven Sigils drawn in blood around the caster keep the sun out of everywhere within seven cells, roof or no roof, for as long as the caster stays inside. Deflection of Wooden Doom For the next day, the first stake driven at the caster's heart splinters and fails. Donning the Mask of Shadows Someone turns translucent and hard to notice for the night. Mortals see what they do from only half as far. Enchant Talisman The caster binds an object to itself with blood and a long night's work. After a season it settles: it adds two dice to the caster's Thaumaturgy and can hold a few points of blood. It is useless to anyone else, and if it is ever destroyed the caster loses a point of Willpower for good. Escape to a True Friend In a few moments the caster steps out of the world and appears beside the colonist it likes best, on any of the colony's maps. Worked anywhere, no circle needed. Eyes of the Grave A mortal sees visions of their own death. For the next few days, terror seizes them now and then and sends them wandering. Flesh of Fiery Touch For a day the caster's skin burns to the touch. Anyone who strikes it in melee is burned. From Marduk's Throat A Dur-An-Ki potion of Kindred blood that lets an Assamite lower its Generation despite the Tremere curse. Converts of other clans on the Path of Blood may brew and drink it too. The drinker rolls Willpower at 9 to keep it down, then again each hour until it has fifteen successes. Each failed roll tears at it for lethal damage. Grasp the Ghostly The caster reaches into the lands of the dead and pulls something back. Usually a ledger of the dead or a hand of glory; once in a long while an artifact of necromancy. Each extra success improves the odds. Heart of Stone The caster's heart turns to stone for a day per success. No stake can pierce it and Presence can't move it, but the caster has almost no Conscience left to resist sin with, and no warmth to charm anyone. Incorporeal Passage For four hours per success, the caster can step through up to four cells of wall or anything else solid. Light within Shadow The caster stares into a ball of shadow until its eyes change. A second roll, Perception + Occult at 8: on a success, Sight improves for good and the eyes turn to black pits. A failure can be tried again. A botch hurts the eyes for good. Unlike the book's Merit, the change is always on. Pavis of Foul Presence For a day, Presence and Passion used on the caster turn back on whoever used them. Principal Focus of Vitae Infusion Seal a point of blood into a small gold bead. Any vampire who crushes it later drinks the point back. Ritual of the Unearthed Fetter Find what anchors a ghost to this world. While its fetter lasts the ghost can always be called; destroy it and the ghost fades in time. Sanguine Assistant Shape a small servant from the caster's blood. It hauls and cleans for a day per success, then runs back into a puddle. Sanguine Trail A red thread runs from the target to everyone it shares a blood bond with, one bond per success. At five successes the caster also sees who is bound to whom. Shaft of Belated Quiescence Carve a stake whose tip breaks off in a vampire it wounds and works its way to the heart over a few hours. The stake crumbles once it has struck. Splinter Servant Animate a stake and send it at someone the caster can point to. It flies straight for the heart, and pins a vampire it hits. The Devil's Touch Curse a mortal with a coin passed from hand to hand. For a day, everyone who meets them dislikes them. The Ferryman's Recall Brings a dead Ghoul back across the river and Embraces it at the ritual's climax, long after the Embrace would normally fail. How long the corpse can have lain depends on the caster's Generation: twelve hours at the 13th, a day at the 12th, up to two weeks at the 6th. The Gargoyle Rite A night of butchery and blood magic that remakes a helpless Gangrel, Nosferatu or Tzimisce as a Gargoyle, with the vitae of a vampire of one of the other two clans close by. It keeps its generation, gains wings, loses its passions and is wholly bound to the caster. Only the Tremere teach it. The Hand of Glory Take a hand from a corpse and make it into a candle. Lit, it keeps every sleeping outsider within a dozen cells asleep for hours, for burglary or quiet feeding. Vision of Shadow A ball of shadow shows the caster every enemy on the map, wherever it hides, and clears the fog around it. For a day after, Sight is reduced by what the caster stared at. Wake with Evening's Freshness For the next day the caster wakes clear-headed by day: no daytime sluggishness, and Humanity doesn't cap any roll. Ward versus Ghouls Mark a door or other building with the caster's blood. Any ghoul from outside the colony that stands on or in it is burned. Ward versus Kindred Mark a door or other building with the caster's blood. Any vampire from outside the colony that stands on or in it is burned. Ward versus Lupines Mark a door or other building with the caster's blood and silver dust. Any werewolf from outside the colony that stands on or in it is burned. Warding Circle versus Ghouls Pour a ring of mortal blood round the spot the caster stands on. Any ghoul from outside the colony that stands inside burns. The caster picks the size, from 2 to 8 cells, and whether it lasts until dawn or, cast over a whole night, a year and a day. Warding Circle versus Kindred Pour a ring of mortal blood round the spot the caster stands on. Any vampire from outside the colony that stands inside burns. The caster picks the size, from 2 to 8 cells, and whether it lasts until dawn or, cast over a whole night, a year and a day. Warding Circle versus Lupines Pour a ring of mortal blood round the spot the caster stands on. Any werewolf from outside the colony that stands inside burns. The caster picks the size, from 2 to 8 cells, and whether it lasts until dawn or, cast over a whole night, a year and a day. Warding Circle versus Spirits Pour a ring of mortal blood round the spot the caster stands on. Any spirit, ghost or demon from outside the colony that stands inside burns, even unseen in Twilight. The caster picks the size, from 2 to 8 cells, and whether it lasts until dawn or, cast over a whole night, a year and a day.

Name What it is Anarch gang Three Kindred who walked out on their prince and kept walking, all the way to a new world, with two mortal friends who came along for the ride. Nobody here tells you what to do. Camarilla coterie A prince far away wants a foothold on this world and sent three young Kindred to make one. Two mortal retainers came along to keep the lights on by day and the coterie fed by night. Make a domain the Camarilla can be proud of, and keep the Masquerade while you do it. Dark Ages fief Your lord granted you this stretch of wild land and told you not to come back until it paid. You rode out with two retainers who drink your blood and two serfs who don't know what you are yet. Nobody out here has heard of the Camarilla. There's only your word, your sword and the dark.Note: one vampire, two ghoul retainers bound to them and two mortal serfs. They walk in with medieval arms and the old crafts; research is as normal. Fallen knight You died on campaign, in the mud outside a town whose name you never learned, and woke three nights later with a thirst. Whoever Embraced you rode on with the army. Only your squire came back to look for you, and you've already given them your blood to keep them close.Note: one vampire in plate and one ghoul squire, with a warhorse. A hard start. Independent clan crew Two Kindred of one of the Independent clans, sent out by their elders on clan business, with three mortals to do the work by day. The clan already has a haven on this world, and it is expecting you. Lone neonate Your sire made you, taught you almost nothing and left you on a transport bound for the rim. You woke in the hold with a crate of stolen blood and nobody to answer to. Now you have a planet to hide on, and the sun comes up in a few hours.Note: one fledgling vampire with no one to feed on. A hard start. Sabbat pack Three Kindred of the Sword of Caine, sent to take this world from the Camarilla, with two mortals who know better than to ask questions. The pack has already shared the Vaulderie, and the Camarilla counts you as its enemy. The stowaway The three of you wake to sirens and tearing metal and barely make the escape pods. One of you was never really asleep. They boarded the ship hidden in a cryptosleep casket, and the others are about to find out what they are. Wandering revenant Your family has served the Kindred for longer than anyone remembers, and the blood in your veins is your own. You left them with a pack animal, a purse and whatever your blood can do, to sell it to whichever court pays best. Note: one revenant ghoul and no vampires. You pick the family when the game starts. The three nearest courts are known, and they hire ghouls for errands while your caravan travels near them, even with no home behind you.

Name What it is Harpy Keeper of reputations. Must be seen at every Elysium, and hears every secret told there. Hound The Sheriff's hunter. Tracks down thin-bloods and Caitiff made without the Prince's leave. Keeper of Elysium Hosts Elysium and keeps its peace. Guests owe the host for a good night. Primogen Speaks for a clan on the Prince's council and votes on what the court does. Seneschal The Prince's right hand. Screens everyone who asks to see the Prince, and is judged by how well. Sheriff The Prince's enforcer. Deals with the bigger trouble: Anarchs, whoever breaches the Masquerade, hunters.

Name What it is Anarchs Kindred who threw out their princes. They keep the Masquerade and little else, run free states under barons, and trade favours without anyone keeping score from on high. Camarilla The largest sect of Kindred, ruled by elders and princes. It keeps the Masquerade and the Traditions, and punishes those who break them. Independents Clans that answer to no sect: the Assamites, the Followers of Set, the Giovanni and the Ravnos. Each keeps its own haven and minds its own business. Sabbat The Sword of Caine. Packs of Kindred who reject their elders and their own lost humanity, bound to each other by shared blood and at war with the Camarilla.

Name What it is Abyss Mysticism The Lasombra's study of the darkness beyond shadow. It has no paths, only rituals, each rated up to the lower of Obtenebration and Occult, and each leaves a mark on the caster that never fades. Worked anywhere, on Wits + Occult. Only Lasombra can learn it. Koldunic Sorcery The Tzimisce kolduns' sorcery of the living land, worked through four Ways: earth, wind, water and fire. Only Tzimisce can learn it, and its one ritual is Binding of the Watcher, worked anywhere. Necromancy Command over the dead and their ghosts, the art of the Giovanni. It is learned one path at a time, alongside rituals. Thaumaturgy Blood magic, made by the Tremere and guarded by them. It is learned one path at a time, alongside rituals.
Name What it is Gale A howling wind called up by blood magic. It throws off aim at range.

Name What it is Diablerist Wants an elder caught alive and brought to it. The factions, the kinds of people and the creatures this mod adds.

Faction What it is Abandoned childe A neonate alone on the rim. Their sire Embraced them, taught them almost nothing and sent them away, and no sect, prince or coterie has claimed them since.In the Camarilla's eyes a childe released without the prince's leave is a breach of the Traditions, and the sire's crime falls on the childe. Some courts will offer a place anyway. Others will want a reason not to stake them. Until then the neonate answers to nobody, and nobody will protect them. Anarch gang Kindred who walked out on their prince and kept walking, with the mortal friends who came along.The Anarchs want what the Camarilla's elders keep for themselves: domain, freedom and a say in their own unlife. They keep the Masquerade, since breaking it would end them too, but they have no time for princes. A gang settles its own disputes and is led by whoever the others will follow, usually under the title of baron. Cainite fief A Cainite lord's fief, held the old way, long before anyone spoke of a Camarilla.In the Dark Medieval nights the vampires called themselves Cainites and ruled from behind castles and churches. A lord held land the way a mortal baron did, with ghoul retainers to keep the day and serfs to work the fields and feed the household. Every lord answers to an older one. Rule well and the fief grows; rule badly and someone hungrier takes it. Camarilla coterie A coterie of young Kindred sent by a distant prince to claim a domain for the Camarilla, with their mortal retainers.The Camarilla holds to the Six Traditions, and above all to the Masquerade: mortals must never learn that Kindred exist. Its princes rule cities through primogen councils, sheriffs and harpies, and their elders measure every neonate by the boons they owe and are owed. Keep the Masquerade, build a domain worth having, and the prince who sent you may name you its regent. Crash survivors Survivors of a ship torn apart over the rim. One of them came aboard in a cryptosleep casket nobody remembers loading.A vampire among mortals has to feed, and the people closest to hand are the ones who shared the escape pods. Whether they become a herd, ghouls, a coterie in the making or a danger to the Masquerade is up to the one who hid among them. Fallen knight A knight who died on campaign and rose a vampire, and the squire who would not leave.Wars drew the Cainites the way battlefields draw crows: plenty of blood, and nobody counts the dead. Now and then one of them took a knight for the sword arm and left them behind when the army moved on. This one has no sire to answer to, only the oath they swore in life and a squire who drinks their blood. Independent clan crew Kindred of one of the Independent clans, out on clan business with mortals to work by day.The Independents belong to no sect. They trade with the Camarilla and the Sabbat alike, and each clan keeps its own ways, its own secrets and its own elders, who expect to be obeyed even across the stars. The clan has a haven on this world already. What the elders want done here, they will say in their own time. Raiders Drifters who answer to nobody and keep late hours. Raiders Hard-faced agents of some distant authority, sent to settle its accounts. Raiders Packs who come after dark and burn what they can't carry. Raiders Gangs who threw off whoever used to run them and mean to stay free. Revenant on the road A revenant of one of the old families who have served the Kindred for centuries, out on their own.Revenants are born, not made. Their blood carries a little of what their masters gave the family long ago, and they never need a domitor to keep it. The family sells its service to the courts, and this one has gone to find the best price. Kindred will see them as a ghoul with no master, to be used, bought or claimed. Sabbat pack A pack of the Sword of Caine, sent to take this world from the Camarilla, and their mortals.The Sabbat calls the Camarilla's elders slaves of the Antediluvians and means to destroy them before Gehenna. Its packs are bound by the Vaulderie, a sharing of blood that replaces any one Kindred's hold on another with loyalty to the pack. A ductus leads them in war and a priest keeps the ritae. Mortals are herds, and the Masquerade is kept only because the war needs it. Travellers Strangers on the road after dark, keeping to themselves.
