1 blood Touch 10 s Touch someone's blood and learn from it: whether they are Kindred, ghoul or mortal, and how much blood they have left. With two successes it also tells a vampire's generation, and with three whether it has ever committed diablerie. For a day the sorcerer's own rolls against them get two extra dice.
Touch 10 s Touch a person or a thing and feel what the dead have to do with it: whether a ghost is inside it or close by, and whether it anchors one.

24.9 cells 1 day Take skill for good: A level per net success moves from the target's best skill to the Kiasyd, never past the target's own level. Anyone who resists is out of this Kiasyd's reach for good. Perception and Social against their Willpower.

1 blood Touch 8 h Turn blood to acid on the hands. Every blow burns and leaves aggravated wounds, for about an hour and a half per success. Cast on a door, a wall or anything else built within reach, the acid eats straight into it, a heavy wound in the steel or wood for every success.

1 blood Touch 12 h Touch someone and leave them needing something: what only the caster's kind can give, the Kiss for a mortal or the blood of other Kindred for a vampire, or any drug the caster chooses, a habit it can then feed for a price.
1 blood Self 1.92 h Wake the spirit of the weapon in hand so it works the way it was meant to. Better aim and surer blows, more with each success, for a while.
1 blood Touch 4 h Touch a machine, turret or mechanoid and understand it: what it is and what shape it is in. For four hours a success after, repairs come half again as fast.
1 blood Touch 10 s A touch takes a friend's pain away for a while. A mortal who isn't a friend can be put to sleep, if the vampire's will beats theirs. Kindred are beyond it.

1 blood 20 cells 15 s Wake a thing no bigger than a person and set it moving: a statue walks and pounds with stone fists, a chair or a table scuttles about battering the caster's enemies, a blade on the floor rises and cuts. It moves for an hour a success, then settles where it stands. The caster keeps as many going as its Intelligence. Aimed at someone armed, the weapon in their hands twists free and strikes them once a success instead.

1 blood 24.9 cells 4 h Conjure two phantom wolves that run at the vampire's enemies for four hours. They draw attacks and seem to bite, but do no harm and take none; a hard enough hit makes one vanish.

1 blood 9.9 cells 20 s Raise a corpse, and one more nearby for each success after the first, as a mindless labourer. It hauls and cleans and nothing else, and falls apart after two days per success. A necromancer keeps up to twice its Necromancy rating of raised dead at once.
1 blood Self 1 h A shining red halo wraps the vampire like armour. Each success adds a layer, up to five, for about an hour and a half a success.
1 blood Self 1 h Shadow closes around the body and hardens, without weighing it down.

1 blood 24.9 cells 1 h Raise tentacles of shadow at a spot. Every enemy within three cells is held fast, unable to act, and squeezed every two seconds for ten seconds. Each squeeze a victim may tear loose with Strength and Potence against the vampire's Obtenebration.

2 blood Self 10 s Collapse into a heap of sticky white ash. Neither the sun nor fire can touch it, and the vampire rises at the next dusk or when told to. Scatter the heap and the vampire comes back torn.
1 blood Self 8 h Take one animal's gift for about an hour and a half a success: the bear's strength, the stag's speed, the falcon's eye, the cougar's nerve or the serpent's venom.

1 blood 12 cells 30 s Wither one of someone's arms or legs to bone and skin. They can try to shake it off; a partial escape leaves the limb weak instead of useless. On a mortal it is permanent unless the limb is replaced. A vampire can restore it with five points of blood.
500 cells Set the animal on someone.

Touch 10 s Handle a thing and soak up what was done with it, as the Spirit's Touch does. A corpse gives up its killer, who stays read for a week (rolls against the killer get two extra dice), and a sealed casket gives up what sleeps inside.
1 blood Touch 10 s Let the cold of entropy out onto a thing in reach. It gives out: broken down and nine tenths destroyed. Machines rust, wood rots, plasteel goes brittle.

24.9 cells 10 s Read the colours around a person: whether they are Kindred, and of what clan and generation, or how close a mortal is to breaking and what they think of vampires. For a day afterwards, this vampire's rolls against them get two extra dice.

1 blood Touch 12 h Touch a tree and wake it. It pulls up its roots and fights for the caster for about six hours a success, then roots again wherever it stands. Every success costs another blood point, as far as the blood goes.

Self 1 s Let the vampire's Presence fill the room. Everyone nearby is drawn to it: better opinions, a stronger social impact and slightly better trade prices while it lasts. At a party, every guest enjoys the evening more. A mortal who hurts the vampire must win against its Presence once, or lower their weapon and trail after it for a few seconds. Use it again to let the pull fade.
2 blood Self 4 h Coat the blade in venomous blood for four hours: every melee hit with it is aggravated and does half again as much, and each one eats a little of the weapon away.
1 blood Self 40 s Coat a blade in blood turned to aggravated venom for four hours. Every cutting or stabbing hit adds half its damage again as venom.

1 blood Self 40 s Smear blood across the eyes and over a blade for four hours. The sorcerer's version of the venom: it only works on spirits and the demon-touched, and every cutting or stabbing hit on them adds half its damage again.

1 blood Self 40 s Coat a blade in vitae for four hours. Every cutting or stabbing hit strips a point of Willpower for a day, and a target stripped bare is charmed by the vizier for a while, as good as bound. The book's blow does no damage, but here the cut still lands.
1 blood, 1 Willpower Self 1 day Shadow thickens around the sleeper. For a day sunlight does half its damage.
1 blood Self 10 s Make the sign Thoth taught Osiris. For a minute, the next power aimed at the Child's mind loses a success for each one rolled here.

1 blood Self 4 h Howl, screech or whistle, and the wild answers. Pick a kind of wild animal nearby, and up to five of them come to the vampire and guard it for about six hours, going for anyone who threatens it.
1 Willpower Self 20.8333 s Nobody thinks the vampire worth noticing, for as long as it takes to walk away.
1 blood 24.9 cells 1 h Something huge broods behind the vampire. Every outsider nearby feels it.
20 blood 24.9 cells 20 s Twenty blood remakes one of the colony's own into a war-beast for good.

1 blood Self 20 s Call a freezing wind round the koldun. While it stands still, every enemy within ten cells moves at half speed, fumbles with its hands and is bitten by the cold every few seconds. Moving stills the wind.

1 blood, 1 Willpower 10 cells 12 h Breathe out a cloud of despair at a spot close by, two cells across a success. Anyone in it whose will fails against it breaks down, a mortal into a catatonic stupor, a vampire into a day of torpor. Even those who hold are shaken for four hours. Costs a blood and a Willpower point.

2 blood Self 4 h Become a thing of shadow for four hours: tentacles of darkness that strike with a cold touch, harder to hurt, and so terrible to see that enemies within eight cells who fail to hold their nerve run. Charisma and Social against each enemy's Willpower.
Self 6 h Fall into a trance before beauty and come back steadied, with the world a little easier to bear.
1 blood Touch 40 s A touch that hurts and keeps on hurting: four hours of strong pain and a deep cut. A vampire hurt this way tests against frenzy. Willpower at 8.
1 blood Self Push a point of blood into the body for an extra dot of Strength, Dexterity or Stamina for four hours. Cast it again to stack, up to the most this generation allows.

1 blood Self 1 day Concentrate the blood until it is as strong as an elder's. The vampire counts as a lower generation for four hours or more: a deeper blood pool, more blood spent at once, and eye contact that works on stronger blood. More successes lower it further and make it last longer. Any blood beyond the normal pool thins away when it ends. Once a night.

1 blood Touch 15 s Touch another vampire and make its blood surge. It burns a point of blood for each success, gets a burst of speed and strength from it, and has to fight off a frenzy that gets harder with every success.
24.9 cells 20 s Taste what a pawn's blood is, and whose.

1 Willpower 24.9 cells 20 s Wring guilt out of someone in sight until it runs from their skin as blood: a point of a vampire's pool per net success, or a mortal's blood as if fed on. Manipulation and Social against their Willpower.
1 blood 8 cells 10 s Spit a hardened spine of blood at someone within eight cells. The wound is aggravated.
1 blood Touch 20 s Touch someone and turn their blood to water. A vampire or ghoul loses a blood point a success. A mortal loses a fifth of its blood a success: three put it down, five kill it.

Self 40 s Melt into a pool of the vampire's own vitae for four hours. Blows and bullets splash through it, and it seeps under any door. It can't fight or work, and fire and sunlight still burn it. While in it, the vampire can melt a hand, an eye or a whole limb into blood: 3 for an arm or leg with everything on it. When it pulls itself back together, missing parts grow back for what they're worth, 2 blood at least, while the blood lasts. Costs no blood to take.

1 blood Self 8 h Burn blood and move faster than mortal eyes can follow: quicker on foot, with weapons and at work, for four hours. Mortals who catch the blur may become witnesses. Stronger from Celerity 3, and twice as long at 5.
2 blood Self 1 h Grow blades out of bone and flesh.

Intelligence and Medicine.

1 blood Touch 20 s Breathe the mist of death into someone in reach: an aggravated wound, and until dawn people who don't know death shy away from them.

1 blood Self 1 h Send a drowsy wind over every enemy within fifteen cells. Each that fails a Stamina and Plants roll moves and works at half pace for four hours; one that botches falls asleep.

1 blood Self 1 h Bare hands burn with Rage for the fight, and what they tear doesn't mend the easy way.

1 Willpower 30 cells 3 s Bring the storm's lightning down on a spot under open sky, for a Willpower point.

1 blood 20 cells 15 s Call up a fire the size of a campfire. It burns everyone around the spot where it lands. Five successes put the fire exactly where it was aimed; fewer let it land a few cells off. The caster isn't burned by it, but anything it sets alight is ordinary fire.

1 blood 20 cells 10 s Light a small flame anywhere within reach. It catches what it touches. Five successes put the fire exactly where it was aimed; fewer let it land a few cells off. The caster isn't burned by it, but anything it sets alight is ordinary fire.
1 blood 4.9 cells 20 s Three of the vampire's wounds pass to a colony animal, which takes them instead.

24.9 cells 20 s Follow someone's blood bonds to whoever holds them.

Self 30 s Spread the cloak over everyone close by: the vampire and its people within three cells all fade from sight together.
2 blood Self 8 h Run time faster through the vampire alone. Everything it does goes much faster, for four hours a success.

For four hours the body takes blows like dead flesh, a third less harm, and the necromancer can talk with the dead as Lifeless Tongues does. Drinking it shows how close to death everyone within fifteen cells is, and whether they are Kindred, ghoul or mortal. The corpse is left dry.

3 blood Self 1 h Spin a shell of hardened blood where the vampire stands, on any ground. The sun can't get in, and it takes a great deal of breaking. The vampire comes out at dusk or when told to.

1 blood 22 cells 15 s The air round someone in sight turns searing and they burst into flame: an aggravated burn a success, and they catch fire.

1 Willpower 500 cells 20 s A word in the mind of anyone of the colony's, anywhere on the map, keeps them steady.
1 Willpower 24.9 cells 20 s One look, and the hostile animals around the target break and run.

1 blood Touch 5 s Touch an ally and pass on one of the lower powers of Mars the caster knows, for as long as it would last.

1 blood Self 1 h Feel the history of the blade in hand until it answers like part of the arm, and learn what it really is if it is an unknown relic. Until it leaves the hand it strikes truer (more with more successes), nobody can knock it away, and the other powers of the path get an extra die through it.
1 blood 15.9 cells 5 s Hurl a bolt of black, cold hellfire. It burns like any fire once it lands, aggravated to Kindred, and other vampires fear it as they fear any flame.

1 blood Self 4 h Bleed onto the plants underfoot and wake them. For a few minutes, enemies among the plants nearby are tangled and slowed, and lashed the first time they're caught. Up to three blood points: the more, the wider the grove.

1 blood 22 cells 10 s Turn someone in sight from what they meant to do. They drop it and lash out at whoever is near with insults instead. Not in a fight. They resist with Willpower, a vampire with Self-Control.
1 blood Self 1 day Let the Blood settle on everyone of the colony within ten cells. For a night they feel on the same side: no social fights, and a better mood.
Touch 5 s Lay hands on wounds and they close, as the third eye opens. Each blood point heals a good cut; aggravated wounds take twice the blood. Up to three points a touch, on the living or the dead.

1 Willpower 20 cells 12 h Infect a vampire within twenty cells with the plague of the undead, unless it fights it off with Stamina and Fortitude. For up to a week it is weak and slow, rising costs an extra blood, and blood often won't stay down. Drinking from it passes the plague on.
1 blood Touch 1 h A touch that leaves a Withering lying in wait. Three to six days later one of the victim's limbs shrivels.
24.9 cells 20 s Wear whatever the target fears the most, and watch them go.

1 blood Self 4 h Paint war runes in blood across the skin and let the spirits of battle in. For four hours pain matters less with each success, frenzy is easier to hold back, and the next melee blow lands much harder.

1 Willpower 20 cells 1 h Curse a vampire within twenty cells with the worst of being alive until dawn: hunger, thirst, sweat and worse. Slowed by needs it no longer has, every roll it makes is two harder.

2 blood 9.9 cells 1 h Put one of the necromancer's shades into a fresh corpse. It gets up with the dead face and the ghost's own name and skills, and works and fights for the necromancer for three days plus a day per success, until the body gives out. A shade put back into its own corpse walks as itself again.

1 Willpower 30 cells 30 s Burst the blood vessels of someone this vampire has struck in melee within the last day, from as far as it can see them: one pulse of internal damage a second for each success. Stamina and Quietus against the victim's Stamina plus 3.

1 Willpower 30 cells 30 s Harrow the mind of someone this vampire has struck in melee within the last day, from as far as it can see them. Manipulation + Intellectual against their Willpower: each success strips a point of Willpower, for a day.

1 blood 22 cells 20 s Make the plants at a spot in sight come alive and seize every enemy within two cells, four seconds a success. A living target can fight free with Willpower. There must be plants there.

2 blood Touch 20 s Sweat one of the four humours and touch someone with it. Phlegm makes them sluggish, blood makes their wounds bleed twice as fast, yellow bile leaves them no Willpower to call on, black bile wounds them as deep as the necromancer's Stamina. Stamina resists. Costs two blood.
24.9 cells 20 s Read an aura for what it has been feeling, not only what it feels.
1 Willpower Self 4 h Reach into the lands of the dead for four hours per success. Shades from outside the colony within ten cells can be seen and struck.

1 blood Touch 10 s Touch an object and it ages years in a moment: a fifth of its condition per success, and food spoils. Touch someone and it takes their weapon or something they wear. Living flesh is untouched.

1 blood 22 cells 30 s Pull the water out of someone in sight. Each success they can't fight off with Stamina and Fortitude is a wound no armour stops; a vampire loses blood instead while it has any. The agony may leave them unable to act for a moment.

1 blood 4.9 cells 12 h Talk with someone and tie their soul to the caster's for a day a success. Away from the caster they work and fight worse and get no Willpower back, and they resist the caster's mind powers with only half their will.
1 blood Touch 10 s Drip blood on a human corpse in reach and it crumbles to a heap of dust. No body, no evidence.
1 blood 24.9 cells 20 s Mark a colonist's skin with Presence, so that all who see them are swayed.
1 blood 20 cells 15 s Tear the weapon out of someone's hands. It lands at their feet. A living target can resist with Willpower.
1 blood Touch 4 h Touch someone and cool every tie they have. They turn withdrawn and cold, a third less persuasive, for four hours, half a day, a day, two days or four by successes.

1 blood, 1 Willpower Touch 30 s Drip grave-cursed blood on a vampire in reach and its flesh crumbles to ash: an aggravated wound a success, against its Stamina and Fortitude. Costs a blood point and a Willpower point.
1 blood Self 1 h Until dawn, whoever tries to read this vampire's aura may fall entranced.

3 blood Self 4 h Take the shape of one of Set's beast-headed children for four hours: much stronger, much tougher, two points of Willpower more than the vampire usually has, and so frightful that enemies within eight cells who fail to hold their nerve run. Charisma and Social against each enemy's Willpower.
Do As I Say, Not As I Say
24.9 cells 20 s A muddled order sends the target wandering off with no idea what it is doing.

1 blood, 1 Willpower 30 cells 12 h Open a whirlpool on water in sight, a cell across a success. Everyone in it is held for up to four hours, until a Strength roll frees them, and anyone who breathes drowns slowly. Costs a Willpower point too.
1 Willpower 24.9 cells 1 h Pick a victim. For the next hour, if this vampire would frenzy while the victim is within fifteen cells, the victim goes berserk in its place.

24.9 cells 15 s Let the Beast into the face: fangs out, eyes gone animal. A target who loses their nerve runs in terror for a short while, and one who is badly beaten drops their weapon. Charisma and Social against the target's Willpower.

1 blood 4.9 cells 1 day Drain the life out of fertile ground. Until dawn every roll gets two extra dice for each success, as many successes as the soil is rich allows. The ground around turns to sand and every plant on it dies.
1 blood Self 1 h Great ears for a while. Hearing is everything, and strangers are put off.

1 blood Self 1 h Sink into the earth and sleep in it, as the Gangrel do. Safe from the sun and out of reach until dusk or until told to rise. Only on soil, not rock, floors or water. Anyone can dig the vampire out.
1 blood 21 cells 10 s Strike the ground, and the blow bursts up out of the earth under someone up to 21 cells away. It hits like a Surge punch and stuns for a moment.
1 blood Self 10 s Take the shape of a statue until dawn, or until choosing to come back. The vampire can't move or act, enemies take it for a thing and pass it by, and blows do half their harm.
1 blood Self 8 h Draw on the strength of the stone and metal nearby: about an hour and a half a success of much harder blows and a fifth less harm taken.
1 blood 24.9 cells 20 s Lend Potence to a thrall of the colony.

1 blood Touch 10 s Lock a door so that only its own colonists can open it, for a day per point of the caster's Willpower. No prisoner breaking out, slave or guest gets through. Used on a locked door, it opens it again.
1 blood Self 4 h Draw the earth's toughness into the body for four hours. The skin turns to cracked stone, and blows do a third less harm.
1 blood Self 8 h Burn blood and let it harden the dead flesh for four hours: less damage from everything, and nothing staggers the vampire. At Fortitude 5 the sun burns half as hard while it lasts.
Self 1 day Seize a spirit, tear it apart and swallow it. Each success is a point of Willpower back.

24.9 cells 4 h Become, for one person, the most wonderful thing they have ever seen. If it works they stop fighting and trail after the vampire for a few minutes, and think far better of it for days. A faction leader or trader won over this way brings their people round to the colony too. Appearance and Social against the target's Willpower.
1 blood Touch 1 h Work blood venom into a knife's steel so it keeps it. The knife becomes a Quietus blade: anyone who wields it, mortal or not, adds Baal's Caress's venom to their next five hits.

1 blood, 1 Willpower Touch 2 h Smear blood on a thing or a person in reach and make it the fetter of a ghost of the necromancer's choosing, for a day a success. While it lasts, that ghost can always be called.
1 Willpower Self 2 h Everyone of the vampire's own nearby stands firmer against fear and breaks far less easily.

1 blood, 1 Willpower Self 8 h Step bodily into the lands of the dead for a while, about an hour and a half per success. Nobody living can see or target the necromancer, and it can step through up to four cells of wall at a time. It costs blood and Willpower both.
1 blood Self 1 h Ghosts crowd close around the necromancer for an hour. Necromancy rolls gain two dice.
1 Willpower 500 cells 20 s Read the aura of anyone on the map, in sight or not.
2 blood, 1 Willpower Self 10 s For a few moments every blow can be seen and turned aside.

Self 1 day See the patterns under everything for a day: research goes a quarter faster, and the vampire can tell which colonists are close to breaking. Looking that deep sometimes sets off one of its own derangements.

12 cells 1 h Stare into the pattern of one person's soul until it gives up what they hide: their true nature, and whether another vampire's hand is on them, a Sabbat pack's errand, or a hunter's purpose. Perception and Occult. For a day the vampire's own rolls against them get two extra dice.
Self 1 s Let the eyes glow red like the Beast's. At night the vampire hits, dodges and aims better. Up close the glow is hard to explain. Use again to let them fade.

15 cells 10 s Read the marks death has left on someone: what ails and curses them, and with more successes what is likeliest to kill them and how soon. Someone friendly bleeding out within the day can be held back from death for a blood point: the bleeding stops for two hours a success. For a day after, the necromancer's own rolls against them get two extra dice.
1 blood Touch 1 h Look into still water and see who died near it: within twenty cells, back a day, a week, a month, a year or ten years by successes.

24.9 cells 20 s Look at someone with eyes that see magic other than the dead's. A hunter's purpose shows plainly, and so does True Faith. For a day the vampire's own rolls against them get two extra dice.

1 blood, 1 Willpower 24.9 cells 4 h Conjure a solid-looking illusion for eight hours: a wall nobody sees through or walks through, a gun emplacement that draws every shot, or splendour that makes a cellar look like a ballroom and lifts the room's beauty. A blow from someone who resists the illusion ends it. Manipulation and Social against the attacker's Willpower.
1 blood 24.9 cells 20 s Shadows move at the edge of sight, and the target and those around them run.

24.9 cells 20 s Talk to someone whose weakness the Baali knows and turn their fears on them. One success leaves them terrified, two send them running, three knock them senseless. A vampire may shrug it off with its Courage.
1 blood Self 4 h Burn the blood of war for four hours: stronger, faster and tougher. Afterwards it has to be rested off, or every hour on its feet costs a blood point for eight hours.
1 blood 12 cells 12 h Curse a vampire to eat only ashes for a week. Blood comes straight back up, but the ash is enough to wake each night, so it costs nothing to rise.
1 blood Self 40 s Let the fingers grow into the claws of the Beast for four hours: a heavy armour-piercing melee attack whose wounds are aggravated, even to other vampires.

24.9 cells 40 s Speak to an animal in the language of the Beast. One in a rage, like a manhunter, calms at once; any other follows the vampire for three days if it fails to resist, breaking off only to eat and sleep. One of your own animals can be told a role it was never trained in, and does it for six hours. Manipulation and Animals against the animal's will.
1 blood Touch 10 s A touch strips the skin away. Aggravated, at arm's length.
3 blood Self 4 h For four hours the skin turns to flexible stone: blows, blades, bullets and blasts do half damage. Fire and the sun hurt as much as ever.
1 blood Self 1 h Injuries stop showing, and the vampire goes on as if they had never landed.

1 blood Touch 1 h Reshape another body's flesh, if they are helpless, a prisoner, or one of the colony's own: sculpt them lovelier or uglier, change their build, harden their skin into a hide, smooth away old scars, seal their mouth shut, or grow them into living furniture: a chair, armchair, table, lamp or sculpture. Cast on living furniture, installed or packed up, it shapes the person back. Intelligence and Medicine.
1 blood 6 cells 5 s Melt into a wall of rock or stone and come out on the other side, up to six cells away.
2 blood Self 4 h For four hours, all of the vampire's Celerity goes into every blow: melee hits land harder and more often.

1 blood, 1 Willpower 25 cells 2 h Standing by water, raise a straight wall of it across the line to a spot in sight, three cells long a success. Nothing walks through it, and it stands until dawn. Costs a Willpower point as well as the blood.
1 blood Self 2 h Call fog over the land for twelve hours. Aim at range is halved. More successes bring it sooner.
1 blood Self 10 s From the water's edge, glide out across the water like a ghost to a spot up to twenty-five cells away. Deep water is no obstacle.
4.9 cells 1 h Talk to someone and hear the lie in what they say. A thrall of an outside vampire, or a Sabbat plant, is found out. For a day the vampire's own rolls against them get two extra dice.
1 blood 24.9 cells 1 h Mark out a place. For hours, outsiders who enter are slowed by dread.
1 blood Self 3 h Cover ground for hours at a pace nothing mortal could hold, for a fraction of Celerity's price.

1 blood Self 4 h Every brother on the map spends a point of blood and the circle becomes one mind for a while. They see what each sees and aim better for it, and a mind power against any of them meets the strongest will among them.

6 blood Self 1 day Burn six blood to be nearly alive for a day: awake and clear-headed by day, the sun only hurting bare skin and at half, and the Beast quieter. Afterwards it is six nights before frenzy stops coming easily.

1 Willpower Self 8 h Become more corpse than vampire for about an hour and a half a success: no frenzy and no fear, a stake won't hold, and the sun burns half as hard. Whatever is waiting comes back when it ends.

1 blood 20 cells 10 s Twist and split wood with a glance: doors, furniture, walls, bows, a stake in someone's hand. A third of its condition per success. Every wooden weapon in an enemy's hands within sight warps along with it.
500 cells Send the animal to a spot.
1 blood Self 4 h Bind the blade to the hand for a while. Nothing can make the sorcerer let go of it, and nothing knocks it off its stride.

1 blood 20 cells 10 s The soil under someone within twenty cells climbs their legs and holds them, four seconds a success. It only works on someone standing on bare earth. A living target can fight free with Willpower.
30 cells Send the blade to hang over another spot and guard that instead.

1 blood 20 cells 5 s Lift a melee weapon lying on the floor and leave it hanging in the air until dawn. It guards the spot it rose from, or wherever it is sent later, and cuts at any enemy who comes near. The thaumaturge keeps as many going as its Intelligence.
5 blood 24.9 cells 1 h Five blood soaked into the ground leaves a place wrong for fifteen days. Outsiders hate every moment there.
1 blood 29.9 cells 1 h Tie one of the necromancer's shades to a spot, a night per success. Outsiders who come near may panic and flee; the colony's own people are used to it.
1 blood 24.9 cells 20 s Whisper something, and the victim sees the vampire everywhere and can think of nothing else.
1 blood, 1 Willpower 24.9 cells 20 s Show someone what they want the most, and they will stand and stare.
1 blood 22 cells 30 s Breathe a blast of dry heat over someone in sight. It parches them like the desert, a heavy wound, and a vampire loses five blood besides.

Self 1 s Sharpen sight and hearing far past a mortal's. While they're on, hidden Kindred within twelve cells are seen through if this vampire's Auspex beats their Obfuscate, but an explosion stuns. Use again to let them dull.

1 blood Touch 1 h Touch a plant and ask what it has felt pass by. One success tells whether outsiders are on the map, three name their factions, and five point to every one of them, even those who are hidden.
1 blood Self 2 h Call up a gale for twelve hours. Aim at range suffers. More successes bring it sooner.
Self 1 h Hear what a listener wants and say it, and everyone is easier to talk round for the rest of the scene.

2 blood Self 40 s Unfold into the zulo, a towering war-form of claws and bone spikes, for four hours: nearly twice the melee damage, much harder to hurt, faster, and so hideous that enemies within eight cells who fail to hold their nerve run. It can't work or use weapons. Charisma and Social against each enemy's Willpower.

2 Willpower 24.9 cells 12 h Convince one person they are burning, or being torn apart, for four hours. The pain is real enough to drop most people, but no wound comes of it, so nobody dies of it. A vampire who believes it is burning has to master its fear of the fire as well. Manipulation and Social against the target's Willpower.
1 blood 20 cells 20 s The ground opens under someone on bare earth within twenty cells and swallows them to the waist. They are held three seconds a success and crushed every two.
1 blood 22 cells 10 s Rip a heavy chunk of something from the surroundings and throw it at someone as hard as a falling boulder.
24.9 cells 20 s A look that says the vampire knows. The target loses its nerve for the fight.
1 Willpower 24.9 cells 1.44 h Conjure a lone figure at a spot for two minutes. Enemies take it for real and shoot at it, until a blow passes through it and the attacker sees the trick.
24.9 cells 20 s The target loses all interest in the vampire and in the fight.
Self 1 h Never a wrong word: Talk and trade go easier for a while.
1 blood Touch 5 s Grip a wall, a door or a machine and tear it apart like wet cardboard.

1 blood 20 cells 30 s Call up an inferno. Everything near where it lands burns, friend or foe. Five successes put the fire exactly where it was aimed; fewer let it land a few cells off. The caster isn't burned by it, but anything it sets alight is ordinary fire.
3 blood 24.9 cells 1 h Write someone's name in blood on the skin and let them see it. For a day a mortal is sick and weak. A vampire's blood won't answer it for anything but keeping it going.

3 blood Self 5 days Bleed for the spirit-shard until it gives up the name of a great beast, and call it. A thrumbo comes to the map and fights at the Lhiannan's side for three days, then goes back to the wild. Intelligence + Occult at 9.

2 blood Self 40 s Turn blood into a narcotic on the hand or blade. The next melee hit within four hours rolls the vizier's Willpower against the target's Stamina + Fortitude. Each net success lasts longer, from moments to a year, and while it lasts the vizier's mind powers are 2 easier on that target.

2 blood Touch 1 h Touch someone and move time. An enemy grows 1, 5, 10, 50 or 100 years older by successes, and dies within a day if that is past their span. A friend grows that much younger instead, never below adulthood, and the vampire takes a wound per success. Manipulation + Occult at 7.
1 blood Self 40 s Coat the teeth with black bile mixed with blood. The next bite within the hour does twice its harm.

1 blood, 1 Willpower 30 cells 12 h Strike the ground and send a quake out from a spot in sight, a cell and a half wider a success. Everyone in it takes a heavy blow, friend or foe, and buildings shake apart; wooden ones three times as fast. Costs a Willpower point too.
1 blood 24.9 cells 15 s Slow someone's time almost to a stop. They move and strike at half speed, a third with three successes, a quarter with five, for a few seconds a success.
12 cells 1 h Clear walls and gaps in one bound, up to twelve cells.
Self Leave the animal and wake in the vampire's own body.
1 blood 20 cells 5 s Lift the body by will alone and float through the air to a spot in sight, over walls and anything else in the way. A failed roll spends the blood and goes nowhere.
Touch 20 s Talk with the dead where they lie, without calling them up. Touch a corpse or a grave and its ghost tells how it died and who killed it, the same as a summoned one would.
1 blood 30 cells 1 h Bring lightning down on a spot under open sky. Whoever stands there is badly burned. A second roll, Perception and Occult, aims it; a miss lands it a few cells away.
1 Willpower 4.9 cells 1 day A minute's talk that leaves a mind broken for good: a derangement that never goes away. Manipulation and Social against the target's Willpower. Once a day.

Self 1 h Push blood into the skin and lungs to pass as a living person until dawn: warm to the touch, breathing, with colour in the face. Hunters don't see the pallor and low Humanity stops showing. Free at Humanity 8 or more; below that it costs a blood point for every step under 8. A vampire on a Path can't do it.

1 blood Self 10 s Spend a blood point and look hard through the Monocle of Clarity. For an hour, Obfuscate and Chimerstry nearby are seen through as if by Auspex 7: hidden Kindred come out, and other people's illusions fall apart. A roll of Perception and Occult may show what else is hidden around, the dead included; a botch shows something nobody should see, and costs Willpower.
Self 1 h A song that makes everyone near feel what the singer wants. Friends are moved for a day; each success sends a fifth of the foes in earshot running.

3 blood Self 2 h Make something with working parts out of nothing, for three blood: a revolver, a bolt-action rifle or a pump shotgun. It stays, but it is never better than poor, and nobody will buy or smelt it.

1 Willpower Self 12 h Spend Willpower and wear the full majesty of the Blood. Enemies within nine cells who fail to resist can't bring themselves to strike and back away in fear, and friends there feel braver for hours. Charisma and Social against each enemy's Willpower.
24.9 cells 20 s Plant a feeling in a word. For a day, the target's nerves are never quite steady.

1 blood Self 1 h Reshape the vampire's own face and body like clay: more beautiful, less beautiful, thinner, heavier or hulking, or the exact face and build of someone else. A failed roll wastes the blood; a botch tears the flesh. Intelligence and Medicine.
Self 1 s Wear an ordinary mortal face: no corpse-like look, and a Nosferatu passes for human. Or wear one particular person's face and build, after a good look at them. Use again to drop it.
1 blood Self 10 s Take on the look of a corpse until dawn: pale, shrunken and stiff, slower and uglier. Standing still, nobody can tell the vampire from a dead body.
1 blood Touch 10 s Touch another vampire and force the corpse's look on it until dawn: slower, uglier and stiff. It resists with Stamina and Fortitude.
1 blood 22 cells 40 s Seize every enemy within a few cells of a spot and hold them all where they stand, four seconds per success. Each living target can resist with Willpower.
2 blood 2.9 cells 1 h A long, quiet talk that lifts one derangement from someone. It can't touch a Malkavian's own madness, which is in the blood.

12 cells 1 h Look into someone's eyes and plant an order deep enough to be carried out later: leave this place for good, turn on their own friends for a few seconds, or walk to a chosen spot and wait there. Manipulation and Social against the target's Willpower.
1 Willpower 24.9 cells 20 s Meet someone's gaze and hit them from the inside.

1 blood, 1 Willpower Self 12 h Drip blood into water within ten cells and raise undines from it to fight until dawn: one for each blood point spent, up to the successes. Away from water they wear away; in it they mend. Costs a Willpower point too.
1 blood Self 8 h Read the reflexes of everyone in reach. For four hours the vampire hits more often and is hit less.
1 blood Self 40 s Dissolve into mist for four hours. Blows and bullets pass through, and the mist seeps under any door. It can't fight or work, and fire and sunlight still burn it.

1 blood Touch 1 h Trace the moon's sign on a vampire's skin. Until dawn it has the gift of the moon's phase: deft at the new moon, quick-witted at the crescent, sharp-eyed at the half, charming at the gibbous, strong at the full. It also makes frenzy a little harder to resist.
2 blood Touch 20 s A touch that makes flesh slough off the bone. Rot damage for every success, and with enough of them the victim loses looks, then speed, then strength, until the wounds heal.

1 Willpower Self 1 h Scream into both worlds at once, over everyone within a cell per dot of Necromancy. To harm, every foe there takes an aggravated wound a success, and each after the first costs a blood point. To aid, every friend's rolls come easier for a turn a success.
1 blood 9.9 cells 10 s Lend a brother arms, eyes and legs out of this body. For four hours the brother is handier, harder to hit and sharper-eyed, and this one is as much less.

1 Willpower Self 8 h Burn the body of a mortal sacrifice lying beside the bearer, holding the Uraeus, and spend a point of Willpower. If the rite was done right (Intelligence and Occult at 9), the smoke opens a way into the lands of the dead, and the bearer walks there for about an hour and a half per success: nobody living can see or target them, and walls are no obstacle.

1 blood 20 cells 10 s Hurl a handful of fire that bursts where it lands, setting a single spot ablaze. Five successes put the fire exactly where it was aimed; fewer let it land a few cells off. The caster isn't burned by it, but anything it sets alight is ordinary fire.
1 Willpower 24.9 cells 4 h Speak a riddle that shows a listener how small they are against all of creation. If it beats their will, they stand lost in it for up to four hours, or until hurt.
24.9 cells 10 s One look, and the target freezes in terror until someone hurts them: ten seconds per net success. Manipulation and Social against their Willpower.

24.9 cells 20 s Reach into someone's feelings and stir them up into a giddy high, or dull them to grey, for a day. The colony's own allow it; anyone else must fail to resist. Charisma and Social against the target's Willpower.

2 blood 14.9 cells 20 s Stop time around a spot. Enemies there stand frozen for four seconds a success, fires freeze and die out, and food keeps a day longer for each success. The more successes, the wider the circle.
1 blood 24.9 cells 10 s Make one of the vampire's illusions or phantoms last until it is dispelled or seen through.

1 blood Self 1 h Make a simple thing that stays: a wooden stake, a club, mace, spear or knife of wood or steel, or a chunk of granite, for a blood point. It is never better than poor, and nobody will buy or smelt it.
1 blood 12 cells 1 h Leave a Shattering Crescendo hanging over a spot for up to five days. The colony walks through it untouched; the first enemy to step in hears it all at once.
2 blood Self 4 h For four hours the skin is hard as steel. A blade that hits may shatter, and anyone who lands a punch feels it in their own bones.

1 blood 500 cells 1 h Speak or sing into the ear of anyone on the map, wherever they are. A friend takes heart from it; a prisoner or a foe is unsettled by a voice out of nowhere. A prisoner's resistance wears down a little, and a foe in a fight falters for a moment.
1 blood Self 8 h For about an hour and a half a success, blows go into metal armour and wreck it instead of the body under it. Against someone without metal armour they land at half strength.

1 Willpower 2.9 cells 1 day Spend a long meditation making a place a Pillar of Osiris. Anyone who knows Bardo rolls two extra dice within eight cells of it. Once the Child has learned this, every week it goes without a night by a Pillar makes frenzy harder to hold back.
1 blood 25 cells 1.44 h Raise an illusion on a water surface in sight: a decoy, a wall or a turret that draws fire. Anyone who touches it may see through it.

12 cells 2 days Push the vampire's mind into a mortal's body and wear it for half a day, sunlight and all. The mortal is the colony's to command until then, and goes back to its own people after. The vampire's body sleeps, and any harm to it calls the mind home; the host dying stuns the vampire. Manipulation and Social against the target's Willpower. A second roll, Manipulation and Social, decides which of its own powers it can use from there: Auspex with two successes, Presence with three, Dominate and Dementation with four, Chimerstry and blood sorcery with five.
1 blood 24.9 cells 20 s Lend Potence to a colony animal.

5 blood Self 1 day For five blood, make a copy of an animal that lives here. It has no will of its own and guards the caster for three days, then fades. Its fur repeats like a pattern, if anyone looks closely.
1 blood 22 cells 15 s Water rises and wraps round someone standing within five cells of it, holding them four seconds a success. A living target can fight free with Willpower.
1 blood 30 cells 5 s Put the body's speed into a thrown stone. It flies faster than a bullet and hits like a sledgehammer.

1 Willpower Self 2 days Leave the body for eight hours as an unseen double that nothing can touch. It walks where it likes and looks into rooms, but can't work, fight or carry anything. The vampire's body sleeps meanwhile, and any harm to it calls the mind home. Once a projection it can fly out over the world and look into a settlement, finding any court the Kindred keep hidden there. It can still use Auspex, and with three successes on Perception and Awareness the other powers that need no body: Animalism, Dementation, Dominate, Obtenebration, Presence and blood sorcery.

1 blood 24.9 cells 30 s Set someone whose weakness the Baali knows against a phantom of their own darkest self. If their lowest Virtue fails them, the fight hurts as if it were real. A bad failure drives a vampire into frenzy, a mortal into a berserk rage.
24.9 cells 20 s Size up a stranger: How much Celerity, Potence and Fortitude they carry.

1 blood Touch 10 s A touch that rots. Hair falls out, teeth loosen and the skin grows mould. Rot damage and a little of the victim's looks, which a vampire gets back night by night and a mortal never does. A plant just withers.

24.9 cells 4 h Stare down the Beast in someone else. A person who fails to resist wanders off with no will to fight for a few minutes. A frenzied vampire is calmed at once. Manipulation and Social against the target's Willpower.
1 blood Self 2 h Call rain for twelve hours, or snow if it is freezing. Rain puts out fires and dulls the sun a little. More successes bring it sooner.
24.9 cells 20 s The target keeps seeing someone else: a face it trusts, whoever is standing there.
1 blood Self 8 h For about an hour and a half a success, the blade can cut arrows and bullets out of the air. Each success is a better chance to stop each one.

1 blood 24.9 cells 1.92 h Catch someone's mind in a loop of the last quiet moments it lived through. They stand and relive them, four hours for each success, until something hurts them. It won't take hold of someone already coming for the vampire.
1 Willpower 24.9 cells 20 s A mortal stops whatever it was doing and stands there, helpless, for all to see.
1 blood 25 cells 30 s Reach into a turret or mechanoid in sight with the mind and turn it on its own side for five seconds a success. If it is destroyed while held, the shock hits the caster.
1 Willpower Touch 1 h A touch and a moment's concentration close every wound, aggravated ones too. Lost limbs stay lost. Works on the Salubri as well.
Self 1 h Within a week of losing a dot of Humanity, meditate for hours to win it back. It takes every drop of blood in the body, and Conscience against the dot being regained. Once for each loss.
1 Willpower 24.9 cells 1 day Rewrite who someone is. With eye contact and at least as many successes as their Self-Control, one of their traits is swapped for one of the vampire's.

1 blood Touch 10 s Handle a thing and learn whether it is a ghost's fetter. With three successes, whose, and knowing its anchor gives the necromancer a hold on it: that ghost resists Compel Soul with two less Willpower from then on.
1 blood Touch 10 s Unmake something conjured, whoever made it. Aimed at someone, it unmakes everything conjured they carry, wear or hold.
1 blood Self 10 s Become a blur on the wind and fly to any spot under open sky on the map. It can't be done indoors or under a roof.
1 Willpower 25 cells 15 s Stiffen the muscles of someone within twenty-five cells as if they were dead: held four seconds a success. A living target can fight free with Willpower.

1 blood 20 cells 1 h The earth takes someone on bare ground into itself, the koldun too, holds them, and closes a wound a success. An aggravated wound takes two successes. Every wound after the first costs another blood point.
24.9 cells 20 s One barbed remark and the target has nothing to say for a while.
1 blood 3 cells 40 s Lay Scorpion's Touch on the ground as a hidden ward. The first enemy to step on it within five days takes the poison, weak, slow and short of breath for a day.

1 blood 8 cells 40 s Turn blood into a weakening poison on the hand or blade. The next melee hit within four hours leaves the target slow, clumsy and short of breath for a day, and so does drinking from the vampire meanwhile. Aimed at someone within eight cells instead, the vampire spits the poison straight at them.
1 Willpower 24.9 cells 20 s Chain the Beast and set it loose inside someone else. It hurts them from within, and a vampire must fight off frenzy.
1 blood 24.9 cells 20 s Pull the worst thing out of someone's head and show it to them. A mind can stay broken after that.
1 Willpower Self 1 h Feel through the stone for everyone nearby until dawn. Hidden Kindred within twelve cells are found as if by Auspex one dot below the Gargoyle's Visceratika.
24.9 cells 20 s See what a pawn really is, whatever shape it wears.
9.9 cells 10 s Find where someone is weakest: a vampire's lowest Virtue, a mortal's worst trait. The Baali knows them well enough for a day to use it.

1 blood Touch 5 s A touch reads the body: What it is, then with more successes its wounds, its blood and its diseases. The hands stay surer at tending for four hours after, and with two successes the body fights off disease a quarter faster for a day. For a day the healer's own rolls against them get two extra dice.
1 blood Self 10 s Slip half out of the eye for a moment, so attacks land where the assassin no longer is.
1 blood 500 cells 1 h Step through the Abyss to any of the colony's own, anywhere on the map.
1 blood Self 40 s Make the shadows cling and writhe around the vampire for four hours. Bullets and arrows do 40% less damage, and blows find less to hit.

1 blood Self 1 h The vampire's shadow peels off the floor and fights beside it, four hours per success and never past dawn. It hits and is hurt at half strength, except by fire and fangs. If it is destroyed, the vampire loses half its Willpower and must face down Rötschreck. Willpower at 8.
15 cells 10 s Step into one shadow, through the Abyss, and out of another up to fifteen cells away. Walls don't matter; the place stepped into has to be dark.

1 blood 14.9 cells 30 s Raise a corpse, and one more nearby for each success after the first, to fight. They feel no pain and do nothing but fight. They never tire of it: draft them where they should stand and they stay there, as long as the necromancer lasts, until something cuts them down.
1 blood Self 10 s Become a huge bat for half a day: very fast and hard to hit, with a weak bite. Clothes and gear come back with the vampire's own shape.

3 blood Self 1 h Swell into a hulking half-beast until dawn: twice as fast, with claws and jaws whose wounds are aggravated, hitting harder and harder to hurt. It can't work or use weapons, frenzy is 2 harder to resist, and Willpower won't help.
1 blood Self 10 s Become a great wolf for half a day: fast and deadly with its jaws, but unable to work or use weapons. Clothes and gear come back with the vampire's own shape.

2 blood Touch 1 h Work a corpse's flesh into something useful: a suit of fleshcrafted armour, or clothes and furniture of human leather. Intelligence and Crafting. The corpse is used up even if the work fails.
3 blood, 2 Willpower 24.9 cells 12 h Horrid Reality on a crowd: the target and every enemy within four cells of them, each resisting on their own.
3 blood, 1 Willpower Touch 4 h Press a drop of blood onto someone's forehead and lend them the vampire's toughness: they take half damage for four hours per success. Stamina + Survival at 8.
1 blood 24.9 cells 20 s Lend one of the colony's own, living or dead, some of the master's strength.

1 blood 12 cells 10 s A song, even a lullaby, that splits skin and cracks bone in one listener up to twelve cells away. Each success is an aggravated wound no armour stops. Stamina + Artistic against the target's Stamina and Fortitude.
1 Willpower Self 10 s Body and stubbornness soak together for a few moments, against anything.

2 Willpower Self 5.76 h For a few minutes, an unseen ring three steps wide surrounds the vampire. An enemy who steps into it is thrown back and stunned, unless its will beats the vampire's by a long way. Guns still reach in.

1 blood 29.9 cells 2 h Thicken the shroud around a spot. Other necromancers' ghosts within a dozen cells are banished for a month, and the necromancer's own shades on the map stay a day longer per success.
1 blood Self 20.8333 s A pocket of nothing closes around everyone of the vampire's own within three cells.
1 blood 24.9 cells 30 s Call up the darkness of the Abyss over a spot, four cells across each way. Nobody sees through it or shoots well inside it. Only fire still burns in it.
Self 1 h Look through the shroud between the living and the dead. For a dozen cells around, walls no longer hide what is behind them, and the haunted places on the map are counted.

1 blood Self 4 h Swallow all sound within six cells of the vampire for a few minutes. The first blow on anyone inside who isn't already fighting does double damage and leaves them reeling for two seconds.
24.9 cells 30 s Sing someone into madness. If the song beats their will, they gain a derangement for a night, and a night more for each extra success. It leaves when the song wears off.

Self 1 s The skin takes on the colour and grain of whatever is behind it. The Gargoyle is hidden as by Obfuscate, moving or still, until it attacks. It can't start with an enemy watching. Use again to show itself.
3 Willpower 24.9 cells 20 s Three Willpower, and a colonist's aura is remade. Nobody can read it for a week.

1 Willpower Touch 1 day Feed on the dead. Aimed at a ghost in reach, drink it dry, as good as blood, and it is gone. Aimed at the necromancer itself, draw a blood point from each death close by in the last day, up to four. Once a night.
24.9 cells 20 s Paint what someone is. A vampire's Path and Virtues, a mortal's state of mind.

1 blood 9.9 cells 1 h Tear the soul out of a living mortal. The body lies comatose and the soul walks as the necromancer's shade, eight hours for each success beyond the victim's Willpower. If the body dies meanwhile, the soul is left behind as a free ghost that frightens everyone near it.

1 blood Touch 1 h Touch a plant and it grows a fifth of the way to harvest per success. Touch something wooden, or someone holding a wooden weapon, and the wood rots a fifth of its condition per success.
Self 20 s Catch the scent of the undead: names every vampire on the map.

24.9 cells 1 h Take everything someone knows. They stand empty, and the Kiasyd has their two best skills at their level, for four hours to a season by successes. Perception and Social against their Willpower.
1 Willpower Self 8 h Spend a point of Willpower to shut the pain out for four hours. Wounds still slow the body down, but they no longer hurt or knock the vampire down from the pain.
1 blood Self 2 h Call a thunderstorm for twelve hours, or hard snow if it is freezing. Lightning falls where it will. More successes bring it sooner.
1 blood Self 8 h For about an hour and a half a success, every blow meets its target as bare flesh: Fortitude and every other unnatural toughness do nothing against it.
1 blood Self 8 h Let the blood guide the hand: for four hours, blows land far more often.

1 blood 24.9 cells 2 days Pour the vampire's mind into an animal for eight hours. The vampire's own body falls asleep where it stands, and any harm to it calls the mind back. The animal takes orders like a colonist: right-click to send it somewhere or set it on someone, or use its buttons to go, attack or let go. A wild animal has to fail to resist first. Manipulation and Animals against its will. A second roll, Manipulation and Animals, decides which of its own powers it can use from there: Auspex with two successes, Presence with three, Dominate and Dementation with four, Chimerstry and blood sorcery with five.

1 blood 22 cells 1 h Meet someone's eyes and let loose a desire they keep buried: a binge, a sulk alone, a tantrum, a spree of insults. It lasts four hours, half a day, a day, two days or four by successes.

1 blood 500 cells 4 h Call one person, and they will come. Anyone on the map heads for the vampire, wherever they are. Cast on the vampire itself, it reaches anyone the colony has met elsewhere: they walk in from the edge of the map, come to the vampire, then go about their business, or attack if they are an enemy. The colony's own come at once; anyone else has to fail to resist. Charisma and Social against the target's Willpower.

1 blood Self 12 h Call a spirit out of the element at hand until dawn: a salamander from a fire within ten cells, a sylph under open sky, a gnome from the soil underfoot, an undine from water within ten cells. More successes make it stronger and harder to master. A botched mastery turns it on the caster; a failed one lets it run wild.

1 blood 5.9 cells 20 s Call a ghost back to its corpse, or to a grave, for eight hours. It says how it died and who killed it. A colonist's last words reach the people it loved; an outsider may give away a hidden stash. Someone the necromancer killed, or someone the colony killed cruelly, comes back to haunt it instead.

1 blood Self 1 h Call the spirit of an animal that lives here into a body of flesh. It guards the caster for an hour, two hours, four hours, a day or a week by successes, and fades when hurt badly enough.

3 blood Self 1 day A blasphemous rite calls one of the masters' servants into the world. It fights for the vampire for a night. Nothing in the rite sends it back, so for its last hour it turns on everyone.

1 blood Self 10 s Make a simple thing of one material out of nothing: a wooden stake, a club, mace, spear or knife of wood or steel, or a chunk of granite appears at the caster's feet. Its quality follows the successes. It is gone in a day.
3 blood Touch 1 h Trace the sun's sign on a vampire's skin, the caster's own or a friend's. Until dawn, sunlight and fire do half their harm to it.

1 blood Self 8 h Burn blood into the muscles and hit with the strength of the Blood: melee blows land much harder for four hours. From Potence 3 they stagger, from 4 they stun, and at 5 they hit twice as hard again.
1 Willpower Self 1 day Whatever they saw, they decide it was a trick. Manipulation + Social at 7; one to five successes clear 5, 10, 25, 50 or every Masquerade witness on the map.
24.9 cells 20 s Every hurt the target takes for the next hour feels far worse.
30 cells 5 s Fly to a spot in sight: Six cells for every dot of Flight.

2 blood 10 cells 5 s Breathe a fine red mist at someone within ten cells. Four dice against their Willpower: each success strips a point of Willpower for a day, and any success counts as a drink of the vizier's blood. A target stripped bare is charmed by the vizier for a while.

1 blood 10 cells 5 s Spit a gout of the Assamites' poisoned blood at someone within ten cells. It eats flesh like acid and keeps burning for a few seconds after it lands, and its wounds are aggravated.
1 blood 10 cells 5 s Spit the Assamites' poisoned blood at a spirit or a demon-touched target within ten cells. It works on nothing else.
1 blood 999 cells 1 h Send the mind through the wires to any machine on the map, seen or not, and work Burnout, Encrypt or Remote Access on it, whichever the caster knows.
1 blood 20 cells 20 s Seize someone with the mind and hold them where they stand, four seconds per success. A living target can resist with Willpower.
500 cells 20 s An order given in the mind, with no word spoken and no eyes to meet.

500 cells 1 h Reach into a mind anywhere on the map. One of the colony's own is steadied for four hours and breaks less easily. Anyone else gives up what they're thinking about and, if they came with a group, what the group plans and when it moves. Reading another vampire costs a point of Willpower. Perception and Social against the target's Willpower. For a day after a reading, the vampire's own rolls against them get two extra dice.

1 blood, 1 Willpower Self 1 day Call a thunderstorm: It arrives in six hours, an hour sooner a success, and rages four hours a success. While it lasts the koldun can bring lightning down on a foe for a Willpower point. Costs a Willpower point to call.

1 blood Self 40 s Become living shadow for four hours. Nothing physical can touch it and it slips under any door, but it can't strike a blow or work, and sunlight and fire burn it half again as hard. Other powers still work.
24.9 cells 20 s See the magic worked on a pawn, as Aura Perception sees a mood.
1 blood 12 cells 1 h Speak the crone's curse to a vampire. Until dawn it is hideous, and nobody can be talked round by it.

12 cells 15 s Catch someone's eyes and hold them. They can't move for as long as the vampire keeps staring, up to a minute; any other order breaks the gaze. Mortals can't resist. Another vampire rolls its Willpower against the vampire's Appearance and Social.

12 cells 1 h Reach into someone's memory and cut something out: everything bad the vampires have done to them, or the whole of the last day. The colony's own allow it; anyone else must fail to resist.
1 blood Self 10 s Become a huge black cobra for half a day: quick, hard to hit, with a venomous bite, but unable to work or use weapons. Clothes and gear come back with the vampire's own shape.
1 blood 24.9 cells 1 h Set phantoms on someone for three days: bad sleep, sudden frights, and now and then a fit of terror. Manipulation and Social against the target's Willpower.

Self 1 h Cut out the vampire's own heart and set it down to be hidden. While the heart is away, no stake can paralyse the vampire and its frenzies are two steps easier to resist, but destroying the heart destroys the vampire. With the heart in hand or at its feet, use again to put it back. Another vampire's heart can be taken by surgery.

29.9 cells 10 s Throw the voice to any spot in sight. Enemies near it who have nothing better to do go to see who is talking. One already fighting turns to look too, unless it resists: Manipulation and Social against its Willpower.
4.9 cells 4 h Whisper a riddle that takes over someone's mind. They stand and think about it, four hours for each success, and only harm breaks them out of it.
1 blood, 1 Willpower Self 4 h Grow scales and venomous fangs for four hours: much better armour, a poisoned bite and a little more dodge, at the cost of a horrible face.

Touch 10 s Handle a thing and feel what was done with it. A corpse gives up its killer, who stays read for a week (rolls against the killer get two extra dice), and a sealed casket gives up what sleeps inside.
Self 1 s Let out a long forked tongue that strikes in melee and drinks half a point of blood from every wound. Use again to draw it back in.
2 blood Self 1 h Grow lean and hunched, with slitted eyes and claws whose wounds are aggravated. Much stronger and quicker, and monstrous to look at, for four hours for each point of Willpower.

1 blood 15 cells 10 s Pull someone's blood out of them in a stream through the air, a point for each success, from up to fifteen cells away. It feeds the vampire like drinking does, but never creates a blood bond. Nobody who sees it will mistake it for anything natural.
1 Willpower 24.9 cells 20 s Pull a running Discipline effect off a target and take it for the rest of its time.
Touch 10 s Strike a shade as if standing among the dead. Anyone else's shade is banished for a month. One of the necromancer's own is cowed into serving a day longer per success.
1 blood 24.9 cells 1 day Pour the Malkavian madness into another mind: three derangements at once, for five days. Manipulation and Social against the target's Willpower.
Self 1 h Feel how close the lands of the dead lie here, from the deaths nearby. Where three or more died close by, the necromancer gets a die more on every roll for six hours. Once an hour.
14.9 cells 10 s Make a corpse twitch, sit up or mutter a word. Outsiders nearby may panic and flee, and the colony's people are unsettled.
1 blood 20 cells 10 s Yank someone's feet out from under them with an invisible hand. They go down for two seconds per success. A living target can resist with Willpower.
24.9 cells 20 s The target sees someone they love and won't raise a hand against them.

1 blood Touch 40 s Touch someone and add ten years to their age for each success. They can resist only by beating the caster outright. Aged far enough past a natural lifespan, a mortal crumbles. Kindred only look withered for a night.
3 blood Self 2 h Take the shape of Set's own beast: stronger, tougher and faster, with claws to match.

24.9 cells 1 day Draw a willing vampire's soul into the third eye and mend it. They sleep a day and wake with a point of Humanity back, up to their Conscience plus Self-Control. It costs the Salubri a dot of Willpower for good.
24.9 cells 20 s Read a target's aura for a day's advantage, the way Aura Perception does.
1 blood 12 cells 12 h Curse a vampire with the dark of the Angel of Death for a week. Any well-lit spot burns it, a little every few seconds.

1 blood 12 cells 1 day Speak the long verse against diablerie, nine seconds of it. For a week the vampire is back at the generation it had before it ever drank another's soul: a smaller pool, less blood a turn, lower limits.

Self 30 s Vanish in the middle of a fight, in plain sight. Enemies within six cells are dazed for a moment, their minds unsure of what they just saw. Mortals within fifteen cells who saw it may forget the vampire was ever there, and are no longer witnesses: Charisma and Social, and the successes have to beat each one's Willpower.
1 blood Touch 4 h A touch, and an enemy drops out of everyone's notice, their own side included. For four hours they are unseen and wander about lost. Wits and Social against their Willpower.
2 blood Self 2.88 h The third eye opens, icy blue, and guides the next blow. Within a few minutes, the vampire's next three melee attacks land and do double damage.

1 blood Self 1 h Among thick plants, weave a dome of branches round the caster and sleep in it. It keeps out the sun and anyone the caster doesn't let in, until it chooses to come out. Needs at least eight plants within three cells.
1 blood Self 2 h The siren's song for a whole crowd: every enemy within earshot has to fight off the madness. A blood point covers five listeners, and one more for every five after.

1 blood Self 12 h Speak in a voice that unhinges everyone who hears it. Every person within eight cells, friend or foe, who fails to resist flies into a rage or runs in terror for a few seconds, and the vampire's own Beast stirs. Manipulation and Social against each listener's Willpower.

1 blood, 1 Willpower 30 cells 12 h Lava bursts from the ground at a spot in sight and spreads two cells round, for nine seconds a success, then cools. Anything in it burns. Costs a Willpower point too.
8 cells 1 day Believe in an illusory bridge or rope long enough to cross it. Once a day.
1 blood Self 2 h Borrow strength of blood from the circle: for four hours, a generation lower for every other brother on the map, never past the fourth.

1 blood Self 1 h The ground splits round the koldun and molten rock wells up in a ring three cells out, for six seconds a success. Anyone who walks into it burns badly, while the koldun inside the ring is safe.
1 blood Self 4 h Scream to the night and steel the heart for four hours: the fear of fire and sun comes a die harder, and minds are a point of Willpower harder to bend.
1 blood Self 1 h Sink into water and sleep under it, safe from the sun, as Earth Meld does into soil. It takes two successes.
24.9 cells 20 s Lay bare what someone lives by: a vampire's Path and Virtues, a mortal's state of mind.

Touch 12 h Whisper someone's name in their ear and let a breath of bile in with it. Unless they fight it off with Willpower, nightmares and mutterings plague them for days equal to the necromancer's Manipulation: poor sleep, slower work and a die less on every roll.
1 blood Self 4 h Move like the wind for four hours, out of the way of blows before they are thrown: far more blows dodged.

1 Willpower Touch 30 s Touch an arm, a leg, an eye, an ear, the tongue or the face, and wither it: two aggravated wounds, and the part is useless until they heal. A withered eye is blind, a withered tongue mute, a withered face ugly. A mortal never heals them.

1 Willpower Touch 30 s Touch an arm or a leg and shrivel it. It takes three successes; fewer only bruise. A mortal's limb stays useless unless it is replaced. A vampire's fills out again after a night.
Self 1 h See the dead who still linger here: who died on this map, how, by whose hand, and where. Each one can be found on the map from the letter.
1 blood 24.9 cells 20 s Hide a colony animal from every eye.

1 blood Touch 10 s Talk with the spirit of a thing about what it has seen. A corpse gives up its killer, who stays read for a week (rolls against the killer get two extra dice), and a sealed casket gives up what sleeps inside.
1 blood 4.9 cells 20 s Mould three wounds shut with bare hands, on any of the colony's own.
1 Willpower 24.9 cells 20 s A cursed gift: The target's luck turns into bruises and broken bones.

1 blood 12 cells 10 s Speak Zillah's verse to a vampire and hear who holds it: everyone it is blood bound to, and everyone it shares a Vinculum with. Until dawn those bonds give their holders no hold over it and it can raise a hand against them, and an outsider's thrall hidden in the colony is found out.

Every setting in Options, Mod settings, The Rim by Night, with what it does. Setting What it does Vampires sleep by day Off, a vampire keeps a mortal's hours: it sleeps at night, works by day, and is never drowsy or hard to draft in daylight. Its schedule resets to a mortal's when you change this. The sun still burns unless that is off too. The sun burns vampires Off, sunlight does a vampire no harm and never sends it into Rötschreck, and it walks out under the sky like anyone. Orders come before shelter A vampire you wake or give an order to by day (prioritized work or any other right-click order) does it while it stays under a roof, then goes back to bed. On, it keeps at the order even out in the sun. Off, it drops an order that takes it into the sun to get under a roof or into bed. Either way, work it picked up on its own is dropped for shelter, and the red fear still takes over. Sunlight damage How hard the sun burns a vampire caught outside by day. At 0% it does no harm at all. Blood used each night The blood a vampire burns to wake each evening. Lower it if feeding takes up too much of the colony's time. At 0% they only need blood for healing and powers. Blood to heal The blood a vampire spends to mend a wound. Lower it and a feeding goes further in a fight. Torpor length How long a vampire sleeps in torpor, which depends on its Humanity: a day at 10, a month at 1. A torpor sentence set by a court stays as it is. Frenzy difficulty Added to the difficulty of every frenzy and Rötschreck roll. Above zero the Beast gets loose more often, below zero less. Conscience difficulty Added to the difficulty of the Conscience roll after a sin. Above zero, vampires lose Humanity more often; below zero, less. Mercy wins Humanity back Once a week, a vampire on Humanity who captured a downed enemy or recruited a prisoner rolls Conscience against its Humanity plus one. On a success it wins back a dot. Not in V20, where only experience buys Humanity back. At Humanity 0 What happens to a colony vampire whose Humanity falls to 0. Lost: it becomes a wight, turns on everyone and is never yours again (V20). Frenzy: the Beast rides it for a few hours, then lets go at Humanity 1. Rehab: it becomes a wight, but if you down it and hold it in a cell it rolls Conscience once a week, with extra dice for a colony vampire with Obeah on the map, and a success brings it back at Humanity 1. Powers camera shake How hard big powers shake the camera: a lightning strike, a volcanic blast, the earth opening. At 0% the camera stays still. Powers sky flashes Big powers flash the sky in their colour, and storms tint it while they build. Off, the sky keeps its own light. Pale skin Show a vampire's skin drained to an ashen grey. It looks like any living person's again while it looks alive or wears the Mask of a Thousand Faces. Cappadocians are paler still. Only the look changes; hunters spot the pallor either way. How pale How far a vampire's skin is drained toward ashen grey. Blood heals mortal scars Off, a vampire keeps the scars it had when it was Embraced, and blood heals only the ones since. On, blood heals those old scars as well. Humanity Off, sins never cost Humanity or a Path's rating, and every vampire counts as at Humanity 7: no dice cap by day, no inhuman looks, no beast dreams, no fall to the Beast at 0. Frenzy and Rötschreck Off, the Beast never takes over. Vampires and ghouls don't frenzy or flee in fear, and fire nearby doesn't drive them back. A power used on purpose can still send someone into a frenzy. Clan weaknesses Off, no clan or bloodline has a weakness, and ghouls take no taint from their domitor's clan. Turning it back on brings them back. Soften clan weaknesses Each clan's weakness still applies, in a milder form. Breaches have consequences Outsiders who see a vampire at work carry the story away, and the world reacts: warier visitors, then hunters, then the hunting order. Turn off to play without any of it. How much a breach counts How much each sighting adds to the colony's Masquerade breach score. How fast breaches fade How quickly the world forgets what it saw. Higher numbers bring the breach score down sooner. NPC Kindred How often vampires from outside the colony turn up: in the dark at night, in cryptosleep caskets, in rogue bands. 0% turns them off. Extra courts in a new world Every world gets one court of each sect and a haven for each Independent clan. This many more courts go to sects at random. Read when a world is made, or when the mod is added to a save. Court mission offers The chance each hour that a court posts a new mission, until it has three open. The default of 5% comes to about one a day; 0% stops new ones. Sleepers in ancient dangers The chance that one casket in a new map's ancient danger holds a Kindred instead of a soldier. Also scaled by the NPC Kindred setting. Psylinked Tremere With Royalty, the chance that a Tremere met outside the colony has a psylink of level 1 to 3. Its psycasts are random, from every psycast loaded, Vanilla Psycasts Expanded's paths included. At 0% none do. Wights come back A vampire lost to the Beast who escapes the map returns now and then as a night threat. The Red List A handful of Anathema the Camarilla wants destroyed roam the world map, each with a bounty. They roam either way, but only a colony in the Camarilla is told of them, sees them on the map or is paid for one. Turned off, they leave the world map; turned back on, a new list arrives in one letter. Sect politics Archons, Sabbat packs and Anarch gangs sent against the colony, infiltrators, thralls of outside Kindred, Anarch unrest, Assamite contracts, Setite corruption and Tremere hit teams. Kindred attacks Rogue bands, elder raids, and the angry dead coming back to haunt the colony. Kindred visitors Kindred at the door, Path mentors, the occult trader, the ghoul black market, the anonymous benefactor and revenants asking to join. A stranger at the door A colony with no vampire gets a pale stranger at its door by night, some time between day 15 and day 40, and again every 30 to 60 days until one is taken in. Off, the stranger only comes by chance. Scourges Camarilla courts seat a Scourge, who comes after colony vampires of the 14th generation and higher, and a colony with its own domain can name one. Off, nobody is sent and the office is gone from the domain page. Sire calls A sire out in the world calling on its childe with demands. Background world Courts changing by themselves while you play: coups, rival schemes, blood hunts and cities changing sect. Switched off, the courts stay as they are. Koldunic Sorcery for any clan Any vampire can learn the Ways of Koldunic Sorcery from a teacher, at the out-of-clan price. Off, only the Tzimisce and their bloodlines can. Sanguinus for any clan A Discipline that only its clan can learn (Sanguinus, the Blood Brothers' shared flesh) can be taught to anyone. Its powers that work through a circle of brothers do nothing for a vampire without one. Gargoyle rite for any clan Any vampire who knows rituals can learn the rite that makes a gargoyle. Off, it stays a Tremere secret. Ghouls learn guarded Disciplines A ghoul can learn Protean, Thaumaturgy and a Discipline only one clan has from any domitor who knows it. Off, only from a domitor of that clan. Ghouls study lore A ghoul reads lore books and treatises under Research work like a vampire: experience, treatises for the Disciplines it has, and rituals a ghoul can cast. Off, ghouls leave the books alone. Ghouls get a full character sheet The Ghoul tab gains a page list down its left side, with the Virtues on its Sheet page and an Attributes page: Virtues, Willpower and Attribute dots a ghoul buys with its experience, at a vampire's prices. They count in its rolls. Off, a ghoul keeps a mortal's Willpower and Attributes, plus whatever it has already bought. Caitiff learn their sire's Disciplines easily A Caitiff learns only its sire's Disciplines at the in-clan price, and one with no known sire takes the three of a random clan. Off, a Caitiff counts every Discipline as its own. New powers start off the bar A colony vampire's new powers stay off the command bar until you turn them on in the Kindred tab. Off, each new power gets its button at once. Any Discipline self-taught Any Discipline a vampire could take lessons in can be bought with experience alone, at the self-taught price. A clan's own sorcery stays closed unless its own setting opens it. Off, as in V20, only Celerity, Fortitude and Potence can be learned without a teacher. Out-of-clan experience cost Multiplies what each dot of an out-of-clan Discipline costs, taught or self-taught. Clan Disciplines and a Caitiff's cost the same either way. Chance to take a Discipline dot The chance a diablerie gives the diablerist a dot of one of the victim's Disciplines, if the victim had more of it. Not in V20, where diablerie gives only generation. Neonates can give a dot A neonate's blood can give a Discipline dot too. Off, only ancillae and elders have blood old enough. Diablerie opens the victim's Disciplines Every Discipline the victim had, and the diablerist could learn, can be bought with experience afterwards as if a teacher had started it. Not in V20. Each diablerie risks a derangement Every soul eaten makes the next harder to keep down: each diablerie after the first has a 10% chance of a derangement for every one before it. Not in V20. The Pyramid guards Thaumaturgy The colony's Tremere owe the Pyramid a yearly tithe, and a vampire of another clan seen casting Thaumaturgy by a Tremere or the Camarilla brings a Tremere hit team. Off, neither happens. A childe needs the Prince's leave In a sect that keeps the Traditions, a colony vampire who holds no office needs a permit to Embrace, and a childe made without one costs standing when the court meets it. Off, no permit is needed. Hunger frenzy lasts until fed A vampire in a hunger frenzy only comes back to itself once it has fed enough or its time runs out. Off, it may pass early, like any other frenzy. Draft vampires freely by day A vampire can be drafted by day with no roll and no blood spent. Off, it has to stir first: a roll with a threat on the map, or a blood point. Resonance The vessel's mood colours the blood a vampire drinks, giving a few bonus dice to the Disciplines that match it. Taken from the fifth edition; V20 has no such rule. Off, blood is only blood. Hemogen runs on vitae A vampire with Biotech's hemogen genes pays for hemogen powers from its vitae pool, and anything that gives hemogen fills the pool instead. Off, the hemogen bar is its own, filled and drained the vanilla way. Move as a cloud A drafted vampire on the move, or a hostile one closing in, travels as a faint cloud of its strongest Discipline, and faster. Off, vampires walk like anyone else. Needs fighting motion on. Hunters among tavern guests The chance that a guest at the colony's tavern is a hunter, from a strong Masquerade to a broken one. The mod's chances run from 5% to 40%. At 0% none come this way. Blood market Vials, Kindred vitae and hemogen share one price that moves: hunter raids, blood hunts, the Scourge and a breach push it up, and selling a lot brings it down. Off, they keep their plain market value. The lure A raiding vampire with Summon or Entrancement may call a lone colonist out past the walls before the raid comes in.
