The Rite of Contrition makes amends While the colony has a Garou, tonight's moon shows beside the clock at the bottom right. Click it for the moon calendar.

Most menus open a list beside the window you clicked in, or above the gizmo. A long list has filters down the left with a count beside each, and Can pick only hides what can't be had yet. Click a row to read about it on the right, then press Choose, double-click it, or press Enter. A greyed row says under it what's missing. A list with nothing to read takes the row on one click.

The book button in the bottom-right corner, beside vanilla's play settings, opens the grimoire: a panel on the right edge that leaves the game running. It covers the alerts and letters while it's open, and its X closes it. It holds every tribe, breed, auspice, Gift, rite, totem, fetish, merit, item and creature the mod adds, made from the game's own data, with this guide in the Garou chapter. The setting "Grimoire", under The Rim by Night: Core in the mod settings, hides it. - Selected shows what to do about whoever or whatever you have selected, and links to read more. It changes as you select something else. A vampire or Garou hiding among your prisoners shows nothing of what it is. - Ask looks through every chapter. A question works ("how do I step sideways"): each answer shows the sentence it found, and clicking one opens that part of the page. - Browse lists every chapter, with a "what to do" section at the top of each mod's. - Gold, underlined words open their own page. Back returns to the page before. - The info button beside a page's title opens the game's own card, with every stat. - From the game: click a row on the Garou or Kinfolk tab, right-click a Gift's icon, or press the ? beside a tab heading. - The book opens where you left it until you restart the game.

With The Rim by Night: Kindred loaded too, vampires and werewolves share a world. Garou call vampires leeches and count most of them creatures of the Wyrm.

- Embracing a Garou is offered, and the confirmation names the odds: the Garou is drained to death and almost never rises. The rare exception is an Abomination (see the Abominations page). A Garou deep in Harano, or of a fallen tribe, may ask for it. - Ghouling a Garou spends the vitae for nothing. No blood bond takes a Garou. - Kinfolk can be ghouled and Embraced. The Embrace ends the kin blood, so a vampire never goes through the First Change.

- The Wyrm's smell. A vampire below Humanity 7, or on a Path, smells of the Wyrm. It counts as the Wyrm for everything that reads it: Sense Wyrm, Fangs of Judgment, the Gifts that only touch the Wyrm, the kinfolk's First Change, and double experience for the kill. A vampire with Humanity 7 or more reads as "something dead that walks, but not the Wyrm's". - Damage. Garou claws and bites are aggravated to vampires. Fire is aggravated to both. - Drinking a Garou. Each point gives a vampire two vitae, and leaves them on edge: frenzy and Rötschreck come harder to resist, and they're quick to pick a fight, until it wears off over a few days. The Garou gains three Rage and rolls for frenzy. - Minds. Dominate and Presence work on a Garou, but not one in frenzy or the Thrall, and a Garou resists with Willpower plus Rage. Garou Gifts roll against a vampire's own Willpower. - The Delirium doesn't touch vampires, except the Gift Terror of the Dire Wolf.
Gifts, fetishes and rites that touch vampires

What Against a vampire Halo of the Sun Burns the undead within 18 cells Calm, Calm the Savage Beast End a vampire's frenzy, at three successes and one Song of Rage Drives a vampire into its own frenzy Take the True Form Ends any other shape, a vampire's Protean forms among them Dam the Heartflood For a few seconds a success, a vampire or ghoul can't spend blood, and a ghoul's blood stops healing them Renew the Cycle A contest of Gnosis against Willpower. A win is Final Death. Costs a Gnosis a century undead Break the Bonds Ends blood bonds, Dominate's conditioning, Presence and every other mind bond Fangs of the North, Claws of Frozen Death The vampire's blood can't close wounds for a day Rending the Craft Ends Disciplines that are on Thieving Talons of the Magpie Steals a Discipline The d'siah Three aggravated levels more Rite of Cleansing, Rite of the Opened Sky Can't wash out what a vampire is; they leave it in agony for an hour

A colony can hold both, and it's tense. - Each Garou thinks less of the colony for each vampire in it, twice that for one that smells of the Wyrm. Red Talons, Get of Fenris, Wendigo and Silent Striders mind it half again as much; Glass Walkers and Bone Gnawers half as much. - A Garou rolls for frenzy when a colony vampire feeds in sight, once a day at most. - Vampires within 12 cells of the colony's Garou are uneasy. - The septs lose 2 goodwill a day while the colony keeps both. - A Garou who strikes someone fighting the colony's vampire breaks the Litany's "Fight the Wyrm", once a day. - Opinion between a Garou and a vampire can still grow as any colonists' does.

- Hunters hunt both, armed for every kind the colony holds: silver for Garou, faith and training for vampires. - The Masquerade and the Veil are separate scores, kept from one list of witnesses. Someone who saw both counts on both. - The Black Spiral and Sabbat raid: a rare raid by night of Black Spiral Dancers with a Sabbat vampire for each 400 points of the raid, up to three.
Each mod's enemies in the other

- A Garou pack hunt comes to a colony with vampires and no Garou: a pack of Garou gathers at the map edge. A vampire with Humanity 7 or more can go out to talk them down, from the letter: Charisma plus Social against the pack's best Willpower. They leave, or attack at once. - A leech sighting comes to a Garou colony with no vampire: by night a rogue vampire walks in, feeds on a sleeping colonist and leaves. Sense Wyrm finds it while it's there. These answer to Kindred's attack setting, and the combined raid to "The Wyrm attacks" as well.

Each side names the colony's pawn who hurt its own, for two quadrums or until that pawn dies: - A colony vampire who feeds on or kills kinfolk is named by the nearest sept. While they're on a home map, the pack hunt comes three times as often, even to a colony with Garou, and its letter names them. - A colony Garou who destroys a court's vampire, or the childe of one of its members, is named by that court. Its sect's raids come as often as in a blood hunt, and its stalkers strike at the named Garou first. In the background, septs and courts within 30 tiles of each other fight now and then: a sept's raid destroys one of the court's vampires, never its ruler, or the court's ghouls strike the caern for a level. A pack is two or more Garou bound to one totem spirit.

1. Open a Garou's tab, Pack page, and press Form a pack.... 2. Pick a totem. Each shows the Totem dots it needs. 3. That Garou leads the Rite of the Totem. Every free Garou of the colony on the map gathers for it, and those in the circle when it ends form the pack. Their Totem dots together must reach the totem's cost. A Garou can also Join a pack... that already exists, or Leave the pack.

- Rage when a packmate within 15 cells is hurt. - A better mood within 10 cells of each other. - The totem's gifts, while the Ban holds: stat changes for every member, Renown once on joining, and for some totems a shared Willpower pool, Rage each lunar cycle, faster learning or changed Renown awards. - Shared Willpower, for totems that have it: a member below 2 Willpower draws a point at a time. The pool refills every lunar cycle. - A shared fight: packmates go for the same enemy. - Stepping sideways together: packmates within 6 cells cross on the same roll. - A chronicle on the Pack page: who joined, left, died, broke the Ban.

Each totem asks something of its pack. The game checks these: Totem Ban Falcon No member may lose a dot of Honor Boar No member may kill a wild boar Griffin No Homid may join Rat No member may kill vermin, the smallest animals Raven No member may carry silver or gold The rest are shown and kept on trust. A broken Ban takes away every gift of the totem, with a letter. Make amends on the Pack page leads the Rite of Contrition; if it works, the gifts come back.

A pack starts with its totem's name. The first deed worth 3 Renown or more in one award earns it a name of its own from the sept, such as "the Ash Walkers": a line in the chronicle and a point of Glory for every member. It happens once per pack.

At each lunar cycle there's an even chance the totem sets the pack a task, told in a letter and on the Pack page: slay a Wyrm creature, hunt a wild beast at least the size of a person, take a foe alive, tend someone, lead a rite, pay chiminage or sense the Wyrm. The packmate who does it gains 2 Renown for the deed, and the pack is in the totem's favour, with a full Willpower pool, until the cycle ends. A task left undone lapses at no cost.

The pack's leader is whoever won the last challenge, or else the highest rank, then the most Renown. In peacetime, a packmate of the alpha's rank or higher can Challenge the alpha: the alpha picks a duel or a staring match, and the better roll wins. A Garou who frenzies in a duel loses it and a point of Honor. Packmates start challenges on their own now and then. No challenges while enemies are on the map. Now and then a Get of Fenris or Silver Fang Ahroun of the Nation, of the colony's strongest Garou's rank or one higher, comes to test them. The contest is the alpha challenge's. A win is 2 Glory and a loss costs 1. Turning the challenger away costs 2. It only happens while the Nation isn't hostile.

Totem Kind Background cost What it is Falcon Respect 5 The noble hunter of the high air. His packs earn honor and lead well, and draw on a store of resolve when they flag. Grandfather Thunder Respect 7 The proud and fearsome lord of storms. His packs carry themselves well and are hard to stare down. Pegasus Respect 4 The winged guardian of wild places. Her packs have a way with animals. Stag Respect 6 The horned lord of the forest. His packs run far and live off the land. Bear War 5 Strong, patient and a healer. His packs gain his strength and his touch, but the Garou frown on those who seek out the werebears' patron. Boar War 5 Too angry to back down and too stubborn to die. His packs are hard to put down. Fenris War 5 The great wolf of the end of days. He wants packs that bleed their enemies often. Griffin War 4 The hunter who mourns every lost species and blames humans for them. His packs see far. Rat War 5 The quiet raider who bites and runs. His packs strike from hiding and share a store of resolve. Wendigo War 7 The hungry spirit of the winter storm. His packs carry a cold fury that never runs dry. Chimera Wisdom 7 She of many faces, keeper of riddles. Her packs grow wise by puzzling things out. Cockroach Wisdom 6 Quick, hardy and everywhere. He knows the ways of machines and the people who build them. Owl Wisdom 5 The silent watcher who knows the secrets of death. His packs move unheard. Raven Wisdom 5 The clever scavenger who always finds a meal. He provides for packs who trust him. Uktena Wisdom 7 The old water spirit of dark places, who knows secrets other totems don't. His packs learn quickly but are hard to warm to. Unicorn Wisdom 7 The spirit of peace and healing. Her packs mend wounds and quarrels alike. Coyote Cunning 7 The trickster of tricksters. His packs sneak, bargain and survive, but wisdom earned with him counts for less. Cuckoo Cunning 6 The master of slipping in unnoticed. Her packs talk their way anywhere, and are honored less for it. Fox Cunning 7 Sly and quick, a talker and a thief. His packs get by on their wits, and are honored less for it.

Kinfolk are humans and wolves of Garou blood who never Changed. They know what the Garou are, the Delirium doesn't touch them, and a frenzied Garou goes for them last. Select one and open the Kinfolk tab. Each has a tribe and a blood: weak, true or strong.

- Blood relatives of a Garou are kin half the time, at creation and later. A baby born to a Garou is always kin of its parent's tribe. - Kinfolk of a tribe come to join a colony that has a Garou, and so do wolves of the tribe. - The Kinfolk family and pack scenarios start with them. The setting "Kinfolk events" turns the joiners and lost cubs off.

Once a sept has made contact, the colony's kinfolk get a settlement of their own, a friendly faction 3 to 6 tiles from home. It trades as a sept does, and kin join the colony twice as often. Now and then the village calls for help: a Pentex outpost 1 to 3 tiles from it. Clear it, and the village thinks better of the colony. Let the offer run out, or accept and let the 15 days run out, and the village is destroyed. It never comes back, and every Garou and kin colonist takes it hard.
Join a pack... on the Kinfolk tab lets kin stand with a pack. They share its company and its chronicle, but not its totem's gifts.

Kinfolk who live in ordinary towns can still answer to the Garou. They show on the Contacts page of the Sept tab, under the town they live in. There are two ways to get them: - When a caravan with one of the colony's Kinfolk stands at a town, Kinfolk: live here leaves them there for good. - When the colony first meets a sept, a few of its families turn out to live in the towns nearest it. Blood holds them, so they never drift away, but they go down with their town. Once a week each can be asked for one favour: - Goodwill: they put in a good word, and the town's faction thinks better of the colony. - Wyrm word: they pass on what the town whispers, and a Pentex site or a fouled factory near the colony comes to light.

Some kinfolk could still Change. Nobody knows which until a colony Garou has spent three days within 12 cells of them; then the Kinfolk tab says whether the wolf could still wake, or that it never will. Until then the tab shows how much longer it takes. For one who could, four moments can force it, each only once: - being close to death; - facing a creature of the Wyrm; - seeing a loved one killed; - a caern rite performed within 20 cells. The chance each time is 10% for weak blood, 25% for true, 50% for strong. The setting "Kinfolk who Change" scales it. The Kinfolk tab lists which moments are still open. The Change is violent. The kin tears into Crinos, frenzies for a short while, and the Delirium hits anyone in sight who doesn't know. They become a Garou of their tribe, their auspice set by that day's moon, a cub of rank 0 with one breed Gift. A wolf that Changes becomes a Lupus Garou. A cub needs the Rite of Passage to become a Cliath.

Now and then a young Garou turns up alone after a First Change they don't understand: Homid most of the time, sometimes Lupus, rarely Metis. They come as an offer in the Quests tab, open for two days. Accept it, and they arrive at the map edge as a cub, half the time with hunters or the Wyrm on their heels. Taking one in pleases the septs. Let it run out, and they're gone. A colony with no Garou at all can get a stray cub instead, more rarely: the same youth, but nobody there knows what they are, so the offer only speaks of a hurt stranger at the edge of your land with something following them. Taken in, they're the colony's first Garou. The stray cub has its own slider on the Event chances page.

Tame animals can learn more than guard and attack. The extra roles show on the vanilla Training tab, are taught by a handler over several lessons, and fade the same way when nobody keeps them up. Each needs guard (obedience) first. Role Who can learn it What it does Guard post body size 0.4 or more Holds a spot you pick with its Guard post button (or right-click, Guard this spot), and goes for any enemy within 8 cells of it Watch any Raises the alarm when it sees an enemy, day or night, and wakes everyone asleep. Once an hour Sniff out an animal with a nose Barks at anyone within 12 cells who hides what they are. A pawn hidden by a power shows for an hour; a guest or prisoner in disguise is known for good Track after sniff out Follows a trail you pick with its Track button: a fled prisoner, quarry marked for hunting, an enemy unseen. It stays close and sniffs them out Scouting a bird that really flies Circles a spot, shadows someone, or flies out over the land and comes back with what it saw Messenger a flier, or body size 0.3 or more Tends one of your town contacts, or asks an allied town for a trade caravan on the comms console's terms (15 goodwill, once every four days) Hunt a predator Once a day brings back one or two small animals from round here, about half of them still alive Fight beside after attack Defends its master without an order, and fights better at their side for an hour Spirit scout a familiar only Looks across to the spirit side for three hours, once a day, and comes back with what waits there Selected, a trained animal shows a line to its guard post or to the one it's tracking. The kennel (Misc tab) takes up to six of your animals: they learn half as fast again and forget at half the rate. Name a kennel master on it, and that colonist trains the kennel's animals before any other handling work. A wolf bonded to a Garou counts as a familiar: it learns twice as fast, forgets at half the rate, and can learn spirit scout, which looks into the Penumbra and counts the spirits there. Members of your sworn sept sell trained wolves, raised among the Kinfolk. Ask for a trained animal is on each member's row, paid with the favours that member owes you: a trivial favour counts 1, a minor 2, a major 3 and a life debt 4. An animal costs 1, plus 1 a role, plus 1 for every 500 silver it's worth, and comes by drop pod.

A tavern counter (Furniture tab) works for a Garou colony too. Its Guests button lets in the nearest known, friendly sept's Kinfolk, and its Garou by tribe, besides townsfolk. - On a caern's map the tavern is a Kin lodge: Kinfolk guests stay half as long again, and now and then one settles in the nearest town as a new Kinfolk contact. - A party of Garou guests sometimes tells of a Wyrm nest near the colony. - Garou hate Kindred, the Black Spirals and fomori, and smell what a guest is. Get of Fenris and Red Talons hate the mortals as well. Mark the counter as neutral ground for the Litany's truce: a Garou who kills under it leaves for the sept's judgment. ← Garou contents · The Rim by Night This is not official World of Darkness material. Garou The Rim by Night: Garou brings Werewolf: The Apocalypse, 20th Anniversary Edition, to RimWorld. Your colonists can be Garou: werewolves of the thirteen tribes, with five forms, Rage and Gnosis, Gifts taught by spirits, rites, packs and totems. Around them are kinfolk, caerns, the spirit world next door, and the Wyrm and its servants. This wiki covers everything in the mod: how being Garou works, the tribes, breeds and auspices, every Gift, rite, totem and fetish, each tab and menu, the events, and the settings. > In development. Balance will change and bugs are likely. Keep a backup of any save you add > the mod to.

Every alert this mod can show on the right of the screen. Alert What it means Rage running high These Garou have enough Rage, under tonight's moon, that the next wound or insult could set off a frenzy. Keep them away from trouble or let them rest. Gnosis spent These Garou have no Gnosis left, so Gifts that cost it and stepping sideways are out of reach. It comes back by meditating, by staying near a caern, and all at once from a Sacred Hunt. Harano drowning These Garou are sunk so deep in Harano that one of them may walk away from the colony for good. Keep them with their pack, hold the moot, and spare them more losses until it eases. Silver weapons Enemies here are carrying silver. Silver hits Garou harder and leaves aggravated wounds that don't regenerate. Keep your Garou at range, or take these enemies down first. Totem Ban broken This pack broke its totem's Ban and has lost every favor the totem gives. The Rite of Contrition makes amends. Garou seen by outsiders These Garou are in Crinos or Hispo while outsiders are on the map. Anyone with the will to keep their wits who sees them becomes a witness to a breach of the Veil. Shift back to Homid, or keep them out of sight until the visitors leave. Gift ready to learn These Garou have the rank and experience for a new Gift from their own lists. A sickly green fire that gives off no heat. It burns in the Wyrm's places and nowhere else.

A place where the Gauntlet wears thin and the world beyond shows through. Stepping across is easier here, and possible even for a Garou with no Gnosis left. A Garou resting by it slowly regains Gnosis.

Every health condition, state and effect a pawn can carry, as shown on its Health tab. Condition Bad What it does Abomination A Garou who rose from the Embrace. The wolf is still here, with its forms, its Rage and the Gnosis it had left, but Gaia is gone. It heals only with blood, its Gnosis never comes back, and both Garou and Kindred want it dead. Acute sense Eyes sharper than most Garou have. Adaptation At home anywhere: no poison, disease or weather troubles it. Ancestor's guidance An ancestor spirit guides this Garou's hands and memory, lending a skill it had in life. Animal control Gives a wail too high for people to hear. Wild animals nearby come running and fight on its side. Apecraft's Blessings Tools answer this hand better. Apeskin Lives as a Homid for a day: silver no worse than steel, and no regeneration. Apeskin A Homid ancestor rides with the Garou. Armored hide Leathery hide, scales or an oozing slime that blades slide off. Armored skin Wounds that should cut deep only bruise. Takes a quarter less damage from everything. Assimilation Fits in anywhere, among anyone. Attributes Strength, wits and the rest, each dot above a mortal's average worth a little, more at a higher rank. The war forms add to the physical ones. Aura of Confidence Sure of themselves. Bad sight Yes Poor eyesight that no regeneration fixes. Balance Always on their feet. Balor's agony Yes Doubled over in pain under a terrible glare. Balor's Gaze A glare that doubles foes over in pain. Bane inside Yes A bane got inside this person when it struck them. It is working its way into the mind and then the body. In a day they will belong to the Wyrm, unless a Garou drives it out with the Rite of Cleansing. Bane-glass A watcher spirit looks out of the glass. Bane-glass sight Sees the Umbra's edge through the glass. Bane-ridden Yes A bane has crawled inside this animal and drives it. It's stronger than it should be, it hates everything alive, and where it dies the ground will be tainted. Baneskin Banes take the Garou for kin. Barbed wound Yes Torn by barbed claws. It hurts to move. Battle Mandala A burning sigil around the Garou that drains spirits. Bear's favor Bear lends this pack his strength and his healing hands, though other Garou think less of them for asking. Beast mask The wolf's shape, held by the mask. Beast Speech Talking with animals. Berserker It has Rage like a Garou and none of the wisdom to hold it. Hits harder and faster, and a wound can send it into a frenzy. Beyond Human People find the Garou more striking, more important and more worth listening to. Black Mark The next foe the Garou wounds will be haunted. Blissful Ignorance Unseen while standing still. Blood of the North Cold can't touch the Garou. Bloody Feast Strong from the taste of blood. Hungry for more. Blur of the Milky Eye Hard to keep in sight. Blurred mirror Yes The Gauntlet stands like a wall. No stepping sideways. Boar's favor Boar makes this pack too stubborn to fall and quick with their fists. Body Shift Flesh shifted from where it isn't needed to where it is. Body wrack Yes Wracked with pain. Everything is harder. Body-barbs Blades of bone grow out of its joints. Brain eating Goes for the head and gnaws. Whoever it hits in melee is left dull and slow to learn for days. Breath of Gaia A morning breath taken in Gaia's honor. The body fights off sickness a little better. Breath of the Wyld Mind wide awake. Brother's Scent Smells like a friend. Burning Blade A weapon wreathed in fire. Burrow Claws and hands made for digging. Burrowing claw Yes A claw left burrowing in the wound. It digs deeper every few seconds. Bury the Wolf The wolf is buried. The Garou looks human to every sense, causes no Delirium, and can neither shift nor spend Rage. Caern of Enigmas The caern's riddling power sharpens the mind. Caern of Leadership The caern lends the Garou the bearing of a leader. Caern of Stamina The caern's endurance runs through the body. Blows land softer. Caern of Strength The caern's might fills the arms. Blows land harder. Caern of the City The caern teaches the ways of streets and markets. Caern of Wisdom The caern's old wisdom makes every lesson easier. Camouflage Blends into the wild. Cancerous carapace Growths and scaly blotches that harden into armor when it's angry. Catatonic terror Yes Saw something the mind refused, and shut down. It passes in an hour or so, and little of it will be remembered. Catfeet Light on its feet as a cat. Cause insanity Babbles in the Wyrm's own tongue, or lets its body twist into shapes no mind should see. A colonist who meets its eyes in a fight may lose their grip for a while. Chains of mist Yes Bound in mist. Slow and clumsy. Chameleon Blends into whatever is behind it. Chameleon skin Fur that blends with the land. Channeling Rage poured into every blow. Chaos Mechanics Rage and Gnosis come together without strain. Chilled Yes Frozen by a wind out of nowhere. Chimera's favor Chimera sets riddles before this pack, and they get better at solving them. Circular Attack Turns aside a blow for each success left. City Running Moving through the city like a native animal. Clarity Sees through glare, dark and illusion. Claw wound Yes Deep gashes from a werewolf's claws. Claws and fangs Talons, quills, spurs or a jagged proboscis. They leave wounds like a werewolf's, the kind that heal slowly. Claws of Frozen Death Claws of ice. Cleansing agony Yes The rite tried to wash the Wyrm out of this body, and found nothing else there. It burns. Clenched Jaw Whatever the Garou bites, it holds. Cockroach's favor Cockroach knows machines and wires. This pack learns them fast. Cocoon Sealed in a hard, chitin shell. Blows that aren't heavy enough do nothing, and fire, hunger and cold don't reach. Coils of the Serpent Yes Wrapped in unseen coils. Combat Healing Heals twice as fast. Cornered Rat's Ferocity Fighting like a cornered rat. Coup de Grace The weak spot is found. The next blow lands double. Cowed Yes Too shaken by a Gift to raise a hand against anyone. Cowing the Bullet Made weapons are reluctant to hurt the Garou. Coyote's favor Coyote teaches this pack to sneak, to haggle and to get by, though nobody takes their wisdom quite seriously. Crinos The war form: nine feet of muscle, fur, claws and teeth. Clothes and guns fall away, though a blade still fits the hand. Claw and bite wounds are aggravated. Mortals who see it suffer the Delirium. Cuckoo's favor Cuckoo helps this pack talk their way in anywhere. Honor comes harder to them. Cup of the alicorn Poison turns harmless in the Garou's cup. Curse of Hatred Yes Eaten up by a hatred with no target. Cut shadow Yes Their shadow is open to the Garou's blows. D'siah A cobra spirit coils in the blade. Dagger of retribution A vengeance spirit points the way to the Garou's enemies. Darksight Sees as well in pitch dark as in daylight. Daunted Yes Unnerved by a werewolf's snarl. Shaky hands and a weak swing. Dazzled Yes Half blinded by a werewolf's silver light. Den parent Raises the sept's cubs. The colony's cubs and kinfolk on the same map learn faster while the den parent is with them. Den parent's care The sept's den parent is watching over them, and they pick things up faster. Desperate Strength Strength from desperation. Diagnostics Sees what is wrong with machines. Disquiet Yes Listless and low. Rage won't come back, and work drags. Dominated Yes Treats the Garou as their alpha and fights for them. Doppelganger Wears someone else's face, voice and scent. Their own people take the Garou for one of them until it attacks or shifts. Dream stealer The Garou can watch other people's dreams. Dulled blade Yes The blade in hand will not bite. Durance A talen's spirit can be held for a point of Gnosis. Early frost Yes Frozen to the bone. Slow at everything. Echoes of wrath Knows exactly which buttons to push. A colonist near it in a fight may snap and lash out at anyone close. Endurance of Heimdall Twice the endurance. Exoskeleton A gnarled, bony shell with ivory growths. Stronger and harder to hurt. Extra limbs Extra arms, tendrils or a long tongue, bent at the wrong angles. Eyes of the Cat Sees as well in pitch dark as in daylight. Fair Fortune Luck is on the Garou's side. The next failed Gift is tried again. Falcon's favor Falcon watches over this pack. Others find it easier to follow them. Falcon's Grasp The next blow holds fast. Falling sideways Yes Falling through the Gauntlet. Fang dagger The next wound bites twice as deep. Fang dagger A snake spirit waits in the fang. Fangs of Judgment Claws that burn with the law. Fangs of the North A freezing bite. Feathered cloak A bird spirit lifts the Garou. Fenris' Bite The next bite maims a limb, or with enough strength tears it off. Fenris' favor Fenris hungers for this pack's battles. They hit harder and more often. Feral mind Yes Reason burned away. What's left thinks like a beast. Fire ward The klaive's fire spirit turns flame aside. Flame Dance Too quick to hit. Fog on the Moor A ghost of fog. Only silver touches it, and it can't heal. Fomor A bane rode this person until it changed them, body and mind. The Wyrm's gifts came with a price, and the price shows. A Garou can smell it from across a room. Fomori don't suffer the Delirium. Foreseen Saw what's coming. The next failed Gift is tried again. Forge-Crusher The hammer blazes with fire. Form Mastery Shifts with ease. Fox's favor Fox makes this pack sly talkers and quiet movers. Honor comes harder to them. Frozen wound Yes A cold that won't leave the flesh. Slower, and the wound won't knit. Fury Rage loosed into the fight: blow after blow, faster than a man can strike. Garou A werewolf, one of Gaia's warriors. The wolf's fury and the spirit world both run in the blood, and the moon stirs them. Gift of the Porcupine Fur turned to quills. Anyone who strikes the Garou bare-handed gets a fistful. Gift of the Spriggan Grown to giant size. Gift-born madness Yes A mind pushed past its edge. Breaks come easily. Glabro The near-man form: taller, heavier and hairier, with thick nails and bad teeth. Clothes and armour still fit, just. Mortals see an ugly brute and nothing worse. Gnaw Jaws that crush steel. Gnawed mind Yes A fomor got its teeth into this person's head. Thinking is slow and nothing new sticks. It wears off in a few days. Gorge Holds three more Rage than the rating. Grand klaive A fire spirit rides with the war spirit. Grandfather Thunder's favor Grandfather Thunder rumbles behind this pack's words. They command a room and know how to behave in one. Greeted the moon Luna heard the howl. The Garou is steadier for it. Griffin's favor Griffin hunts beside this pack. Their eyes are sharp and little gets past them. Guardian Watches the sept's borders, and sees and hears a little more than the rest. Halo of the Sun Blazing like the sun. Blows burn, and the undead nearby smoke. Halt the Coward's Flight Yes Legs like lead. Hand Blade A hand like a blade. Hands Full of Thunder Shooting faster. Harano Yes A grief for the dying world that some Garou never climb out of. Every loss sinks them deeper, and only time, rites and the pack bring them back. Hard of hearing Yes Misses sounds that others catch. Harmonious Unity The war form's strength and healing in human shape. Harmony flute A songbird spirit sings for the Garou. Haunted Yes Ghosts at every corner. Nerves fray and sleep won't come. Heart Claw The next claw that lands breaks off and burrows in. Heart of Fury Holding the Rage down. When this ends, it all comes back. Heart of ice Yes Insides turning to ice, a little more every few seconds. Heart of the Mountain Endures anything. Heightened senses Sharper sight and hearing than any human. Held fast Yes Caught in a grip that will not let go. Held in form Yes Held in one form. No shifting until it passes. Hero's Stand Rooted to the spot until every foe is down. Hispo The dire wolf: a prehistoric beast as big as a horse. Fast and heavy, with a crushing aggravated bite and no hands. Horns of the Impaler Spiral horns of chitin grow from the skull. Howls in the night Yes A howl still ringing in the ears. No rest while the Garou are on the prowl. Huge size Huge in every form, and takes blows that would stagger anyone else. Hunted Yes Marked by the Hunt. Every Garou who sees this one knows what they did, and whoever brings them down is honored for it. Hunting Prayer The spirits were asked for a good hunt. The Garou stalks a little quieter. Immune to Wyrm emanations The Wyrm's poisons barely touch this Garou. Inner Light Steps sideways by the light within. Inspiration Fights with a werewolf's courage. Invisibility Unseen. Iron resolve Will tempered like steel: the next Gift lands harder. Ironhammer A war spirit rides in the hammer. Jackdaw's tongue Yes The Rite of the Jackdaw has loosened this Garou's tongue. Every private, petty secret comes tumbling out to anyone nearby, and it rarely goes down well. Jammed gun Yes The weapon in hand refuses to fire straight. Jarlhammer Spirits of war and silver ride in the hammer. Kali's Tongue Yes Wounds won't close. Kinfolk Family of the Garou. The wolf's blood runs in them, but it has never woken. They know what the Garou are and don't fear them. Kiss of Helios Fire can't touch the Garou, and their blows burn. Labrys of Isthmene A war spirit rides in the axe. Lambent Flame Burning with silver light. Lame Yes Bad legs and a heavy limp. Laugh of the Hyena Laughing off anything that tries to get into their head. Ley Lines The ley lines lead pursuers astray: once no foe can see the Garou, they lose it. Liar's Craft Every lie sounds like the truth. Lightning Reflexes Moves before others think. Long vigil Yes This Garou sat the Long Vigil and heard the year's battles told again. They're hungry for the fights of the long nights ahead. Long-distance runner Runs fast and keeps it up. Luna's Armor Shielded by the moon. Luna's Avenger Luna's champion: silver can't hurt the Garou, and the Garou's blows burn like silver. Luna's Blessing Under a visible moon, silver is no worse than steel. Lupus A wolf, bigger than most. Twice as fast as a man, with the keenest senses of any form. Outsiders see only a wolf. Magpie's swag A bag that holds far more than it should. Man's Skin Mortals see nothing to fear. Manifested A spirit that has forced its way across the Gauntlet. It can't hold its shape here for long. Mark of the Wolf Yes People keep their distance without knowing why. Marked Yes A werewolf has found the weak point. Blows land harder. Master of Fire Fire treats this Garou as one of its own. Master of the Rite Keeps the caern's rites. Leading a rite on a map with a caern, rolls one more die. Merciful Blow Blows leave no wounds, but enough of them knock a foe out. Merciful daze Yes Beaten senseless without a mark. Mercy Pulling every blow. Messenger's Fortitude Runs without tiring. Might of Thor Thor's strength: twice as strong. Mindblock A mind closed to psychic powers. Mindspeak Sharing a waking dream with the pack: they see each blow coming for one another, but the dream slows their hands. Mired Yes Stuck in a bog. Slow, and clumsy in a fight. Mirrorshades A mirror always to hand. Stepping sideways is easier. Monkey puzzle Seen as an ordinary person, whatever the form. Monkey puzzle A trickster hides the wolf. Monkey Tail A prehensile tail, as good as a third hand. Moon glow Luna watches over the journey. Spirits leave the Garou be. Moon-tooth edge The Lune in the knife guides each blow. Moon-tooth knife A Lune sleeps in the knife. Nauseated Yes Retching from a werewolf's stench. Noxious breath Breathes out fumes that eat at the lungs of anyone close. Noxious fumes Yes Breathed in a fomor's fumes. The lungs burn. Nyx's bangle The night hides the Garou when asked. Nyx's veil Masked by the night. Odious Aroma An overpowering stench. Open wound Yes A wound that won't stop bleeding. Open Wounds The next wound the Garou deals keeps bleeding. Ostracized Yes The pack has turned its back on this Garou. Until the moon turns, their packmates act as if they had no such brother or sister. Owl's favor Owl keeps this pack quiet in the dark. Pack Tactics Fighting as one pack. Pack unity Close to a Silver Fang who holds the pack together. Para Bellum Ready for war. Partridge wing Can sweep away a memory. Pathfinder Finds the quick way through anything. Paws of the newborn cub Yes Helpless as a newborn pup: no Gifts, no shifting, no healing. Pegasus' favor Pegasus carries this pack. Animals trust them and learn from them quickly. Pentex agent Works for a Pentex front company and leaves the Wyrm's mark wherever it stays. Perfect Recall Remembers everything. Persuasion People find it hard to say no. Phoebe's veil Gone from every sense but touch. Phoebe's veil A lune can hide the Garou. Pinned with silver Yes Silver spikes through the hands and feet. A Garou pinned like this can't rise or change until someone carries it to a bed and draws them out. Prayer for the Prey The prey was thanked. Nothing of it goes to waste. Predator's Arsenal Teeth and nails sharper than they should be. Preternatural Awareness Feels every blow coming. Prey Mind Always ready to bolt. Protean Form Extra claws, limbs and teeth wherever the Garou wants them. PUDA A bee spirit files everything. Pulse of the Invisible Always half aware of the spirit world. Rage-stone A little fury waits in the stone. Rat's favor Rat teaches this pack to strike from hiding and slip away. Their bites land more easily. Rattler's Bite Venom in the fangs. The next bite poisons. Raven's favor Raven shows this pack where food is to be found, so long as they don't hoard. Razor Claws Claws honed to a razor's edge. Reach the Umbra Steps sideways at once, with no roll and no mirror. Redirected pain Yes Feels the wounds of the Garou who cursed them. Rending the Craft The next blow tears away the foe's magic. Resist Pain Feels no pain. Resist Temptation Hard to sway. Resist Toxin Hard to poison. Runestones A spirit of time reads what's coming. Sanctuary chimes Chimes in the wind keep hostile spirits away. Sanctuary chimes Chimes that ward off spirits. Saw a Crinos Has seen a werewolf in its war form. Scabwalker curse Yes Anything man-made blisters the skin: clothes, weapons, floors. Scent of Running Water Leaves no trail. Scent of Sight Smells what others see. Scent of Sweet Honey Yes Covered in buzzing insects. Seer's warning The stars have shown what comes next. When it comes, the Garou will know it. Seizing the Edge A tied contest goes the Garou's way. Sept leader Leads the sept. When the leader is at a moot, everyone takes more heart from it, and the leader gains 1 Honor. Serenity Perfect calm. No Rage, no frenzy. Shadows of the Impergium The old terror walks. Shell Walled off from the world: no magic touches the mind, and no Rage can be spent. Shield of Rage A fury that makes lesser spirits quail. Spirits hit softer. Sidestep Death A blow that would bring the Garou down misses, for three Willpower. Sight From Beyond Prone to visions of what is coming. Silence Makes no sound. Silver burn Yes A wound from silver. On a Garou the flesh around it blackens and smokes, and it won't regenerate. Silver Claws Claws of burning silver. They hurt the Garou too. Smell of Man Animals take this one for a master. Song of Heroes Filled with the strength of old heroes. Speech of the world Speaks any tongue, with an outsider's accent. Speed Beyond Thought Running faster than thought. Starving when it ends. Speed of Thought Running at twice the speed. Spirit Friend Spirits like the Garou. They ask no price. Spirit of the Fray Always first to act. Spirit snare Yes Tangled in an unseen net. Fights and dodges badly. Spirit Speech Understands the speech of spirits. Spirit tracer The ingot pulls toward spirits. Spirit traps Carries jars, fetters and a bound net for catching spirits. Break them and whatever is inside goes free. Spirit Ward A warding sign that burns spirits who come close. Spirit whistle A screech owl wails at the Garou's call. Spur Claws Barbed claws that catch and tear. Stag's favor Stag runs with this pack. They cover ground tirelessly and know how to live off the land. Steel Fur Fur of steel. Stoking Fury's Furnace Every wound feeds the Rage twice over. Stolen dream Knows what someone else dreams of. It makes them easy to talk round. Stolen power A power taken from someone else, until it slips back to them. Strength of Gaia The wolf's full strength. Strike the Air One foe can't land a blow on the Garou. Striking air Yes Can't land a blow on the Garou who cursed them. Summoned Called by a Gift. Fades when its time is up. Sun whip The whip blazes with sunlight. Sun whip A flame spirit waits in the whip. Survivor Hardened against hunger, cold and wounds. When it ends, the Garou needs sleep and food. Sworn oath Gave their word before a Philodox and went free on it. Talesinger Keeps the sept's tales. While someone holds this seat, every deed of the colony's Garou worth 2 or more Renown is worth 1 more. Talons of the Falcon Claws that cut bone like paper. Thousand Forms In the shape of an animal, with its speed and its bite. Any shift ends it. Totem banished Yes The totem can't reach this Garou, and the pack's bond is cut: it fights alone. Totem pleased The pack did what its totem asked this cycle, and the spirit runs close beside them until the moon comes round again. Trackless waste Yes Lost in wild country that won't let them through. Trick Shot A sure shot. Troll Skin Skin like stone. Truth earring No lie gets past the Garou. Truth of Gaia Hears every lie. Truthcatcher Judges the sept's disputes. A title of respect, with no other effect. Uktena's favor Uktena shares hidden lore with this pack. They learn faster, but other Garou find them hard to warm to. Umbral Camouflage Hidden from spirit senses. In the Penumbra the banes don't notice the Garou until it strikes. Umbral Dodge The next to strike at the Garou in melee falls through the Gauntlet. Umbral Tether A silver cord back to where the Garou entered the Penumbra. Unbroken cord The pack is bound together. Uncaught Since the Primal Morn Faster than anything that chases. Under the gun Yes Shots find this one easily. Unicorn's Arsenal Every blow leaves a mark. Unicorn's favor Unicorn makes this pack gentle healers and good listeners. Unity of the Pack Holds the pack together. Veil parted Sees the Garou as they are and keeps their wits: no Delirium, ever again. Venom Blood Blood like acid. Whoever draws it gets burned. Visage of Fenris Looks bigger and more terrible. Visceral agony Yes Every wound hurts twice as much. Visceral Agony Every wound the Garou deals hurts twice as much. Voice of the jackal Yes This Garou speaks in a shrill, grating whine that nobody wants to hear, until the ritemaster lifts the punishment. Warder Guards the caern. Gains 1 Rage each hour while enemies are on the caern's map. Water stride Crosses water as easily as open ground. Wendigo's favor Wendigo's cold anger is in this pack. The cold bothers them less and their fury runs deep. Werewolf bite Yes A torn bite from a werewolf's jaws. Whelp body Yes A curse that left the body weak as a newborn pup's. It doesn't wear off. Wind Claws Claws that cut through armor like air. Wind snorkel Breathes anywhere. Wind whistle A cold wind answers the whistle. Wind's Returning Favor The next foe to swing a weapon at the Garou loses it. Wisdom of the Ancient Ways Ancestors whisper what they knew. Withered limb Yes A limb gone weak and twisted. Wolf at the Door Yes Something is out there, waiting. Words of the dead Learned what the dead knew. Wyrm Hide Skin hardened into a leathery hide by a bane's favor. Wyrm taint Yes The Thrall of the Wyrm left something behind. Spirits shy from it and other Garou smell it. Each fall makes the next one likelier, and the last one takes the Garou for good. Wyrm-bloated The Wyrm has got into this animal. Every event the storyteller can send, what it means and what to do about it. Most can be switched off or made rarer one by one in the mod settings. Event Kind From day Again after What happens A Garou asks to be taught Event A Garou of a known sept asks one of yours to teach it a Gift or rite: one lesson a night by right-click. All lessons given earns Honor, Wisdom and the sept's goodwill. A Garou chased by fomori Event 15 A wounded Garou of a known sept, fomori an hour or two behind, asks to be let in for a day. The fomori follow; if the Garou is alive at the end of the day, the colony gains Honor and the sept owes you aid. A Garou pinned with silver Event 15 20 days A Garou of a known sept has been pinned with silver and left at the map's edge for hunters. Carry it to a bed and the silver comes out: Honor, and its sept owes you aid. The hunters come looking. A maimed Garou asks for a doctor Event A Garou who lost a part to silver, which no regeneration closes, asks your best doctor to make it whole. Right-click it with the doctor to operate: Honor, goodwill and the sept's aid. A moot to host: Concolation Event 30 days The septs offer you a Concolation, the great gathering of the Nation, to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Grand Moot of the Bone Gnawers Event 30 days The Bone Gnawers offer you their Grand Moot to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Grand Moot of the Children of Gaia Event 30 days The Children of Gaia offer you their Grand Moot to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Grand Moot of the Fianna Event 30 days The Fianna offer you their Grand Moot to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Grand Moot of the Furies Event 30 days The Black Furies offer you their Grand Moot to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Grand Moot of the Get of Fenris Event 30 days The Get of Fenris offer you their Grand Moot to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Grand Moot of the Glass Walkers Event 30 days The Glass Walkers offer you their Grand Moot to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Grand Moot of the Red Talons Event 30 days The Red Talons offer you their Grand Moot to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Grand Moot of the Shadow Lords Event 30 days The Shadow Lords offer you their Grand Moot to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Grand Moot of the Silent Striders Event 30 days The Silent Striders offer you their Grand Moot to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Grand Moot of the Silver Fangs Event 30 days The Silver Fangs offer you their Grand Moot to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Grand Moot of the Stargazers Event 30 days The Stargazers offer you their Grand Moot to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Grand Moot of the Uktena Event 30 days The Uktena offer you their Grand Moot to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Grand Moot of the Wendigo Event 30 days The Wendigo offer you their Grand Moot to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: Hearing Event 30 days A sept writes to offer you a Hearing to host. At most once a year. A moot to host: moot of the neighbours Event 30 days A sept writes to offer you a moot of the neighbours to host, once that moot opens. At most once a year. A pack asks to hunt your land Event A sept's hunting pack, its own land hunted bare, asks to run yours for two days. It takes some of the map's wild game home, and the sept remembers. A Ronin begs shelter Event 20 A Ronin cast out by its sept begs a few days' shelter. It costs goodwill with the Nation now; kept safe to the end, the Ronin repays it in Honor and asks to stay. A sept asks to borrow a Kinfolk Event A sept asks to borrow one of your skilled Kinfolk for a season. It walks back in at the end, and the sept owes you aid. A sept asks you to foster a cub Event A sept asks a colony Garou of rank 2 or more to foster a new cub for a season and teach it the Litany: three lessons, one a night. All three given: Honor, Wisdom and goodwill. A sept asks you to keep a fetish Event A sept sends you one of its fetishes by drop pod to keep for a season, then takes it back from wherever it lies. Still there: Honor, goodwill and aid. Lost, used up or carried off, and the sept is angry. A sept asks you to keep an elder Event A sept asks you to keep a wounded elder for a season while it heals. Half the time the Wyrm finds out where it went. Kept to the end: Honor, goodwill and the sept's aid. A Theurge asks to visit Event A Theurge of a known sept asks to commune at your caern or study one of your fetishes for a few nights. The more lore you keep, the longer it stays and the more it pays: Honor to your strongest Garou and goodwill with the Nation. A Theurge needs a fetish housing Event A sept's Theurge needs a well-made thing to bind a spirit into: the best weapon or work of art of good quality or better in your storage. The maker earns Honor and the sept sends a talen back. Abomination attack Threat 30 60 days With Kindred loaded: an Abomination comes out of the dark to kill, with a vampire's hunger and the wolf's forms and Rage. Fire burns it like any vampire, and silver in every form. Bane-ridden beast Threat A bane slips through the Gauntlet and rides the biggest wild animal on the map, or comes in its own shape if there is none. It attacks anything alive, and the ground is tainted where the ridden beast dies. Black Spiral and Sabbat raid Big threat 30 With Kindred loaded: Black Spiral Dancers raid with Sabbat vampires at their side, one vampire for each few hundred raid points, up to three. Black Spiral Dancer raid Big threat 20 Black Spiral Dancers, Garou who walked the Labyrinth and came out the Wyrm's, hunt the colony by night. Black Spiral Dancers after a fetish Big threat 30 30 days Black Spiral Dancers come for your strongest fetish, named in the letter. Only a fetish of level 3 or more draws them. Black Spiral Hive Event 40 Black Spiral Dancers dig a Hive a few days from the colony. The land around it sickens and its Dancers hunt your Garou at night. Break it for great Glory. Corrupted factory Event 30 Pentex opens a factory staffed by fomori a few days away. Its waste reaches your land and its fomori come for your Garou. Shut it down for Glory. First Team raid Big threat 10 A Pentex First Team moves in: mercenaries paid to kill werewolves, with silver blades and fomori of their own. Fomori raid Big threat Fomori raid: people the Wyrm has ridden until nothing human was left. They have caught your Garou's scent, and the Delirium doesn't touch them. Garou hunters Big threat 6 days Once the Veil has fallen to Hunted, hunters come for your Garou by day with silver: a probing band at Hunted, the Society of Leopold in force at Exposed. Those still alive go back at nightfall. Takes the place of a normal raid. Garou pack hunt Big threat 20 30 days With Kindred loaded: a pack of werewolves follows the stink of your vampire to the colony, or comes for your hunters once the Nation knows they kill Garou. It gathers at the edge before attacking, and a vampire who still holds on to Humanity can go out and try to talk it down. Hunted Abomination Event 30 60 days With Kindred loaded: an Abomination, a Garou who rose from the Embrace, comes in hurt and asks for shelter. Garou and Kindred both hunt it, so taking it in brings a court's blood hunt and the sept's anger with it. Kin wolf joins Event A wolf of one of your Garou's bloodlines comes out of the wild, tame, and treats your Garou as family. An arctic wolf in the cold. Kinfolk joins Event A wanderer with the blood of one of your Garou's tribes finds the colony and joins as Kinfolk. Needs a Garou colonist. Leech sighting Threat 15 20 days With Kindred loaded and no vampire of your own: a vampire slips in at night, feeds on a sleeping colonist and leaves. Sense Wyrm finds it while it's here. Lost cub Event Someone going through their First Change sends word to your Garou, scared and confused. Take them in from the Quests tab before the offer runs out. The only way a metis arrives outside the scenarios. Pentex front Event 10 20 days A trader caravan with cheap goods that is really a Pentex front. It taints the ground it stands on, and only Sense Wyrm unmasks it. Pentex subsidiary Event 15 Pentex opens a subsidiary a few days from a colony with Garou. Its runoff seeps into your land and its First Team comes calling until your Garou shut it down, for Glory. Sept pack Sent by another event When the Wyrm raids, an allied sept sends a pack of Garou to fight beside you. Never sent by the storyteller on its own. Spirit poachers Threat 15 days Trappers with spirit jars come to bottle the spirits around your caern. While they hold it, the caern weakens. Kill or down them to free the spirits, or they leave in half a day with what they caught. Stray cub Event For a colony with no Garou: a youth fresh from a First Change, half wild and hurt, stumbles onto your land with something following. Take them in and they are your first Garou. This is the usual way a colony meets the Garou. The Black Furies ask a guard Event The Black Furies ask their Garou of the colony to stand guard. Done: tribe regard (1 to 3 by rank) and Renown. Refused or failed: lost regard. The Bone Gnawers ask for food Event The Bone Gnawers ask their Garou of the colony for food from storage. Done: tribe regard and Renown. Refused or failed: lost regard. The Children of Gaia ask for a peace Event The Children of Gaia ask their Garou of the colony to make a peace. Done: tribe regard and Renown. Refused or failed: lost regard. The Fianna ask for a tale Event The Fianna ask their Garou of the colony for a tale. Done: tribe regard and Renown. Refused or failed: lost regard. The Get of Fenris ask for blood Event The Get of Fenris ask their Garou of the colony to spill the Wyrm's blood. Done: tribe regard and Renown. Refused or failed: lost regard. The Glass Walkers ask for parts Event The Glass Walkers ask their Garou of the colony for parts from storage. Done: tribe regard and Renown. Refused or failed: lost regard. The Red Talons ask the wild back Event The Red Talons ask their Garou of the colony to give land back to the wild. Done: tribe regard and Renown. Refused or failed: lost regard. The Shadow Lords ask for backing Event The Shadow Lords ask their Garou of the colony for backing. Done: tribe regard and Renown. Refused or failed: lost regard. The Silent Striders ask for a runner Event The Silent Striders ask their Garou of the colony to run a message. Done: tribe regard and Renown. Refused or failed: lost regard. The Silver Fangs ask for a rite Event The Silver Fangs ask their Garou of the colony to perform a rite. Done: tribe regard and Renown. Refused or failed: lost regard. The Stargazers send a riddle Event The Stargazers send their Garou of the colony a riddle to work out. Done: tribe regard and Renown. Refused or failed: lost regard. The Uktena ask for a bane bound Event The Uktena ask their Garou of the colony to bind a bane. Done: tribe regard and Renown. Refused or failed: lost regard. The Uktena ask for a fetish Event The Uktena hear you keep a Wyrm-tainted fetish and send for it, to lock it away. Hand it over for Honor, Wisdom and goodwill; refuse and every Uktena of the colony loses regard with the tribe. The Wendigo ask the land avenged Event The Wendigo ask their Garou of the colony to avenge the land. Done: tribe regard and Renown. Refused or failed: lost regard. Travellers Visitors Once there are rumours of Garou in the colony, hunters arrive as ordinary visitors carrying silver and ask questions. More often as the Veil fails. Anything a Garou does in front of them counts against the Veil. Two packs ask for neutral ground Event Two feuding packs of two septs ask to meet for one night at your caern, or your best hall without one. If both leave unharmed, your strongest Garou gains Wisdom and both septs think better of you. Visiting challenger Event 25 days A Get of Fenris or Silver Fang of the Nation, of the same rank or one higher, comes to test your strongest Garou. Accepted, the one challenged picks a duel or a staring-down. The winner gains Glory. Wyrm's Hunted Big threat 20 days One of the Wyrm's Hunted passes near the colony. Every item, weapon and piece of apparel this mod adds. Value is the base market value in silver.

Name Value What it is ← Garou contents · The Rim by Night This is not official World of Darkness material. Portions of the materials are the copyrights and trademarks of Paradox Interactive AB, and are used with permission. All rights reserved. For more information please visit worldofdarkness.com.
300 A scrap of tattooed skin with a Homid ancestor bound in it. Woken, it lets its Garou live a day as one born human: silver is no worse than steel, but the wounds don't knit by themselves either.
160 An obsidian-headed arrow with a war spirit in it. Woken, it flies at the nearest hostile spirit and never misses.
600 A shard of smoked glass with a watcher spirit in it. Looked through, it shows the Umbra's edge for a day, banes and all. Three looks, and then it needs a point of Gnosis for each one more.
900 A scrap of a bane wrapped in cloth and worn as an amulet. Woken, it makes the banes around take its Garou for one of their own.
900 A carved wolf mask with an animal spirit bound in it. Woken, it pulls its Garou into the wolf's shape and holds them there for an hour.
2000 A Black Spiral Dancer's account of the Labyrinth, written down before it died. It's ugly to read. A Garou who gets through it understands the Wyrm's ways better for it, and gains experience.
600 A belt of lizard hide with a chameleon spirit bound in it. Woken, the Garou's fur takes the colors of the land around.
240 A wooden bat figurine with a bat spirit in it. Woken, it flies off to scout and shows every foe on the map before it turns to sawdust.
600 A carved, covered cup said to be unicorn horn. Any poison poured into it turns harmless.
1200 A flint knife curved like a crescent moon, with a cobra spirit in the blade: the Silent Striders' own. Its cuts are aggravated, and woken after a strike it drinks the foe's Gnosis.
800 An ugly iron dagger with a vengeance spirit in it. Held and woken, it tugs toward whoever wronged its Garou.
240 A small jar of dust with a spirit of death in it. Sprinkled on the newly dead, it lets them speak: what they knew is the Garou's.
600 A many-colored gem with a dream spirit in it. Held near a sleeper and woken, it plays their dreams in its depths.
1200 A dagger carved from a great beast's tusk, with a snake spirit in it. Woken after a strike, it bites deeper into the wound.
1200 A full-length cloak of a thousand colored feathers with a bird spirit bound in it. Woken, it carries its wearer through the air.

2000 Pages copied from the Silver Record, the Garou Nation's history as the Galliards keep it. Between the tales are the words and motions of a rite. A Garou who reads it through learns the rite, if it's one they're ready for.
200 A dried, glyph-painted gourd with a healing spirit in it. Crushed over a wound, it heals even aggravated wounds.

2000 An immense silver sword with a war spirit and a fire spirit bound in it: the klaive of a legendary hero. Its cuts are silver, and woken the fire spirit shields its Garou from flame. Carrying one dulls its Garou's Gnosis by two.
300 A hickory flute hung with songbird feathers. Its tune calls up memories of a whole world, and every angry creature that hears it stops fighting.
The Garou's own mirror image, scars on the wrong side. It moves and sounds like them, but has no scent, no warmth and no weight.
1600 A one-handed hammer of silver-laced iron with a war spirit in it: the Get of Fenris's own. Its blows are aggravated, and thrown it flies back to its Garou.
2000 One of the seven great hammers of the Get of Fenris, silver-laced iron with spirits of war and silver in it. Its blows are silver, and woken it blazes with fire.
1600 A silver dagger with a war spirit bound in it, the signature weapon of the Garou. Its cuts are silver: no Garou soaks them. Carrying one dulls its Garou's Gnosis by one.
1600 A massive double-headed axe dedicated to Isthmene, the Gorgon of battle: the Black Furies' own. Its blows are aggravated, and woken it grants the Spirit of the Fray. It answers no male.
300 A plain sack with a magpie spirit bound in it. It holds three times what it looks like it should.
300 Mirrored sunglasses with a glass elemental bound in them. A mirror always to hand: the Gauntlet is two lower to step sideways.
1200 An amber talisman holding one human hair, with a trickster spirit bound in it. Woken, people see an ordinary person, whatever form the Garou wears.
320 A moonbeam caught in a crystal by a lune. Woken, it keeps its Garou safe on a journey through the spirit world: spirits ask no price and leave them be.
200 A wax seal with the sign of the full moon and a lune in it. Thrown down before a Garou, it forces them into Lupus.
900 A knife ground from a wolf's tooth, with a Lune bound in it. Woken, it makes its bearer's blows bite deeper for two hours. The Lune wakes once, then sleeps until the next full moon.
200 A vial of night distilled. Drunk, it turns its drinker to shadow for an hour.
300 A silver bracelet carved with glyphs to Luna and a night spirit bound in it. Woken, it hides its Garou in the shadows; only the eyes shine.
900 A snow-white partridge wing on a gold chain, with a spirit of forgetting in it. Swept around someone in a circle, it sweeps away a memory, and with it their fear.
300 A smooth stone that hums faintly with the Umbra's paths. A ritemaster can spend it in the Rite of the Opened Bridge to join the caern to a sept's caern.
A machine or a wire as the Penumbra shows it: a thick, bright web that the pattern spiders keep spinning tighter. It clings to whoever walks through it.
1200 A tablet with a bee spirit in its circuits: the Glass Walkers' own. Its hive of files keeps the Garou's notes and research in perfect order.
A barricade that looks, sounds and even feels real. It isn't.
900 A small gold half-moon pendant with a lune bound in it. Woken at night, its wearer vanishes from every sense but touch, a minute a success.

40 A small mirror of polished steel. A Garou can stare into it to step sideways into the Penumbra, though it's harder than with still water. It works from the inventory: right-click it with a pawn selected to pick it up.
400 A red river stone that holds a little fury. Woken, it gives its bearer a point of Rage. It fills again under the moon its bearer was born under.
1500 Carved divination stones with a spirit of time bound in them. Cast and woken, they show what is to come.
900 A tiny tubular bell with a turtle spirit in it. Rung, its chimes keep hostile spirits away for a day.
A grave, a corpse left unburied, a prisoner's cell or a broken mind, as the spirit world sees it: a cold shadow where banes come to feed.
4 Fruit grown in a Wyld glade of the Penumbra, faintly glowing. It feeds like any berry, and a Garou who eats it regains a point of Gnosis.
600 A human hair set in an iron ingot with a predator spirit bound in it. Woken, the ingot pulls toward spirits.
1200 An ivory whistle with a screech-owl spirit in it. Its wail tears at every spirit in sight.
1200 A bullwhip woven with gold nuggets, with a spirit of flame bound in it. Woken, it bursts into fire against whatever it strikes.
300 A small gold earring with a servant of Falcon in it. It trembles at every lie its wearer hears.
1200 A length of braided hemp cord with a flock spirit in it, enough for a whole pack. Woken, its Garou shares Gnosis with every packmate near.
The spirit of something built, shown in the Penumbra as a faint outline of web. The Weaver spins over everything people make.
120 A hollow reed with an air elemental in it. Through it, its Garou breathes anywhere: under water, in smoke or in poison.
900 A whistle of bone with a wind elemental in it. One long blast calls a freezing, snow-laced wind on the Garou's pursuers.
320 A sigil with a captive Wyrm spirit in it. Woken, every servant of the Wyrm on the map shows its true form; then it burns up in green fire.

Every mission a court, sept, cell or consilium can give, and every quest these mods offer. Mission What it asks Banes at the thin place Travel to a place where banes have crossed over and kill every one of them, for one of the sept's packs. The watch in the bawn Lend one of your Garou to a pack of the sept for some days, to stand guard in the caern's bawn. The Galliard's run Lend one of your Garou to carry a pack's word to another sept and bring the answer back. The stolen fetish Travel to the Black Spiral Dancers' hideout that holds the sept's stolen fetish and clear it. The sept's Theurges bind a fetish for you in thanks. The cub's watch Keep a cub from the sept at your caern until its Rite of Passage and keep it alive. Something will probably come looking. Offerings for the moon rite Bring the goods the sept is short of for its full-moon moot by caravan before the deadline. The Wyrm-bloated beast Travel to where a Wyrm-tainted animal roams the sept's land and kill it. The fallen caern Travel to the lodge of a dead sept and clear out the fomori who moved in. The Wyrm's holdings near *sept* The elders of *sept*, a sept that leans *tribe*, have found the Wyrm's hand at *target*: a Pentex subsidiary behind a friendly logo, First Team guards on the gate and fomori working the poisoned ground. They want your Garou to tear it down.- Kill everyone there- Leave it standing too long and the sept will remember it Banes upon the wind The Theurges of *sept*, a sept that leans *tribe*, have watched banes moving through the Umbra toward *target*, drawn by something rotten. If your Garou are ready, the banes will cross the Gauntlet within a few hours of your answer.- Kill every one of them *sept*'s Kin in peril Pentex has set up at *target*, right beside *sept*, the homestead your Garou's people come from. The Kinfolk there carry the blood of the Garou, and the fomori are already watching the village. The kin can't fight them alone.- Kill everyone at the outpost and the village is safe- Leave the call unanswered, or take it and wait too long, and there won't be a village left The moot at your caern Host a small moot of the sept's Garou at your colony for a while and keep them all alive. The Wyrm's creatures are likely to follow them. A claw for *asker* Lend one of your Garou to the sept for some days to stand guard at its caern. They come home with Honor when the days are up. The wound in the Gauntlet Travel to a place where banes crossed through a worn Gauntlet and kill every bane there. Kinfolk in the Wyrm's grip Travel to the fomori camp holding the sept's Kinfolk and clear it. The Kinfolk who is still alive joins you. Purging the camp at *site* Travel to a camp cutting into the last wild land near the sept and clear it. Gaia's vengeance at *site* Travel to the camp of the people who fouled a spirit spring and clear it. Cleanse the *site* *description*It stays until someone shuts it down. Every other kind of thing this mod defines that has a name and a description: Merits, Backgrounds, gatherings, places, personalities and the rest.

Name What it is A beast of the Wyrm Kill one of the Wyrm's beasts: a twisted animal, a bane in beast shape, a Wyrm monster. A tale at the moot Host a moot, where the sept hears the colony's tales. Bind a spirit Perform the Rite of Binding. Cleanse the land Perform the Rite of Cleansing on a tainted place or thing. Hold the caern Be at home when enemies reach the colony's caern, and still have it once they're gone. Judge a dispute Settle a dispute the sept brings to you. Keep the Litany Go a whole season without breaking the Litany. Outwit a foe Take two enemies alive, beaten and made to yield. Rites for the sept Lead two rites, any rites at all, as their ritemaster. Slay the Wyrm's own Kill two creatures of the Wyrm: banes, fomori, Black Spiral Dancers or worse. Teach a Gift Teach a Gift you know to another Garou. Win a challenge Beat a Garou who comes to challenge you.

Name What it is Ahroun Born under the full moon. The warrior, first into every fight against the Wyrm. Galliard Born under the gibbous moon. The moon-dancer, who keeps the tales and sings the pack into battle. Philodox Born under the half moon. The judge, who keeps the Litany and settles disputes between Garou. Ragabash Born under the new moon. The trickster and the questioner, who tests the rules so the rest remember why they have them. Theurge Born under the crescent moon. The seer, who speaks with spirits and knows the rites.

Name What it is Ancestors Ancestor spirits who answer the Garou's call. Set at birth and never bought: once a season the Garou can borrow an ancestor's skill for an hour. Fetish The sept lends a fetish of a level up to the dots, picked from the row's link and given already attuned. A starting fetish from the making menu is this loan. Losing dots below the fetish's level takes it back, and picking another returns the first. Kinfolk Kin who know the Garou for what it is. Each dot makes kinfolk come to join the colony 25% more often. While the kin village stands and is friendly, you can call one of its own to join, as many as the dots. Another comes only when one of them dies. Rites The sept's ritemasters take an interest. Each season they teach one rite for each dot, of a level up to the dots, picked from the row's link. No teacher is needed on the map, but Rituals still has to reach the rite's level. Totem Points the Garou brings toward its pack's totem. Set at the First Change and never bought: it is pooled when a pack forms.
Name What it is Penumbra The spirit world nearest our own, where the land shows as its spirits see it.

Name What it is Homid Born human and raised among people, with no idea what they were until the First Change. Homids handle tools, trade and talk well, but the spirit world comes to them slowly. Lupus Born a wolf, and a wolf at heart in any shape. Lupus are at home in the wild and the spirit world, and have a hard time with tools and polite talk. Metis The child of two Garou, which the Litany forbids. Born in the war form, always marked by some deformity, and unable to have children. Raised inside a sept, a Metis knows Garou ways better than anyone, and many Garou still look down on them.
