Hearing A famous pack of the Nation comes to tell its deeds at the colony's caern, and the colony's elders judge its Renown. Moot of the neighbours Garou of the neighbouring septs come to the colony's caern for a night of the moot: news, boasts and the Rite of the Moot's howl.

Name What it is A Thousand Voices Howls, footfalls and shadows of a pack that isn't there. Mortals nearby break and run. Adaptation One Gnosis, and for an hour a success poison, disease, heat and cold barely touch the Garou. Allies Below A howl to the things deep in the earth: the ground heaves and throws everyone close to the Dancer off their feet. Apecraft's Blessings Tools made by human hands answer the Garou better for an hour: quicker work, and a steadier aim with a gun. Assimilation For an hour the Garou passes as one of any people, however strange: much better at talking, trading and bargaining. Attunement One Gnosis to ask the spirits of the place what's going on: shows every enemy and every supernatural power on the map. Aura of Confidence Always on. Others see a born leader, and the Garou believes it. Balance Always on. Never knocked off balance: hits barely slow the Garou. Balor's Gaze One Rage and one Gnosis, and for an hour every foe within 10 cells of the Garou doubles over in pain. Bane Protector A pact with a bane: it comes to fight beside the Dancer for a while. Banish Totem One Gnosis and one Willpower to bar an enemy pack's totem for an hour: the Garou aimed at and its packmates nearby lose the totem's favour and fight apart, with no shared target. Battle Mandala One Gnosis to burn a sigil into the ground around the Garou: for an hour every spirit within 8 cells, but the pack's own, loses strength every few seconds. Beast Life One Gnosis to call the animals around: every beast within 30 cells comes to the Garou's side and fights for them for a few minutes a success. Beast Speech Talks with animals for an hour: much better at taming and training. Beastmind Strips a person back to an animal mind: they wander, lost, for an hour a success. Garou are only cowed. Beat of the Heart-Drum Hears every enemy heartbeat on the map, and lifts the fog around each. Beyond Human Always on. People pick the Garou out of any crowd as someone who matters. Black Mark One Gnosis. The next foe the Garou wounds within the hour is haunted for a day. Blink One Gnosis to vanish and reappear in any shaded spot up to 18 cells a success away. Blissful Ignorance While the Garou keeps still, no one sees them. Lasts an hour. Blood of the North Always on. Cold doesn't bother the Garou. Bloody Feast A taste of a foe's blood makes the Garou stronger for a few seconds a success. When it ends, they risk a frenzy. Blur of the Milky Eye Eyes slide past the Garou for an hour. Attacking gives them away for a few seconds. Blurring the Mirror One Gnosis to thicken the Gauntlet around one foe for an hour: they can't step sideways. Body Shift Moves strength around the body for an hour: harder, surer blows. Body Wrack One Gnosis for pain that leaves a foe convulsing a few seconds a success, and weaker at everything for an hour. Break the Bonds Always on: no power bends the Garou's mind. Used on another, Manipulation + Social frees them from a blood bond, Dominate, Presence or a Gift's hold, easier the stronger their own will. Breath of the Wyld A breath that wakes the mind: whoever the Garou touches learns and researches faster for an hour a success. Bridge Walker One Gnosis for a small moon bridge to anywhere on the map. Brother's Scent For an hour mortals take the Garou for one of their own: no Delirium, and easier to talk to. Burning Blade The Garou's weapon burns for a few seconds a success: every blow burns and sets things alight. Burrow Digs like an animal for an hour: mining goes much faster. Bury the Wolf One Gnosis to bury the wolf for half a day a success: no Delirium, no shifting, no Rage. Freeing it early costs another Gnosis. Call Elemental One Gnosis to call an elemental that fights for the Garou for an hour. Call of the Cannibal Spirit One Rage and one Gnosis call the cannibal spirit to hunt the Garou's foes for an hour. Call of the Wyld A howl that stirs every friend within 20 metres: a point of Rage each, and a better mood. Call of the Wyrm A call the Wyrm's creatures can't ignore: each one within 40 cells who loses the contest of wills comes to the Garou. Call the Breeze An icy wind around a spot: for an hour enemies within 6 metres are slowed and shiver too hard to aim well. Call the Hunt An hour's chant and one Gnosis call the Wild Hunt's hounds to run down the Garou's foes for an hour. Call the Rust One Gnosis to rust a foe's weapon and armor: anything metal they carry wears down with every success. Call to Duty Calls a spirit the Garou knows by name: it fights at their side for a few minutes, then goes back to the Umbra. Once a day. Calm Soothes the target's anger: a Garou loses Rage, and three successes end a rage, frenzy or berserk. Calm the Savage Beast A point of Willpower lends a frenzied Garou the will to break free of their Rage. Camouflage Under open sky the Garou can't be seen for an hour. A roof overhead breaks it. Catfeet Always on. Sure-footed as a cat: much harder to hit in melee. Chains of Mist One Gnosis to bind a spirit in mist for an hour: it moves and fights badly. Chameleon One Gnosis, and the Garou's skin takes the color of whatever is behind it for an hour. Attacking gives them away for a few seconds. Channeling Three Rage poured into the next half-minute: blows land half again as hard. Chaos Mechanics Always on. Rage and Gnosis no longer pull against each other: a Rage Gift used right after a Gnosis Gift, or the other way round, is ready again in half the time. Chill of Early Frost One Gnosis to bring a killing frost: everyone without fur within 30 cells, but the pack, slows down for an hour. Circular Attack One Willpower. For a few seconds the Garou turns aside one blow a success, sidestepping out of reach. City Running One point of Rage, and the Garou moves through streets and over walls at a run for an hour. Clap of Thunder One Gnosis to clap like thunder: everyone within 6 metres is stunned for a few seconds. Willpower resists, friends easily. Not in Hispo or Lupus. Clarity For an hour nothing clouds the Garou's sight: sharper eyes and surer aim. Claws of Frozen Death One Gnosis. For an hour the claws freeze what they cut: the victim slows and the wound won't heal. Not in Homid form. Clenched Jaw One Rage, and for an hour whatever the Garou bites is held fast. Cocoon One Gnosis to seal the Garou in a chitin cocoon for a day. Nothing short of a heavy blow gets through, and that one breaks it. Coils of the Serpent Invisible coils hold the target nearly still, a few seconds a success. Cold Voice of Reason Cold words that cool a hot head: a Garou loses Rage, and two successes end a rage or frenzy. Combat Healing Always on. The Garou regenerates twice as fast. Command Spirit One Willpower and a command a spirit must obey: it fights for the Garou for an hour. Command the Gathering One Gnosis. Everyone within 8 metres stops to listen, frozen a few seconds a success. Willpower resists; friends resist easily. Control Complex Machine One Willpower to take hold of a mechanoid's mind: it stands still for a few seconds a success. Control Simple Machine Tells a turret or a mechanoid to stand still, for a few seconds a success. Cooking Turns scraps and junk into a simple meal for each success. Once a day. Cornered Rat's Ferocity One Rage to fight like a cornered rat for an hour: harder, surer blows, but it may tip into frenzy. Coup de Grace One Willpower to find a foe's weak spot: the Garou's next blow within the hour does double damage. Cowing the Bullet One Gnosis, and for an hour bullets and blades that aren't silver hit the Garou softer. Create Element One Gnosis to make a little of one element at a spot: fire that burns, water that puts fires out, a chunk of stone, or clean air. Curse of Aeolus One Gnosis to call up a thick fog around a spot: no one can see or shoot through it. Curse of Hatred One Gnosis to fill someone with hatred that eats at them: a Garou loses Willpower and Rage, anyone else is close to breaking for an hour. Curse of Lycaon One Gnosis to force the wolf-skin onto someone: a Garou is held in Lupus for an hour, and anyone else becomes a wolf for good. Cutting Wind One Gnosis to hurl a blast of freezing wind that knocks the target down. Cybersenses Sight and hearing tuned like instruments for an hour. Dam the Heartflood One Gnosis. A vampire's blood goes still for a few seconds a success: no blood spent, no blood magic. Dazzle Leaves a foe standing in mute awe for a few seconds a success. Desperate Strength Pushes the body past its limits: a bruising strain, then an hour of hitting and carrying much harder. Diagnostics Knows what is wrong with any machine for an hour: builds and repairs faster, and seldom fails. Direct the Storm One Gnosis to take hold of someone's fury: whoever is already raging fights for the Garou a few seconds a success. Disquiet Pulls the target's spirits to their lowest ebb for an hour: no Rage comes back, and everything feels like too much effort. Distractions Yips and taunts that put one enemy off their aim and their swing, a few seconds a success. Willpower resists. Doppelganger One Gnosis to take someone's exact likeness for a day per success. Their faction takes the Garou for one of their own until it attacks or shifts, or someone from another side spots it. Dreamspeak Walks into a sleeper's dream anywhere on the map and steers it: a friend wakes rested, anyone else shaken. Durance Always on. A talen the Garou uses keeps its spirit for a point of Gnosis. Ears of the Bat Bat ears unfold and the Dancer hears everything nearby, including anyone hiding by Gift or Discipline. Electroshock Two Rage for a jolt that burns a foe and anyone touching them. Elemental Favor Asks a building's spirit for a favor: it falls apart a little with every success. Elemental Favor (wild) Asks the elements for a favor: earth heaps up around a spot. Elemental Gift One Gnosis to call an elemental that fights for the Garou for an hour. Endurance of Heimdall Two Gnosis to double the Garou's endurance for an hour: blows do much less. Exorcism Drives a spirit out: a spirit in the Penumbra is banished, and a bane is torn out of a fomor or anyone it rides. Tearing it out of a fomor nearly kills them. Eye of the Cobra A gaze that draws the target to walk to the Garou's side, whatever they were doing. Eye of the Eagle Sees far: lifts the fog for 25 metres all around. Eye of the Falcon A falcon's sight: lifts the fog for 20 metres all around. Eye of the Hunter Picks out the weakest enemy within 20 metres: for an hour every blow against them lands harder. Eyes of the Cat Always on. The dark slows the Garou down no more than daylight. Fabric of the Mind One Gnosis to dream up a creature that fights for the Garou for an hour. Faerie Kin One Gnosis to call the fae: a dream-spirit, and more for more successes, fight for the Garou for an hour. Faerie Light Calls a soft light that hangs over a spot for a few hours. Fair Fortune One Gnosis, and the next Gift the Garou fails within the hour is rolled again. Falcon's Grasp One Rage. The next creature the Garou strikes is held fast for an hour, barely able to move. Falling Touch A touch that drops the target to the ground, stunned for a few seconds. Fangs of Judgment One Rage, and for an hour the Garou's blows bite half again as hard into creatures of the Wyrm. Fangs of the North One Gnosis. For an hour the Garou's bite freezes: wounds it leaves slow the victim and won't heal. Not in Homid form. Fatal Flaw Finds the target's weak spot: for an hour every blow against them lands harder. Fenris' Bite One Rage. The Garou's next bite within the hour maims a limb; five successes tear it off. Feral Lobotomy Two Gnosis to burn the reason out of a person for good: they can no longer research and barely learn. Fetish Doll Through a doll made in the victim's likeness, an aggravated wound a success, anywhere on the map. Once a day. Fetish Fetch One Gnosis to call every fetish the Garou is attuned to into their pack, wherever on the world it lies. Flame Dance One Gnosis. For half a minute the Garou flickers like a flame, hard to hit at all. Fog on the Moor One Willpower to turn to fog a few seconds a success: only silver can hurt the Garou, but nothing heals either. Form Mastery Always on. Changing shape is easier: the shift roll is one lower. Full Moon's Light One Gnosis, and everyone on the map who means the Garou harm glows like the moon, hidden or not. Gaia's Vengeance One Gnosis and one Rage, and the land strikes everyone but the pack around a spot: stones fly and roots grab. Gate of the Moon Two Gnosis to open a gate to anywhere up to 100 tiles away, twice that from or to a caern or a sept. The Garou goes alone. Geas One Gnosis for a command the target can't refuse: they leave, and keep going. A Garou won't run, but won't fight either. Gift of Dreams One Gnosis to breathe a vivid dream into someone: it lifts their mood for days. Gift of the Porcupine One Gnosis to turn the Garou's fur to quills for an hour. Whoever strikes them in melee is torn by the quills. Gift of the Skunk A spray of musk that leaves a foe up to 4 cells away retching for an hour. Gift of the Spriggan One Gnosis to grow to giant size for an hour a success: much harder blows and a much bigger load. Gift of the Termite One Gnosis to set termites on everything wooden around a spot: walls, doors and furniture rot away. Glib Tongue Talks circles around a prisoner: their resistance drops by two a success. Gnaw One Willpower, and the Garou's jaws can chew through steel for an hour: much harder bites. Gorge Always on. The Garou can hold three Rage past their rating. Gorgon's Gaze One Gnosis and a stare that freezes a foe a few seconds a success. Five successes turn them to stone for good. Grandmother's Touch As Mother's Touch, but the Garou can heal themselves too. Grasp the Beyond Three Willpower to step sideways holding someone: both cross into the Penumbra, or back out. Great Leap One Willpower for a leap of up to 35 cells. Gremlins Sets a gremlin loose in a machine: a mechanoid stalls, or a powered machine breaks down. Halo of the Sun One Gnosis, and for an hour the Garou blazes like the sun: harder blows, and any undead within 18 cells burns. Halt the Coward's Flight The target's legs go heavy: half speed for half a minute a success. Willpower resists. Hand Blade One Gnosis to make a blade of the Garou's own hand for an hour: a cut that wounds like a klaive. Hand of the Earth Lords One Gnosis to fling a foe with an unseen hand: knocked back a cell a success, and bruised. Hands Full of Thunder One Gnosis. For an hour guns in the Garou's hands fire faster. Hare's Leap A great bound to a spot up to 12 metres away. Harmonious Unity of the Emerald Mother One Gnosis, and for a day the Garou has the Crinos's strength and regeneration in human form, without the Delirium. Head Games Turns a person's feelings inside out: they wander off in a fog of sadness. Heart Claw One Willpower. The Garou's next blow leaves a claw that keeps burrowing into the wound. Heart of Fury Holds the Rage down for an hour: frenzy is harder by the successes. When it ends, the Garou risks a frenzy. Heart of Ice One Gnosis and a name whispered to the winds: the foe's insides freeze, an aggravated wound every few seconds, once a success. Heart of the Mountain One Rage and one Willpower, and for an hour nothing breaks the Garou: pain can't drop them and every blow lands a little softer. Heightened Senses Sight and hearing far past human for an hour. Hero's Stand The Garou roots to the spot for an hour: harder to hit, surer and harder blows, but no moving until it's over. Hidden Killer Makes the claw marks on a body pass for an animal's work, so it no longer gives the Garou away. Horde of Valhalla Two Rage and two Gnosis call four great wolves of Valhalla to fight for the Garou for an hour. Horns of the Impaler Always on. Spiral horns of chitin, good for goring. Howl of Death A howl that ruptures a foe's insides: a wound a success. Howl of the Banshee One Gnosis for a wail that sends enemies within 12 metres running for a few seconds a success. Willpower resists. Howl of the Unseen A howl heard on both sides of the Gauntlet: the colony's Garou on the far side hear it and cross over to join the Garou. Howls in the Night One Gnosis for a howl that robs the Wyrm's creatures within 40 cells of their rest: woken at once, and kept awake three hours a success. Ice Echo One Gnosis to raise the Garou's mirror image anywhere within 30 cells for an hour. Enemies take it for the Garou; one who touches it may see through it. Icy Chill of Despair One Gnosis, and every foe within 10 cells who means the Garou harm is too spooked to fight for an hour. Infectious Laughter A laugh that spreads to everyone within 8 metres: it can end a fight or a frenzy, and lifts the mood. Infest One Gnosis to call a swarm of rats, one a success, that fight for the Garou for an hour. Inner Light Always on. Steps sideways by the Garou's own inner light: no water or mirror needed, and no harder for the lack. Inner Strength Turns anger into resolve: each point of Rage becomes a point of Willpower. Inspiration One Gnosis. Friends within 10 metres fight better and hold their nerve for an hour, and each gets a point of Willpower. Intrusion One Gnosis, and every door and lock within 6 cells swings open. Invisibility One Gnosis to go unseen for an hour. Attacking gives the Garou away for a few seconds. Invoke the Spirits of the Storm Two Gnosis to call a thunderstorm and bring its lightning down on a foe. Iron Resolve One Willpower, once an hour: the Garou's next Gift roll gets two more successes. Jam Technology One Gnosis. Every gun within 15 metres of the spot stops working, mechanoids and turrets freeze, for a few seconds a success. Friends' guns too. Jam Weapon The target's weapon fails them for a few seconds a success: guns won't shoot straight and blades won't cut. Kali's Tongue A curse that stops wounds closing for an hour a success: even a Garou stops healing. King of the Beasts An animal not of the colony comes to heel and joins it, calmed if it was raging. Kiss of Helios One Gnosis, and for an hour fire and heat do nothing to the Garou, and their blows set foes alight. Kneel One word, and the target drops to their knees for a few seconds a success. Willpower resists. Lambent Flame One Gnosis. The Garou burns with silver light for an hour: enemies within 8 metres are dazzled. Lash of Rage One Rage lashes out at a foe up to 45 cells away: an aggravated wound a success that armor can't stop. Laugh of the Hyena For an hour the Garou laughs off psychic powers and strain alike. Ley Lines One Gnosis to bend the ley lines for an hour: anyone chasing the Garou loses it as soon as no foe can see it. Liar's Craft For an hour any lie the Garou tells is believed: much better at bargaining and trading. Lightning Reflexes One Gnosis, and for a day the Garou is quicker than anyone: faster aim and swing. Lover's Touch One Gnosis and a kind touch heal a wound a success. Not aggravated ones. Luna's Armor One Gnosis. For an hour Luna shields the Garou: less damage from everything, and silver no worse than steel. Luna's Avenger One Gnosis, and for an hour silver can't hurt the Garou, their blows burn like silver, and they take less from everything. Luna's Blessing Always on. While the moon is up and showing, silver hurts the Garou no more than steel. Madness One Gnosis to drive a person to the edge of madness for a day a success: they break under the slightest strain. Malleable Spirit Reshapes a spirit's purpose: an angry spirit calms, a hunting bane stops hunting, and none asks the Garou any price. Man's Skin One Gnosis, and for an hour the Garou's forms cause no Delirium: mortals see only a big animal. Mark of the Death-Wolf One Gnosis for a mark that sets ghosts on everyone but the pack around a spot, for a day a success. Mark of the Wolf Passes the Curse to someone the Garou has met: for a day a success, people around them feel something is wrong with them. Master of Fire One Gnosis, and for an hour fire hurts the Garou half as much, and the burns heal like any other wound. Mastery One command to another Garou, obeyed a few seconds a success: they stand where they are. Merciful Blow One Gnosis, and for an hour the Garou's blows leave no wounds. Enough of them knock a foe out. Mercy For an hour the Garou's blows bruise instead of tear: they can beat someone down without killing them. Messenger's Fortitude One Gnosis to run for a day without tiring: faster, and no need to sleep. Might of Thor One Gnosis and one Rage double the Garou's strength a few seconds a success. Mindblock Always on. Psychic powers barely touch the Garou's mind. Mindspeak One Willpower to join everyone of the Garou's side within 15 cells in a waking dream for an hour: they warn each other of every blow, but their hands are slower at work. Monkey Tail Always on. A prehensile tail, as good as a third hand. Mother's Touch Heals another's wounds at a touch, one a success, aggravated ones too. Not the Garou's own, and not the undead. Name the Spirit One Willpower to read every spirit on the map: what kind each one is, and where. Lifts the fog around each. Obedience One Gnosis for a command everyone within 8 cells must obey. With three successes, foes take the Garou as their alpha and fight for them for a day; with fewer, they won't fight at all. Odious Aroma For an hour the Garou stinks so badly that enemies within 6 metres retch and can barely fight. Open Moon Bridge One Gnosis to open a moon bridge and take the pack up to 60 tiles across the world in an instant, twice that from or to a caern or a sept. Open Seal Opens a door or a sealed container at a touch, locked or not. Open Wounds One Gnosis. The next wound the Garou deals within the hour bleeds again every few seconds, once a success. Pack Tactics Friends within 10 metres fight as a pack for an hour: their blows land more often. Para Bellum One Willpower to put peace aside for an hour: surer, harder blows. Paralyzing Stare One Gnosis and a stare that freezes a foe a few seconds a success. Part the Veil One Gnosis and a touch, and a mortal is free of the Delirium for good. Pathfinder Blazes a quick path through any country for a day: faster on foot and in a caravan. Paws of the Newborn Cub Two Gnosis to strip a foe of every power a few seconds a success: no Gifts, no shifting, no regeneration. Perfect Recall Remembers everything for an hour a success: learns and researches faster. Persuasion Words carry more weight for an hour: better at talking people round, recruiting and trading. Phantasm One Gnosis to raise an illusory barricade within 30 cells for an hour. It stops bullets until someone sees through it. Power Surge One Gnosis to overload every powered machine within 10 metres of a spot: they break down, and turrets and mechanoids freeze. Predator's Arsenal One Gnosis, and claws and teeth cut deeper for an hour, in any form. Preternatural Awareness One Gnosis, and for an hour the Garou feels every blow coming: much harder to hit in melee. Prey Mind Thinks like hunted prey for an hour: quicker on their feet and quicker to react. Primal Anger Once an hour the Garou tears into their own flesh, an aggravated wound, for three Rage, even past their rating. Protean Form Always on. The Garou grows extra claws, limbs and teeth as they like: harder blows, surer hits and quicker legs. Pulse of the Invisible Always on. The Theurge half sees the spirit world: it notices anyone a spirit rides nearby, banes gathering beyond the Gauntlet wake it, and where its permanent Gnosis matches the Gauntlet it peeks and steps sideways without fail. Pulse of the Prey One Gnosis to feel every enemy on the map, and lift the fog around them. Quicksand One Gnosis turns the ground around a spot into a bog for an hour: everyone but the pack wades at half speed. Rattler's Bite One Rage, and the Garou's next bite within the hour carries venom: twice the wound. Razor Claws One Rage to hone the claws on stone: for an hour they cut deeper and through armour. Not in Homid form. Reach the Umbra Always on. The Garou steps sideways at once, anywhere, with no roll and no mirror. Redirect Pain One Rage, and for an hour a foe feels all the pain of the Garou's wounds. Render Down One Gnosis, and everything made around a spot starts to dissolve. Rending the Craft One Willpower. The Garou's next blow within the hour tears away every power working on the foe. Renew the Cycle A Gnosis for each century the vampire has been dead, permanent Gnosis past that. Gnosis against its Willpower: on a win it dies for good, an old one crumbling to ash. Reshape Object One Gnosis to shape wood, bone or hide into a spear in an instant. Resist Pain One Willpower, and pain means nothing for an hour. Resist Temptation Always on. Hard to sway: psychic pressure and the urge to break bite less. Resist Toxin Always on. Poisons and toxic fallout do far less. Riot One Gnosis to set spirits whispering in every stranger's ear: those who can't hold their will riot. Roll Over A battle of wills with every foe in sight: those who lose submit and won't fight the Garou for an hour. Salmon Swim One Gnosis to move through rivers and lakes as easily as on land, an hour a success. Scabwalker Curse One Gnosis for a curse that lasts a day a success: anything man-made the victim wears or holds blisters their skin. Scent of Beyond Sends the Garou's senses anywhere on the map: everything around the spot comes into view. Scent of Running Water Always on. Leaves no scent: a quieter hunter, and a harder one to track. Scent of Sight Always on. The nose fills in what the eyes miss. Scent of Sweet Honey Covers the target in a smell insects love: for an hour a success they can barely work or aim for the swarm. Scent of the Oathbreaker One Gnosis to witness a prisoner's oath as they go free. If they ever come back with a raid, the Philodox knows them, and they are easier to hit and to hurt. Putting one down earns Honor. Scent of the True Form Smells what someone really is: Garou, human, animal, or something dead that walks. Scream of Gaia One Gnosis for a scream that knocks down everyone within 15 cells but the pack: a bruise a success that armor can't stop. Scrying One Gnosis to watch any spot on the map. Seizing the Edge Always on. A contest that ends in a tie goes the Garou's way. Sense Balance One Gnosis to feel the balance of the land: shows every spirit on the map and whether it is the Wyrm's, the Wyld's or the Weaver's. Sense Magic Feels magic on the map: anything supernatural, Garou included, and lifts the fog around it. Sense Prey Finds every animal worth hunting on the map, and lifts the fog around them. Sense Silver Feels silver on the map: weapons, items and anyone carrying it. Sense the Unnatural Smells out every supernatural creature and power on the map. Sense Wyrm Smells out the Wyrm on the map: tainted creatures, fomori and the undead. Lifts the fog around each one. Serenity One Gnosis to fill someone with perfect calm a few seconds a success: no frenzy, no Rage, and any fury ends. Shadow Cutting One Gnosis and a spit into a foe's shadow: for an hour they can barely dodge. Shadow Pack Two Gnosis call two shadows of the Garou to fight beside them for an hour. One blow puts a shadow out. Shadow Weaving Gathers the shadows over a spot: a pocket of darkness no one can see through. Shadows by the Firelight One Gnosis to press a foe into the Garou's story: they stand caught in it a few seconds a success. Shadows of the Impergium One Gnosis. For an hour mortals see the Garou as their ancestors did: even the Hispo brings on the Delirium, and the Crinos is far worse. Shed The Garou sheds skin or fur and slips free: shakes off a stun, or slips their bonds as a prisoner. Shell Walls the Garou off for an hour: no psychic power reaches them, but they can't spend Rage either. Shield of Rage One Willpower, and for an hour spirits hit the Garou far softer: their lesser fury quails before the Ahroun's. Shroud Calls darkness over a spot: a wide pool of it that no one can see through. Sidestep Death Always on. Once in a while, for three Willpower, a blow that would bring the Garou down finds them somewhere else. Sight From Beyond Always on. Dreams and visions come before trouble: a threat may wait a few hours while the Garou sees it coming, veiled in symbols. A sharp mind can tell what it means. Signal Rider One Willpower and one Gnosis to ride a signal to any comms console on the map. Silence Always on. Moves without a sound: a better, quieter hunter. Silence the Weaver One Rage and a howl that blows out every machine within 20 cells: mechanoids stall and powered machines break down. Silver Claws The Garou's claws turn to silver for an hour: they burn other Garou as silver does, and they hurt. Sky Running One Willpower to run across the sky: up to 40 cells in one go. Smell of Man Always on. The Garou smells of human power: tame animals trust them, and wild ones are easier to bring to heel. Snarl of the Predator One Rage for a snarl that leaves one enemy shaking for an hour. Song of Heroes Two Gnosis and a tale of old heroes: everyone of the Garou's side listening fights and works better until the sun rises. Song of Rage Stirs a person into a killing rage for a few seconds a success. A Garou or a vampire goes into frenzy. Song of the Earth Mother Two Gnosis and a long listen to the earth: shows everything supernatural on the map, the Wyrm's creatures among them. Song of the Great Beast Two Gnosis and a song from the deep wild call one of the great beasts of the first days to fight for the Garou for a day. Song of the Siren One Gnosis for a song that holds everyone in earshot but the pack spellbound a few seconds a success. Speak with Wind Spirits Asks the wind what moves nearby: every enemy within 30 cells is found, and the fog lifts around them. Only under open sky. Speech of the World Speaks any tongue for an hour, with an outsider's accent: much better at talking with strangers. Speed Beyond Thought One Gnosis to run at blinding speed for eight hours. When it ends, the Garou is starving. Speed of Thought One Gnosis, and the Garou runs twice as fast for an hour. Spirit Drain Drains a spirit's strength into the Garou: a wound to the spirit a success, and a Willpower back for every two. Spirit Friend For an hour spirits take to the Garou: they teach and help without asking a price. Spirit of the Bird One Gnosis for a flying leap to anywhere within 30 metres. Spirit of the Fish One Gnosis to swim as fast as the Garou runs, an hour a success. Spirit of the Fray Always on. Quicker to act in a fight: aims faster and strikes sooner. Spirit Snare One Gnosis to throw an unseen net over a spirit within 10 cells: for an hour it fights and dodges badly. Spirit Speech Always on. The Garou can talk with spirits and bargain with them without a Theurge beside them. Spirit Ward One Gnosis for a warding sign that travels with the Garou for an hour and burns any spirit that comes close. Spur Claws One Gnosis. For an hour the claws grow barbs: whoever they hit is slowed for an hour. Staredown A look that sends one person running for a few seconds a success. Garou don't run, but won't attack while it lasts. Steel Fur One Gnosis to turn the fur to steel for an hour: much harder to cut or bruise. Not in Homid form. Stoking Fury's Furnace Always on. Wounds give the Garou twice the Rage. Strength of Gaia One Rage, and for an hour the Garou's Lupus form hits half again as hard. Only in Lupus. Strength of Purpose Steels the Garou's will: a point of Willpower back for every two successes. Strength of the Dominator Takes a Garou foe's Rage for the Garou's own: one a success. Strength of Will One Willpower and a rallying cry: every Garou of the Garou's side within 30 cells gains a Willpower a success. Strike the Air One Willpower, and for an hour one foe can't land a blow on the Garou, however hard they try. Summon Net-Spider One Gnosis to call a pattern spider that fights for the Garou for an hour. Surface Attunement Crosses water as easily as open ground for an hour. Survivor One Gnosis to endure anything for a day a success: half the hunger, no fear of the cold, and wounds that barely slow. When it ends, the Garou is exhausted and starving. Take the True Form Forces a Garou back into their breed form and holds them there a few seconds a success. A vampire wearing another shape is forced back into its own. Taking the Forgotten With three successes, lifts something from a person's pack, and they forget they ever had it. Talons of the Falcon One Gnosis, and for an hour the Garou's claws cut through bone and armor like paper. Tech Speak One Gnosis to talk to factions and passing traders through any machine, as if at a comms console. It needs a powered machine of the colony's nearby or something industrial carried, and works from a caravan too. Territory Senses any spot on the map as if standing there. Terror of the Dire Wolf One Rage, and everyone who can see the Garou feels the Delirium's full weight, in any form. Only other Garou are spared. The Living Wood One Gnosis to wake the trees: one a success uproots itself and fights for the Garou for an hour. Thieving Talons of the Magpie With three successes, steals one of the target's powers and uses it for a few minutes a success. Thousand Forms One Gnosis to take the shape of any animal from a small bird to a bison, with its speed and its bite, until the next shift or a day. A mythic beast bigger than a bison costs one Gnosis more and a harder roll. Totem Gift One Gnosis to call on the tribe's totem, who sends a great beast to fight for the Garou for an hour a success. Trackless Waste One Gnosis to turn the land against the Garou's foes: every enemy within 30 cells slows to a crawl for an hour. Trash is Treasure Makes something broken whole again: a building or item back to full health, a broken machine working. Tread Sebek's Back One Gnosis to cross water as easily as open ground, an hour a success. Trick Shot Always on. A steadier aim with any gun. Troll Skin One Gnosis. The hide turns tough as stone for an hour. True Fear Terror that sends one enemy running for a few seconds a success. A Garou won't run, but won't fight either. Truth of Gaia Hears every lie for an hour: better at bargaining, and hard to cheat in trade. Ultimate Argument of Logic An argument no mind can stand against: a prisoner's resistance crumbles with every success. Umbral Camouflage One Gnosis to hide from spirits for an hour: in the Penumbra, banes don't sense or hunt the Garou. Attacking breaks it. Umbral Dodge One Gnosis. The next foe to strike the Garou in melee within the hour misses and falls into the Penumbra. Umbral Tether Always on. A silver cord leads back to where the Garou stepped into the Penumbra: stepping out, they come out there again, for a Gnosis for each full day spent across. Uncaught Since the Primal Morn One Gnosis, and for an hour a success nothing can catch the Garou. Under the Gun One Gnosis and a touch curse someone for a day a success: shots hit them harder. Unicorn's Arsenal One Gnosis. For an hour every blow marks its victim: they take more damage from everyone. Unity of the Pack Always on. Friends near the Garou fight together and keep their nerve. Venom Blood One Rage, and for an hour the Garou's blood burns whoever wounds them in melee. Visage of Fenris Looms huge and terrible for an hour: friends are impressed, and enemies within 8 metres lose their nerve. Visceral Agony One Rage, and for an hour every wound the Garou deals hurts twice as much. Wall of Granite One Gnosis to raise a ring of granite around the Garou and those huddled close, standing for an hour. Wasp Talons One Rage to fire a claw like a dart at a foe up to 20 cells away. It grows back at once. Weak Arm A turn spent reading a foe finds their weak spot: for an hour they take more damage from everyone. Web Walker One Gnosis to run the Pattern Web with the pack to any settlement up to 30 tiles away, twice that from or to a caern or a sept. Whelp Body One Gnosis for a curse that leaves a foe weak as a pup for good: worse with every success. Wind Claws One Rage, and for a few seconds the Garou's claws ignore armor. Wind's Returning Favor One Willpower. The next foe to strike the Garou with a weapon within the hour drops it. Wings of Pegasus One Gnosis for wings: the Garou flies up to 40 cells. Wisdom of the Ancient Ways Meditation on the past brings the ancestors' knowledge: research and learning are quicker for an hour a success. Wisdom of the Seer One Gnosis and an hour gazing at the night sky to ask one question: where the colony's nemesis waits, where an Anathema of the Red List is, where the nearest Wyrm site lies, or what threat comes next. Three successes make the answer plain. Wither Limb One Gnosis and a stare that withers a limb for an hour: the victim limps and fumbles. Wolf at the Door Leaves a person sure something is hunting them: for a day a success they are close to breaking. Wrath of Gaia One Gnosis to show Gaia's wrath: every creature of the Wyrm within 15 cells flees in terror. A Garou won't run, but won't fight either. Wuxing Turns fire into water: every fire around the spot goes out, more of them with each success. Wyld Resurgence Draws on the Wyld to close the Garou's own wounds, one a success. Not aggravated ones. Wyld Warp One Gnosis and one Rage call Wyldlings to fight for the Garou for an hour: one, and another for every two successes. Wyrm Hide A bane's favor hardens the skin into a leathery hide for an hour.

Name What it is Cunning Wants to win without a fair fight. Asks for quiet work away from the caern. Pays in silver and favors owed. Traditional Wants the Litany kept and the caern held. Asks for guards in the bawn. Pays in Honor and standing at the sept. Warlike Wants the Wyrm's servants dead, and soon. Sends you after banes and asks you to stand guard. Pays in fetishes and Glory. Wild Wants to run free and fight what it finds. Hunts banes when the mood takes it. Pays in whatever it carries. Wise Wants the spirits listened to and the old lore kept. Sends word to other septs. Pays in talens and Wisdom.

Name What it is Acute Sense Sharp-eyed even for a Garou. Sees better than anyone around them. Bad Sight Poor eyesight that nothing fixes, and regeneration doesn't touch it. Calm Heart Stays calm when others wouldn't. Frenzy is two harder to fall into. Harano Prone Falls into dark moods easily. Every loss sinks twice as deep into Harano. Hard of Hearing Misses sounds others catch. Huge Size Close to seven feet tall in human form, and huge in the others. Takes a beating better than most. Immune to Wyrm Emanations Gaia guards this one against the Wyrm's poisons. Toxins and toxic air do far less. Iron Will Hard to get inside. Three more dice against Gifts and powers that work on the mind. Lame Old damage to the legs that never healed right. Walks slowly, with a heavy limp. Long-Distance Runner Can run fast and keep running. Moves quicker than others, in every form. Metamorph Changes shape as easily as breathing. Every shift works, with no roll. Natural Channel Slips through the Gauntlet more easily than most. Stepping sideways is one easier. Pierced Veil Mortals see this Crinos for what it is and remember it. No Delirium, so every witness costs the Veil. Short Fuse Rage burns hotter in this one. Frenzy is two easier to fall into, and the Thrall of the Wyrm can take them at any time. Silver Tolerance Silver still leaves wounds that heal slowly, but it hits no harder than steel. Taint of Corruption The Wyrm touched this one long ago, and the mark stays. Sense Wyrm finds them, and no rite washes it off. Weak-Willed Easily pushed around. Never resists a Gift that works on the mind, and Willpower never goes above 4.

Name What it is A cub A cub becomes a Cliath through the Rite of Passage. See [[WTA_Guide_Renown_and_Rank#rank\ Rank]]. A Gift to learn This Garou can afford a Gift. Open the Gifts page on the Garou tab and press Learn a Gift. It needs the rank, the experience and a teacher. See [[WTA_Guide_Gifts#learning-a-gift\ Learning a Gift]]. Broke the Litany This Garou broke a tenet this season. Until the season passes it can be the subject of a [[WTA_Guide_Rites_and_the_Caern#punishment-rites\ punishment rite]], and it can fall to the Thrall. See [[WTA_Guide_Frenzy_and_the_Litany#the-litany\ The Litany]]. Fox frenzy Below half health, or facing three foes or more, a frenzied Garou runs instead of fighting. See [[WTA_Guide_Frenzy_and_the_Litany#frenzy\ Frenzy]]. Harano This Garou is sinking in grief for the dying world. At its deepest it may give up and leave the colony. - It eases by itself over weeks. - Gathering for the Departed eases it faster, by each success. See [[WTA_Guide_Frenzy_and_the_Litany#harano\ Harano]]. In frenzy The wolf has this Garou, and you can't give orders until it ends. It takes the war form and attacks strangers first, kinfolk and packmates last. - Keep mortals and outsiders away. - It lasts at least an hour, then ends once no foe is in sight and a Willpower roll succeeds. See [[WTA_Guide_Frenzy_and_the_Litany#frenzy\ Frenzy]]. Kinfolk This pawn has Garou blood and never Changed. They know what the Garou are, the Delirium doesn't touch them, and a frenzied Garou goes for them last. See the Kinfolk tab. See [[WTA_Guide_Packs_and_Kinfolk#kinfolk\ Kinfolk]]. No hands Hispo and Lupus hold nothing, and can't do work that needs hands. Change back for that work. See [[WTA_Guide_Forms_and_Shifting#gear\ Gear]]. No pack A pack is two or more Garou bound to one totem spirit. Open the Pack page on the Garou tab and press Form a pack, or Join a pack if one exists. See [[WTA_Guide_Packs_and_Kinfolk#packs\ Packs]]. Out of Gnosis Gifts, fetishes and stepping sideways all want Gnosis. - Press Seek Gnosis on the Garou. It meditates where it stands. - Standing near the colony's [[WTA_Guide_Rites_and_the_Caern#the-caern\ caern]] also brings it back. See [[WTA_Guide_Being_Garou#gnosis\ Gnosis]]. Rage running high With this much Rage under tonight's moon, the next wound or insult could set off a frenzy. - Keep it away from trouble, or let it rest. Rage sinks back an hour after the last harm. - Keep Resist frenzy on, on the form bar, if it has Willpower to spend. See [[WTA_Guide_Frenzy_and_the_Litany#frenzy\ Frenzy]]. Ready for the next rank This Garou has the Renown for its next rank. It takes a rite or a challenge to win it. Hover the rank on the Garou tab to see what it needs. See [[WTA_Guide_Renown_and_Rank#rank\ Rank]]. Silver wounds Silver deals aggravated damage, and aggravated wounds don't regenerate. They heal at a mortal's pace, and a part lost to silver takes three days to grow back. - Pull this Garou out of the fight and let it mend. See [[WTA_Guide_Being_Garou#silver\ Silver]]. Starving A starving Garou doesn't regenerate, and starving provokes a frenzy roll about once an hour. - Feed it now. Raw food doesn't bother a Garou. - Crinos and Hispo eat twice what a mortal does, so change to a smaller form if food is short. See [[WTA_Guide_Being_Garou#hunger\ Hunger]]. The caern Garou within 12 cells get back a quarter of a Gnosis a level, every so often, and the Gauntlet is thin here. Every three moots held at a level raise it by one, up to 5. See [[WTA_Guide_Rites_and_the_Caern#the-caern\ The caern]]. The Veil at risk Outsiders are on the map and this Garou is in a form they could remember. - Change to Homid, or keep it out of their sight. - Kill, imprison, recruit or talk round any witness before they leave. See [[WTA_Guide_The_Veil_and_Septs#the-veil\ The Veil]]. The war form Crinos keeps melee weapons only. Clothes, armour and guns come off, and by default they drop at its feet. Claws and bite deal aggravated wounds, and mortals who see it suffer the Delirium. See [[WTA_Guide_Forms_and_Shifting#the-five-forms\ The five forms]]. Thrall of the Wyrm This Garou attacks anyone, packmates included, and no Willpower holds it off. - Get everyone clear until it ends. - It costs four Wisdom and leaves Wyrm taint behind, deeper each time. See [[WTA_Guide_Frenzy_and_the_Litany#the-thrall-of-the-wyrm\ The Thrall of the Wyrm]]. Totem's Ban broken The pack has lost every gift of its totem. Press Make amends on the Pack page to lead the Rite of Contrition. If it works, the gifts come back. See [[WTA_Guide_Packs_and_Kinfolk#the-ban\ The Ban]]. Wyrm taint A tainted Garou can fall to the Thrall of the Wyrm, and at the last step of taint it is lost for good. - The Rite of Cleansing washes taint out. - Keep it calm until then. Six successes on a frenzy roll is the Thrall. See [[WTA_Guide_Frenzy_and_the_Litany#the-thrall-of-the-wyrm\ The Thrall of the Wyrm]].

Name What it is Harano-struck Sunk in the grey sorrow. Asks little and only to see the Wyrm's taint cleansed, and is warmed quickly by anyone who helps. Rage-driven Asks only for fights, and pays in Glory: the sept hears of every Garou who stood with it. Short with anyone who stops it for a chat.

Name What it is Bane nest A place where the Gauntlet has worn through. Banes crossed into the world here and stayed, and the ground around them has gone grey. Black Spiral hideout A hole the Black Spiral Dancers dug for themselves, where they keep what they stole from the sept. Black Spiral Hive A Black Spiral Dancer den. Green balefire lights it, banes crawl through it, and the ground for miles around is sick with the Wyrm. Corrupted factory A factory where Pentex makes its worst products. The workers are fomori, and the waste has turned the land black for miles. Fallen caern A caern that died when its sept did. Fomori live in the lodge now, and the totem's carving is cracked through. Fomori camp A camp of fomori, raw and crowded. They took some of the sept's kin when they came. Loggers' camp A camp of loggers and squatters cutting its way into the last wild land near the sept. Stumps and spoiled water spread out around it. Pentex subsidiary A plant run by one of Pentex's companies. It poisons the land around it, and fomori and First Team mercenaries guard it. Wyrm-bloated beast An animal the Wyrm got into. It's bigger than it should be, and the ground where it sleeps has gone grey.

Name What it is Breath of Gaia A deep breath of clean air at dawn, to honor Gaia. The body fights off sickness a little better for a day. Gathering for the Departed A howl for the dead, over their body. Everyone nearby mourns together, and the Garou's despair eases a little. Greet the Moon A howl to Luna, outdoors under tonight's moon. The Garou is steadier for a day. Hunting Prayer A quiet word to the spirits before the hunt. The Garou stalks a little quieter for a day. Moot Rite The gathering at the caern, once each lunar cycle. The whole colony takes heart, the ritemaster earns Honor, and each moot held makes the caern stronger. Prayer for the Prey Thanks given to the animals the Garou kills. Nothing of the prey goes to waste for a day. Rite of Accomplishment The Garou's deeds are told and honored. Every full measure of temporary Renown becomes a permanent dot, and a Garou with the Renown for the next rank takes it. Rite of Binding A willing spirit is bound into a talen: a one-use charm that does its task and lets the spirit go. One talen a success, up to three. Rite of Caern Building The greatest rite: a night-long working at a cleansed place of power, begun at dusk under a waxing moon. Three or more Garou pour in thirty Gnosis between them, kinfolk a point each, and every Garou gives up a point of Gnosis for good. The Wyrm will come while it runs. Failure burns everyone in the circle. Rite of Cleansing Water, smoke and a howl drive the Wyrm's taint out of a person, a patch of ground or a fetish, or ready a place of power for a caern. Rite of Contrition The Garou humble themselves to make amends. It brings back a totem whose Ban was broken, and clears a Litany broken this season. Rite of Ostracism One by one the circle names the offender, says they have no such kin, and turns away. The offender loses Renown, and their packmates shun them until the moon turns. Rite of Passage A cub proves themselves before the tribe and becomes a Cliath, with a Cliath's Renown and the Gifts of their auspice and tribe. Rite of Reawakening At the spring equinox the ritemaster leads the circle sideways into the Penumbra, where banes come at them in waves. If every bane falls, Gaia wakes: the circle's Gnosis fills, and the crops grow faster for the rest of the season. Rite of Summoning Performed in the Penumbra, where it comes easiest: a spirit of the chosen kind is called to the circle. Rite of the Fetish A willing spirit is bound into a cleansed vessel for good, making a fetish of any level up to the ritemaster's rank. Rite of the Jackdaw Open-mouthed sigils are carved and laid around a Garou who broke a promise of secrecy. For a day per success, they can't stop telling everyone about their own petty secrets. Rite of the Opened Bridge The ritemaster lays a pathstone at the heart of the caern and calls on its totem to open a road through the Umbra to the nearest friendly sept. For a year, renewed at every moot, colonists can cross from the caern to that sept and back, and the sept's Garou come at once when the Wyrm attacks. Rite of the Opened Caern The ritemaster wrestles with the caern's spirit to draw out its power, of whatever kind the caern holds. Losing badly burns them. Rite of the Opened Sky A rain dance calls down a cleansing rain over the caern. It washes out the Wyrm's taint, and for two more Gnosis a level it heals everyone under it who isn't an enemy. Vampires and the Wyrm's creatures are left in agony, but not cleansed. One Gnosis at the caern, ten anywhere else. Rite of the Totem Garou with no pack call a totem spirit and bind themselves to it as a pack. Their Totem dots together must reach the totem's cost. Rite of the Winter Winds On the longest night the circle howls, grabs burning branches and runs through the dark making every frightful noise it can, to scare the Wyrm's servants off. The next Wyrm raid this season doesn't come. Satire Rite A song of ridicule performed at the caern while the offender watches, remembered for generations. The offender drops a rank. If it goes badly wrong, the song turns on the ritemaster. Stone of Scorn A stone passes around the circle, and each Garou carves a mark of shame on it and tells a mocking tale about the offender, who has to sit and listen. The offender loses a great deal of Honor. The Great Hunt At midsummer Gaia names a servant of the Wyrm, and it comes. Kill it before midnight and the circle wins Glory. Let it get away and they lose Glory, and every rite is harder for a year. The Hunt Called against a Garou guilty of a capital crime. The offender is cast out of the colony and runs, and the hunters give no quarter. Whoever brings them down earns Honor. The Long Vigil At the autumn equinox the caern is hung with the year's trophies, and the circle tells their stories around a bonfire until dawn, then burns them. Until winter the circle rolls a die more on Rage and is in better spirits. Voice of the Jackal Ash is blown in the face of a Garou who shamed the whole sept. They lose Renown, and their voice becomes a shrill whine that hurts every dealing with others until the punishment is lifted.

Name What it is Garou pack Three young Garou, newly through their Rite of Passage, sent by their sept to guard a wild place on a world the Wyrm has started to notice. Two kinfolk came with them. The pack has its totem, and the totem expects a lot. Hill village Your village has married into the wolf-blood for as long as anyone remembers. You leave offerings at the standing stones and keep the dogs in at the full moon. Now the five of you have gone up into the hills to start a new village, and one of you has started dreaming about running.Note: five kinfolk and no Garou. One of them can go through the First Change, and nobody knows which. Medieval arms and the old crafts; research is as normal. Kinfolk family Your family has always known about the wolves in the bloodline. Grandmother told the stories, and an uncle went away one full moon and never came back. Now the family has moved to the edge of nowhere, and one of you has started to dream about running.Note: five kinfolk and no Garou. One of them can go through the First Change, and nobody knows which. Lone cub Last week you were ordinary. Then something broke loose inside you, and when you woke up the house was wrecked and everyone was gone. You ran as far as the transport would take you. No sept knows you exist, and nobody has told you what you are.Note: one Garou of rank 0, with a single Gift and no pack. A hard start. Lost tribe The sept fell. Three Garou of one tribe got out with two of their kin and the stories of everyone who didn't. You've gone a long way from home to start again, and you'll carry the tribe's ways with you.Note: everyone shares one tribe, rolled when the game starts. The old sept Your sept keeps the old ways: no machines, no guns, no cities. The elders sent three young Garou and two kin out with spears and bows to find a new caern and hold it. A wolf of the sept's line came with you.Note: three Garou and two kinfolk as a pack, with a timber wolf. They walk in with medieval arms and the old crafts; research is as normal.

Name What it is Den parent Raises the sept's cubs through their first Change. Fosters a cub when the sept asks. Guardian Walks the bawn and turns back what doesn't belong there. Master of the Rite Keeps the sept's rites and leads them. Owes the sept one rite a season. Sept Leader Leads the sept and calls its moots. Taken only by a Garou of rank 5 who beats the elder's challenge. Talesinger Tells the sept's deeds at every moot, and keeps who did what straight. Truthcatcher Hears disputes between the sept's Garou and judges them by the Litany. Warder Holds the caern against whatever comes for it.

Name What it is Accept an honourable surrender A beaten foe who yields is spared. Killing a captive is a crime, not a victory. Do not eat the flesh of humans People are not prey. A Garou who eats one has taken a step toward the Wyrm. Don't let your people carry you A Garou who can no longer do their part steps aside rather than be carried. Fight the Wyrm wherever it is No Garou leaves the Wyrm's servants alone once they know of them. Garou do not mate with Garou Two Garou together make a Metis, born deformed and barren. The Litany forbids it. In peace, the leader may be challenged In peace, any Garou may challenge for a higher place. This one permits rather than forbids. In war, the leader is not challenged When the sept fights, its leader is not questioned until the fighting is over. Keep the Veil closed Humans must not learn what the Garou are. The last time they did, they hunted the wolves nearly to the end. Never let a caern be violated A caern is Gaia's own ground. Losing one through carelessness is among the worst things a Garou can do. Respect another's territory A sept's land is its own. Hunting or settling there takes leave first. Respect those beneath you: all are of Gaia Kin, captives and animals are Gaia's too. They aren't to be harmed for no reason. Submit to those of higher station The lower-ranked defer to the higher, and challenge only in turn. The first share of the kill to the greatest in station At a feast, the highest-ranked eats first.

Name What it is Bear Strong, patient and a healer. His packs gain his strength and his touch, but the Garou frown on those who seek out the werebears' patron. Boar Too angry to back down and too stubborn to die. His packs are hard to put down. Chimera She of many faces, keeper of riddles. Her packs grow wise by puzzling things out. Cockroach Quick, hardy and everywhere. He knows the ways of machines and the people who build them. Coyote The trickster of tricksters. His packs sneak, bargain and survive, but wisdom earned with him counts for less. Cuckoo The master of slipping in unnoticed. Her packs talk their way anywhere, and are honored less for it. Falcon The noble hunter of the high air. His packs earn honor and lead well, and draw on a store of resolve when they flag. Fenris The great wolf of the end of days. He wants packs that bleed their enemies often. Fox Sly and quick, a talker and a thief. His packs get by on their wits, and are honored less for it. Grandfather Thunder The proud and fearsome lord of storms. His packs carry themselves well and are hard to stare down. Griffin The hunter who mourns every lost species and blames humans for them. His packs see far. Owl The silent watcher who knows the secrets of death. His packs move unheard. Pegasus The winged guardian of wild places. Her packs have a way with animals. Rat The quiet raider who bites and runs. His packs strike from hiding and share a store of resolve. Raven The clever scavenger who always finds a meal. He provides for packs who trust him. Stag The horned lord of the forest. His packs run far and live off the land. Uktena The old water spirit of dark places, who knows secrets other totems don't. His packs learn quickly but are hard to warm to. Unicorn The spirit of peace and healing. Her packs mend wounds and quarrels alike. Wendigo The hungry spirit of the winter storm. His packs carry a cold fury that never runs dry.

Name What it is Black Furies Defenders of the wild places, and of women and children who have nowhere else to turn. Nearly all of them are women. A man is born to the tribe only as a Metis. Black Spiral Dancers Garou who walked the Black Spiral Labyrinth and came out serving the Wyrm. Mad, twisted and many of them Metis, they breed in hives under poisoned ground and hate the other tribes more than anything alive. Bone Gnawers Scavengers who live on the edges of cities, among the poor and the forgotten. Other tribes look down on them. They survive anything, and they eat anything. Children of Gaia Peacemakers and healers. They hold that the Garou's worst wounds are the ones they give each other, and they show mercy where other tribes would not. Fianna Bards and revellers who love a song, a drink and a fight in about equal measure. They keep the old tales alive, and some say the fey still walk with them. Get of Fenris Warriors who measure everything by strength. They don't forgive weakness in others or in themselves, and they meet the Wyrm head on. Glass Walkers The Garou of cities and machines. They believe the fight has to be won where people live, and they put technology to work for it. Red Talons Wolves who want humanity gone and the world given back to the wild. They take no human-born Garou, and their kin run on four legs. Shadow Lords Ambitious and ruthless politicians who believe the Garou need a strong hand, and that the hand should be theirs. Silent Striders Wanderers and messengers who never stay long in one place. They travel faster than anyone and carry word between septs, and the dead follow them. Silver Fangs The royal line, which has led the Garou for as long as anyone remembers. Proud and noble, and prone to madness from breeding too long within their own line. Stargazers Seekers who look for balance through discipline and patient thought. They keep their Rage on a shorter leash than most Garou. Uktena Keepers of hidden lore. They study the mysteries other Garou avoid, and they watch over things that were bound away long ago and must stay bound. Wendigo Fierce guardians of the cold northern wilds. They are hard as the winter they live in, and slow to trust the tribes who came from across the sea.

The factions, the kinds of people and the creatures this mod adds.

Faction What it is Garou pack A young pack sent by its sept to guard a wild place, with the kinfolk who came along.Garou are the warriors of Gaia, born to fight the Wyrm and its servants. A pack is the smallest unit of the Garou Nation: a few werewolves of different tribes and auspices, bound to each other and to a totem spirit that asks a ban of them in return for its gifts. The pack's alpha leads in the hunt, but it earns its Renown with the rest of them. Keep the Litany, honour the totem, and the sept may one day ask you to guard a caern of its own. Hill village A village of kinfolk in the hills, where the wolf-blood still runs.Kinfolk are the human relatives of the Garou. They don't Change, and the Delirium doesn't touch them. For generations the people of this village have married into the families the wolves watch over, and they keep the old customs without always knowing why. Somewhere among them the blood runs strong enough for one to Change. Kinfolk family A family with wolves in the bloodline, moved out to the edge of nowhere.Kinfolk are the human and wolf relatives of the Garou. They don't Change, and the Delirium doesn't touch them, so they see the werewolves for what they are. The tribes count on them for children, for cover in the human world and for a home to come back to. Somewhere in this family, the blood runs strong enough for one of them to Change. Lost cub A Garou who went through the First Change alone, with no sept or elder to explain it.Most cubs are found before the Change by the Garou who watch over their bloodlines, and taken to a sept to learn the Litany and pass their Rite of Passage. This one was missed. Until a sept finds them, they have no tribe that knows them, no Gifts but what instinct gives, and a Rage that does not care who is standing close. Raiders Hired guns on someone's payroll. Nobody who asks who pays them gets an answer. Raiders A hard crowd that follows a trail until it ends. Remnant of a fallen sept The last Garou of one tribe and their kin, who got out when their sept fell.Every tribe of the Garou Nation keeps its own ways, its own totem and its own homeland, and its septs guard the caerns that Gaia's power wells up from. When a caern falls, its spirits die or go to the Wyrm, and the sept goes with it. These survivors carry the tribe's ways far from home and mean to build a new sept around them. Sept of the old ways A young pack from a sept that never took up the ways of the cities.Septs of the old ways kept their caerns deep in the forests and high in the hills, with kinfolk villages nearby to raise the children and keep the fires lit. They fought with claw, spear and bow, and they still do. This pack was sent to find a caern of its own and guard it as the old sept guards theirs. Settlers Scattered settlements that keep to their own land. They trade with those they trust and tell outsiders very little. Settlers Ordinary people working a stretch of land nearby. They trade with their neighbors and send their young out to find work.

Name Value What it is ← Garou contents · The Rim by Night This is not official World of Darkness material. Portions of the materials are the copyrights and trademarks of Paradox Interactive AB, and are used with permission. All rights reserved. For more information please visit worldofdarkness.com.
Great Wendigo's hunger made flesh, called by a Gift. It hunts the Garou's foes until its time runs out.
A creature of dream, made real for a while by a Gift. It fights for the Garou who called it until it fades.
A spirit of raw earth, fire, air or water, called up by a Gift. It fights for the Garou who called it until its time runs out.
One of the great beasts of the first days, called back by a Gift. It fights for the Garou who called it until its time runs out.
A great wolf of Valhalla, called by a Gift. It fights for the Garou who called it until its time runs out.
0 A beast bred in the Wyrm's own Realms: all muscle, horn and burning hide, with the Wyrm's hunger in its eyes. It hunts Gaia's children by scent across whole regions and does not stop.
A hound of the Wild Hunt, called by a Gift. It runs down the Garou's foes until its time runs out.
A tree woken by a Gift and walking on its roots. It fights for the Garou who woke it until it takes root again.

0 One of the Wyrm's great destroyers: a heaving mass of chitin, mouths and grasping limbs the size of a house. It crawls out of the Umbra's dark places to unmake whatever it finds, and Garou who meet one alone seldom come back to say so.
A shadow of the Garou who called it, given claws. One blow puts it out.
An avatar of the sept's totem, crossed over from the Umbra to stand at its moot. It stays a few hours beside the ritemaster, and fights for the sept if it must.
A spirit of pure, mad change, loosed by a Gift. It fights for the Garou who called it until it fades.

Every power in this mod in one list: the ones learned, the ones items and forms give, and the ones only NPCs use. Cooldowns are in game time. Power Cost Reach Cooldown What it does ← Garou contents · The Rim by Night This is not official World of Darkness material. 1 Willpower Self 1 h One Willpower for the howls and shadows of a pack that isn't there. Enemies within 15 cells who fail a Willpower roll run, a few seconds a success. Garou aren't fooled.
1 Gnosis Self 4 h One Gnosis, and for four hours a success poison, disease, heat and cold barely touch the Garou.
1 Gnosis Self 1 h One Gnosis and a howl to the things under the earth. The ground heaves: everyone within 10 cells but the Dancer is thrown down for five seconds unless they keep their feet.
Self 4 h Tools made by human hands answer the Garou better for four hours: quicker work, and a steadier aim with a gun.
Self 4 h For four hours the Garou passes as one of any people, however strange: much better at talking, trading and bargaining.
1 Gnosis Self 1 h One Gnosis to ask the spirits of the place what's going on: shows every enemy and every supernatural power on the map.
1 Rage, 1 Gnosis Self 4 h One Rage and one Gnosis, and for four hours every foe within 10 cells of the Garou doubles over in pain.
44.9 cells 1 h Strikes the nearest hostile spirit: three aggravated wounds.
1 Gnosis Self 1 day One Gnosis and a bargain with a bane: it fights beside the Dancer, longer for each success. Once a day.

1 Gnosis, 1 Willpower 24.9 cells 1 h One Gnosis and one Willpower to bar an enemy pack's totem for an hour: the Garou aimed at and its packmates nearby lose the totem's favour and fight apart, with no shared target.
1 Gnosis Self 4 h One Gnosis to burn a sigil into the ground around the Garou: for four hours every spirit within 8 cells, but the pack's own, loses strength every few seconds.
1 Gnosis Self 15 s One Gnosis to call the animals around: every beast within 30 cells comes to the Garou's side and fights for them for a few minutes a success.
Self 4 h Talks with animals for four hours: much better at taming and training.
24.9 cells 4 h Strips a person back to an animal mind: they wander, lost, for four hours a success. Garou are only cowed.
Self 10 s Hears every enemy heartbeat on the map, and lifts the fog around each.
1 Gnosis Self 4 h One Gnosis. The next foe the Garou wounds within the hour is haunted for a day.
1 Gnosis 44.9 cells 1 h One Gnosis to vanish and reappear in any shaded spot up to 18 cells a success away.
Self 4 h While the Garou keeps still, no one sees them. Lasts four hours.
Self 8 h A taste of a foe's blood makes the Garou stronger for about an hour and a half a success. When it ends, they risk a frenzy.
Self 10 s A Gnosis roll at 8: Every spirit within 20 cells but the Garou's own is torn and staggered.
Self 4 h A Gnosis roll at 5: Every foe within 30 cells is chilled to the bone and slowed for four hours.
Self 4 h Eyes slide past the Garou for four hours. Attacking gives them away for a few seconds.
1 Gnosis 24.9 cells 4 h One Gnosis to thicken the Gauntlet around one foe for four hours: they can't step sideways.
Self 4 h Moves strength around the body for four hours: harder, surer blows.
1 Gnosis 24.9 cells 15 s One Gnosis for pain that leaves a foe convulsing a few seconds a success, and weaker at everything for four hours.

24.9 cells 1 h Always on: No power bends the Garou's mind. Used on another, Manipulation + Social frees them from a blood bond, Dominate, Presence or a Gift's hold, easier the stronger their own will.
Touch 4 h A breath that wakes the mind: whoever the Garou touches learns and researches faster for four hours a success.
1 Gnosis 999 cells 1 h One Gnosis for a small moon bridge to anywhere on the map.
Self 4 h For four hours mortals take the Garou for one of their own: no Delirium, and easier to talk to.
Self 8 h The Garou's weapon burns for about an hour and a half a success: every blow burns and sets things alight.
Self 4 h Digs like an animal for four hours: mining goes much faster.
1 Gnosis Self 12 h One Gnosis to bury the wolf for half a day a success: no Delirium, no shifting, no Rage. Freeing it early costs another Gnosis.
1 Gnosis Self 1 day One Gnosis to call an elemental that fights for the Garou for four hours.
1 Rage, 1 Gnosis Self 1 day One Rage and one Gnosis call the cannibal spirit to hunt the Garou's foes for four hours.
Self 1 h A howl that stirs every friend within 20 metres: a point of Rage each, and a better mood.
Self 10 s A call the Wyrm's creatures can't ignore: each one within 40 cells who loses the contest of wills comes to the Garou.
24.9 cells 4 h An icy wind around a spot: for four hours enemies within 6 metres are slowed and shiver too hard to aim well.
1 Gnosis Self 1 day An hour's chant and one Gnosis call the Wild Hunt's hounds to run down the Garou's foes for four hours.

Every setting in Options, Mod settings, The Rim by Night, with what it does. Setting What it does Renown gained Scales the Renown a Garou earns for deeds, and so how soon they can rise in rank. Renown lost for breaking the Litany stays as it is. Rage gained Scales the Rage a Garou gains from the moon, wounds, insults and the rest. Less Rage means fewer actions in a fight, fewer form shifts and fewer frenzies. At 0% a Garou only has the Rage they start the night with. Frenzy Off, wounds, insults and hunger never send a Garou into frenzy or the Thrall of the Wyrm. A Gift that calls up a frenzy still does, and so does the First Change. Harano Off, losses no longer sink a Garou into Harano. Any Harano they already have fades as usual. The Litany Off, breaking a tenet of the Litany costs no Honor or Wisdom and doesn't count against the Garou this season. The Delirium Off, no one panics or flees at the sight of a Crinos, and colonists aren't shaken by it. Outsiders remember what they saw, as with the Pierced Veil flaw, so the Veil suffers more. Challenges for alpha Packmates now and then challenge the alpha for the lead. Off, they never do on their own. Regeneration Scales how fast a Garou's wounds close on their own. Silver and other aggravated wounds still won't regenerate. Silver damage Scales the extra harm silver does to a Garou. At 100% it hits half again as hard as steel. Frenzy difficulty Added to the difficulty of every frenzy roll. Higher means the wolf takes over less often. Kinfolk who Change The chance that a Kinfolk with the blood for it goes through the First Change when something sets it off: from thin blood to strong. The mod's chances are 10%, 25% and 50%. The Curse Scales how much a Garou's Rage unsettles mortals: their mood near a Garou whose Rage beats their Willpower, and the Garou's worse luck with talk, trade and animals. At 0% the Curse is off. Kinfolk events Kinfolk and wolves of the tribe come to join the colony, and lost cubs turn up. A stray cub comes A colony with no Garou gets a stray cub at the edge of its land, some time between day 15 and day 40, and again every 30 to 60 days until one is taken in. Off, the cub only comes by chance. Needs kinfolk events on. Gear stays with the Garou When a Garou takes a form that can't wear or hold something, it goes with them and comes back when they change back. Off, it drops at their feet, as in the tabletop game. The Wyrm attacks Fomori, Black Spiral Dancers, Pentex First Teams and banes come for colonies with Garou, and Pentex opens plants nearby. The Veil Outsiders who keep their wits after seeing a Crinos can spread the word when they leave. Too much of that, and hunters come with silver. Veil damage Scales how much the Veil score rises for each outsider who leaves with what they saw. Veil healing Scales how fast the Veil score falls back each day as people forget. Wounds roll for frenzy once a fight Only the first wound of a fight, after an hour without one, makes a Garou roll for frenzy. Off, every wound does. The Thrall needs taint Only a Garou with Wyrm taint, one who broke the Litany this season, or one with Short Fuse can fall into the Thrall of the Wyrm when a frenzy goes badly. Off, any Garou can. Black Fury men are born Metis A man is only born to the Black Furies as a metis. Off, a man can be a Homid or Lupus Black Fury too. Garou to build a caern How many Garou the circle of the Rite of Caern Building needs, the ritemaster among them. Gnosis to build a caern How much Gnosis the circle pours into the Rite of Caern Building, kin giving a point each. Every Garou in it still gives up a permanent point. Totem tasks The chance, each lunar cycle, that a pack's totem asks a task of one of the pack. At 0% totems never ask. A misused spirit stays silent How long a fetish's spirit refuses to answer after it is used against its nature, in a frenzy or against a friend. A Gnosis point wakes a fetish A Garou who has a Gnosis point spends it to wake a fetish with no roll. Off, every use is a Gnosis roll. Gifts camera shake How hard big Gifts shake the camera: a storm's lightning, Gaia's Vengeance, a Great Leap landing. At 0% the camera stays still. Gifts sky flashes Big Gifts flash the sky in their colour, and storms tint it while they build. Off, the sky keeps its own light. Moon bridges on the world map Gifts that open a moon bridge or walk the Pattern Web carry the Garou to a tile in range at once. Off, those Gifts are greyed out and travel goes by caravan. Towns for each sept The Garou Nation keeps one sept for this many ordinary towns in the world, two of them always within a caravan's reach of the colony. Lower means more septs. Takes effect on a new world, and on new septs founded later. The challenge A raiding pack that isn't of the Wyrm may hold back and offer the colony's Garou a duel instead of a fight. Win, and the pack leaves; lose, and it takes silver worth the raid. The Wyrm's Hunted A handful of the Wyrm's servants the Garou Nation most wants dead roam the world map: Black Spiral packs and great Wyrm beasts. They roam either way, but only a colony the Nation knows is told of them, sees them on the map or earns Renown for one. The tips the game shows the first times you meet something. Tip What it is Forms A Garou has five forms: Homid, Glabro, Crinos, Hispo and Lupus.The form bar above its buttons picks one, and "In fights" sends it into Crinos when a fight starts. Crinos is the strongest and the most dangerous to be seen in: outsiders who keep their wits become witnesses to a breach of the Veil. Gnosis Gnosis is the Garou's bond with the spirit world. Many Gifts cost it, and so do stepping sideways and calling a spirit.It comes back slowly through meditation, faster near a caern, and all at once from a Sacred Hunt. Harano Harano is the Garou's despair at a war they may be losing. Losses, failures and a pack that falls apart feed it.Keep a Garou in Harano with its pack, hold the moot and spare it more grief. Sunk deep enough, it may walk away from the colony for good. Learning Gifts Experience and rank buy new Gifts.Open the Garou tab's Gifts page and press "Learn a Gift...". A spirit can be called to teach it for Gnosis, or a higher-ranked Garou of the colony who knows it can give lessons. Rage and frenzy Rage is the wolf's fury. The moon gives it each night outdoors, most at the full moon, and it pays for extra actions in a fight.When something provokes a Garou (a wound, an insult, hunger, a cage) it rolls its current Rage against the moon. Enough successes and the wolf takes over. Keep a Garou with high Rage out of trouble near the full moon, or let it spend the Rage in a fight. Renown and rank Garou society runs on Renown: Glory, Honor and Wisdom. Deeds give temporary points, shown over the Garou as it happens.Ten temporary points in a track become a permanent dot through the Rite of Accomplishment, or by winning an elder's rank challenge at a sept. Enough permanent dots raise the Garou's rank, and rank opens stronger Gifts. Hover the rank on the Garou tab to see what the next one needs. Rites Rites mark rank, bind packs and spirits, cleanse taint and keep the caern.Select the Garou who will lead and press "Perform a rite". The colony's Garou come to form the circle, and everyone close to the ritemaster when it ends takes part. More Garou than the rite needs make the roll easier. The Garou A werewolf lives in your colony now.The Garou tab shows its tribe, breed and auspice, tonight's moon, and its Rage, Gnosis and Willpower. Its wounds close on their own, paid for in food, so keep it fed. Its Gifts sit on tiles above the buttons, one tile per list. The Penumbra Beside the world lies the Umbra. The Penumbra, its nearest part, is a mirror of the home map with nothing the colony built in it.Stepping sideways costs Gnosis. Wyld glades there give it back, banes rise from the Wyrm's taint, and spirits can be met, bargained with and taught by. "Step back" returns the Garou home. The Veil The Litany forbids letting humans learn what the Garou are.The Delirium makes most people forget what they saw, but a strong-willed outsider who sees a Garou in Crinos, shifting shape, using an unexplainable Gift or a body torn by claws becomes a witness. Kill, imprison or recruit a witness before they leave the map, or the Veil suffers and hunters come. The Wyrm The Wyrm is corruption gone mad, and its servants come for colonies with Garou: fomori, Black Spiral Dancers, Pentex's First Team.Where they die, taint spreads on the ground and stokes a Garou's Rage. The Rite of Cleansing lifts it. Silver is the Wyrm's best weapon: its wounds don't regenerate. ← Garou contents · The Rim by Night This is not official World of Darkness material. Garou society runs on Renown, and Renown sets rank. Experience pays for Gifts and Backgrounds.

Three tracks, each with temporary points (0 to 10, in brackets on the Garou tab) and permanent dots (0 to 10). Track For Glory Courage and victory Honor Duty, keeping one's word, keeping the Litany Wisdom Insight, dealings with spirits, restraint Deeds give temporary Renown, shown over the Garou as it happens. Ten temporary points in a track become a permanent dot through the Rite of Accomplishment, or by winning an elder's rank challenge at a sept. A gain on the auspice's own track counts one more and gives back a point of Willpower: Glory for Ahroun and Galliards, Honor for Philodox, Wisdom for Theurges. Ragabash have none.

Each colony Garou works toward one goal at a time, taken from the deeds Renown is given for. A letter offers three, and one of them suits the Garou's auspice or tribe where one fits. The tab shows the goal and how far along it is, and so does the Quests tab. Only what happens after it is taken counts. A met ambition pays its experience and a point of temporary Renown of its own kind the same day, and a new letter comes the day after. There is no deadline and no failure. Drop one, or turn all three down, and another letter comes in five days.
