*The current does what the mage tells it: a switch flips, a lock lets go, and nobody touched a thing.* - Target: One building or mechanoid in sight - Effect: It switches on or off, or a door opens or shuts, with nobody at it: lights, turrets, doors, consoles - Mechanoid or turret: An enemy one takes the current as a jolt instead, stunned 1 seconds (one per Potency) - Lasts: Instant How to use it: Flips a switch from afar: turn off an enemy turret, open a locked door, switch on a console. Cast on a mechanoid or enemy turret, it stuns it for a few seconds. Not obvious, so it's safe in front of witnesses.

*Flames bend toward the mage's will, leaning one way and shying from another.* Influence Fire: Contain - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Fire in it doesn't spread, and anyone burning in it stops burning - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Influence Fire: Fan - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Its fires reach out to a neighbouring cell, 1 fires (one per Potency) every few seconds - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Contain stops a fire spreading and puts out anyone burning in the area: cast it the moment a fire starts in your base. Fan makes fires spread, for burning out an enemy position. The Reach also grows or shrinks the fires.

*Heat flows around the subject the way the mage wants it to, keeping them warm in the snow and cool in the desert.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Comfortable 15 degrees colder and 15 degrees hotter than usual - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Keeps someone comfortable in heat and cold: 15 degrees each way. Good for a caravan through desert or tundra. The Reaches widen it and cover everyone near.

*The mage wastes none of the force in their own steps and lifts: they walk faster and carry more.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Moving and carrying capacity +5% for each dot of Forces - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: As a Praxis it lasts only one turn (0.4 hours) until Forces 2 How to use it: A small travel buff: faster walking and more carrying, 5% per dot of Forces. Good on a caravan. Before Forces 2, a Praxis of it lasts only one turn.

*The mage sees by light too faint for other eyes, and by the heat that bodies give off.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Darkness doesn't slow their work or bother them, aim +2 in the dark, and in the dark nothing within 20 cells in their line of sight stays hidden under fog - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Darkness stops mattering: no work slowdown, better aim in the dark, and the fog lifts within 20 cells in their sight at night. Cast it before a night raid.

*Sound far below or above human hearing reaches the mage: footsteps in the next room, breath behind a wall.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Hearing +5% (5% per Potency), and an invisible enemy within 20 cells who walks or fights is heard and shimmers into sight - Traders: An orbital trader passing by is heard on the cast, and can be called with no console - Insects: Insects digging under the map are heard: an infestation is held off two hours, and a letter says where it will break out - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Super hearing. Invisible enemies within 20 cells show up when they move or fight. An orbital trader can be called with no console. It also hears insects digging: an infestation is held off two hours and a letter says where it'll come out.

*A cantrip of Forces. A spark snapped from the fingers.* - Target: One target in range (Gnosis x10 cells), with an attack roll - Effect: A spark: one burn wound - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: A cantrip, only with the Cantrips setting on: one wound from range, for a mage with a single dot of Forces.

*Radio waves turn into voices in the mage's head.* - Target: The caster - Effect: They hear radio waves. While it lasts, a raid on their map shows up as a letter two hours before it arrives - Traders: When you cast it, a list of the orbital traders in range opens, and you can call one down with no comms console - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: It's the way to trade before you've built a console, or when the power is out. For the raid warning, cast it with a long Duration on a mage who stays home.

*Worked from Transmission, Forces Ruling. A call goes out over the radio, and traders answer it.* - Target: A powered comms console - Effect: A faction's traders hear a call for trade and send a caravan - Lasts: Instant How to use it: Uses a powered comms console to get a faction to send a caravan.

*The mage commands the current in the wires: where it goes, where it stops, and who it jumps to.* Control Electricity: Cut - Target: A conduit or powered building in sight - Effect: Everything on its power net that has a switch goes off, and back on after - Lasts: The Duration Control Electricity: Shield - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Electric shocks don't hurt them, and their blows carry a shock: 3 more burn damage - Lasts: The Duration Control Electricity: Route - Target: A powered building in sight - Effect: The whole net's power goes to it: everything else on the net that has a switch goes off, and back on after - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Three uses of current. Cut switches a whole power net off (an enemy base's turrets and doors). Shield makes a person shock-proof and their blows shock. Route sends a net's whole power to one building, switching the rest off: keep your turrets running in a blackout. The attack is Shock.

*Fire flares up or gutters out at the mage's word.* Control Fire: Shrink - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Every fire in it shrinks 1 sizes (one per Potency). One shrunk to nothing goes out - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Control Fire: Grow - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Every fire in it grows 1 sizes (one per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Shrink puts fires out instantly (a fire shrunk to nothing goes out): faster than any firefighter. Grow makes every fire in the area bigger, for burning out enemies.

*Down stops pointing at the floor. In the mage's area it points out toward the edges.* - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Everyone in it who isn't on the caster's side slides 3 cells toward its edge every few seconds, and a full slide does 8 blunt damage - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Pushes enemies out of an area: they slide toward its edge every few seconds and get hurt by a full slide. Your people aren't affected. Good for keeping raiders off a doorway.

*The mage pulls heat into a room or draws it out.* Control Heat: Warm - Target: The room at a spot in sight - Effect: It warms toward 15 degrees above 21 (15 per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened) Control Heat: Cool - Target: The room at a spot in sight - Effect: It cools toward 15 degrees below 21 (15 per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened) How to use it: A magic heater or cooler for one room: warm a bedroom in winter, or turn a room into a freezer for food. It's magic for a chore.

*Light gathers where the mage wants it and stabs into the eyes of those they point at.* Control Light: Brighten - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Lit as bright as a sun lamp: crops grow there and nobody works in the dark - Sunlight: The light is the sun's own, so a vampire standing in it burns as at dawn, night or day - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Control Light: Dim - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: No light reaches it: lamps, sun and fire leave it pitch dark, for work, aim, sleep and crops - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Brighten lights an area like a sun lamp: crops grow, nobody works in the dark, and since it's real sunlight a vampire in it burns. Dim makes an area pitch dark. The Reach blinds enemies in the area. Dazzle, against one person's eyes, is its own spell.

*The mage turns sound up, down, or somewhere else entirely.* Control Sound: Deafen - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Everyone there who isn't on the caster's side is deafened: hearing 0 - Lasts: The Duration Control Sound: Silence - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: They make no sound: their steps don't wake sleepers, stir a waiting ambush or a sleeping hive, or set off a tripwire - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Deafen silences enemies in an area. Silence makes one person soundless, so they don't wake sleepers, trigger ambushes, wake an insect hive or set off tripwires. Neither is obvious. The decoy is Thrown Voice.

*Clouds gather or part as the mage commands.* Control Weather: Rain - Target: The whole map at the whole map's Scale, or else an area in sight, the Scale - Effect: The whole map: the weather turns to rain. An area: rain falls on it and puts out its fires - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Control Weather: Fog - Target: The whole map at the whole map's Scale, or else an area in sight, the Scale - Effect: The whole map: the weather turns to fog. An area: fog fills it and cuts everyone's sight there - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Control Weather: Thunderstorm - Target: The whole map at the whole map's Scale, or else an area in sight, the Scale - Effect: The whole map: the weather turns to a thunderstorm. An area: rain falls on it and puts out its fires - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Control Weather: Snow - Target: The whole map at the whole map's Scale, or else an area in sight, the Scale - Effect: The whole map: the weather turns to snow. An area: snow falls on it, covers the open ground and puts out its fires - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Control Weather: Clear skies - Target: The whole map, at the whole map's Scale only - Effect: The weather turns to clear skies. Cast smaller, the wind blows smoke and gas out of the area - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Set the weather. Cast at the whole map's Scale to change the map's weather; cast smaller to affect only an area. Rain puts out fires, fog cuts sight, a thunderstorm lets Call Lightning work, snow covers the ground, clear skies ends bad weather. It's magic for a chore. The Reach makes the change look natural.

*Worked from Control Light, Forces Ruling. Light gathers in one person's eyes until they can barely see.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: Light is focused in their eyes: sight -10% (10% per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Cuts one person's sight for the Duration. Cast it on an enemy sniper.

*Heat, cold and poisoned air slide off the subject as if a skin of glass covered them.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Comfortable 15 degrees further each way (15 per Potency), and toxic air does 20% less (20% per Potency). No gas touches them: tox gas, rot stink, smoke (their shots go through it clean) - Odyssey: Vacuum hurts them 20% less - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Another mage's weather spell breaks it if that mage wins a Clash of Wills How to use it: A full environment suit: comfortable in heat and cold, safe in toxic air and gas, and with Odyssey safer in vacuum. Their shots go cleanly through smoke. Cast it before going into toxic fallout or a burning building. Another mage's weather spell can break it.

*Worked from Zoom In, Forces Ruling. The mage sees the whole map from where they stand.* - Target: The caster - Effect: They see the whole map from where they stand, with sight +10% (10% per Potency), aim +1 (1 per Potency), and guns and bows reaching 3 cells further (3 per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Zoom In with the whole map shown from where the caster stands: scout a raid before it reaches the walls.

*Worked from Kinetic Blow, Forces Ruling. A weapon's swing carries on as a blade of force past the one it hits.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Each melee blow sends a blade of force on past the target: the first enemy within 2 cells behind them takes the blow at half. Their weapon glows and every swing and shot leaves a trail - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: A greatsword's cutting wave: each melee blow carries on as a blade of force into the next enemy behind the target, at half the blow. Comes with Kinetic Blow's rote.

*Light bends around the subject. Eyes slide past where they stand.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Nobody can see them. Attacking flickers them into sight for a moment - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: A mage with Receiver hears them walking How to use it: Nobody can see them. Attacking makes them flicker into sight for a moment. Use it to scout, sneak past enemies, or get a free first strike. A mage with Receiver can hear them.

*The subject's blows land with the force of a sledgehammer behind them and an edge in front.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Bare hands cut like blades, and melee hits 10% harder (10% per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Turns bare hands into blades and makes every melee hit land harder. Good on a brawler with no weapon. The Reaches make blows knock down or stun.

*Worked from Kinetic Blow, Forces Ruling. Space folds under a swing, so the blade lands across a gap. Needs Space 2 as well as Forces.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Melee blows land from up to 1 cells away, the blade crossing the gap. Their weapon glows and every swing and shot leaves a trail - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Melee blows land from a few cells off, so a swordsman hits a runner before closing in. Needs Space 2 as well as Forces 2. Comes with Kinetic Blow's rote.

*Worked from Control Electricity, Forces Ruling. Current leaps from a live wire into whoever stands too close to it.* - Target: One person in sight, standing within 2 cells of a powered building - Effect: A shock: 8 burn damage (8 per Potency) and a stun of 1 seconds (1 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant How to use it: Shocks someone standing within 2 cells of a powered building. Good by a turret line or a battery bank.

*Worked from Control Sound, Forces Ruling. A voice calls out somewhere the caster isn't, and enemies go to look.* - Target: A spot in sight - Effect: A voice calls out there, and enemies nearby go to see who it was - Lasts: Instant How to use it: Calls out at a spot and draws nearby enemies to check it: a decoy to pull guards off a door. Not obvious.

*The mage speaks through the radio waves, or fills them with noise.* - Target: Enemies on the caster's map - Effect: They can't coordinate over their radios: aiming takes 50% longer - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Ruins the enemies' radio: every enemy on the map takes 50% longer to aim. Cast it at the start of a raid. Calling traders is Call Traders.

*The mage bends light into a lens and sees far things up close.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Sight +10% (10% per Potency), aim +1 (1 per Potency), and guns and bows reach 3 cells further (3 per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: A sniper's buff: better sight and aim, and guns and bows reach further. The Reaches ignore weather's aim penalty, or (microscopic) help research and tending. Seeing the whole map is Far Sight.

*The mage calls a bolt down out of the storm onto whoever they point at.* - Target: One person under open sky, with an attack roll. Only in a thunderstorm - Effect: Lightning strikes them: 8 burn damage (8 per Potency), a stun of 1 seconds (1 per Potency), and a fire - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Big damage, a stun and a fire, but only in a thunderstorm and only on someone under open sky. Make the storm first with Control Weather.

*Worked from Telekinesis, Forces Weaving. The weapon jerks out of a fighter's hands and lands at the mage's feet.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: The weapon in their hands is pulled away and falls at the caster's feet, if it weighs under 25 kg (25 kg per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Pulls the weapon out of an enemy's hands to the caster's feet, up to a weight limit by Potency. Takes a gunner out of the fight in one cast.

*The mage makes the ground pull harder, or lets go of what stands on it.* Gravitic Supremacy: Heavy - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Everyone in it who isn't on the caster's side moves 15% slower (15% per Potency) - Drop pods: A drop pod landing in it comes down hard: everyone inside takes 8 blunt damage (8 per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Gravitic Supremacy: Light - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: The caster's side moves 10% faster there (10% per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Heavy slows every enemy in an area, and a drop pod landing there smashes everyone inside: cast it where drop pod raids land. Light speeds up your own people in the area.

*Worked from Turn Momentum, Forces Weaving. Shots turn round and go back to whoever fired them.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Up to 1 shots (one per Potency) every 3 seconds are turned aside before they hit and sent back at the shooter. Explosions still land - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Bullets bend away from the caster and go back at whoever fired them, up to one shot per Potency every 3 seconds. Explosions still hit.

*An invisible hand does what the mage's own could, at a distance.* Telekinesis: Hold - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They're held down: moving at most 20% - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Telekinesis: Fetch - Target: One item in sight - Effect: It floats to the caster's feet, if it weighs under 25 kg (25 kg per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: An invisible hand. Hold pins an enemy down to 20% speed. Fetch brings an item to the caster: a dropped weapon, a medicine kit, with a weight limit by Potency. Pulling a weapon away is Disarm.

*Worked from Telekinesis, Forces Weaving. An unseen hand at the throat. A lost rote from the Seventh Storm.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: An unseen grip closes on the throat: consciousness and breathing fall by 15% (15% per Potency), and they can't talk or cast while it holds. Low enough, they black out - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Stamina, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) How to use it: Takes away a tenth of consciousness a Potency while it lasts. Stamina resists. A lost rote, taught only by the Seventh Storm.

*A blow of pure force, thrown across the room like a fist the size of a door.* Force Blow - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: 8 blunt damage (8 per Potency), and it throws them back. A Reach throws them a cell per Potency and knocks them down - Shape: The builder can give it a line, cone, burst, ring or chain, sized by Scale. Everyone in it is hit, friends too unless a Reach spares them - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Air Blade - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: A blade of air: 8 cut damage (8 per Potency), and it throws them back - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Force Spike - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: A spike of force: 8 stab damage (8 per Potency), and it throws them back - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Forces' basic attack: a blow of force that rolls to hit and throws the target back. Blunt, Cut and Pierce do different damage types, so pick the one their armour handles worst. Blunt can take a shape (line, cone, burst, ring or chain). The Reaches add a stun or a knockdown.

*Worked from Telekinesis, Forces Weaving. Whatever lies to hand thrown with the force of the mind. A lost rote from the Seventh Storm.* - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: The heaviest loose thing within 5 cells of the caster that the spell can lift (an item, a chunk, someone down; 25 kg at most) is hurled at them. Both take blunt damage by its weight - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Hurls the heaviest loose thing near the caster, and both it and the target take the blow. A lost rote, taught only by the Seventh Storm.

*Bullets bend away from the mage at the last moment.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Up to 1 shots (one per Potency) every 3 seconds are turned aside before they hit. Explosions still land - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Bullets bend away from the caster: up to one shot per Potency every 3 seconds misses. Explosions still hit. The Reach turns the shots into nearby enemies. Sending them back is Return Fire.

*The mage drags at someone's speed or adds to it.* Velocity Control: Slow - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They move at half to 12% of their speed - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Velocity Control: Speed - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They move at 150% to 250% of their speed - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Slow drops someone to a fraction of their speed with no roll to resist: stop a charging melee fighter. Speed makes a friend much faster: get a doctor to a downed colonist.

*A silent wave of force that kills machines and burns nerves.* - Target: An area in range, the Scale - Effect: Machines, turrets, shields and mechanoids in it take 10 EMP damage (10 per Potency), which stuns them; more damage stuns longer - Other magic: Another mage's Forces spell there ends, and an Artifact there loses its Mana, if the caster wins a Clash of Wills - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Stuns every machine, turret, shield and mechanoid in an area (more Potency, longer stun) and can end another mage's Forces spells there. The best answer to a mech raid. Its single-target cousin is Nerve Burn.

*Worked from Thunderbolt, Forces Patterning. Thunderbolt's fire made a ball that bursts where it lands. A lost rote from the Seventh Storm.* - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: A ball of fire bursts round them, wider than other bursts: 10 burn damage (10 per Potency) to everyone in it, and the ground catches fire - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing: no one inside dodges it - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: A burst of burn wounds that sets the ground alight. A lost rote, taught only by the Seventh Storm.

*Worked from Levitation, Forces Patterning. The subject's weight goes away and they fly where they please.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: They can fly to any spot up to 20 cells away, over walls, water and people - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Stamina, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Lets someone fly to any spot within 20 cells, over walls and water: get into a sealed base or out of a surrounded spot. The Reach gives free flight, out of reach of melee.

*The subject's weight goes away and they rise off the ground.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They're lifted off their feet and hang helpless in the air: they can't move - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Stamina, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Hangs an enemy helpless in the air. Flying is its own spell, Flight.

*Worked from Electromagnetic Pulse, Forces Unraveling. The pulse thrown at one body, burning along its nerves.* - Target: One living target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: 8 burn damage through the nerves (8 per Potency) and a stun of 1 seconds (1 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: A single-target attack, aimed and rolled to hit, that burns and stuns a living target.

*The air turns to sandpaper around the subject, or the ground under them turns to ice.* Rend Friction: Raise - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They take a burn wound for every three cells they move, up to 1 wounds (one per Potency), and armour only half helps - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Rend Friction: Lower - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They slip now and then as they move, losing a moment each time - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Raise burns someone every few cells they move, and armour only half helps: punish a runner or a charger. Lower makes them slip now and then, losing a moment each time.

*Lightning leaps from the mage's hand.* Lightning Bolt - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: A bolt of electricity: 8 burn damage (8 per Potency) and a stun of 1 seconds (1 per Potency) - Chain: It jumps from the target to the next person near, once for each subject the Scale allows (16 subjects, 16 jumps) - Shape: The builder can make it a bolt, line, cone, burst or ring instead, and a Reach spares the caster's side - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Fire Bolt - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: A bolt of fire: 8 burn damage (8 per Potency), and it can set them alight - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Frost Bolt - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: A bolt of cold: 8 frostbite damage (8 per Potency), and it chills them toward hypothermia - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Radiation Bolt - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: An unseen burst of radiation: no wound, but 8% toxic buildup (8% per Potency), less by their toxic resistance - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Thunderclap - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: A thunderclap: a small bruise (2 damage, 2 per Potency), a stun of 1 seconds (1 per Potency) and deafness for 10 seconds (10 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Forces' big attack in five flavours. Lightning burns, stuns and chains from person to person (the Scale sets how many jumps; a Reach spares your side). Fire sets them alight, Frost chills them toward hypothermia, Radiation poisons with no wound, and Sound stuns and deafens.

*Heat becomes current, fire becomes light: the mage changes what energy is.* Transform Energy: Power - Target: A conduit, and an area in sight, the Scale - Effect: A fire in the area goes out, a hot room cools, a cold room warms, or a battery there drains, and the conduit gets the energy as 100 to 5,000 W of power - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Powering the colony is magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Transform Energy: Light - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: A fire in it goes out, a hot room cools, a cold room warms, or a battery there drains, and it's lit like a sun lamp - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Transform Energy: Heat - Target: The room at a spot in sight, the Scale - Effect: A fire in it goes out, a cold room's chill or a battery there is used up, and the room warms 15 degrees at once (15 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Transform Energy: Cold - Target: The room at a spot in sight, the Scale - Effect: A fire in it goes out, a hot room's heat or a battery there is used up, and the room cools 15 degrees at once (15 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Transform Energy: Sound - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: A fire in it goes out, a hot or cold room evens out, or a battery there drains, and a thunderclap stuns everyone there who isn't on the caster's side for 1 seconds (1 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Transform Energy: Kinetic - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: A fire in it goes out, a hot or cold room evens out, or a battery there drains, and a blast throws everyone there who isn't on the caster's side 3 cells out and stuns them for 1 seconds (1 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Takes energy already in an area (a fire, a hot or cold room, a battery) and turns it into something else. Power feeds a conduit, which is free electricity from a fire. Light makes a sun lamp. Heat and Cold shift a room's temperature at once. Sound stuns enemies, Kinetic throws them back. Each one also puts out a fire there. The Reach goes one level higher.

*The mage calls up weather that kills: a tornado, a firestorm, killing heat or cold.* Adverse Weather: Flashstorm - Target: An area in sight, the Scale, or the whole map at that Scale - Effect: A dry storm throws lightning over it - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Adverse Weather: Heat wave - Target: The whole map at the whole map's Scale, or else the room at a spot in sight - Effect: The whole map: a heat wave. A room: it heats toward 45 degrees above 21 - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Adverse Weather: Cold snap - Target: The whole map at the whole map's Scale, or else the room at a spot in sight - Effect: The whole map: a cold snap. A room: it freezes toward 45 degrees below 21 - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Weather as a weapon: a lightning flashstorm over an area, or a heat wave or cold snap over the whole map (or one room at smaller Scale). Hit an enemy camp, never your own base. Every one is an Act of Hubris. The tornado is its own spell.

*Energy out of nothing: light, heat, fire, current, or the invisible poison of radiation.* Create Energy: Power - Target: A conduit in sight - Effect: It gets 100 to 5,000 W of power - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Powering the colony is magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Create Energy: Light - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: It's lit like a sun lamp - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Create Energy: Fire - Target: A spot in sight - Effect: Fire bursts out: a spark to a firestorm - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Create Energy: Heat - Target: The room at a spot in sight - Effect: It warms 15 degrees at once (15 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Create Energy: Radiation - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Everyone in it gets 8% toxic buildup at once (8% per Potency), less with toxic resistance. With Biotech the air there turns to tox gas too - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Create Energy: Current - Target: The mechanoids in an area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Each gets 20% of its energy back (20% per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Energy from nothing. Power is free electricity on a conduit (up to 5,000 W at Potency 5). Light is a sun lamp. Fire starts anything from a spark to a firestorm. Heat warms a room at once. Radiation poisons an area. Current recharges your mechanoids.

*The ground heaves. Walls crack, roofs fall in, and nobody keeps their feet.* - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Every building in it takes 30 damage (30 per Potency), built roofs may cave in (half of them, never a mountain's), and everyone there is knocked down for 1 seconds (1 per Potency). Half of them take 8 blunt damage - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Shakes an area: buildings take heavy damage, built roofs may fall in, and everyone is knocked down. It hits your own people too. Use it on an enemy base, never on yours. It's an Act of Hubris.

*Energy simply stops: fire, current, heat, and the spark that keeps a body alive.* Eradicate Energy: Fire - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Every fire in it goes out - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Eradicate Energy: Power - Target: A conduit or powered building in sight - Effect: Every battery on its power net is emptied - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Eradicate Energy: Heat - Target: The room at a spot in sight - Effect: It drops to -40 degrees - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Eradicate Energy: Drain a mechanoid - Target: The mechanoids in an area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Each loses 20% of its energy (20% per Potency). One left empty shuts down - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Stamina, each dot takes 1 off the Potency - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Makes energy stop. Fire puts out every fire in an area. Power empties every battery on a net. Heat drops a room to -40 degrees. Drain a mechanoid empties mechs until they shut down. Killing a creature outright is Snuff Out.

*Worked from Eradicate Energy, Forces Unmaking. The spark of life in one creature goes out.* - Target: One person or animal in sight - Effect: They die on the spot - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Stamina, each dot takes 1 off the Potency (the caster's own people don't resist). Nothing happens if no Potency is left - Watch out: Killing a person this way is an Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll for any mage). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Kills a person or animal outright if your Potency beats their Stamina. Killing a person this way is an Act of Hubris for any mage.

*Worked from Adverse Weather, Forces Making. The sky twists down into a funnel of wind.* - Target: A spot in sight - Effect: A tornado touches down there - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: A tornado touches down at a spot. Drop it on an enemy camp, never near your own base. An Act of Hubris.

*The mage reads a living body the way a doctor reads a chart: its kind, its age, and every sickness and wound, even the ones that don't show.* - Target: One living person or animal in sight - Effect: A letter with its kind, age, health and every condition on it, hidden ones too. With Biotech, the letter lists their genes - Afterwards: For a day, surgery on them goes 5% better (5% per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: The walking dead show nothing, and an unknown kind of monster shows as unknown until the colony has one of its own How to use it: A full medical check, hidden conditions included, and surgery on them goes better for a day afterwards. Cast it before an operation. With Biotech it also lists their genes.

*The mage coaxes a body into flushing out what poisons it.* Cleanse the Body - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Toxic buildup, food poisoning and drug highs drop by 10% (10% per Potency), and drug cravings are sated - Lasts: Instant Cleanse the Body: Flush the blood - Target: One ghoul touched (needs Life 4 and Death 2) - Effect: The vampire's blood washes out of the body. The ghouling ends, and the years the blood held back catch up at once - Blood bond: A blood bond is in the mind, so it stays - Lasts: For good How to use it: Flushes toxins, food poisoning and drug highs, and sates drug cravings: useful for an addict in withdrawal or after toxic fallout. Flush the blood (Life 4, Death 2) ends a ghoul's ghouling for good; the years the vampire's blood held back catch up at once.

*The mage tunes their own body to the world: sharper eyes and ears, and a nose like a hound's.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Sight and hearing +5% (5% per Potency), anyone invisible within 10 cells shimmers into sight, and +1 dice to follow a case's footsteps - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: As a Praxis it lasts only one turn (0.4 hours) until Life 2 How to use it: Sharper senses for the caster, and invisible people within 10 cells show up: cast it when something unseen is stalking the colony. It also helps follow a case's footsteps. Before Life 2, a Praxis of it lasts only one turn. The Reach smells out hidden people too.

*Animal calls and gestures turn into meaning for the mage, and the animals seem to understand them back.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Taming and training chances +10% (10% per Potency), and animals they hunt or tame never turn on them - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: A tamer's and trainer's spell: much better taming and training chances, and animals the caster hunts or tames never turn on them.

*A cantrip of Life. The flesh stings as if bitten.* - Target: One target in range (Gnosis x10 cells), with an attack roll - Effect: A sting in the flesh: one bashing wound, and +5% pain for an hour - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: A cantrip, only with the Cantrips setting on: one wound from range, for a mage with a single dot of Life.

*The mage feels every heartbeat around them, through walls, earth and dark.* - Target: Everything around the caster within the Scale - Effect: A letter counts the people, animals and insects there, through walls and fog, and points at each - Insect hives: It also feels the rock where a hive could break out, and points at those spots: floor or light them to stop it - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: The walking dead don't count How to use it: Counts every living thing around the caster, through walls and fog, and points at each. It also shows where an insect hive could break out of the rock: floor those spots or light them up to stop it.

*The mage takes conscious hold of what the body does on its own: hunger, sleep, breath and healing.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Half the hunger to half the hunger and need for sleep, +50% toxic resistance, wounds heal twice as fast, 20% less pain (one more at each Potency, up to 5) - Odyssey: A Reach means no breath is needed, so vacuum can't hurt the body - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: A self buff that grows with Potency: less hunger first, then less sleep, then toxic resistance, then faster healing, then less pain. Cast it with a long Duration before a caravan trip or a long siege. The Reaches add natural armour, faster healing of lethal wounds, or (with Odyssey) no need to breathe.

*The mage reaches past thought into the old animal brain and gives it a push.* Control Instincts: Flee - Target: One animal or ordinary person in sight - Effect: They panic and run - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: Monsters and the Awakened aren't touched Control Instincts: Rage - Target: One animal or ordinary person in sight - Effect: They fly into a mindless rage and attack whoever is near - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: Monsters and the Awakened aren't touched Control Instincts: Hunger - Target: One animal or ordinary person in sight - Effect: They're suddenly starving: their food need empties - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: Monsters and the Awakened aren't touched Control Instincts: Sleep - Target: One animal or ordinary person in sight - Effect: They're suddenly exhausted: their need for sleep empties - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: Monsters and the Awakened aren't touched Control Instincts: Calm - Target: One animal or ordinary person in sight - Effect: They calm out of a panic, a rage or a manhunting fit - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Monsters and the Awakened aren't touched How to use it: Pushes an animal's or ordinary person's instincts. Flee makes them run; Rage makes them attack whoever's near (great in the middle of a raid). Hunger and Sleep empty those needs. Calm ends a panic, rage or manhunter fit, and can't be resisted. Monsters and mages aren't touched unless you take the Reach.

*The mage makes a place smell of food, safety or danger to every animal nose for miles.* Lure and Repel: Lure - Target: A spot in sight - Effect: Wild animals come to it, 2 at a time (2 per Potency), nearest first - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened) Lure and Repel: Repel - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Animals not of the colony run out of it and stay out, 2 at a time (2 per Potency): insects, rats in the stores, a manhunter pack. No insect hive can break out inside it - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened) How to use it: Lure brings wild animals to a spot: free hunting, or animals to tame. Repel keeps animals out of an area: rats out of the stores, insects out of the base, a manhunter pack off your fields, and no insect hive can break out inside it. Both are magic for a chore.

*The subject's face, hair and voice look like someone else's to anyone watching, though nothing about them has changed.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Another hairstyle and hair colour, and nobody in a town knows them, so talking there can't give them away - Lasts: The Duration, then the old look comes back How to use it: A disguise: different hair, and nobody in a town recognises them, so talking there can't give them away. Use it on a vampire or a wanted colonist before a town visit. The Reach makes them look like a particular person.

*The mage turns the body's defences on a sickness all at once.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Every illness drops by 20% (20% per Potency), and one of rank 1 or less is cured - Ranks: 1 food poisoning; 2 flu, worms, infections; 3 malaria, plague, sleeping sickness; 4 chronic illness; 5 dementia - Lasts: Instant How to use it: Cures disease. Every illness gets better, and one illness of rank up to the Potency is cured outright: food poisoning at 1, flu and infections at 2, plague and malaria at 3, chronic illness at 4, dementia at 5.

*Worked from Bruise Flesh, Life Fraying. The skin parts and the blood runs. A lost rote from the Red Herbal.* - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: The skin splits: 1 gashes (one per Potency) that bleed hard - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss How to use it: Gashes that bleed far harder than a blade's cuts. A lost rote, taught only by the Red Herbal.

*Blood vessels burst under the skin all at once. The target is covered in bruises without anything touching them.* - Target: One living target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: 8 blunt damage as bruises (8 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there How to use it: Life's first attack: bruises from nothing. It rolls to hit and only works on the living. The Reach makes it hurt much more, which can down a target from pain.

*Muscle wastes, nerves misfire and the heart labours, all in a moment.* Degrading the Form: Strength - Target: One person in sight - Effect: Strength -1 (one per Potency), never below 1 - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Stamina, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist Degrading the Form: Dexterity - Target: One person in sight - Effect: Dexterity -1 (one per Potency), never below 1 - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Stamina, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist Degrading the Form: Stamina - Target: One person in sight - Effect: Stamina -1 (one per Potency), never below 1 - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Stamina, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist How to use it: Weakens an enemy's body. Strength cuts their melee damage, Dexterity their hitting and dodging, Stamina their toughness. Each is its own button. The Reaches spread the Potency over two or all three.

*The mage brings a body to the best it can be: stronger, quicker, harder to break.* Honing the Form: Strength - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Strength +1 (one per Potency), up to 5. Strength is melee damage and carrying - Lasts: The Duration Honing the Form: Dexterity - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Dexterity +1 (one per Potency), up to 5. Dexterity is hitting and dodging - Lasts: The Duration Honing the Form: Stamina - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Stamina +1 (one per Potency), up to 5. Stamina is taking less harm - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Boosts a body. Strength for a melee fighter or a hauler, Dexterity for anyone who fights, Stamina for whoever will take the hits. Duration is its primary factor, so it can last all day. The Reaches spread the Potency over two or three Attributes, or go past 5.

*Bruises fade and swelling goes down as the body does a week's mending in a moment.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Heals 2 bruises' worth (2 per Potency), the worst first - Biotech: A Reach also fills the blood: blood loss goes and hemogen fills - Lasts: Instant How to use it: First aid by magic: heals bruises and other light wounds, worst first. The Reaches make it far more useful: heal lethal wounds instead, set broken bones, give a full night's rest, or (with Biotech) refill lost blood and hemogen. Filling the stomach is Sustenance.

*The subject's body changes for real, within the bounds of its kind.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: A hairstyle the player picks, another hair colour and a better-looking face (+1 beauty) - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: At an Indefinite Duration the change stays How to use it: A real change of looks: a hairstyle you pick, a new hair colour and a better face (+1 beauty). Cast it Indefinite and the change is permanent. The Reach makes them younger too.

*Worked from Knit, Life Perfecting. The stomach fills as if after a full meal.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Their stomach fills as a full meal would, and 2 bruises' worth heal (2 per Potency), the worst first - Lasts: Instant How to use it: Fills someone's stomach as a full meal would, and heals a few bruises. Feeds a caravan or a besieged colony with no food at all.

*The mage gives a living thing something its kind was never meant to have.* Bestial Claws - Target: One person or animal, by touch - Effect: Sharp claws to fight with - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Each trait is its own spell, and they stack. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Thick Hide - Target: One person or animal, by touch - Effect: A hide that turns blades and blows - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Each trait is its own spell, and they stack. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Hardiness - Target: One person or animal, by touch - Effect: Comfortable in heat and cold about 40 degrees past the usual - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Each trait is its own spell, and they stack. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Immunity - Target: One person or animal, by touch - Effect: +50% toxic resistance, and immunity builds 30% faster - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Each trait is its own spell, and they stack. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Venom Fangs - Target: One person or animal, by touch - Effect: A venomous bite - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Each trait is its own spell, and they stack. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Keen Senses - Target: One person or animal, by touch - Effect: Sight and hearing +20% - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Each trait is its own spell, and they stack. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Tail - Target: One person or animal, by touch - Effect: A tail for balance: moving +10%, and harder to hit in melee - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Each trait is its own spell, and they stack. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Tentacles - Target: One person or animal, by touch - Effect: Tentacles to fight with: 8 blunt damage a blow, and a stun - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Each trait is its own spell, and they stack. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Leaping - Target: One person or animal, by touch - Effect: Legs that jump 20 cells - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Each trait is its own spell, and they stack. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Wall-crawling - Target: One person or animal, by touch - Effect: Hands and feet that grip stone: they walk over walls and rock as if they were floor (if walking on walls is on in the mod settings) - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Each trait is its own spell, and they stack. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Rewrite the Blood - Target: One person touched (needs Life 5) - Effect: After the cast, pick from a list with a search box and a fold for each gene category: add any gene the game has loaded, modded ones included, take one of the subject's xenogenes away, or make them another xenotype (its genes replace their xenogenes) - Archite genes: They need Prime 3 as well - The list: Each row shows the gene's icon, and hovering it shows what the gene does. Genes the game names alike, such as the nine skin colours, are numbered, lightest first - Germline: With a Reach it works on germline genes, which pass to children - Lasts: The Duration, then the gene goes back as it was. An Indefinite one stays for good - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Gives a living thing a new trait: claws, tough hide, hardiness to heat and cold, immunity, venom, keen senses, a tail, tentacles, leaping legs or wall-crawling. Each trait is its own button and they stack. With Life 5, Rewrite the blood opens a gene picker with every gene the game has loaded. The Reaches pass the traits to children.

*Seasons pass in hours for whatever the mage chooses: shoots climb, fruit swells, children grow.* Accelerate Growth: Plants - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Plants in it grow 2 to 32 times as fast (doubling with each Potency) - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Speeding crops is magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Accelerate Growth: Creature - Target: One creature in sight - Effect: It ages 2 to 32 times as fast (doubling with each Potency) - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Stamina, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: Children and animals go back to their real age when it ends; a grown person keeps the years. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: On plants it's a farmer's dream: crops grow 2 to 32 times as fast. On a creature it ages them fast: grow a child or a baby animal up quickly (they go back to their real age when it ends), or age an enemy (a grown person keeps the years). Speeding crops is magic for a chore.

*The mage leaves their own body behind and rides another's.* - Target: One animal or person in sight - Effect: The caster takes them over: they join the colony as a puppet, then go back to their own side - Your body: The caster's own body lies helpless meanwhile, and any harm to it ends the spell - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Stamina, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: Riding a person is an Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) How to use it: The caster rides another body: an animal or a person joins the colony as a puppet for the Duration. Meanwhile the caster's own body lies helpless, and any harm to it ends the spell, so leave it somewhere safe. Riding a person is an Act of Hubris.

*The mage tears at a body from the inside: vessels open, organs bruise, and nothing shows on the skin.* - Target: One living target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: 8 damage as internal wounds (8 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there How to use it: Life's big attack: internal wounds with nothing on the skin. It rolls to hit and only works on the living. The Reaches add a lot of pain or aggravated wounds.

*Cuts close, bones knit and torn flesh pulls itself back together.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Heals 2 wounds' worth (2 per Potency) of any kind but aggravated, the worst first - Lasts: Instant How to use it: Real healing: cuts, burns, bites and gunshots, worst first. The Reaches remove scars, fill the stomach, give a full night's rest, or heal aggravated wounds too.

*A lost hand grows back over a few minutes, bone first, then muscle, then skin.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: The biggest lost part up to size 1 grows back, and old scars that deep heal for good - Sizes: A finger or toe is 1; an eye, ear, nose or jaw 2; a hand or foot 3; an arm or leg 4; an organ 5; the heart 6; the brain 7 - Lasts: The Duration, then the part withers away, unless the Duration is Indefinite - Watch out: Costs 1 Mana. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Regrows a lost body part, up to a size set by the Potency: a finger at 1, a hand at 3, an arm or leg at 4, an organ at 5. Cast it Indefinite or the part withers away when the spell ends. It costs 1 Mana.

*Bones slide, fur spreads and the face pulls into a muzzle. Inside the animal, the mind stays the same.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: They take the body of an animal of a kind the colony has seen, as big as the Scale allows (the Scale). They get its speed, hide and attacks and keep their own mind, skills and spells, but drop their gear and can't use tools or guns - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Stamina, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: Hurt or starving, the animal's instincts may take over for a while unless Composure + Resolve + Gnosis holds them. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Turns a person into an animal the colony has seen, as big as the Scale allows. They keep their mind, skills and spells but drop their gear and can't use tools or guns. Hurt or starving, the animal's instincts may take over for a while. The Reaches keep the gear or stop the instinct rolls. The swarm is Swarm Form.

*Worked from Shapechanging, Life Patterning. The body comes apart into a swarm of small animals.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: They become a swarm of an animal the colony has seen: blows do much less harm, and enemies beside it can barely see or aim. They keep their own mind, skills and spells, but drop their gear and can't use tools or guns - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Stamina, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: Hurt or starving, the animal's instincts may take over for a while unless Composure + Resolve + Gnosis holds them. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Shapechanging into a swarm: blows do much less harm, and enemies beside it can barely see or aim. Good for a scout who has to walk through gunfire.

*The mage writes a sickness into the bodies around a spot, and it spreads from there.* - Target: Everyone living in an area in sight, the Scale - Effect: They catch food poisoning to plague. Each passes it to anyone close by who fails Stamina + Resolve against its rank - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Starts an epidemic in an area: food poisoning at Potency 1, flu at 2, plague at 3, and it spreads to anyone close who fails to resist. Aim it at an enemy camp, never near home. The Reach makes a new plague that's much harder to fight off. It's an Act of Hubris.

*Something that never existed is alive where the mage points.* Create Life: Plant - Target: A spot in sight - Effect: A fully grown plant of the player's choice springs up - Lasts: The Duration, then it fades away, unless the Duration is Indefinite - Watch out: Making life is an Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Create Life: Animal - Target: A spot in sight - Effect: A tame animal of a kind the colony has seen appears, as big as the Scale allows (the Scale) - Lasts: The Duration, then it fades away, unless the Duration is Indefinite - Watch out: Making life is an Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Create Life: Human body - Target: A spot in sight - Effect: A grown human body with no soul in it appears, on the colony's side: a decoy, or a body to ride with Animal Minion - No soul: It grows dull within a week and becomes an empty puppet within a month - Lasts: The Duration, then it fades away, unless the Duration is Indefinite - Watch out: Making a human is an Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Makes life from nothing. Plant: a full-grown plant of your choice. Animal: a tame animal the colony has seen. Human body: a soulless body for a decoy or to ride with Animal Minion; it goes dull within a week. Cast it Indefinite to keep what you make. Making life is an Act of Hubris. The servant is Homunculus.

*Worked from Create Life, Life Making. A small pale body with nobody inside, made to serve.* - Target: A spot in sight (needs Life 5) - Effect: A small pale body with nobody inside appears and serves as a golem does: one standing order (haul, clean, mine, build, guard or follow), no food, sleep or mood, and not one of the colonists. Its Potency is its strength - With Mind 5: It's a real person instead, with a mood of its own, for two kinds of work you pick (cleaning, hauling, growing, cutting plants, cooking, crafting, mining or construction) at skill 3 (3 per Potency) and nothing else - Lasts: The Duration, then it fades away, unless the Duration is Indefinite - Watch out: Making a person is an Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Life 5: a golem-like servant with one standing order and no needs; with Mind 5 a real worker with two jobs. Making life is an Act of Hubris.

*Nothing will grow in the ground the mage curses, and nothing living stays there long.* - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Every plant in it dies and nothing grows back, and the living there gain 1% toxic buildup (1% per Potency) every 4 seconds - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Kills every plant in an area and nothing grows back while it lasts, and the living there slowly poison. Use it on an enemy's fields or a siege camp. It's an Act of Hubris.
