*The mage looks at a machine and knows it the way its maker did.* - Target: One item or building in sight - Effect: A letter says what it's for and what's wrong with it: its hit points, quality, a breakdown, fuel, power, or a trap - Learning: The caster gets 200 XP in Construction for a building, Crafting for an item - Lasts: Instant How to use it: Tells you what's wrong with a thing (a breakdown, low fuel, no power, a hidden trap) and teaches the caster 200 XP of Construction or Crafting each time. Cast it on new buildings and items to train a builder. The Reach makes them build and work better for a while.

*Every piece of one kind of matter nearby tugs at the mage's attention, through walls and under rock.* - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Pick a kind of item, building or ore: a letter points out every one of it there, through walls and rock - Lasts: Instant How to use it: Finds every one of a kind of thing in an area, through walls and rock. Use it to find ore veins under the mountain, or a lost item.

*The mage weighs a thing with a glance: what it's made of, how much of it, and what's hidden inside.* - Target: One item or building in sight - Effect: A letter with its material, mass, worth, hit points and Durability, and whatever is inside it - Trading: Knowing its true worth, the caster's prices are 10% better for a day - Lasts: Instant How to use it: Weighs and values a thing at a glance, and shows what's inside it (handy for sealed caskets). Knowing what things are really worth gives the caster 10% better prices for a day: cast it before trading.

*Matter of one kind leans toward a spot the mage chose, or shies away from it.* Lodestone: Draw - Target: One item in sight - Effect: Items of its kind in the area (the Scale) slide to it, 2 stacks (2 per Potency) every few seconds - Lasts: The Duration Lodestone: Repel - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Dirt, blood and other filth are pushed out of it, 10 (10 per Potency) every few seconds. Smoke and gas are pushed out too - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Draw pulls every item of one kind in the area to a spot: a free hauler for steel, wood or loot after a battle. Repel pushes filth, smoke and gas out of an area: a free cleaner for a hospital or kitchen.

*A cantrip of Matter. A stone flung without a hand to throw it.* - Target: One target in range (Gnosis x10 cells), with an attack roll - Effect: A pebble thrown hard: one blunt wound - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: A cantrip, only with the Cantrips setting on: one wound from range, for a mage with a single dot of Matter.

*A machine does one thing it was built to do, with nobody at the controls.* Remote Control - Target: One building in sight - Effect: A door opens or shuts, a trap springs, or a turret turns its fire on the caster's nearest enemy, with nobody at it - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Remote Control: Mechanoid - Target: One mechanoid in sight - Effect: It fights for the caster, with no mechlink needed - Lasts: 1 hours (an hour per Potency) - Resisted by: A mechanitor's mech: the caster must win a Clash of Wills against the mechanitor's Resolve plus two - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Works a machine from afar. The basic version opens or shuts a door, springs a trap, or makes an enemy turret fire on its own side. The Mechanoid version steals a mechanoid for a few hours; a mechanitor's mech needs a Clash of Wills. Running a bench is Remote Crafting.

*Worked from Remote Control, Matter Compelling. A work bench does its bill with nobody at it.* - Target: One work bench in sight - Effect: Its first bill is done once with nobody at it, from ingredients the caster could fetch, as if a crafter of skill 3 made it (3 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Runs a work bench's first bill once with no crafter there, as if a crafter of skill 3 a Potency made it. Magic for a chore.

*One kind of poison or acid washes off the subject like rain.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Toxins, toxic gas and fallout hurt them 20% less (20% per Potency). On a Garou, silver bites no worse than steel - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Protection from poison, toxic gas and fallout. A must for toxic fallout or a toxic-gas fight. On a Garou, silver hurts no more than steel. The Reaches give full immunity, or fireproofing.

*Worked from Shaping, Matter Ruling. Stone chunks split into neat blocks.* - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Each stone chunk in it splits into the blocks a stonecutter would make of it. Its smoke and gas are pushed away and its fires drowned as well - Lasts: For good - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Cuts every stone chunk in an area into blocks, no stonecutter needed. A chore.

*A tool sits in the hand as if it had grown there, and a weapon finds its mark.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Their weapons and tools sit just right: melee hit +5 and aim +1 (a point is about one skill level), and 1 boon charges for a day: each makes the next thing they craft a step better or helps a blow land - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: A fighter's and crafter's buff: better hit and aim, plus a few boon charges for a day that make the next craft better or help a blow land.

*Eyes slide off the things the mage hid, and hands looking for them find something else.* - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Thieves and raiders looking for loot find nothing there, and what lies there counts 10% less toward the wealth raids are sized by - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Hides your stockpile. Raiders and thieves looking for loot find nothing there, and what's stored there counts less toward the wealth that decides raid size. Cast it over your main storeroom.

*Worked from Shaping, Matter Ruling. Smoke and gas gather into one cloud, and the mage throws it.* - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: The smoke, tox gas and stink in it gather into one cloud, and the caster throws it where they point - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Gathers the smoke and gas in an area into one cloud and throws it where you point: send a toxic cloud back at the enemy.

*Lenses and sensors see an empty space where the subject stands.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Turrets and mechanoids don't see them and won't shoot at them - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Turrets and mechanoids can't see the person and won't shoot at them. Send someone through a mech cluster or past enemy turrets. The Reach also hides them from golems and other animated things.

*Water and air take the shape the mage gives them.* - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Its smoke and gas are pushed away, and its fires drowned under shaped water - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Clears smoke and gas and drowns fires in an area: a firefighter in one cast. The Reach speeds up building and repairs. Throwing the gas, washing and cutting stone are Hurl the Fumes, Wash Clean and Cut Stone.

*Worked from Shaping, Matter Ruling. Shaped water carries off every mess in an area.* - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Water carries off every mess in it: blood, vomit, mud and the rest. Its smoke and gas are pushed away and its fires drowned as well - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Washes every mess in an area away, and clears smoke and fire too. A chore.

*Cloth turns hard as plate, or plate goes soft as cloth.* Aegis: Harden - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: What they wear stops 10% more of a sharp or blunt blow (10% per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration Aegis: Soften - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Their armour goes soft: they take 10% more damage (10% per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Harden makes a colonist's armour much better: cast it before a fight. Soften makes an enemy take more damage from everything.

*Current runs around the subject the way water runs around a stone.* Alter Conductivity - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Electric shocks don't hurt them, and they stay comfortable 10 degrees colder - Lasts: The Duration Alter Conductivity: Shock trap - Target: One wall or door, by touch - Effect: With a powered conduit or building beside it, it shocks every enemy next to it each second: 3 burn damage (3 per Potency) and a short stun - Lasts: The Duration Alter Conductivity: Insulate - Target: One building, by touch - Effect: EMP doesn't touch it: turrets, shields and machines keep working through a pulse - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Three uses. On a person: shocks don't hurt them and they handle cold better. Shock trap: a wall or door next to power shocks and stuns every enemy beside it. Insulate: a building shrugs off EMP, so your turrets keep firing in a mech raid.

*The mage tightens the bonds that hold a thing together, or loosens them.* Alter Integrity: Strengthen - Target: One item or building in sight - Effect: It takes 10% less damage (10% per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration Alter Integrity: Weaken - Target: One item or building in sight - Effect: It takes 10% more damage (10% per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Its Durability, each dot takes 1 off the Potency How to use it: Strengthen makes a wall, door or item take less damage: good on the wall raiders always break. Weaken does the reverse to an enemy's barricade. The Reach doubles the change.

*Gold shines brighter and a ring sits finer under the mage's hands.* - Target: One item in sight - Effect: It's worth 20% more (20% per Potency), at most double. A weapon or tool also gives whoever holds it 1 boon charges for a day - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Sold and then turned back, it costs goodwill with the buyer. Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened) How to use it: Makes an item worth more, up to double (triple with the Reach). A weapon or tool also gives boon charges to whoever holds it. If you sell something and the spell ends, the buyer finds out and you lose goodwill with them. It's magic for a chore.

*Worked from Alter Integrity, Matter Perfecting. The weapon in hand sharpened, its bullets hardened, past what any smith could manage.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Their blows and shots do 10% more damage. Their weapon glows and every swing and shot leaves a trail - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Plain extra damage on every blow and shot, 10% a Potency. Comes with Alter Integrity's rote.

*Worked from Nigredo and Albedo, Matter Perfecting. Clothes a corpse wore come clean of the dead.* - Target: Loose clothes, or a person, in sight - Effect: The clothes, or everything the person wears and carries, no longer show that a corpse wore them - Lasts: For good - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Takes the "tainted" mark off clothes taken from the dead: cast it on a pile of loose clothes, or on a person to clean all they wear and carry. A chore.

*Cracks close and rust flakes away, or the thing rots before the mage's eyes.* Albedo: Repair - Target: One item or building in sight - Effect: It gets back 10% of its hit points (10% per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Mending the colony's own things is magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Nigredo: Damage - Target: One item or building in sight - Effect: It loses 10% of its hit points (10% per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Albedo repairs an item or building at range: no repair job, no materials. Nigredo damages one instead. Mending your own things is magic for a chore. Slag and the dead's taint are Purify Slag and Lift the Taint.

*Worked from State Change, Matter Weaving. The air at the target turns into burning plasma.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: The air at them turns to burning plasma: 8 burn damage (8 per Potency), and they catch fire - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: An attack that burns and sets the target on fire.

*Worked from Nigredo and Albedo, Matter Perfecting. Slag gives up its metal as a smelter would.* - Target: One slag chunk, item or building in sight - Effect: A slag chunk becomes the metal a smelter would get out of it, for good. Anything else gets back 10% of its hit points (10% per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Turns a slag chunk into the steel a smelter would get, or mends anything else as Albedo does. A chore.

*Worked from State Change, Matter Weaving. Stone rises out of the bare ground.* - Target: Empty ground at a spot in sight, out to the Scale's radius - Effect: Natural rock of the map's own stone rises on every empty cell (no wall, item or person there, and not water) - Lasts: For good: the ground was stone below - Watch out: The +2 Reach puts overhead mountain over it, which can cave in and draw infestations. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Builds natural rock walls on open ground for good. The Reach adds a mountain roof, which can cave in.

*Worked from Windstrike, Matter Weaving. Whatever rubble lies near is flung out as a storm of edges. A lost rote from the Leaden Codex.* - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: Loose chunks and rubble near the caster fly out as a cone: 1 cut wounds to each (one per Potency). With no chunk or rubble within 3 cells, it can't be cast - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing: no one inside dodges it - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: A cone of cut wounds, but only with chunks or rubble near the caster. A lost rote, taught only by the Leaden Codex.

*The thing is the same thing, only smaller, or larger.* Shrink - Target: One item in sight - Effect: It weighs half to a thirty-second as much (half again for each Potency) - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Its Durability, each dot takes 1 off the Potency - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Grow - Target: One item in sight - Effect: It weighs 2 to 32 times as much (double again for each Potency) - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Its Durability, each dot takes 1 off the Potency - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Shrink makes an item much lighter: carry more on a caravan, or haul a heavy sculpture. Grow makes it heavier.

*Stone runs like wet clay, or a lake goes still and hard.* State Change: Melt - Target: Walls, doors, rock and furniture at a spot in sight - Effect: They turn to mud you can walk through, then set again where they stood. Anyone inside is pushed out and hurt - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Rock under an overhead mountain stays. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die State Change: Freeze - Target: Water at a spot in sight - Effect: It freezes into ice you can walk on - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die State Change: Molten ground - Target: Ground at a spot in sight, out to the Scale's radius (needs Forces 3 as well) - Effect: The ground melts into deep lava that burns and sets alight whoever is in it or next to it - Lasts: The Duration, then the old ground comes back - Watch out: Walls and water stay as they are. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Matter's toolkit. Melt turns walls and rock to mud you can walk through, then it sets again: walk through a wall into an enemy base. Freeze makes a bridge of ice over water. Molten ground (needs Forces 3) turns ground to lava for a while. Plasma and Raise Stone are spells of their own.

*A fist of air or a lash of water hits like a club.* - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: A blow of air or water: 8 blunt damage (8 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Matter's basic attack: a club of air or water. It rolls to hit.

*What makes one machine good moves into another.* - Target: One weapon, tool or building in sight - Effect: It takes the quality of a better one within 5 cells, up to 1 tiers better (one per Potency), and the other gives up as much - Special rounds: A gun can instead take the rounds of an EMP or incendiary launcher (or grenades) within 5 cells: its shots stun machines or set fires - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Moves quality from one thing to another nearby: take the quality of a masterwork gun lying in storage and put it on the one your best shooter carries. A gun can instead copy the rounds of an EMP or incendiary launcher nearby, so its shots stun machines or start fires.

*Worked from Piercing Earth, Matter Patterning. The earth's bitterest salts thrown as darts that eat through armour. A lost rote from the Leaden Codex.* - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: Darts of acid: 1 acid burns (one per Potency), and the armour they wear loses 10% of its condition - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Acid burns that also eat into the target's armour. A lost rote, taught only by the Leaden Codex.

*Worked from Piercing Earth, Matter Patterning. Ground water drawn up and frozen into shards. A lost rote from the Leaden Codex.* - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: Shards of ice: 1 piercing wounds (one per Potency) and a chill. Needs Forces 1 as well as Matter - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Piercing shards and a chill, so a lightning bolt or a blow after it shatters. Needs Forces 1. A lost rote, taught only by the Leaden Codex.

*Walls go thin as smoke. People and bullets pass through.* - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Walls, doors, rock and furniture there don't stop anyone or anything, and show only as a faint image. When it ends, anyone standing inside one is pushed out and hurt - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Rock under an overhead mountain stays. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Walls, doors and rock in the area stop nobody and nothing: walk or shoot straight through. Good for getting into a sealed base, or for shooting past enemy cover. Anyone still inside a wall when it ends is pushed out and hurt.

*A statue climbs off its plinth and waits to be told what to do.* Golem - Target: A sculpture in sight, or furniture or a stack of stone blocks of 20 kg or more - Effect: It gets up as a slow, strong golem on the caster's side: it hauls, fights and cleans the home area, trained and obedient. The more Potency, the harder it hits, the more it carries and the less harm it takes - Orders: Its Order button gives it one standing order: haul, clean, mine, build, guard a spot or follow its maker - Lasts: The Duration, then it turns back - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Stone Giant - Target: A natural rock wall in sight (needs Matter 4) - Effect: The rock stands up as a golem with an earth elemental's body: slow and hard to hurt, strong by the Potency, and it mines when it has no other order - Lasts: The Duration, then it's rock again where it stood - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Animates a statue, furniture or a stack of stone blocks (20 kg or more) as a strong, slow servant. It hauls, fights and cleans; more Potency makes it tougher. Give it a standing order from its button. With Matter 4, Stone giant raises a rock wall as a big earth golem that mines when idle.

*The ground heaves up and closes like a fist.* Crushing Earth - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: The ground crushes them: 8 damage as deep wounds (8 per Potency) - Shape: The builder can give it a line, cone, burst, ring or chain, sized by Scale. Everyone in it is hit, friends too unless a Reach spares them - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Stone Spikes - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: Stone spikes shoot up: 8 stab damage to the legs (8 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Sand Blast - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: The ground blows up as sand in their eyes: no wound, but they're nearly blind for 2 seconds (2 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Matter's big attack, three ways. Crush does deep wounds and can take a shape (line, cone, burst, ring or chain) that hits everyone in it. Spikes hit the legs, slowing whoever survives. Sand does no damage but nearly blinds the target for a few seconds.

*Worked from Transubstantiation, Matter Patterning. Soil, sand or stone becomes another kind of ground.* - Target: Ground at a spot in sight, out to the Scale's radius - Effect: The natural ground turns into the one you pick: soil, rich soil (needs Life 2 as well), sand, gravel, rough stone, marsh or shallow water - Lasts: For good - Watch out: Floors and bridges are left alone, and no cell with a building or an item turns to water. Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Changes the ground for good: turn sand into soil, or marsh into solid ground.

*Lead into gold, the old dream, done in a breath.* - Target: One stack in sight - Effect: It turns, one for one, into a material of up to Potency 1 - By Potency: Wood, stone blocks, steel and cloth at 1; silver, jade, synthread and leather at 3; gold, plasteel and devilstrand at 4; uranium, hyperweave and thrumbofur at 5 - Lasts: The Duration, then it turns back - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Lead into gold, but only for the Duration: the stack turns back when it ends, so use it to build or craft with materials you don't have, not to sell. The ground and the ore spells are Reshape the Ground and Vein of Ore.

*Worked from Transubstantiation, Matter Patterning. A rock wall turns into a seam of ore.* - Target: One natural rock wall in sight - Effect: It becomes a vein of ore up to Potency 1: compacted steel at 1; silver and jade at 3; gold and plasteel at 4; uranium at 5 - Lasts: For good, and so does what is mined from it - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Turns a rock wall into a vein of ore, and what you mine from it stays.

*The thing is simply gone, and nothing is left to show it was there.* - Target: One item or building in sight - Effect: It's gone for good - Lasts: For good - Resisted by: Its Durability, each dot takes 1 off the Potency - Watch out: Magic items can't be unmade. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Deletes an item or a building for good. Great for an enemy's turret or a wall in your way. Magic items can't be unmade unless you take the Reach.

*Worked from Ex Nihilo, Matter Making. The colony's plans stand up built, out of nothing.* - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Every blueprint and frame of the colony's in it is built at once, out of nothing, in a material up to Potency 1 (as Transubstantiation), its quality by Potency - Lasts: For good - Watch out: Costs 1 Mana more for each step of Scale. Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: The big builder: every blueprint and frame of the colony's in the area is finished at once, for good, in any material the Potency reaches. Costs more Mana the larger the area.

*Out of nothing, a made thing: a knife, a coat, a chair.* - Target: A spot in sight - Effect: A tool, a medieval weapon or bow, a revolver, clothes or a piece of furniture appears, of a material up to Potency 1 (as Transubstantiation), its quality by Potency - Lasts: The Duration, then it vanishes - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Makes a simple thing out of nothing (a tool, a medieval weapon or bow, a revolver, clothes or furniture) until the spell ends. The industrial Reach adds rifles and components. Finishing the colony's plans is Build from Nothing, and a stone wall is Wall from Nothing.

*Dents fill and wires splice themselves overnight.* - Target: One item or building in sight - Effect: It mends 10% of its hit points (10% per Potency) each day - By a link: Cast along a sympathetic link at a person, it mends a piece of their gear you pick, wherever they are - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened) How to use it: A thing that mends itself every day: put it on your best turret or your power plant. The Reaches make it mend every hour or quarter hour. Cast along a link to a person, it mends a piece of their gear wherever they are.

*Worked from Ex Nihilo, Matter Making. A wall of plain stone stands where there was none.* - Target: A spot in sight - Effect: A line of plain walls of the local stone stands across the way from the caster to the spot, 3 cells long and 2 more for each step of Scale, on the open ground there - Lasts: The Duration, then the walls are gone - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Puts up a line of stone walls as instant cover, gone when the spell ends.

*The mage reads a person at a glance: what drives them, what they're like, how sharp and how charming.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: A letter with their personality traits and their total Mental and Social dots - Lasts: Instant How to use it: A quick read on a stranger: their personality traits and roughly how sharp and charming they are. Cast it on a visitor before you try to recruit them. The Reach shows each Attribute dot by dot.

*The mage skims the surface of a mind: the mood on top, the worries under it, what it wants.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: A letter answers 1 questions (one per Potency), in this order: their mood and why, how sharp they are, any break or derangement, what they need most, and what they are - Reach: The caster follows their surface thoughts in a talk for a day - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist How to use it: Reads what's on someone's mind: their mood and why, any break coming, what they need most, and what they really are. The answers come in a fixed order, so you need Potency 5 to learn what they are. The Reach lets the caster follow their thoughts in a talk for a day.

*The mage splits their attention cleanly in two and works both halves at once.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Research and recruiting go 50% faster - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: A research and recruiting boost for the caster: 50% faster. Cast it with a long Duration on your researcher or your warden.

*Every detail the mage has ever taken in comes back sharp, and stays.* - Target: The caster - Effect: They forget nothing: no skill fades, and they learn 20% faster - Case clues: Any case clues where they stand are read with 1 successes - Lasts: 1 days (a day per Potency) How to use it: Stops skill decay and speeds up learning by 20% for a few days. Good on a mage who's away from their usual work. It also reads case clues where they stand.

*A cantrip of Mind. A sharp pain behind the eyes.* - Target: One target in range (Gnosis x10 cells), with an attack roll - Effect: A twinge in the mind: one bashing wound to the head - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: A cantrip, only with the Cantrips setting on: one wound from range, for a mage with a single dot of Mind.

*The mage paints a false calm over a mind, so readers see what the mage wants them to see.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: A spell that reads their mind must first win a Clash of Wills (a contest of the two casters' power). Insults and slights don't land - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Hides a mind from mind-reading spells, and insults stop bothering them. Good on a colonist who keeps getting into fights over insults.

*The mage steps into a sleeper's dream and leaves something there.* Dream Reaching: Soothe - Target: One sleeping person in sight - Effect: They dream of something good and wake in a better mood: +8 mood for a day - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist Dream Reaching: Ask - Target: One sleeping person in sight - Effect: The caster walks in their dream and asks it 1 questions: what they want, what they fear, who they trust. They don't remember it - Lasts: Until they wake or the questions run out - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist How to use it: Works on someone asleep. Soothe gives a colonist a good day's mood. Ask questions the dreamer about what they want, fear and trust, and they don't remember it. The bad dream is Send Nightmare.

*The mage leans on a feeling someone already has until it fills them.* Emotional Urging: Warm - Target: One person in sight, best a prisoner - Effect: They warm to the caster. A prisoner's resistance and will drop by 2 (2 per Potency) - Lasts: For good - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: On anyone but a prisoner, an Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) Emotional Urging: Cold - Target: One person in sight, best a prisoner - Effect: They turn cold toward the caster. A prisoner's resistance and will rise by 2 (2 per Potency) - Lasts: For good - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: On anyone but a prisoner, an Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) How to use it: A recruiting spell. Warm on a prisoner drops their resistance and will a lot; Cold raises them. Used on anyone who isn't a prisoner, it's an Act of Hubris.

*Whoever meets the mage next likes them before a word is said.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They think better of the caster: +20 opinion for 3 days. A prisoner's resistance and will drop by 2 (2 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist How to use it: Makes someone like the caster: +20 opinion for 3 days, and a prisoner's resistance drops. No Act of Hubris, unlike Emotional Urging, so it's the safer recruiting spell.

*Eyes slide off the subject. Nobody minds them, and nobody remembers them after.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Nobody attacks them until they attack, and nobody counts as having seen their magic - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Costs 1 Mana How to use it: Nobody attacks them until they attack, and nobody counts as a witness to their magic. A mage can cast obvious spells freely under it. It costs 1 Mana.

*The mage takes a memory out and fills in the hole so nobody notices.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Their 1 worst bad memories (one per Potency) are gone - Lasts: For good - Watch out: On anyone but the caster, an Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) How to use it: Removes someone's worst bad memories (the mood debuffs), one per Potency. A fix for a colonist about to break after a death or a raid. On anyone but the caster it's an Act of Hubris.

*The mage walls a mind in, and anything that pushes at it pushes at the mage too.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Every Mind spell on them must first win a Clash of Wills (a contest of the two casters' power), and psychic sensitivity -20% (20% per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Protection from mind control: every Mind spell needs a Clash of Wills, and psychic effects hurt less. Cast it on colonists before facing an enemy mage or psychic drones. The Reach also blunts a Goetia's blows.

*One word, spoken into a mind, and the body obeys it.* Psychic Domination: Sleep - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They fall asleep where they stand - Lasts: The Duration, or until they're hurt - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) Psychic Domination: Flee - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They run - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) Psychic Domination: Drop - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They drop their weapon - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) Psychic Domination: Stop - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They freeze for 3 seconds (3 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) Psychic Domination: Come - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They walk to where the caster stands - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) How to use it: One-word commands. Sleep drops an enemy where they stand until hurt (great for taking a prisoner). Flee, Drop (their weapon), Stop (freeze for a few seconds) and Come (walk to the caster) all work in a fight. Every use is an Act of Hubris.

*Worked from Dream Reaching, Mind Ruling. A sleeper has a nightmare and wakes shaken.* - Target: One sleeping person in sight - Effect: They have a nightmare and wake shaken: -8 mood for a day - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist How to use it: Gives a sleeping enemy prisoner a bad day's mood. Their Composure resists.

*Two minds hear each other's surface thoughts.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Social impact +10% (10% per Potency). The two can talk mind to mind: +1 dice to the caster's Social rolls with them, and the caster sees their thoughts in a talk - At a distance: While the link lasts, the caster can cast touch and sensory spells on them anywhere on the map - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: A mind link: better social impact, dice on talks with them, and while it lasts the caster can cast touch and sensory spells on them from anywhere on the map. Link your healer to your best fighter and heal them across the battlefield.

*Worked from Psychic Domination, Mind Ruling. A mind turned so hard it fights its own. A lost rote from the Mirror Psalter.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They fight for the caster's side until it ends, then go back to their own. Needs Mind 4, and costs two Reaches - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) How to use it: The target fights for the caster's side for the Duration, then goes back to their own. Needs Mind 4 and costs two Reaches. A lost rote, taught only by the Mirror Psalter.

*The mage brings a mind to its peak, quicker, clearer or more winning.* Augment Mind: Intelligence - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Intelligence +1 (one per Potency), up to 5 - Lasts: The Duration Augment Mind: Wits - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Wits +1 (one per Potency), up to 5 - Lasts: The Duration Augment Mind: Charisma - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Charisma +1 (one per Potency), up to 5 - Lasts: The Duration Augment Mind: Manipulation - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Manipulation +1 (one per Potency), up to 5 - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Boosts a mind: Intelligence for research and medicine, Wits for quick thinking, Charisma and Manipulation for talks. Each is its own button. The Reaches spread the Potency over two or three, or go past 5.

*The mage muddies a mind: thoughts slow, words trip, charm sours.* Befuddle: Intelligence - Target: One person in sight - Effect: Intelligence -1 (one per Potency), never below 1 - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist Befuddle: Wits - Target: One person in sight - Effect: Wits -1 (one per Potency), never below 1 - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist Befuddle: Charisma - Target: One person in sight - Effect: Charisma -1 (one per Potency), never below 1 - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist Befuddle: Manipulation - Target: One person in sight - Effect: Manipulation -1 (one per Potency), never below 1 - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist How to use it: The opposite of Augment Mind: lowers a Mental or Social Attribute. Cut a rival negotiator's Manipulation, or an enemy mage's Intelligence. The Reaches spread it over two or three.

*The mage stills a mind's storm and holds it still.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: A mental break ends, and no new one starts. No derangement surfaces either - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Composure if they're unwilling, each dot takes 1 off the Potency How to use it: Ends a mental break on the spot and stops new ones for the Duration. Cast it on a colonist who's breaking, or on everyone before a funeral. The Reach gives back a Willpower.

*Something the subject already knows comes easier, as if they'd practiced for years.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Pick a skill they have some of: it rises 4 levels (4 per Potency), up to 20 - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Raises a skill the person already has, by 4 levels per Potency, up to 20. Turn a decent doctor into a great one before surgery, or a good shooter into a sniper. The Reaches add a second or third skill, splitting the bonus.

*The mage calls a Goetia, a living feeling, out of wherever it hides.* - Target: The caster - Effect: The nearest Goetia on the map comes and stays near the caster. With none, the feeling of a recent mental break here takes shape as one - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Calls a Goetia (a living emotion) to the caster. If none is on the map, the feeling of a recent mental break takes shape as one. The Reach pulls one out of a person, and they lose a matching bad trait (like Bloodlust or Nervous) while it lasts.

*The subject looks at the mage and sees someone they trust.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They take the caster for a friend and won't attack them - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist How to use it: The person sees the caster as a friend and won't attack them. Walk past a guard, or keep a raider off your mage.

*The mage slams a mind against the inside of its skull.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: A stroke from the inside: 8 damage (8 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant How to use it: Mind's attack: damage from the inside that can't miss and isn't obvious. The Reaches leave the target dazed.

*Worked from Psychic Assault, Mind Fraying. A blow to one mind that echoes into the next. A lost rote from the Mirror Psalter.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: A blow to the mind: 1 bashing wounds to the head (one per Potency), and half of it hits their nearest friend within 5 cells too - Lasts: Instant How to use it: A blow to the mind, half of which echoes into the target's nearest friend. A lost rote, taught only by the Mirror Psalter.

*The mage goes down past the surface of a mind, into what it keeps.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: A letter answers 1 questions (one per Potency), in this order: where their people live, who leads them, who they love and hate most, what they are, and what they're best at - Cases: A townsperson in a case town tells what they know of the attack, and a Seer gives up a clue - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) How to use it: A deep mind read: where their people live, who leads them, who they love and hate, what they are and what they're best at. In a case town, a townsperson tells what they know of the attack and a Seer gives up a clue. It's an Act of Hubris. The Reach makes them remember the caster as a friend.

*The mage takes charge of a body's sleep: none at all, or the deepest there is.* Sleep of the Just: Wake - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: They don't get tired - Lasts: The Duration Sleep of the Just: Dream - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: They rest half again as fast, with sweet dreams - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Wake means no tiredness at all for the Duration: a doctor through a long night, a guard through a siege. Dream makes sleep half again as restful, with a nice dream.

*Every tongue and gesture makes sense to the mage, and theirs to everyone.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Social impact and negotiating +20%, and trade prices 5% better - DLC: With Ideology, conversion talks +20%; with Anomaly, studying a held entity +30% - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: A trader's and diplomat's buff: better social impact and negotiating, and 5% better prices. With Ideology it helps conversions, and with Anomaly it helps study entities.

*The mage writes a skill into a mind that never learned it.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Pick a skill they're poor at (under 8): it rises 4 levels (4 per Potency) - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Teaches a skill the person is poor at (under 8), 4 levels per Potency. The way to give someone a skill they never learned, like Medicine for a fighter. The Reaches add more skills, splitting the bonus.

*The subject sees, hears and smells something that isn't there, and nobody else does.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They wander lost in things that aren't there - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist How to use it: Sends someone wandering lost in visions: one enemy out of the fight for a while.

*The mage tears at a mind until the body behind it bleeds.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: The mind torn apart from the inside: 8 damage (8 per Potency) - Lasts: Instant How to use it: Mind's big attack: damage that can't miss and isn't obvious. The Reaches add a berserk break, so they turn on their friends, or aggravated wounds.

*The mage moves into someone else's head and takes the controls.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: The caster takes them over: they join the colony as a puppet, then go back to their own side. The body uses the caster's Intellectual, Social, Medicine and Artistic where hers are better - Your body: The caster's own body lies helpless meanwhile, and any harm to it ends the spell - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) How to use it: Takes over a person for the Duration: they join the colony as a puppet, using the caster's mental skills where those are better. The caster's own body lies helpless, so leave it somewhere safe. It's an Act of Hubris.

*The mage leaves their body and walks the world as a thought.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Twilight form: no physical harm reaches them, they pass through doors and see ghosts and Goetia nearby, but they can't harm, work or carry. Spells still work - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: The caster leaves their body as a thought: no physical harm reaches them, they walk through doors and see ghosts and Goetia. They can't hit or work but can still cast spells.

*The mage rewires who someone is: a habit, a temper, a love for one kind of work.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: 1 changes (one per Potency), each picked from a list: a personality trait swaps for another, a passion moves from one skill to another, or four levels move between two thinking skills (Intellectual, Medicine, Crafting) or two people skills (Social, Animals, Artistic) - Reach: An Attribute dot moves the same way - Lasts: The Duration, then it goes back, unless the Duration is Indefinite - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) How to use it: Rewires a person: swap a bad trait for a good one, move a passion to the skill you need, or move skill levels between related skills. Cast it Indefinite and it stays. It's an Act of Hubris. The Reach moves Attribute dots too.

*The mage floods a mind with fear until there's nothing else in it.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They panic and flee - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) How to use it: Floods someone with fear so they panic and flee. The Reach leaves them catatonic instead, which takes them out of the fight completely. It's an Act of Hubris.

*The mage cuts a conscience out, or a craving.* Amorality: Cut the Virtue - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They have no Virtue: mental break threshold +5%, and a mage's Vice gives back twice the Willpower while her Virtue gives nothing - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll for any mage) Amorality: Cut the Vice - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They have no Vice: mental break threshold -5%, a mage's Vice gives nothing, and no Act of Hubris weighs on her - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll for any mage) How to use it: Cuts a Virtue or a Vice out of someone. No Virtue: they break more easily, and a mage's Vice pays double Willpower. No Vice: they break less, and a mage's Acts of Hubris stop weighing on her. Both are Acts of Hubris for any mage.

*Months of someone's life are gone, and so is everything they felt about them.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They forget every memory from the last 1 months (a month per Potency) - Prisoner: They forget their loyalty: resistance drops to nothing and will is halved - Lasts: For good - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll for any mage) How to use it: Erases months of memory for good. On a prisoner it wipes their loyalty: resistance goes to nothing and will is halved, so they're easy to recruit. An Act of Hubris for any mage.

*The mage traps a mind in a loop of one thought, and the body stops.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: They go still and senseless - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher) How to use it: Locks a mind in a loop: they go still and senseless for the whole Duration. One of the strongest ways to take an enemy out of a fight, or to hold a prisoner. It's an Act of Hubris.

*The mage makes a mind out of nothing, and it serves them.* Psychic Genesis - Target: A spot in sight - Effect: A Rank 1 Goetia of rage, grief or fear, picked from a list, appears and serves the caster - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Psychic Genesis: Open a psylink - Target: One person touched - Effect: Their psylink rises a level, or they gain one at level 1 - Lasts: For good - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Psychic Genesis: Close a psylink - Target: One person touched with a psylink (needs Prime 3) - Effect: Their psylink falls a level, or goes at level 1 - Lasts: For good - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Makes a Goetia servant of rage, grief or fear (Rank 2 with the Reach). With Royalty, it can open someone's psylink or raise it a level, or (with Prime 3) close one. Psylink changes are for good and are Acts of Hubris.

*Overnight the mage seems to know everyone worth knowing.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Pick a faction: its goodwill rises 10 (10 per Potency), and falls back after - Potency 2+: Its people warn of raids two hours ahead - Potency 3+: They also send fighters to the next attack - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Instant friends in one faction: goodwill rises for the Duration (it falls back after). From Potency 2 they warn you of raids; from Potency 3 they send fighters to help. Cast it on the faction you need for a trade deal or a war.

Spell Dots Practice Primary factor Rote skills Reach upgrades Dispel Magic 1 Compelling Potency Intellectual, Social Mote 1 Compelling Shooting Pierce Deception 1 Unveiling Duration Intellectual, Social A hint of what lies under it Sacred Geometry 1 Unveiling Duration Intellectual, Construction Scribe Grimoire 1 Compelling Potency Intellectual The writing never fades Supernal Vision 1 Unveiling Potency Intellectual Other supernatural kinds show too Word of Command 1 Compelling Potency As Above, So Below 2 Ruling Duration Intellectual, Artistic 8-Again Cloak Nimbus 2 Veiling Duration Social, Intellectual Invisible Runes 2 Ruling Duration Supernal Veil 2 Veiling Duration Social, Intellectual Wards and Signs 2 Shielding Duration Intellectual, Melee Words of Truth 2 Ruling Potency Social Aetheric Winds 3 Weaving Potency Intellectual, Shooting Burns a point of Mana, vitae, Gnosis or Rage for each wound, before the skinThe burned fuel comes to the caster Bottle Mana 3 Weaving Potency Intellectual, Crafting Channel Mana 3 Weaving Potency Intellectual, Medicine Cleanse Pattern 3 Fraying Potency Display of Power 3 Weaving Duration Ephemeral Enchantment 3 Weaving Duration Melee, Intellectual Geomancy 3 Weaving Duration Mana Bolt 3 Weaving Potency Intellectual Platonic Form 3 Weaving Potency Stealing Fire 3 Perfecting Duration Supernal Rounds 3 Weaving Duration Shooting, Intellectual The glyph Apocalypse 4 Patterning Duration Celestial Fire 4 Patterning Potency Shooting, Intellectual Sets the ground around them alightBurns a point of Mana, vitae, Gnosis or Rage for each wound, before the skinAggravated wounds Destroy Tass 4 Unraveling Potency Hallow Dance 4 Patterning Potency The Hallow stays damped Radiance 4 Patterning Potency Intellectual Supernal Dispellation 4 Unraveling Potency Intellectual, Social Blasphemy 5 Unmaking Potency Create Truth 5 Making Duration Eidolon 5 Making Potency Forge Purpose 5 Making Duration Word of Unmaking 5 Unmaking Potency It explodes

*The mage finds the loose thread in another's spell and pulls.* - Target: One lasting spell on a person in sight - Effect: It's suppressed for the Duration, then comes back with the time it had left. An Indefinite Dispel ends it for good - Needs: A dot in the spell's Arcanum - Other kinds: Mind, Life or Death reaches a vampire's lasting power; Spirit or Fate a werewolf's or a fetish's. Those end - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Its caster's dots in its Arcanum, each dot takes 1 off the Potency How to use it: Switches off another mage's lasting spell on someone. A timed Dispel only pauses it: it comes back afterwards with the time it had left. Cast it Indefinite to end it for good. You need at least a dot in that spell's Arcanum. With the right Arcanum it also ends a vampire's or werewolf's lasting power.

*A cantrip of Prime. A mote of raw Mana flicked at a foe.* - Target: One target in range (Gnosis x10 cells), with an attack roll - Effect: A mote of raw Mana: one bashing wound, and it hits ghosts, spirits and anyone in Twilight - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: A cantrip, only with the Cantrips setting on: one wound from range, for a mage with a single dot of Prime.

*Lies and masks look thin and wrong to the mage's eyes.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: You learn whether they are what they seem: one of another kind the colony doesn't know, or someone under a magical disguise - Afterwards: For the Duration, any colonist who talks to them sees their lies - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: A magical disguise needs a Clash of Wills (a contest of the two casters' power) How to use it: Unmasks someone: a vampire or werewolf the colony doesn't know about yet, or someone in a magical disguise. Duration is the primary factor, and for that whole time your people see through their lies when talking to them. The Reach gives a hint of what's underneath.

*The lines of power under the world show to the mage like chalk on a floor.* - Target: The caster - Effect: The map's ley lines and nodes show, and a spell cast on a node gets 1 more die. Avernian Gates and Garou caerns on the map are pointed out too - No lines here: The lines point toward the nearest place that has them - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Shows the map's ley lines and nodes. Stand on a node to cast for 1 more die, and use Geomancy to move one somewhere useful. It also points out Avernian Gates and caerns. On a map with no lines, it points toward the nearest place that has some.

*The mage writes a rote into a book so other mages can learn it.* - Target: A grimoire within reach - Effect: One of the caster's rotes is written into it. A grimoire holds ten - Lasts: The Duration, then the writing fades, unless the spell is Lasting - Watch out: Costs 1 Mana How to use it: How your mages teach each other rotes. Write a rote into a grimoire (ten per book), and another mage can learn it from the book. The writing fades when the spell ends unless you take the "never fades" Reach or cast it Lasting.

*The mage looks for the light of the Supernal in someone's soul.* Supernal Vision - Target: One person in sight - Effect: You learn whether they are Awakened. If so, 1 answers (one per Potency), in this order: their Mana, their Path, their best two Arcana, how many Arcana, their Gnosis - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Cloak Nimbus or Supernal Veil on them needs a Clash of Wills (a contest of the two casters' power) Supernal Vision: Place or item - Target: A spot or an item in sight - Effect: 1 answers and one more (one per Potency): whether a Hallow is there, which lasting spells hold it and whose, and whether the things there are Artifacts, tass, fetishes or other magic items - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Supernal Veil on the place needs a Clash of Wills (a contest of the two casters' power) How to use it: Tells you if someone is a mage, and how strong. Each Potency gives one more answer, in a set order: Mana first, Gnosis last. The Place version checks a spot or an item for a Hallow, spells, Artifacts, tass and fetishes. The Reach shows other supernatural kinds too.

*One word, and the power sleeping in an object wakes.* - Target: A werewolf's fetish, an Artifact or a vampire's relic in sight - Effect: A fetish answers the caster at once, paid for in Mana instead of Gnosis. An Artifact fills with the caster's own Mana. A relic works on the caster, worn or not - Lasts: Instant. The relic for the Duration - Watch out: A fetish needs a dot of Spirit, a relic a dot of Death How to use it: Wakes up a magic object. A fetish works for the mage paid in Mana, an Artifact fills with the mage's Mana, and a vampire's relic works on the mage without being worn. Fetishes need a dot of Spirit, relics a dot of Death.

*The mage's gestures line up with the Supernal and the magic answers more readily.* - Target: The caster - Effect: Their rotes roll 9-Again (a 9 or 10 rolls another die) - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Makes the mage's rotes more reliable: 9s and 10s roll again. With the Reach, 8s do too. Cast it with a long Duration at the start of a busy day.

*The mage's aura dims until they look like any Sleeper.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Supernal Vision sees a Sleeper unless its caster wins a Clash of Wills (a contest of the two casters' power). Their spells count one fewer outsider witness for Paradox - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Hides a mage from other mages' Supernal Vision, and makes their spells a little safer: one fewer outsider witness counts for Paradox.

*Words in light only the Awakened can read.* - Target: A spot in sight - Effect: Write a message on the ground: pick one of four, or type your own. Only mages see it: select one of your mages to read it - Alarm: An enemy within 3 cells sends you a warning letter, at most once every 2 hours - Other mages: A mage from another faction who walks past reads it too - Lasts: The Duration. The writing fades when the spell ends How to use it: It works best as a tripwire. Put it at the map edge raiders use or by a back door. It holds one of the mage's active spells for as long as it lasts.

*A veil of nothing hangs over someone, and Supernal sight slides off it.* Supernal Veil - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Supernal Vision sees a Sleeper unless its caster wins a Clash of Wills (a contest of the two casters' power) - Lasts: The Duration Supernal Veil: Place - Target: A spot by the caster, and everything within 2 cells of it - Effect: The lasting spells and magic items there hide from Supernal Vision unless its caster wins a Clash of Wills (a contest of the two casters' power) - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Like Cloak Nimbus but for anyone, or for a place. The Place version hides lasting spells and magic items within 2 cells of a spot from Supernal Vision: good for hiding your tass stockpile.

*Sigils of Prime hang around someone and turn spells aside.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Every other mage's spell aimed at them loses 1 Potency (the ward's Potency) - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: A general shield against enemy mages: every hostile spell on the person loses Potency equal to the ward's. Cast it on your mages before facing another cabal.

*The mage speaks, and everyone who hears knows it's true.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: Weakens a prisoner's resistance, or makes an enemy run - Prisoner: Resistance and will drop by 2 (2 per Potency) - Enemy: They hear the call to surrender and live, and run - Afterwards: Anyone who heard believes the caster for a day: +1 dice to her Social rolls with them - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Composure, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: On a prisoner it's a fast way to break resistance. On an enemy in a fight it makes them run. Either way, for a day the caster gets dice on Social rolls with whoever heard. It's obvious.

*A howling wind of raw magic tears at someone.* - Target: One person in sight - Effect: 8 blunt damage (8 per Potency). A point of the target's own fuel burns too: a vampire's blood, a Garou's Gnosis, a hunter's Conviction, a mage's Mana - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Damage that can't miss, and it burns a point of the target's power fuel: blood, Gnosis, Conviction or Mana. Good against other supernaturals. The Reaches burn fuel for every wound, and give it to the caster.

*Worked from Channel Mana, Prime Weaving. The mage pours their own Mana into a plain stone until it sets as tass. No new Mana is made.* - Target: One stone chunk, by touch - Effect: The caster pours up to 1 of their own Mana into it (one per Potency), and it becomes that many hallow stones - Lasts: For good How to use it: Turns the caster's own Mana into hallow stones they can carry, one a Potency, from a stone chunk beside them. A way to store Mana past the pool's cap. Comes with Channel Mana's rote.

*Mana runs from one vessel to another through the mage's hands.* Channel Mana: Give - Target: Another mage, by touch - Effect: Up to 1 of the caster's Mana (one per Potency) goes to them - Lasts: Instant Channel Mana: Take - Target: Another mage, by touch - Effect: Up to 1 of their Mana (one per Potency) comes to the caster - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Composure if they're unwilling, each dot takes 1 off the Potency How to use it: Moves Mana between mages by touch. Give tops up a mage who's about to cast something big; Take drains an enemy mage you've captured (they resist if unwilling).

*The mage wipes away the marks their magic leaves.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Every trace of whose magic touched them is wiped, and Focused Mage Sight finds no Signature there. A Paradox Condition of strength 1 or less lifts - Lasts: Instant How to use it: Wipes the magical fingerprints off someone so nobody can trace whose magic touched them, and lifts a weak Paradox Condition. Good after a spell went wrong.

*Every spell in the area stands out in the air like a diagram.* - Target: The caster's area - Effect: A mentor's lessons there take two thirds of the usual time - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Speeds up teaching. A mentor's lessons in the area take two thirds of the time while it lasts. Cast it where your mentor teaches.

*A weapon or a fist that can touch what lives in Twilight.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Their weapon or fists strike ghosts, spirits, Goetia and anyone in Twilight. Their blows on banes and fomori do half again as much - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Lets a fighter hit what normally can't be hit: ghosts, spirits, Goetia and anything in Twilight. It also does extra damage to Wyrm creatures. Cast it before you fight the restless dead.

*The mage bends the lines of power under the land to where they want them.* - Target: A spot in sight - Effect: The map's ley lines bend to it and make a node there - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: The map needs ley lines. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Moves a ley node to where you want it, so your casting spot (or your workshop) gets the node's extra die. The map has to have ley lines (Sacred Geometry shows them).

*Worked from Aetheric Winds, Prime Weaving. Raw Mana thrown as darts, a lance or a blast. A lost rote from the Lantern Scrolls.* Mana Darts - Target: One target in range - Effect: 1 darts of Mana (one per Potency), a bashing wound each, that curve to the target: no attack roll, no dodge - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Mana Lance - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: A lance of Mana through everyone on a line: 1 bashing wounds each (one per Potency) - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing: no one inside dodges it - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Aether Blast - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: A burst of Mana round the target: 1 bashing wounds to each (one per Potency), and everyone hit is thrown 1 cells and knocked down - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing: no one inside dodges it - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Three buttons of raw Mana: Mana Darts never miss, Mana Lance runs through a line, Aether Blast throws a crowd back. A lost rote, taught only by the Lantern Scrolls.

*The mage pulls an ideal object out of raw Mana.* Platonic Form - Target: The caster - Effect: A blade of pure Mana appears beside them, 1 quality steps better (one per Potency). Each blow costs its wielder a Mana, and with none left it fades - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Costs 1 Mana. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Platonic Form: Gems - Target: The caster - Effect: 1 gems of pure Mana appear beside them (one per Potency). A mage draws a Mana from each, as from tass - Lasts: The Duration, then any left fade - Watch out: Costs 1 Mana. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Platonic Form: Tool - Target: The caster - Effect: An ideal tool of pure Mana appears beside them, 1 quality steps better (one per Potency). Whoever holds it works 15% faster - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Costs 1 Mana. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Makes an ideal object out of Mana. The blade is a strong weapon but each blow costs a Mana. The gems are portable Mana, like tass, until the spell ends. The tool makes all work 15% faster while held. Each version costs 1 Mana to cast.

*For a while a Sleeper can stand beside magic without flinching.* - Target: One Sleeper, by touch - Effect: They aren't an outsider witness to magic. When it ends, all they saw hits them at once - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Resolve if they're unwilling, each dot takes 1 off the Potency How to use it: Lets a Sleeper colonist stand next to magic without being a Paradox witness. Cast it on the non-mages who live with your mages. When it ends they see everything at once, which can shake them.

*Worked from Ephemeral Enchantment, Prime Weaving. Glyphs on a gun turn its bullets to Supernal light.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: Shots fly as light: +10% armour piercing, and they hit ghosts, spirits and anyone in Twilight. Their weapon glows and every swing and shot leaves a trail - Lasts: The Duration How to use it: Glyphs on a gun: its bullets fly as light, pierce more armour and hit ghosts and spirits. Comes with Ephemeral Enchantment's rote.

*The mage tears the blindfold off a Sleeper's eyes.* - Target: One Sleeper, by touch - Effect: They see magic and can't stop. Each hour is a shock, and once the hours pass their Resolve + Composure they go blind until it ends - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Resolve, each dot takes 1 off the Potency. The caster's own people don't resist - Watch out: On anyone not on the caster's side, an Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Forces a Sleeper to see magic. Each hour shakes them, and if it lasts too long they go blind until it ends. It's an Act of Hubris on anyone not on your side. Mostly a story spell, or a cruel weapon.

*A bolt of the Supernal's own fire.* - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: 8 burn damage (8 per Potency). A point of the target's own fuel burns too: a vampire's blood, a Garou's Gnosis, a hunter's Conviction, a mage's Mana. A Reach brings the burned fuel to the caster as Mana, up to her Gnosis - Shape: The builder can give it a line, cone, burst, ring or chain, sized by Scale. Everyone in it is hit, friends too unless a Reach spares them - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing, but it can miss, and a miss lands within a few cells on whoever is there - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Prime's big attack. It rolls to hit, burns the target's power fuel, and can take a shape (a line, a cone, a burst, a ring or a chain) that hits everyone in it, your people too unless a Reach spares them. The Reaches add fire on the ground, more fuel burned, or aggravated wounds.

*Solid Mana comes apart and drifts away.* - Target: Tass in sight - Effect: Up to 1 tass (one per Potency) comes apart, and its Mana drifts back to the nearest Hallow on the map - Lasts: Instant - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Breaks tass apart and sends its Mana back to the nearest Hallow on the map. Useful to deny an enemy cabal their stock, or to feed your own Hallow.

*The mage wakes a sleeping Hallow, or damps a waking one.* - Target: One Hallow in sight - Effect: A sleeping Hallow wakes if 1 is at least its rating. An awake one counts 1 dots lower, and falls asleep at 0 - Lasts: The Duration for the damping. Waking is for good - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Wakes a sleeping Hallow for good, if your Potency is at least its rating. On an awake Hallow it damps it for the Duration, lowering its rating (to sleep at 0). The Reach keeps it damped.

*Worked from Celestial Fire, Prime Patterning. A burst of the Supernal's own light, cruel to whatever lives in Twilight. A lost rote from the Lantern Scrolls.* - Target: One target in range, with an attack roll - Effect: A burst of Supernal light: half its Potency in burn wounds, double the full Potency on ghosts, spirits and anyone in Twilight, and it blinds everyone hit for a few seconds - Lasts: Instant - Resisted by: Nothing: no one inside dodges it - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Weak on the living, brutal on ghosts and spirits, and it half blinds everyone in the burst. A lost rote, taught only by the Lantern Scrolls.

*The mage unwrites another's spell whatever it's made of.* Supernal Dispellation - Target: One lasting spell on a person in sight - Effect: As Dispel Magic, but the caster doesn't need the spell's Arcanum - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Its caster's dots in its Arcanum, each dot takes 1 off the Potency - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die Supernal Dispellation: Silence a nature - Target: One vampire, werewolf or hunter in sight (needs Prime 5) - Effect: Their powers stop: no Gifts, no blood spent, no healing the way they should - Lasts: 1 hours (an hour per Potency) - Resisted by: A Clash of Wills against the subject's Resolve plus three - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Dispel Magic that works on any spell, even one in an Arcanum you don't know. With Prime 5, "Silence a nature" switches off a vampire's, werewolf's or hunter's powers for a few hours.

*The mage kills the magic in a place, and it stays dead.* - Target: An area in sight, the Scale - Effect: Its ley nodes are dead, and Sleepers who spend a day there are left drained - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: An Act of Hubris (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Understanding or higher). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Kills the magic in an area: its ley nodes stop working, and Sleepers who spend a day there are drained. Use it to ruin an enemy cabal's ground. It's an Act of Hubris.

*The mage makes a new Hallow out of nothing.* - Target: A spot in sight - Effect: A Hallow of rating 1 (at most 5) wells up there, and a ley node runs to it - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Costs 5 Mana for each dot of Potency. Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Makes a Hallow where there was none, with a ley node. It's expensive: 5 Mana for each dot of Potency. Cast it Indefinite at home and it pays for itself in Mana and tass.

*A servant of pure Mana stands up beside the mage.* - Target: The caster - Effect: A servant of Mana works and fights for them, and cleans the home area when there's nothing else to do. Its blows and what it carries are 60% to 150% of the usual, and it takes 140% to 70% of the harm - Orders: Its Order button gives it one standing order: haul, clean, mine, build, guard a spot or follow its maker - Lasts: The Duration - Watch out: Costs 1 Mana. Making it is magic for a chore (a Wisdom roll if the caster's Wisdom is Enlightened). Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: A servant made of Mana that works and fights for the mage, and cleans when idle. Potency makes it stronger and tougher: at Potency 1 it's weaker than a person, at 5 much stronger. Give it a standing order from its button. Making it is magic for a chore.

*The mage gives someone one of their own obsessions.* - Target: One person, by touch - Effect: One of the caster's Obsessions becomes theirs - On a mage: She keeps it for good, and her newest gives way if she has too many - On a Sleeper: They carry it for the Duration: they break more easily and Awaken more readily. If they Awaken they keep it, with an Arcane Beat for each week it was carried - Lasts: The Duration - Resisted by: Resolve if they're unwilling, each dot takes 1 off the Potency How to use it: Gives someone one of the caster's Obsessions. On a Sleeper it's a way to push them toward Awakening: they break more easily but Awaken more readily, and keep the Obsession with Arcane Beats if they do. On a mage it's for good.

*One word, and a magic object falls apart.* - Target: One fetish in sight - Effect: It's destroyed - Lasts: For good - Resisted by: Its Durability and the spirit in it, each dot takes 1 off the Potency - Watch out: Obvious: each outsider who sees it adds a Paradox die How to use it: Destroys a fetish outright: the answer to a werewolf's best weapon. Strong fetishes resist. With the Reach it explodes.
