Name What it is Arcas The first auspice: the First Change, the Gallivant and a head full of questions. Blade Slave The warriors, tough and thirsty for blood, each carrying a pain-dagger. Corax Corax have no auspices: every one of them belongs to Raven and to the sun. Decorated Sun, Gathering Changed under a haloed sun, the rarest of all: at their best working with others. Doshi The path of lightning: sorcerers who use evil against evil, living alone in old temples. Eji The path of lava: holy warriors of swift, neat executions. Engineer A freak aspect: tinkerers who can make any machine run for a while out of junk. Grisma A Makara changed in summer: judges and police. Gukutsushi The path of fog: dreamweavers, tricksters and healers. Hatar Servants of the Wyrm as it was, the Destroyer: the Unweavers. Hemanta A Makara changed in winter: tricksters. Kataribe The path of clay: poets, builders and loremasters. Kieh The mystic, given to reflection, rites and mentoring. Knife Skulker Spies and assassins with a sense of justice. A Skulker never lets a target see the blow that kills it. Kojubat The rememberer, learning lore and starting a lifework. Kumoti Servants of the Wyld as it should be: change and growth. Midnight Sun, Shining Changed at night: humour and courage when all seems lost. Munchmausen A freak aspect: liars so good that everyone believes them, themselves included. Nam Hsai A Zhong Lung of summer and the south wind, yellow. New moon Coyote tricked Luna, and since then she sees every Nuwisha as a child of the new moon. No Path A young Kitsune who has not yet chosen a Path at the Rite of the Crossroads. Noonday Sun, Unshading Changed within an hour of noon: the bane of creatures of darkness. Pei Tung A Zhong Lung of winter and the north wind, black. Plague Lord A freak aspect: healers who serve a spirit of disease, and spread what it asks. Rishi The judge, who keeps the peace. Rising Sun, Striking Changed between dawn and noon: quick to strike first. Sai Chau A Zhong Lung of autumn and the west wind, white. Setting Sun, Warding Changed between noon and sunset: defenders of others. Shadow Seer Mystics who hear the spirits and sometimes care more for the spirit world than this one. Shrouded Sun, Concealing Changed under a hidden sun: hunters who go unseen. Solar Eclipse, Crowning Changed in an eclipse. All Mokolé defer to them, and they must serve the greater good. Tenere Servants of the Weaver as she was: order, pattern and control. Tung Chun A Zhong Lung of spring and the east wind, blue-green. Tunnel Runner Messengers and scouts who blend into any crowd and never stay long. Twitcher A freak aspect: paranoid and forgettable, with a Rage that runs away with them. Umbral Danser Followers of Ptah who have fasted and danced their way into the Umbra. They keep their Gifts from other Nuwisha. Uzmati The warrior, travelling alone after the first real battle. Vasanta A Makara changed in spring: warriors and travellers. Zarad A Makara changed in autumn: mystics.

Name What it is Mnesis The memories of every ancestor of its line. Each dot reaches further back, from a century to the time of the Dinosaur Kings, and lends a stronger ancestor's skill to a Mnesis quest. Umbral Glade A stretch of land where the Gauntlet is thin and Bear's children rest. Inside it a Gurahl steps sideways freely, regains Gnosis while it sleeps, and hibernates in half the time. Each dot makes it bigger: 36 cells at one dot up to 5000 at five. Wallow A home by the water where the Mokolé and their kin gather. On its home map it draws half again as much Gnosis from the sun, and a Mnesis trance takes half the time.

Name What it is Arachnid Hatched from an egg sac, a spider that became a person. Corvid Born a raven, and still a raven at heart: a fast flier, poor with tools, books and medicine. Homid Born human, then changed slowly over days in the Metamorphosis. Homid Born human, with thin black hair, black eyes and a ring finger longer than the middle one. Slower to take to the air than a raven-born Corax. Homid Born human, often tall and strong. Homid Born human, often in warm lands. Homid Born human. The First Change came as a revelation, not a horror. Homid A human kin who lived through the Birthing Plague. At the bottom of the nest. Kojin Born human, and aware of being different long before the First Change. Latrani Born a coyote, and far more common than wolf-born Garou. Metis Born of two Ratkin, deformed and sterile. The nest keeps them as guards and wardens. Rodens Born a rat and raised in the walls. Rodens sit at the top of the nest, as courtiers and Rat Kings. Roko Born a fox and often raised by wild foxes. Shinju Born of two Kitsune, with no deformity and no curse: a full Kitsune in every way. Suchid Hatched from a reptile egg, a crocodile or lizard that became a person. Ursine Born a bear, and slow to learn the ways of people.

Name What it is Ananasi Werespiders who serve Queen Ananasa, imprisoned in a web of opal. They drink blood instead of feeling Rage, scatter into a swarm of spiders when they must, and keep the Queen's laws. Corax Wereravens, Gaia's eyes and tattletales. Fragile, fast and curious, they fly, drink the eyes of the dead to see how they died, and can't keep a secret. Gold burns them, not silver. Gurahl Werebears, Gaia's healers. Slow to anger and terrible when they get there, they guard their land, sleep through the winter and teach the cubs of every kind. Kitsune Werefoxes, guides to rulers and masters of illusion. They grow a tail with every rank, learn the Gifts of any kind, and keep the Mandates of the Beast Courts. Mokolé Werelizards, the memory of Gaia. Each carries the remembered lives of its ancestors back to the age of dragons, and its war form is a dragon built anew every time. Nuwisha Werecoyotes, Coyote's children, who teach by pranks. They have no Rage at all, laugh at the Garou, and play tricks on the Wyrm that would get anyone else killed. Ratkin Wererats, made by the Birthing Plague rather than born. They cull the herd for Gaia, live in tunnels under the cities, talk to rats and trust nobody, least of all the Garou.

Name What it is Council of Autumn The elders of the werebears sit in council. Rank is given here to every werebear of the colony who has earned it, and the Council may hand down a task. Gather Werelizards of every stream come to the wallow at midsummer to share memories and settle old feuds. Powwow Werebears of every tribe come for the summer powwow, to trade crafts and teach. For a season after, the colony's werebears learn Gifts at half cost. Regalia Werebears and their kin come for the spring Regalia: dancing, boasting and matchmaking. A kin mate may stay with the colony after. Revel Wererats from the nearest nest come to drink, boast and pick fights. A Rat King's courtiers watch, and give rank to the ones who have earned it.

Name What it is Airt Sense Knows the ways of the spirit world: every spirit on the map is named and the fog around it lifts. All Hell Two Gnosis. A scream that breaks the mind: every mortal on the map whose Willpower is under the Twitcher's Infamy suffers the Delirium. Alter Lilian Reshapes the war form at will: more arms to carry with, longer legs to run on or thicker chitin to hide behind. Alter Mood A Gnosis and a touch lift someone's spirits for a day. Arachnophobia A Gnosis plants a fear of spiders: for a day a success, the victim runs from any werespider or insect it sees. Armor of the Tortoise Its hide hardens like a shell for half a minute: a tenth better armour a success. Once a fight. Aversion Therapy A Gnosis ties fear to a want. A colonist loses every addiction; a stranger loses its taste for raiding the colony, and its people warm to the bear's. Awe A presence like the sun: people listen when it speaks. Backbite One Gnosis and one Rage. The Ratkin vanishes and is behind a foe up to 15 metres off, striking at once with a better chance to hit. Battery One Gnosis. Brews a fizzing pick-me-up from junk: a dose for every two successes, each making a body stronger and quicker for four hours. It goes flat in a few days. Befriend Strangers warm to it from the first word. Bellow A Rage point and a roar from the age of dragons: one mortal suffers the Delirium, its nerve the weaker for the Mokolé's Glory. Beneath Notice A Gnosis makes the spider part of the background for a few hours: unseen while it keeps still, and thieves overlook whatever lies near it. Beneath the Electron Bridge A Gnosis and the perfect thing to say to enrage someone. The target is furious for a day, and throws a tantrum unless its Willpower holds. Bestow Ursa's Blessing A Gnosis and a touch: the bear blesses body, heart or mind, for an hour a success. Blades of the Mantis A blood point grows mantis blades from the forearms for an hour: aggravated cuts, though fine work comes hard. Blessing the Blade A Gnosis and a spirit wakes in its weapon for an hour: each blow adds an aggravated wound. Blessings of the Nest A Gnosis and a blessing hissed in the Dragon Tongue: the one touched conceives with its partner, and sterility leaves it. An animal is bred at once; a person needs a partner on the map. Blind A Gnosis and a touch to the eyes: someone within three metres goes blind for a day, unless their Willpower holds. Blinding Spit A blood point of venom spat into the eyes of someone up to four metres away: blind for three seconds a success. Blisters A touch, and ugly blisters cover the target's face for a day a success: beauty -2 and social impact -30%, unless its Willpower holds. Blood of Illusion Whoever drinks its blood sees things that aren't there and wanders off after them, unless their Willpower beats its Gnosis. Blood of Pain Whoever drinks its blood falls sick with it: too wracked to act for an hour, unless Stamina carries them through. Blood Omen A Gnosis and a sacrifice: a downed animal or a held prisoner is killed and its body read. The next big threat is named when it comes. Blood Pump A Gnosis sets the heart racing for an hour: the spider moves and strikes as fast as a blood point would make it, the whole hour long. Bloody Feather Storm Three Gnosis and two Rage, in a flying form. A storm of razor feathers falls on everyone within 5 metres, friend or foe. Blur of the Weeping Eyes Spits in a foe's eyes from six metres. They swell shut for three seconds a success. Bolt A Rage point and a bolt of fire at a foe up to thirty metres off: an aggravated burn, worse with every success. Bolt! One Gnosis and one Rage. Gone, and up to 15 metres off at the nearest way out in sight: a door, a rat-hole or the map's edge. Breaking the Tomorrow Wall A Gnosis and a glimpse past tomorrow: for a day, the next great threat is foreseen. Breath of Ananasa Holds its breath for as long as it must: smoke, gas and bad air can't touch it for an hour. Brethren Call A blood point calls a swarm of spiders for an hour. They bite and poison every foe that comes within six metres. Burning Blood Its blood is acid: a melee attacker who wounds it is burned for every point of its Gnosis. By the Light of the Moon Whatever the moon touches, it sees: every hidden foe within thirty metres shows. Cajole A Gnosis and a few kind words: for an hour, whoever it wheedles deals with the bear a fifth cheaper. Calcify A Gnosis presses the Weaver's order on the buildings around: every one within thirty metres is mended by 30% of its strength a success. Call of the Dead A Rage point and a touch that calls the dead into the living: a wound that grows with every success. Call the Rain A Gnosis, and the sky over the land opens: rain that puts out fires. Call to Allies Its last cry for help: every friend on the map runs to it, and an ally with a settlement within 10 tiles sends fighters. Once a season. Carapace A Gnosis hardens the skin into chitin for an hour: armour like a flak vest, and wounds close as a Garou's do. Carrion Clothes A Gnosis, and it seems dead to anyone who looks: enemies and hungry animals pass it by for an hour, until it acts. Carrion's Call A vulture's nose for the dead: every corpse on the map is found and the fog over it lifts. Cartoon Physics A Gnosis and it runs on thin air, over water, chasms and walls, to a spot up to fifteen metres off. As long as it doesn't look down. Cheese It! Three Gnosis and three Rage. The whole pack on the map Bolts at once, each to its own way out. Chi Sense It feels the ebb and flow of Yin and Yang: a die more, for good, on every Gift that reads the land around it or changes it. Clear Mind A Willpower turned to thought: it studies and talks a tenth better until sunrise. Climate Control A Gnosis softens the air for an hour: everyone on its side within twelve metres bears heat and cold three degrees better a success. Cloak of Shadows One Gnosis. The Ratkin, and anyone touching it, fade into the shadows for four hours. Attacking gives them away. Compel Truth A Gnosis and the target can't lie to the bear: it gives up a secret it keeps. Corrupt A Gnosis rots what was made: a building, or a foe's weapon and clothes, falls apart a little with every success. Coyote's Intuition One look and it knows what someone least wants to talk about: it bargains and persuades better. Crawling Chaos Scuttles up and over a wall or fence like a lizard, landing up to three metres away. Free, and ready again in ten seconds. Crush Its grip reaches across the room: a crushing squeeze on someone up to four metres away, harder with every success. Curse of the Great Web A touch binds someone to the world of flesh: for an hour it can't step sideways. Curse of Tiresias A Gnosis and a harmless blow: the target becomes the other sex, as a sibling of itself, for three days. Danger Sense A tingle before trouble: while this Ratkin is home, a raid or a manhunting pack is felt coming before it arrives. Darksight A Willpower, and for an hour darkness is no hindrance to it. Darksight A Willpower and the dark doesn't slow it for an hour. Darksight Sees in pitch dark as in daylight for eight hours. Dead Talk One Gnosis. A corpse up to a day dead answers: its killer, then a secret, and with three successes what it had hidden on it. Death Ray One Gnosis. A beam of junk-built light at a foe within 15 metres that burns through flesh and armour, harder with each success. Deceptive Demise One Gnosis and a real wound. The Corax dies in a puff of feathers, blood and ash, and is in the spirit world at once. Deep Pockets Stows things where no one finds them: for a day the Ratkin carries 40 kilograms more. Deeper Lungs It can hold its breath for hours: toxic gas and smoke hardly touch it. Delay the Death Bear's Coming A Gnosis and a touch: for an hour the wounded can't die of their wounds, though they stay down. Devour the Dead One Gnosis. Rat-spirits eat a corpse within six metres, gear and all, in a few seconds. No one will learn anything from that body. Diagnose A glance tells it what ails someone: it tends a fifth faster. Disappearing Act A Willpower and a Gnosis. While it stands still, nothing can see or target it. The first step ends it. Distant Whispers A Willpower and its voice comes out of the river, the fire or the storm: everyone of its side, on every map, shares Mindspeak. Dragon Ally Two Gnosis and a dragon of earth, water or fire comes to fight for it for an hour. Dragon Drill A Gnosis and the Mokole drills its workforce: for an hour, it and an ally a success within fifteen metres each use the best level any of them has in every skill. Dragon's Breath A Rage point and a gout of fire at a foe up to nine metres off: a deep, aggravated burn. Dreams of the Buri-Jaan A Gnosis and the Gurahl dreams of a lost cub, and the cub dreams back: a young Gurahl fresh from its First Change finds the way and joins, with the dreamer as its Buri-Jaan. Once a year. Earworm A Gnosis, and a tune plays in the target's head for a day a success. Research, crafting and tending go 20% slower, unless its Willpower holds. Elemental Meld A Gnosis and it steps into the rock or water beside it, to come out by a cell that the same rock or water touches. Emperor's Clothes A flick of the wrist and one of the target's garments lands at the Nuwisha's feet. The target is left embarrassed. Enduring Warrior A Rage point, and for an hour its wounds close as a Garou's do. Enemy Ways A stormcrow's warning: every foe within 30 metres is named over their head and the fog around them lifts. Entropic Bite Two Gnosis put rot in a bite. The flesh around it dies and keeps dying: an aggravated wound every three seconds, three seconds a success. Epidemic Contagion The weeping eyes, the lesions and the pain this Ratkin gives spread: anyone close to a victim may catch them, and pass them on. Eye of the Raptor Eyes like a raptor of old: the land around it shows itself, fifteen metres a success. Eyes of the Eagle An eagle's eyes for four hours: sharper sight and a surer aim, through dark, smoke and fog. Fable A Willpower and a tale: one listener thinks well of the Kitsune, or keeps calm, for as many days as its Wisdom. False Spoor A Gnosis and it smells exactly as the target, for its Humor in days. Scent of the True Form reads the target instead. Fan-Shadow-Robe A Gnosis and another face for an hour: another skin, another head of hair. Feast of the Dead Eats the heart of a dead supernatural to take three of its powers for a day. Once a body. Filch Lifts something from a person's pack in plain sight. Takes three successes; the victim never knows. Finders Keepers A Gnosis and a touch put Coyote's mark on someone for a season: spirits keep away from it, banes and allies alike. Firebug One Rage. Sets fire to something that burns within three metres, as long as no one is wearing or carrying it. Flight of Separation Two Gnosis. The Corax bursts into a murder of ravens and only one of them is real: it takes the raven's form and goes unseen until it strikes. Flow of Aura A Gnosis and it reads what a place remembers: every tale of this place from the last day a success. Fool's Luck A Gnosis and bad luck can't touch it for half a day: no botches, only plain failures. Fool's Luck A Gnosis and the target's luck runs out: for ten seconds its Gifts fail, its shifts stall and its wounds won't close. Forbidden Words A Gnosis and the target can't speak of what it saw: whatever it witnessed of the colony, it will never tell. Forgetfulness A Gnosis and a Willpower, and someone close forgets: a bad memory a success is gone, the worst first, unless their Willpower holds. Friend and Foe A Willpower and a Gnosis: the target's people trust the Nuwisha as one of their own for a day a success, until it strikes. Gaia's Breath The werebears' great secret. On the body of a dead shapeshifter, it gives up a permanent Gnosis and a permanent Willpower and breathes life back: Charisma and Medicine at 6, one harder for every hour since the death. It can be tried once on anyone. A botch lets a Bane in instead. Gauntlet Runner One Gnosis. The Gauntlet thins within 18 metres for four hours, and anyone there steps sideways as if they held a mirror. Gentle Soul Its Rage no longer frightens people: the Curse has left this Gurahl for good. Ghost Danse Two Willpower and it dances in both worlds at once for an hour: most blows pass through it. Ghost Speech It speaks into the Yin Realm: the dead in a grave or a body say how they died. Gift of Rage A Willpower, and for an hour it has five Rage to spend as a Garou does. It can frenzy, and silver burns it. Groom Always looks well kept, whatever it has been through: people take it as it means to be taken. Hand Fangs A blood point grows venom fangs in the palms for an hour. Every blow with the hands bites and poisons, in any form that has hands. Happy Thoughts A Gnosis and a touch: for an hour the target can't frenzy or spend Rage. Hot Ichor A Rage point boils its blood: it hits harder and moves faster for eighteen seconds. Hummingbird Dart One Rage, in a flying form. For four hours the Corax can throw its feathers like darts up to 15 metres. Hydraulic Strength Pumps blood into the muscles: Strength +1 for each blood point spent, up to its rank, for an hour. Hyperattenuation One Willpower. Senses stretched past belief: everything within 60 metres comes clear, hidden foes too. Ill Winds Three blood points thin the Gauntlet over the whole map: a point lower a success, for an hour a success. Image of the Great Mother Two Gnosis take the Queen's own shape for an hour: Strength +5, Stamina +6, great claws, and the Delirium for all who see it. A week in the swarm follows. Image of the Sky Bear A Gnosis calls down the seven stars of the Great Bear: every friend within six metres has a wound a success closed, aggravated ones too. Imperial Authority A stare that makes it everyone's better for an hour: people listen to it and animals let it tame them. Improvisation One Rage. Anything in hand is a deadly weapon for four hours: a stone, a bottle, a chair leg. Inflict Pain One Rage. For four hours each blow racks the victim with pain, worse with each success up to three. Instinct One Rage, against the target's Willpower. For three seconds the target loses all restraint and lashes out at whoever is nearest. Jointsnake's Mojo A Gnosis and a touch: a limb lost within the hour crawls back and joins again. Ju-Fu: Attraction Paper magic. A Gnosis and a herd of the land's wild animals wanders in. Ju-Fu: Beast Shape Paper magic. A Gnosis and it takes the shape of the animal folded in the paper, as Thousand Forms. Ju-Fu: Lantern Paper magic. A Gnosis folds a paper lantern that lights the spot for an hour. Ju-Fu: Paper Beast Paper magic. Two Gnosis and a paper wolf grows to full size and obeys it for an hour. One wound tears it. Ju-Fu: Paper Flesh Paper magic. Three Gnosis and a paper wolf becomes flesh and blood, to fight for it for an hour. Ju-Fu: Silver Sigil Paper magic. A Gnosis and a paper "badge" that guards take for the real thing: for an hour it sneaks into any settlement. Ju-Fu: Umekochi's Mouth Paper magic. A Gnosis folds a paper box that holds four stacks in one cell, for a day. Kuei Dance A Willpower and the dead in a grave or a body act out their story: how they died, at two successes who they last fought, at three a last wish for the one they loved most. Lesions One Gnosis. For four hours each bite or claw raises weeping sores that keep the victim from running. Living Treasure A Gnosis and the Mokole's own spirit wakes a fetish or a talen: a use back a success, and a sulking spirit listens again. Long Running A Gnosis and the road shortens: a caravan it travels with goes faster for a day. Man-Spider Form Opens the Araneid form between Homid and Lilian: dark bristly skin, reddish eyes and small claws, still able to wear clothes and hold tools. Mangi's Strong Arms A Rage point into the arms: its blows land half again as hard for ten seconds. Many Eyes A blood point opens eyes all over the body for an hour: nothing takes the Ananasi from behind or by surprise. Marionette A Willpower and the target moves as the Kitsune mimes: under its control for six seconds a success, and no powers. Masking the Hunted A Gnosis hides everyone friendly within eight metres from their enemies, an hour a success, until they attack. Mind of the Swarm One Gnosis. Rats pour out of the ground and fight for the Ratkin for four hours: four, and three more for each success. Mind Sight A Gnosis reads what's on someone's mind: what it's doing now and the thoughts that weigh on it most. Minor Unweaving A Gnosis unpicks a lesser working: ends the strongest rank 1 or 2 Gift lasting on someone, a friend's curse or a foe's blessing. Moon Dance A Gnosis, and for the night it moves unseen. Attacking gives it away. Morse Taps out a call for help that only the right ears hear. With three successes an allied faction sends fighters, as a call for military aid would. Mousetrap One Gnosis. Rigs a deadly trap on a spot within five metres out of ten pieces of junk lying near it: scrap, chunks, old clothes. Mynah's Touch Two Gnosis. Borrows any Garou Gift of a lower rank for four hours, one at a time. Natural State A Gnosis and the land around goes back to the wild, six metres for each point of Honor: floors come up, buildings half fall in, grass grows over all. Nature's Plenty A Gnosis, and the land gives what someone in need must have: a simple meal and a herbal medicine, in any season and any biome. New Face A Gnosis and a new face for three days: another skin, another head of hair. Now You Don't A Gnosis and weapons vanish from the target's sight for the Nuwisha's Humor in hours: it drops what it holds and can't find another. Pain Remains A Gnosis and the target's pain won't fade, however it heals, for four hours. Paint the Meadows Pitiful moans draw a creature up to fifteen metres off toward the Mokole, three seconds a success, until something hurts it. Past Whispers It hears what was said in this room in the last day, two things a success. Patience of Ananasa Waits in perfect stillness: unseen until it strikes, for four hours, and its blows land harder. Playing the Heart-Strings A Gnosis, a Willpower and a touch: within twelve months, fewer a success, a chain of odd chances brings the target true love. The Nuwisha must have no lover of its own. Poison Food One Gnosis. All food near the Ratkin, more of it the greater its Infamy, turns bad: whoever eats it gets food poisoning. Portents Two Gnosis, under the night sky. A wind-spirit shows what's to come: one question, answered truly but in symbols, and plainly with three successes. Possession A Gnosis, a Willpower and a touch: the Kitsune leaves its body to ride the target's, a day a success. Its own body lies in a trance meanwhile. Probe Thoughts A Gnosis digs into a mind: one success shows what it truly is, two a secret it keeps. Pull of the Chosen Land Always knows the quickest way: a caravan with this bear in it travels half again as fast. Puppeteer's Secret Everyone assumes it belongs: sneaking into a town, it counts as well hidden. Pyrotechnics One Rage. Builds bombs from ten pieces of junk lying near: a grenade for every two successes, at least one. Quell Mob Rage A Gnosis and a word calm everyone within fifteen metres: fights and furies end, and Rage cools. Rage of the Mother Bear A Gnosis, and it moves and strikes twice as fast for two seconds a success. Rage of the Nest Mother When a kin or a child in its sight has just been hurt, the Mokole draws on a mother's fury: Strength +2 for an hour and a point of Rage. Rat Thing Opens a new form between Crinos and Rodens: a rat the size of a big dog, strong, fast and tough, with no hands. Rat's Judgment One Rage. For four hours the Ratkin's blows land harder on the Wyrm's own, tainted humans among them. Rat's Teeth One Rage. The thrown weapon in hand doesn't run out: copies of it fill the Ratkin's pack for four hours, then crumble. Ratman Opens a new form between Homid and Crinos: mostly human, with a rat's eyes, nose, hands and teeth. Clothes and guns still work, the claws cut, and mortals see only an ugly stranger. Raven's Gleaning A glance tells what's worth having: the three most valuable loose things within 40 metres are priced over them, and anyone close by with a fortune on them gives up a secret. Razor Feathers One Gnosis, in Crinos. The feathers turn to steel for four hours, and the Corax can slash with its wings. Razor Webs Its snares cut. Whoever is caught in one takes an aggravated wound every three seconds until free. Recapitulate Two Gnosis and a foe slides back down the tree of life, ten minutes a success: a rat, then a lizard, then a beetle at three successes. Its gear falls away and it can use no powers. Refresh A Gnosis and a touch: no pain and no wound penalties for an hour. Replenishment of the Flesh A Gnosis knits the flesh: one wound closes a success. Aggravated wounds stay. Reptoid Form Opens a new form between Homid and Archid: hairless and lightly scaled, stronger and tougher, with small sharp claws. Clothes and guns still work, and from a distance it passes for human. Safe Passage A Gnosis and the bear's friends within three metres leave no trace for an hour: unseen while no foe has a clear line to them. Salaryman Just another face in a crowd: with three or more people around it, foes can't pick it out until it strikes. Scamper One Gnosis, to run. For four hours the Ratkin is much harder to hit, but attacking ends it and empties its Rage and Gnosis. Scorpion Tail Three blood points grow a stinging tail for an hour: aggravated stabs that carry its venom. Seal of Inari A ghostly mark only Kitsune see: a death mark turns them against its bearer, a call for help wins their friendship, a warning makes them wary. Secret Question Always has the right answer when someone asks who it is: sneaking into a town, it counts as well hidden. Seduction A Gnosis and a person falls for the Kitsune: opinion +10 a success, up to +30, for a season. Seek A Gnosis and the local spirits say where one person is, if within 30 tiles. Sense Gold Senses every piece of gold on the map, and every gold weapon in a hand. Sense Hostility It feels hostile minds within thirty metres, hidden or not. Sense Imbalance It feels which of the Triat holds the land: the Wyrm's taint, the Weaver's building or the Wyld's growth. Sense Motion Feels everything that moves within fifteen metres, through walls and in the dark. Sense Need A Gnosis and the bear feels who needs it: everyone friendly, on any map, who is down, bleeding, starving or sick. Sense Weaver Feels the Weaver's hand: every machine on the map, mechanoid and turret, is marked and the fog over it lifts. Shadow Walk Walks through the Gauntlet anywhere, as if a mirror were always to hand. Shadow-Fan-Flowers A Gnosis and a perfect illusion: the target sees a threat that is not there and runs, six seconds a success, unless its Willpower holds. Shattering Three Gnosis tear any working apart: ends the strongest Gift lasting on someone, whatever its rank. Sheep's Clothing A Gnosis and it looks, smells and moves like the shifter aimed at, for a day a success: that one's people take it for one of their own until it strikes. Shelter of the Earth A Gnosis, and the land hides it: unseen for an hour, until it attacks. Sigil One Gnosis. A rat sign scratched anywhere, read by other Ratkin who pass: once a quadrum it tells of a site within 30 tiles. Silence Two Gnosis and an eerie quiet falls, four metres a success, for an hour: no one inside can speak. Silent Running One Gnosis. Leaves no trace for four hours: a little quicker, and unseen by any foe who has no clear line to it. Sky's Beneficence Drops what the Corax carries exactly on a spot within 15 metres: a grenade goes off there, and anything else lands at someone's feet. Only in a flying form. Sleep of the Ages A touch on a sleeper, and nothing wakes it for an hour a success: no noise, no raid, no alarm. Slicing Teeth One Rage. Teeth and claws honed for four hours: they cut deeper and through armour. Not in Homid. Sliver Tooth One Rage. For four hours every bite leaves splinters of tooth in the wound, which won't heal until a doctor digs them out. Not in Homid. Sniffle One Gnosis. Anyone hiding near the Ratkin sneezes and gives themselves away. Song of Fear A Rage point and its own fox's fear cast into a foe: it runs for six seconds a success, unless its Willpower holds. Song of Terra A Gnosis and the earth sings what happened here: every tale of this place from the last day a success. Sorcerous Bite A Gnosis and its teeth turn to jade for an hour: each blow adds a deep aggravated wound. Spirit Healing A Gnosis heals a spirit: one wound a success. Spirit Shape A Gnosis and the bear looks like a spirit to spirits, a day a success: banes and the rest leave it be. Spirits of Laughter A Gnosis and laughter spirits fill the air for an hour: everyone within thirty metres keeps their temper, and fewer break or frenzy. Squeeze One Willpower. Slips through a crack in a wall or a closed door, coming out up to two metres away on the other side. Sticky Paws One Rage. Snatches the weapon out of a foe's hands within five metres and holds it. Still Blood Its blood numbs whoever it splashes: an attacker who hits it in melee loses three points of Strength, getting one back each hour. Stolen Moments A touch and a Gnosis take the last quarter hour from someone's memory, and whatever they saw in it. Stonesight Knows the stone around it: the map clears five metres a success, through rock and walls. Stop Continental Drift Two Gnosis and the world remembers it was once one land: a caravan it travels with goes three times as fast for a day. Stop Hitting Yourself A Willpower and a Gnosis. The next blow to land on it within the hour goes back to its attacker instead, past armour. Sun Enfleshed Three Gnosis and it burns in silent sun-fire for an hour: its blows burn. Sun's Guard Two Rage. Raven's sunlight wraps the Corax: no fire or heat touches it for three seconds a success. Balefire still burns. Survival One Gnosis. A day without needing food. Suspicious Glance A sly look, and the target starts to distrust the friend it likes best. Its opinion of them drops by 30 for three days, unless its Willpower holds. Swallow's Return One Gnosis. For two days a caravan with this Corax in it heads home three times as fast. Swarm of Servants A Willpower and from the fur of its tail come rats, two a success, to fight for it for an hour. Swollen Tongue A touch, and the target's tongue swells until it can't say a word for an hour, unless its Willpower holds. Tame Sunbeam A Gnosis and the sun sends its light: real sunlight for an hour, two metres a success around where the Mokole stands. Vampires in it burn as by day. Taste of Madness One Gnosis, against the target's Willpower. A lie so good the target believes it: they wander in a daze for an hour a success and won't fight. Ten Chi A Gnosis and it knows where it stands and which way home lies. Theft of Stars One Willpower and one Rage. Helios takes the target's natural light: they can hardly see for two hours and an hour a success. Threaten A Rage point and a roar: enemies within eight metres flee for three seconds a success, unless their Willpower holds. Thunderbolt One Rage. Calls lightning from the clouds onto a foe it can see. Tick Body The body swells to hold more blood: a pool of 15 at rank 3, 20 at rank 4 and 25 at rank 5. Tiny Coyote A Gnosis, and for an hour it shrinks to the size of a mouse and slips under any door, locked or not. Treeshake A Gnosis and a shake of any tree bring down berries and nuts: ten meals' worth a success, in any season. Trickster's Skin A Gnosis and it wears the target's looks, voice and scent for an hour: that one's people take it for theirs until it strikes. Two Tongues A Willpower and for an hour it holds two conversations at once, each listener hearing only its own: its words carry twice the weight. Ultimatum A Gnosis and a stare that leaves the foe one choice: run. It flees for three seconds a success unless its Willpower holds. Umbral Gateway Three Gnosis open a door through the Gauntlet: the Danser and its friends within three metres walk through, with no roll. Understanding the Tapestry Sees how the threads of the world cross: quicker at research and at reading people and places. Urban Camouflage Just another face in the crowd: for four hours no one picks the Ratkin out until it attacks. Ursa's Light A Gnosis calls down starlight: a soft light twelve metres around, for an hour. Uzume Sings A Gnosis and a song that holds a foe still, six seconds a success, unless its Willpower holds. Voice Bank A Gnosis and it shouts "fall back" in the voice of the one it aims at. That one's side within 20 metres falls back, six seconds a success. Voice of the Mimic A friend's voice from a spot of the Corax's choosing. Foes within 15 metres of the Corax go to see what their ally wants, for five seconds. Voice of Woe A Gnosis and a cry of grief: every Gaian shifter of the colony within a tile a success hears it. Waken A Gnosis and a touch wake someone from an unnatural sleep: a hibernation, a drugged stupor. Walk Like a Man Leaves the prints it chooses for an hour: it hunts unheard, and nothing about its war form strikes the Delirium. Walking Between Worlds Steps sideways anywhere, as the Garou do, wherever it is. Ways of the Tapestry A Gnosis and the bear sees how things connect: it learns a secret of one of the world's factions. Weather Watch Reads the sky: the highs and lows of the next three days, and how long what's on the map will last. Web Sheet Two blood points throw a sheet of sticky web over a wide field: every foe within fifteen metres of the spot is caught until it tears free on Strength at 9. Whisper Catching Hears what someone within 20 metres would rather keep quiet, and learns a secret about them, unless their will is the stronger. Wire Sitter Listens in on the lines a comms console on the map carries, and learns a secret about a faction. Word Beyond One Gnosis. A raven mark in the spirit world, where other Corax leave word: once a quadrum it tells of a site within 30 tiles. Wyrmling Kinship The Wyrm's creatures take the Hatar for one of their own. While only they are near, they leave it be, until it strikes.
Name What it is Double Draught Can drink both of a dead body's eyes, not only one.

Name What it is Champsa Mokolé whose Suchid is the Nile crocodile. Gharial Mokolé whose Suchid is the gharial. Halpatee Mokolé whose Suchid is the American alligator. Karna Mokolé whose Suchid is the saltwater crocodile. Makara Mokolé whose Suchid is the mugger and the Chinese alligator. Ora Mokolé whose Suchid is the monitor lizard. Paisa Mokolé whose Suchid is the American crocodile. Syrta Mokolé whose Suchid is the caiman. Unktehi Mokolé whose Suchid is the Gila monster.

Name What it is Falling weight Something heavy drops on it from above. Only under a roof. False alarm At night, its whole side wakes to an alarm that was nothing. Everyone loses sleep. Rigged blast Something it uses blows up, as hard as a frag grenade. Uses up ten chemfuel. Set them on each other A word here, a word there, and within the day it comes to blows with one of its own. Stolen garment One of its garments ends up in the Nuwisha's hands, and it ends up embarrassed. Swapped food Something wrong in its next meal: food poisoning. Tripwire A wire across its path. It falls, stunned for a moment, and bruised.

Name What it is Burning the Library A memory burned away for each success: first what the one it is held for saw of the colony's secrets, then its bad memories. Used on someone who didn't ask, it breaks the Duty to Remember. Dedication Rite A Rite of the Totem bound to one goal: the nearest enemy camp or base. The circle becomes a pack under the totem until the goal is gone, and then the pack breaks up, each member a little prouder for it. Dreams of Winter The werebear sleeps with the rite's song in its ears. When it wakes it knows what happened in the world while it slept. Eyes of the Flock The Corax calls every raven and crow nearby and asks what they've seen. The whole map comes clear, and the birds tell of sites within as many tiles as the Corax has Gnosis. Hazer Tag The Ratkin marks an unknowing patsy with its droppings. For as many days as it has Gnosis, anyone hunting the Ratkin follows the patsy's trail instead, so no hunter or nemesis can pick it out. Proprieties of Conduct The rules of the gathering, announced so that every spirit hears. For a day everyone on the map keeps their temper better: frenzy comes two harder, and breaks a fifth less often. Rite of Dansing A follower of Ptah eats peyote, fasts and tells its deeds against the Wyrm. It costs three Gnosis and a psychoid leaf. Success makes it an Umbral Danser; failure bars it for a year. Rite of Memory Theft The Corax's harshest punishment. Three or more strip a Corax of all it knows: its Gifts above the first rank, its Renown and its ties, and the master takes its secrets. The victim's will may hold. Rite of Rending the Gauntlet In its war form the werebear claws the Gauntlet open. For an hour it may step into the spirit world from where it stands. Anyone who sees it is struck by the Delirium. Rite of Replenishment Held at a sacred place, a caern, a glade or a thin spot, once a season: each success gives the werebear a point of Gnosis. Rite of Spinning The Ananasi spins its Sylie where the rite is held: a great cobweb in a quiet corner, in both worlds at once. In its room it regains Gnosis and steps sideways more easily. Each Ananasi has one; spinning another tears down the old. Rite of the Birthing Plague A Ratkin bites a kin, human or rat, and passes on Rat's fever. Some die of it, some go mad, some come through unchanged, and a few wake as Ratkin. The odds are shown before the bite. Rite of the Crossroads Four bowls, one for each element. A Nogitsune chooses its Path for life and becomes Yakan. An elder of rank 2 or more holds it, and earns Toku for it. Rite of the Death Bear Over a body Gaia's Breath could not wake, the werebear calls Mangi and fights it for the dead one's life. Win in a day and the dead one rises. Lose, and sometimes Mangi takes the bear instead. Rite of the Joined Circle Shifters of different breeds, Garou among them, sing of Gaia's need for renewal in a space decked out to please a spirit, and bind themselves to it as one pack. Their Totem dots together must reach the totem's cost. A Nuwisha in the circle means a trickster totem. Rite of the Pain-Dagger A Blade Slave binds a spirit of pain into a knife. The dagger answers only its Blade Slave and cuts anyone else who holds it. Rite of the Spirit Egg Two Corax in the spirit world lay a spirit egg in an adult mortal. It costs the maker a point of permanent Gnosis, and in three to six days the carrier wakes as a wereraven. Rite of the Sun's Bright Ray A shaft of Helios's light, called down where the rite is held. It stays an hour a success, by night or underground, and vampires burn in it as in the day. Rite of True Mating The werebear goes looking for a mate of its kin: one on the map, or else the nearest Gurahl home will know of one. A cub can't hold it. River's Portent The werebear catches a fish and reads it. It learns what threat comes next, as a seer's warning does. Rock Art A memory stored in a work of art. Any Garou or Fera who spends a Gnosis on the piece afterwards learns what it holds: a secret about one of the world's factions. Silence of the Oracles The ritemaster locks away the pain of a memory. Each success takes one bad memory off the one it is held for, the worst first. Sing Back the Dead A song over a fresh body, and Coyote decides. If he says yes, the dead lives again and the singer loses a permanent Gnosis. If he says no, the singer may stop; singing on kills the singer and the dead stays dead. The Master's Needs An hour spinning a cocoon around a mortal in the Ananasi's venom, downed, asleep or a prisoner. Each day inside it the mortal fights the venom's hold; each day it loses, it owes the spider a service: its senses, its body for a few seconds, or nothing more when released. Blood can't be refilled past the services owed.

Name What it is Battlefield crow You followed the armies for three seasons, watching and picking secrets off the dead. The war has moved on and the camp has scattered, but two camp followers who know what you are stayed with you.Note: one Corax and two kin. Medieval arms and the old crafts; research is as normal. Coyote's child You pranked this mortal once, and it went so well they stuck around. Now it's the two of you, a long way from anywhere, and you're already bored.Note: one Nuwisha and one mortal. New wallow Your stream sent you two to start a new wallow. The water here is warm and the sun is strong. Two kin came to help build it.Note: two Mokolé of one stream with a Wallow of one, and two kin. Best somewhere wet. Protectorate You've chosen this land as your protectorate. Two human kin and a black bear came with you. Keep the land well and it will keep you.Note: one Gurahl (Arcas) of the Forest Walkers, two kin and a black bear kin. Best in forest or tundra. Rat pack Three Ratkin and two rat-kin humans left the nest with a job: find somewhere quiet, dig in, and grow. The nest knows where you went. It expects to hear from you.Note: three Ratkin of random aspects, two kin and two rats. The Ratkin nests know the colony from the start. Rat-catchers' guild Nobody looks twice at the rat-catchers. You can go anywhere in a town at any hour with a sack nobody wants to open. The three of you have taken the work far from the old town now, and the rats came too.Note: three Ratkin. Medieval arms and the old crafts; research is as normal. Sentai The Beast Court sent your sentai out with a Mandate. You're four of a kind, each on a different Path, and the court expects great things.Note: four Kitsune, one of each Path. The Beast Courts know the colony from the start. The Joined Circle One young Garou and three of the Changing Breeds, joined by the old rite. The sept wouldn't have it, so you left. Now it's just the four of you and the totem that agreed to take you.Note: one Garou Cliath and three Fera of random breeds, already a pack. The Queen's first order The Queen hatched you and sent you out with two mortals who don't know what you are. She will tell you what she wants of you soon. Until then, build a web and wait.Note: one Ananasi and two mortals. The Watcher Raven sent you here to watch. Something in this corner of the world is worth knowing about, and two friends came along without asking too many questions.Note: one Corax and two mortals.

Name What it is Eldest of the wallow The one with the longest memory. Rules the wallow by remembering what everyone else forgot. Gai'nan Sits in the court's council and gives its missions. Rat King Rules the nest by being the one nobody dares cross. Speaks for the nest and settles its quarrels, usually by ending them. Rat King's court Whispers to the Rat King and carries the nest's grudges out into the world. Speaker of the court Speaks for the Beast Court and holds it to the Mandate of Heaven. Wallow elder Sits at the gather and speaks for a clutch of the wallow.

Name What it is Chasers Gangs of young Corax who hunt the uncanny together. They break up within a year or two. Forest Walkers Black bears and spirit bears: the most numerous tribe, fond of powwows and respectful of elders. Gulls of Battle Seekers of old stories and new corpses. They follow the fighting. Gumagan The Stream of the Forerunners, with the deepest memories. Saltwater crocodiles and monitors. Hermetic Order of Swift Light The breed's business arm: couriers and sellers of secrets. Ice Stalkers Polar bears who live in family groups, playful artists of bone and ice. Leshy Paranoid forest tricksters. Three in four of them were born ravens. Makara The Stream of the Folk, diplomats to the other Fera. Gharials and muggers. Mokolé-mbembe The Stream of the Fighters, the largest: alligators, crocodiles and a few caimans. Mountain Guardians Grizzlies: solitary, competitive, given to ritual combat. Murder's Daughters Women only. They pick fights to catch the Morrigan's eye, take the birdman's shape to do it, and stay in a fight longer than other Corax. Myrmidon The Queen's warriors. Nest Ratkin live in nests and rat packs, not tribes. No group Most Corax answer to Raven alone and belong to no group. Nuwisha Nuwisha keep no tribes. River Keepers Bears of every kind, givers of gifts and hosts of gatherings. The Morrigan Always exactly three women, with eagles. They turn up before every great battle. The Sun-Lost Corax who left the sun for the deep spirit world. Tulugaq The tricksters' tricksters, close to the Nuwisha. Unsworn A Kitsune who has not sworn to the Beast Courts. Viskr Judges and mystics. Wyrsta Questioners, who test the other Ananasi. The factions, the kinds of people and the creatures this mod adds.

Faction What it is Battlefield crow A Corax who follows the armies, and the camp followers who know the secret.The wereravens are Gaia's eyes. Where armies march the Corax go too, to watch, to carry the news and to drink the last sights from the eyes of the dead. This one has stopped at the end of a long campaign with two of their kin and means to stay a while. Couriers Messengers who turn up wherever there is news and leave before anyone asks how they heard it. Courtiers Polite, clever households bound by an old court's rules, with guests who come and go at odd hours. Coyote's own A Nuwisha and the mortal it pranked once.The Nuwisha are the werecoyotes, Coyote's children and the tricksters of Gaia. They teach with jokes, and the jokes hurt. They never fight the Wyrm head on; they make it look foolish. Drifters Wanderers with a joke for every town and a reason to leave each one in a hurry. Hermits Big, slow-spoken folk who live alone deep in the woods and the cold country, and help travellers who come to them in need. Joined Circle A Garou and three Fera bound as one pack by the Rite of the Joined Circle.The War of Rage set the Garou against the other Changing Breeds, and most of them never forgave it. The Rite of the Joined Circle is the old rite of truce: a pack of any shifters, bound under one totem. Few are ever made. Protectorate A Gurahl, a bear kin and the humans it watches over.The Gurahl are the werebears, Gaia's healers. They nearly died out in the War of Rage, and the few left keep to the deep woods, guarding a protectorate and sleeping through the winter. Their Rage is slow to come and terrible when it does. Queen's servants An Ananasi and the mortals it has gathered.The Ananasi are the werespiders, the children of Queen Ananasa. They drink blood instead of eating, scatter into a swarm of spiders when hurt, and serve the Queen above Gaia herself. They have no Rage, only hunger and patience. Rat pack A pack of Ratkin and the humans who keep their secrets, out on their own.The Ratkin are the wererats, the Rat King's children, sent by Gaia to keep humanity's numbers in check. They live in the gaps: sewers, tunnels, the back rooms nobody rents. Every one of them is born of the Birthing Plague, and every one of them knows the Litany of Survival: hide, breed, and strike where it hurts. Rat-catchers' guild Ratkin who hide in plain sight as the town's vermin men.The wererats have always lived where people crowd together and throw things away. A rat-catcher goes everywhere, hears everything and is never asked what's in the sack. These ones took the trade for its cover and for the company of rats, and they pass on what they learn to the nest. River folk Old families of the swamps and the jungle rivers, who farm gators, fish and remember a great deal. Scavengers Ragged crews who live under the ruins and in the old tunnels. They trade junk and explosives and trust no one. Sentai Four Kitsune, one of each Path, bound as a sentai.The Kitsune are the werefoxes, the youngest of the Changing Breeds. They follow Paths instead of auspices, wield kami and sorcery, and owe their loyalty to the Beast Courts. A sentai is their pack: four foxes, four Paths, one purpose. Wallow Two Mokolé of one stream and their kin, at a new wallow.The Mokolé are the weredragons, Gaia's memory. They remember everything their ancestors saw, back to the age of dinosaurs, and they take their Gnosis from the sun. Each stream is a family of one kind of reptile, and each gathers at a wallow by the water. Watchers A Corax and the mortals who trust it.The Corax are the wereravens, Raven's children and Gaia's spies. They fly far, drink the eyes of the dead to see what they saw, and trade secrets the way others trade silver. They are few, and they know it. Weavers Quiet tradesfolk spread through many towns. They keep to themselves and pay their debts exactly.

Self 1 h Knows the ways of the spirit world: every spirit on the map is named and the fog around it lifts.
2 Gnosis Self 1 day Two Gnosis. A scream that breaks the mind: every mortal on the map whose Willpower is under the Twitcher's Infamy suffers the Delirium.
Self 1 s Reshapes the war form at will: more arms to carry with, longer legs to run on or thicker chitin to hide behind.
1 Gnosis Touch 1 h A Gnosis and a touch lift someone's spirits for a day.
1 Gnosis 9.9 cells 1 h A Gnosis plants a fear of spiders: for a day a success, the victim runs from any werespider or insect it sees.
Self 1 h Its hide hardens like a shell for half a minute: a tenth better armour a success. Once a fight.
1 Gnosis Touch 1 day A Gnosis ties fear to a want. A colonist loses every addiction; a stranger loses its taste for raiding the colony, and its people warm to the bear's.
1 Rage, 1 Gnosis 15 cells 15 s One Gnosis and one Rage. The Ratkin vanishes and is behind a foe up to 15 metres off, striking at once with a better chance to hit.
1 Gnosis Self 12 h One Gnosis. Brews a fizzing pick-me-up from junk: a dose for every two successes, each making a body stronger and quicker for four hours. It goes flat in a few days.
1 Rage 12.9 cells 1 h A Rage point and a roar from the age of dragons: one mortal suffers the Delirium, its nerve the weaker for the Mokolé's Glory.
1 Gnosis Self 1 h A Gnosis makes the spider part of the background for four hours: unseen while it keeps still, and thieves overlook whatever lies within 6 metres of it.
1 Gnosis 29.9 cells 1 h A Gnosis and the perfect thing to say to enrage someone. The target is furious for a day, and throws a tantrum unless its Willpower holds.
1 Gnosis Touch 4 h A Gnosis and a touch: The bear blesses body, heart or mind, for an hour a success.
1 Rage Self 1 h A blood point grows mantis blades from the forearms for an hour: aggravated cuts, though fine work comes hard.
1 Gnosis Self 4 h A Gnosis and a spirit wakes in its weapon for an hour: each blow adds an aggravated wound.

1 Gnosis Touch 1 day A Gnosis and a blessing hissed in the Dragon Tongue: the one touched conceives with its partner, and sterility leaves it. An animal is bred at once; a person needs a partner on the map.
1 Gnosis 2.9 cells 1 h A Gnosis and a touch to the eyes: someone within three metres goes blind for a day, unless their Willpower holds.
1 Rage 4.9 cells 1 h A blood point of venom spat into the eyes of someone up to four metres away: blind for three seconds a success.
Touch 1 h A touch, and ugly blisters cover the target's face for a day a success: beauty -2 and social impact -30%, unless its Willpower holds.
1 Gnosis Touch 1 day A Gnosis and a sacrifice: a downed animal or a held prisoner is killed and its body read. The next big threat is named when it comes.
1 Gnosis Self 1 h A Gnosis sets the heart racing for an hour: the spider moves and strikes as fast as a blood point would make it, the whole hour long.
2 Rage, 3 Gnosis Self 1 h Three Gnosis and two Rage, in a flying form. A storm of razor feathers falls on everyone within 5 metres, friend or foe.
6 cells 10 s Spits in a foe's eyes from six metres. They swell shut for three seconds a success.
1 Rage 29.9 cells 10 s A Rage point and a bolt of fire at a foe up to thirty metres off: an aggravated burn, worse with every success.
1 Rage, 1 Gnosis Self 1 h One Gnosis and one Rage. Gone, and up to 15 metres off at the nearest way out in sight: a door, a rat-hole or the map's edge.
1 Gnosis Self 1 day A Gnosis and a glimpse past tomorrow: for a day, the next great threat is foreseen.
Self 1 h Holds its breath for as long as it must: smoke, gas and bad air can't touch it for an hour.
5.9 cells 1 day Once a day, a gout of fire on a spot up to six metres off that burns everyone around it.
1 Rage Self 4 h A blood point calls a swarm of spiders for an hour. They bite and poison every foe that comes within six metres.
By the Light of the Moon
Self 1 h Whatever the moon touches, it sees: every hidden foe within thirty metres shows.
1 Gnosis 9.9 cells 4 h A Gnosis and a few kind words: for an hour, whoever it wheedles deals with the bear a fifth cheaper.
1 Gnosis Self 1 day A Gnosis presses the Weaver's order on the buildings around: every one within thirty metres is mended by 30% of its strength a success.
1 Rage Touch 1 h A Rage point and a touch that calls the dead into the living: a wound that grows with every success.
1 Gnosis Self 1 day A Gnosis, and the sky over the land opens: rain that puts out fires.
Self 15 days Its last cry for help: Every friend on the map runs to it, and an ally with a settlement within 10 tiles sends fighters. Once a season.
1 Gnosis Self 1 h A Gnosis hardens the skin into chitin for an hour: armour like a flak vest, and wounds close as a Garou's do.
1 Gnosis Self 4 h A Gnosis, and it seems dead to anyone who looks: enemies and hungry animals pass it by for an hour, until it acts.
Self 1 h A vulture's nose for the dead: every corpse on the map is found and the fog over it lifts.
1 Gnosis 14.9 cells 1 h A Gnosis and it runs on thin air, over water, chasms and walls, to a spot up to fifteen metres off. As long as it doesn't look down.
3 Rage, 3 Gnosis Self 12 h Three Gnosis and three Rage. The whole pack on the map Bolts at once, each to its own way out.
1 Willpower Self 1 day A Willpower turned to thought: it studies and talks a tenth better until sunrise.
1 Gnosis Self 1 h A Gnosis softens the air for an hour: everyone on its side within twelve metres bears heat and cold three degrees better a success.
1 Gnosis Self 4 h One Gnosis. The Ratkin, and anyone touching it, fade into the shadows for four hours. Attacking gives them away.
1 Gnosis 4.9 cells 4 h A Gnosis and the target can't lie to the bear: it gives up a secret it keeps.
1 Gnosis 9.9 cells 1 h A Gnosis rots what was made: a building, or a foe's weapon and clothes, falls apart a little with every success.
3.9 cells 10 s Scuttles up and over a wall or fence like a lizard, landing up to three metres away. Free, and ready again in ten seconds.
1 Rage 4.9 cells 1 h Its grip reaches across the room: a crushing squeeze on someone up to four metres away, harder with every success.
Touch 1 h A touch binds someone to the world of flesh: for an hour it can't step sideways.
1 Gnosis Touch 1 day A Gnosis and a harmless blow: the target becomes the other sex, as a sibling of itself, for three days.
1 Willpower Self 1 h A Willpower, and for an hour darkness is no hindrance to it.
1 Willpower Self 1 h A Willpower and the dark doesn't slow it for an hour.
Self 8 h Sees in pitch dark as in daylight for eight hours.
1 Gnosis Touch 1 h One Gnosis. A corpse up to a day dead answers: its killer, then a secret, and with three successes what it had hidden on it.
1 Gnosis 15 cells 1 h One Gnosis. A beam of junk-built light at a foe within 15 metres that burns through flesh and armour, harder with each success.
1 Gnosis Self 4 h One Gnosis and a real wound. The Corax dies in a puff of feathers, blood and ash, and is in the spirit world at once.
Self 1 day Stows things where no one finds them: for a day the Ratkin carries 40 kilograms more.
1 Gnosis Touch 1 h A Gnosis and a touch: For an hour the wounded can't die of their wounds, though they stay down.
1 Gnosis 6 cells 1 h One Gnosis. Rat-spirits eat a corpse within six metres, gear and all, in a few seconds. No one will learn anything from that body.
1 Gnosis, 1 Willpower Self 4 h A Willpower and a Gnosis. While it stands still, nothing can see or target it. The first step ends it.
1 Willpower Self 4 h A Willpower and its voice comes out of the river, the fire or the storm: everyone of its side, on every map, shares Mindspeak.
2 Gnosis Self 1 day Two Gnosis and a dragon of earth, water or fire comes to fight for it for an hour.
1 Gnosis Self 1 day A Gnosis and the Mokole drills its workforce: for an hour, it and an ally a success within fifteen metres each use the best level any of them has in every skill.
1 Rage 8.9 cells 10 s A Rage point and a gout of fire at a foe up to nine metres off: a deep, aggravated burn.
Touch 1 h A Gnosis roll at 7: A chalk door on the wall beside the carrier takes it through to the far side. One time in five it opens somewhere else within thirty cells.

1 Gnosis 14.9 cells 1 h A Gnosis, and a tune plays in the target's head for a day a success. Research, crafting and tending go 20% slower, unless its Willpower holds.

9.9 cells 1 h A flick of the wrist and one of the target's garments lands at the Nuwisha's feet. The target is left embarrassed.

Every setting in Options, Mod settings, The Rim by Night, with what it does. Setting What it does Fera homes in the world How many nests, dens, wallows and courts each breed has in a new world. Worlds already made keep theirs. War of Rage skirmishes How often Garou septs and Fera homes strike each other. At 0 they never do. Fera asking to join How often a breed that likes the colony sends one of its own to join. Fera hidden in towns How often an ordinary town hides an Ananasi or a breed's kin. Applies to towns settled from now on. A way in for colonies without Fera A stranger in the middle of their First Change may come to a colony that has no Fera yet, with whatever hunts them close behind. Gnosis only in the sun (Mokolé) Off, a Mokolé can seek Gnosis under a roof or by night like any shifter. The book: a Mokolé takes Gnosis from the sun alone. Gold burns Off, a gold blade cuts a Corax or a Mokolé like any other. The book: gold is the bane of the sun's children, as silver is the moon's. Abominations from Fera Off, a Fera the Embrace turns rises as a Garou Abomination does, with none of its breed's own fate. The book: a Corax burns at sunrise, a Ratkin rots, a Kitsune goes up in flames, and so on. Hibernation (Gurahl) Off, winter doesn't make a Gurahl drowsy. It can still hibernate when told to. The book: the werebears sleep through the winter. Fera missions How often Fera homes ask the colony for help. All the way left turns their missions off. Queen's orders How often an Ananasi's Queen sends orders. All the way left turns them off. Plague Lord's spirit quest How likely a plague-bearer Ratkin's spirit quest is to bring a plague with it. Birthing Pains How likely a Kitsune's Birthing Pains are to strike after a big Gift. Archid strength Scales an Ananasi's Archid form, the bigger spider shape, against the book's numbers. Codes and laws The Code of Ursa, the Laws of the Ananasi and Kitsune and Coyote's Rules cost Renown when broken. The books do this. A hundred Nuwisha No more than a hundred Nuwisha walk the world at once, and a new one comes only when another leaves. The book says so. The tips the game shows the first times you meet something. Tip What it is Ananasi An Ananasi is a werespider. It has no Rage: it spends blood instead, which it drinks from people or animals.Keep it above 3 blood. Badly hurt, it scatters into a swarm of spiders and reforms days later, changed. In the room of its Sylie it regains Gnosis. Corax A Corax is a wereraven. It trades in secrets: they show on its page in the Fera tab, and each can be sold or whispered to Raven.It drinks the eyes of the dead to learn what they saw, it can't resist something shiny, and gold hurts it the way silver hurts a Garou. Gurahl A Gurahl is a werebear. It starts as an Arcas and moves through the auspices as it grows, and its Umbral Glade is the only place it steps sideways.In winter it grows drowsy and wants to hibernate. A season away from its home fails its duty. Kitsune A Kitsune is a werefox. Instead of an auspice it follows a Path, chosen at the Rite of the Crossroads or by its own button.It heals as a human does, ages slower as it rises in rank and isn't hurt by silver. It always runs from a fight it can't win. Mokolé A Mokolé is a weredragon. It takes Gnosis only from the sun, so meditating under a roof or by night does nothing.Its Archid form is built from points, one for each dot of Gnosis: spend them on its Fera tab page. Its Mnesis lets it borrow an ancestor's skills in a trance. Nuwisha A Nuwisha is a werecoyote. It has no Rage. It wears one of Coyote's faces at a time, and each face has its Ban.Right-click someone to play a prank on them. A good prank earns it Renown, and the same person can only be pranked once a season. Ratkin A Ratkin is a wererat. Its aspect, shown on its Fera tab page, sets what it's good at and what it can't help.Tamed rats become its kin. New Ratkin come only from the Birthing Plague, a rite most mortals don't survive. Ratkin step sideways only where nobody is watching. The Changing Breeds One of the Changing Breeds lives in your colony now: a shapeshifter, but not a Garou.The Fera tab shows its kind, its group and aspect, its Rage, Gnosis and Willpower, and a page of its kind's own. Each breed has its own forms, its own bane metal and its own ways. The Fera button on the bottom bar lists your Fera and the breeds you've met. The Joined Circle Garou's own Rite of the Totem won't take a Fera. The Rite of the Joined Circle will: it binds any shifters, Garou and Fera of every breed, into one pack under one totem.A Nuwisha in the circle means the totem has to be a trickster. The War of Rage Long ago the Garou turned on the other Changing Breeds, and the fighting never quite stopped. Septs still strike Fera homes now and then, and some breeds strike back.When your colony hears of a fight, its Garou and that breed's Fera think a little less of each other for a while. ← Fera contents · The Rim by Night This is not official World of Darkness material.
